aamon.accroche: The distant Duke of Aberleen Castle.
lore: The distant Duke of Aberleen Castle.
=== Duke of Shards ===
A child's cry broke the silent dawn of Aberleen Castle. House Paxley, the most powerful and influential duchy in the Moniyan Empire, finally had an heir.

The child's father, Duke Paxley, named him Aamon and soon his younger brothers were born one after the other. But as the eldest son and heir of the family, Aamon was subject to stricter discipline since childhood. He was never allowed to be as free-spirited as his brother Gusion, and since childhood, he was busy all day with his studies and official duties.

Aamon didn't just learn the things required for a normal noble. His father, Duke Paxley, would also secretly teach him the spell which was only passed down to direct descendants of the family. It was a devious and merciless spell that killed people neither honestly nor honorably. Aamon once felt skeptical because the secret family spell did not fit with the honorable history of House Paxley who believed in the Lord of Light, and for this he went out of his way to read the family's history.

However, fate did not allow him to find an answer. The year Aamon had just turned 18, his father, who had high hopes for him, disappeared with his mother in a sandstorm while visiting Altaïr. After his father's presumed death, Aamon was left to shoulder the heavy responsibilities of the family as the young heir and became the head of House Paxley.

Aamon showed a level of maturity that a young man like him barely possessed, whether because of his father's teachings or the heavy responsibilities of family life. He was passionate in social circles but cold and distant in the face of his political enemies. He displayed the perfect gentleness of a noble gentleman in politics, but on the battlefield he seemed like a ghoul casting merciless spells. To most people who had worked with him, Aamon was an uncatchable shadow.

After the late Duke Paxley was presumed dead, Aamon was left with not only the responsibilities of the entire family, but also his younger siblings. In fact, he wasn't as mysterious and inscrutable as others saw him. His intention was surprisingly simple: the duty to protect House Paxley had been engraved in his mind since he was its heir, so his family and blood ties were everything to Aamon. No matter what bad deeds or good things he had done, they all had one goal: the future of House Paxley.
Aamon once thought that protecting home and protecting his families were completely the same thing, until the day the curse of the ancient prophecy fell on his younger brother, Gusion...

Aamon had never shown it to anyone, but out of all his siblings, Gusion was the one he had paid the most attention to. Because Aamon saw the qualities he didn't possess in Gusion: he was a free-spirited rebel who wreaked havoc without hesitation. But Aamon didn't like his brother for it, and he thought maybe they were supposed to be like each other as brothers, except he had no choice but to become the person he was now. Every time he looked at Gusion, he seemed to see the person he could have been.

Therefore, even if the entire Moniyan Empire knew that Aamon had a trickster and good-for-nothing brother, they would never discipline Gusion for his delinquent behaviors. Even once, when little Gusion accidentally cut Aamon's face with a knife, leaving a permanent scar on his cheek, Aamon only patted him and said nothing more. Of course, Gusion never dared bring sharp objects near his respectable brother ever again.

As the heir of the family, Aamon had heard of the prophecy of their ancestors from his father from a young age. He knew that anyone in House Paxley who had a dark mark appearing on their body would be bound by the deity. So when he found the mark on Gusion, he immediately made the decision to imprison him and cut all ties between him and the outside world, temporarily preventing other family members from discovering the changes on Gusion.

Aamon was then consumed by immense pain. Gusion's existence was undoubtedly a sword of Damocles hanging over the Paxley household, but Aamon did not want to kill his brother. However, what he did to protect Gusion didn't buy them much time. A few days later, the family elders discovered Gusion's secret and quickly arrived at the place where Gusion was being held. And they obviously weren't there to spare Gusion's life.

The situation no longer allowing Aamon to hesitate, he then made the decision to ask the servant who was watching over Gusion to release his brother in secret. But rather than just letting Gusion roam free, Aamon had kept an eye on his brother and, as expected, his wayward brother did not follow his order and remained hidden at Aberleen Castle.
Young Duke Paxley sighed and decided to do it himself: find the root of the Dark Mark's curse and save his brother, while ending the chains of tragedies that had locked their family in for centuries.
===Destiny Deniers===
=== Glow in the middle of the freezing night ===
anecdotes: Likewise, for his brother Gusion, Aamon is named after the demon of the same name. Also known as Amon or Nahum, Aamon is a Grand Marquis of Hell who rules 40 infernal legions and the 7th of the Goetian demons. Both of their names are derived from the demonological writings of The Lesser Key of Solomon.
Aamon's quote ("It is better to be feared than loved, if you cannot [be] both") is directly derived from Niccolò Machiavelli, an Italian philosopher known for his work The Prince.

This quote suggests that when it comes to leadership and governance, it is more beneficial for a ruler to inspire fear in his subjects than to be loved, especially if they cannot realize fear and love simultaneously. In the context of Aamon's quote, Aamon may believe that fear may be a more reliable means of maintaining control and obedience among the population of Aberleen Castle.
Aamon is based on European nobility and aristocratic assassins.
According to the developers, Aamon is single and currently has no marriage plans.

akai.accroche: The almighty panda hero of Stream Valley.
lore: There were no heroes in Stream Valley, only chubby pandas.
Among them was Akai, a fish seller whose monotonous routine consisted of fishing and selling his catch. As the days passed, an exhilarating idea gradually formed in his mind: Become a Hero!

The heroes of legends wielded almighty swords, fought evil dragons, protected people from all harm... Akai clenched his big fists and devoted himself to all kinds of "heroic deeds". No matter what problems the neighbors encountered, whether it was fixing a roof or rescuing a cat, Akai was always the first to offer help. The only problem was… as round and clumsy as it was, it seemed like it only caused more trouble.
"Akai, stop trying to be a hero!" The neighbors didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

Akai, however, refused to give up easily. So one day, while fishing, he dreamed of the four eastern fighters of the Riverlands of Cadia... "If only I could join their ranks," Akai thought. Without knowing it, he started punching and kicking at the edge of the stream...
"Slow punches. Wrong! Sloppy footwork. Wrong! Slow reaction. Horrible! Yet you want to become an oriental fighter?!"

An angry roar sounded from inside the stream, while Akai's float shook violently as if something huge had just taken the bite. Akai, weighing over three hundred pounds, was almost dragged into the water! Eventually, whatever was at the end of his rod gave up, and Akai brought it back. It was – a frog?!

The frog jumped atop Akai's head, stroking his goatee, and proclaimed himself the Immortal Frog, a disciple of the Great Dragon who came down the stream from the Dragon Altar. He said that Akai was born for martial arts and that if Akai followed his training, he would definitely become an unparalleled hero - on one condition, of course: Akai would give him all his bait.
The story of the chubby panda disciple and his little frog master thus began!
The first year of training under his new master was exhausting, but Akai was delighted!
The second year… was also quite exhausting, but the ever-persistent panda kept going anyway!
The third year was very exhausting, and Akai was on the verge of giving up...

Under the guidance of Frog Immortal, Akai gradually mastered martial arts and developed his namesake moves – Panda Punches! As he proudly called it. With his relatively refined movements and years of training, Akai could easily catch small thieves and hunt wild beasts.

However, when he wasn't chasing thieves and saving villages, the panda disciple and his frog master were fishing together by the stream. The frog would often sit on Akai's shoulder as they observed the serene view before them.
Everything seemed to be going in the right direction, except… Akai's weapon was still just an old fishing rod, and his chubby form still looked nothing like that of a true hero.
“We martial artists never look down on each other!” said the Immortal Frog with a stern look. “As long as you train hard…”
“–I will become the fifth oriental fighter and be congratulated by everyone?!” Akai hurriedly interrupted.
Frustrated, the Frog Immortal jumped up and punched Akai's stomach, "Is that the only reason you practice martial arts? To be evaluated by others? To be praised?"
The poor panda nursed his aching belly, "but master, isn't that what's cool about being a hero? Being known to people and being a part of their stories?!"

"Becoming a hero is more than just being a part of someone's storybooks. To be a true hero, you must make the ultimate sacrifice..." Akai didn't understand it at the time, but his master knew he would eventually.
In the days that followed, Akai gradually perfected his Panda Punches. He was getting closer to making his dream come true!

One day, the Oriental Fighters came to Stream Valley on a mission. Akai, who had always been a fan of the four, quickly rushed to the tavern where they were staying and took a look from the outside wall: the Oriental Fighters were practicing martial arts in the courtyard. In pure fanatical wonder, Akai followed their training, their movements so fast though that he could barely keep up. That didn’t stop him from savoring this moment!

The Eastern Fighters were the four distinguished disciples of the Great Dragon – Zilong, Wanwan, Ling and Baxia. Seeing the legendary characters right before his eyes, Akai was thrilled beyond belief! At the same time, however, he found his clumsy punches a far cry from the masterful movements of the Oriental Fighters...

He started finding all sorts of excuses to skip Frog Immortal's martial arts classes – headaches, back pains, or even fur aches! – when in reality he was admiring every move of the Oriental Fighters from the top of the tavern wall.

It was at this time that Akai accidentally learned that the Great Dragon had never taken a frog as a disciple, even though there was one among his servants. This frog, once responsible for helping the Great Dragon catch flies and other insects, secretly learned martial arts behind the Great Dragon's back, and was therefore kicked out of the Dragon Altar by the guards...
Looking back, Akai realized that he had met this frog before.
After learning the truth, Akai stopped going to Frog Immortal to learn martial arts.
Without telling anyone, Akai headed towards the Dragon Altar. He wanted to learn true martial arts from the Great Dragon himself, become a true hero, and protect Stream Valley!

A panda, want to learn martial arts? The Oriental Fighters were amused by this chubby country boy and so taught him a move or two from time to time. Akai flourished under the training of Zilong, Wanwan, Ling and Baxia. "I will introduce you to the master." Zilong promised Akai before the Great Dragon was about to finish his solitary meditation.
“I’m about to become a hero!” Akai was carried away by this thought and completely forgot that he hadn't even said goodbye to the Frog Immortal.
And then disaster struck.

After expelling the evil god Lieh, Yu Zhong headed straight to the dragon altar with his men. He wanted to kill the Great Dragon and seize the divine throne! The four oriental fighters went to fight him in all haste. However, as soon as they left, the mischievous Chang'e let Sun out. After being locked away by the Great Dragon for centuries, Sun was furious when he learned that his hometown had been occupied by pandas in his absence! With his golden staff in hand, Sun rushed towards Stream Valley, vowing to eliminate them all and reclaim the lands.

Akai was caught in a dilemma. He wanted to follow the Eastern Fighters to fight Yu Zhong and distinguish himself in front of the Great Dragon, but on the other side, the armless pandas simply had no chance against the Raging Sun! Wait, there was also a frog...
Akai left something missing on his shoulder. He turned his head and realized that this was the place where the Immortal Frog used to sit...
At that moment, Akai remembered his master's words and the real reason he wanted to become a hero suddenly came to his mind. He knew what he had to do!
“A true hero fights for the people, not for glory!” »
The storytellers of Stream Valley have a new story to tell: the story of the almighty panda!

That day, Sun smashed his golden staff at the entrance to Stream Valley, roaring in rage as he thought he would wipe out all the pandas! Just when this peaceful land was about to meet its doom, an old frog emerged from the trembling crowd and fought Sun alone!
The Immortal Frog was thrown by Sun in just a few turns, when a fishing rod caught him in mid-air – it was our Panda Hero, Akai!

Akai and Frog Immortal joined hands and fought Sun together. At the most critical moment, Akai parried Sun's staff with his exclusive Panda move. Taken by surprise by this panda's spirit and prowess, Sun retracted his golden staff, "hmm. You're not bad for a flabby panda."
"Not just the panda, I am the panda, Akai."
Amused, Sun gave him a moment to tell the truth, and the misunderstanding was resolved.

Before Akai could even apologize to his master, the Immortal Frog jumped high and punched him in the stomach. "You brat! I skipped so many training sessions! Did you practice what I taught you today?!"

Once the threat has been averted and carried out, the master and disciple fish together at the edge of the stream in Stream Valley. Akai distributing the earthworms: one for his fish, one for his master, another for the fish, another for the master...
anecdotes: The name Akai (赤い) meaning "red" comes from Japan, although pandas are endemic to mainland China.
His "Monk" skin is based on Charon from Moonton's Magic Rush.
He uses Tai Chi Kung Fu.
He resembles Po, the protagonist of the Kung Fu Panda franchise.
Its internal name is xiongmao which translates to panda.
Although the name of his skill 1 indicates a headbutt, he uses his stomach. His skill 2 In advance the server uses his stomach to slam but in the original server he uses his butt to slap.
His companion is not present in combat.
His old skin Soccer Titan uses soccer to attack enemies, he also transforms into a ball in his ultimate form.
Akazonae (or Akasonae) is a Japanese word meaning "red and blue", while samurai were the military nobility and officer caste of medieval and modern Japan.
He has the very first purchase skin of the first season, from season 14.

aldous.accroche: The guardian of the Minoan labyrinth.
lore: Legends of the Land of Dawn say that the Minoan kingdom of the Western Desert has a mysterious labyrinth. In the labyrinth is a statue of a giant minotaur, which people consider to be the Mecca of the Minoan kingdom. Some say there is a group of mercenaries guarding the entire maze. The Kingdom produced much precious jade, which brought great wealth to the Minoan people. Very quickly, the entire kingdom is lost in the intoxicating allure of precious stones. Even many of the mercenaries charged with guarding the Sacred Labyrinth become corrupted and abandon their duty. Only one remained: Aldous, who never forgot his duty to guard the Minoan labyrinth.

Until the day a god came from the sky to punish these lands. The powers of light and darkness decimated the entire Minoan kingdom, from which even Aldous could not escape. The two streams of dark and light energy invaded his body. Aldous thought he was about to die. However, the two energy streams collided, causing great changes in his body. Its skin was blessed with long black scales capable of resisting most attacks and monstrously large arms that could easily strike fear into people's hearts.

When Aldous awoke from his stupor, he discovered that his people's kingdom had vanished and the mysterious labyrinth was now sealed by an unknown force. The remaining minotaurs decided that Aldous would stay to defend the labyrinth, while the others would travel through the Land of Dawn to find answers. News of a mysterious force sealing the Minoan Labyrinth quickly spread throughout the Abyssal Realm. To gather this strange energy, Selena decided to take her abyssal demons with her to the entrance to the Minoan labyrinth. A huge battle was about to begin.
anecdotes: The first name Aldous is a male first name of English origin meaning "old". Aldous has long been associated with the British writer Huxley, author of Brave New World.
His voice line "Abandon hope, all you who enter here." is a direct reference to Dante's quote in Inferno.
While still in development, Aldous' first name and hero title was Armstrong, Gravekeeper. It was later changed to Aulrad, Contractor. However, in patch 1.2.78, his name was changed again to Aldous.
Aldous "Red Mantle" refers to his former appearance without his damaged body.

Aldous is the only survivor of the divine punishment that devastated the barren lands of Agelta. He was blessed by the Orb of Twilight, which not only saved his life, but also granted him immense power, granting him strength almost equal to that of gods or supreme beings.
Aldous is one of only two heroes capable of harnessing the power of the Orb of Twilight, the other being Lunox.
The Twilight Orb sealed the energies of the Lord of Light and the Lord of the Abyss within him.
When Aldous' ultimate durability is exhausted, Aldous will continue to pursue the enemy but Aldous will become invincible. proven by fuego

alice.accroche: Queen of the Blood Demons and one of the two dominant powers of the Abyss.
lore: Sitting on her throne in the Sanguine Maw, blood dripping down the hem of her dress, Alice looked down at those kneeling before her and asked with a slight smile, "What is love?"
To this question, young Alice would have answered: Love is the protection and the feeling of value conferred by her father.

Alice was the illegitimate daughter of a nobleman and a lowly dancer, but with a powerful affinity for dark magic. His mother always told him that their beautiful lifestyle was proof that they were loved. Her father often took young Alice to see the family's sacred treasure, the Crown of Antalus, telling her stories of the family's past glory and how she would help restore their greatness.
Alice understood from a young age that being loved meant her role was to be the shadow knife of the family.

Using her gift for dark magic, Alice moved across the battlefields of the south, manipulating hearts and minds to remove obstacles for the Antalus family. His half-brothers' contempt for his illegitimate status was only static in the symphony of love. Alice held her head high and ignored their petty grievances with arrogant pride.

She had always loved her father and her family despite everything. Even when she was captured and tortured by the Monastery of Light during their last mission, Alice gritted her teeth and revealed none of the family's dark secrets.
But does love really exist?

While imprisoned, a mysterious figure revealed a shocking truth to Alice: her entire life, she had been nothing but a pawn. Alice sneered in response, dismissing this as just another ploy of the Enemy. The figure shook his head, handed Alice a mysterious orb, and unlocked her cell door.

Covered in wounds, Alice returned home to overhear a conversation between her father and the elders. His failure and capture was the result of a calculated deal between the Antalus family and the Monastery of Light, with the aim of restoring the family's former glory.
And love? Alice looked at her father and saw only cold eyes.

Love never existed - all along there had been only its value, its desires and its lies. His birth was permitted because of his talent; her freedom granted because she was used to family. Love was a sweet poison that allowed the family to show its true nature. The Family had long prepared magic to suppress Alice. They looked at her coldly as she lay pinned to the ground, thrashing like a wounded animal; they had already arranged for her to be taken back to the Monastery of Light.

But at the height of her despair, the orb in Alice's possession began to glow. She knew that this mysterious figure could be another Antalus family player trying to use her, but who cares? Alice laughed as despair and hatred consumed her body. The power of the Abyss completely transformed his blood: crimson wings burst from his flesh as demonic energy engulfed the entire family.

Alice crouched down and whispered the truth into her dying father's ear: even if they returned her to the Monastery of Light, the Antalus family would never receive what was promised. In the eyes of those above, his father was a pawn himself. The Antalus family's dream of returning to their former glory, like Alice's desperate desire for love, was just an illusory fantasy.
Her father let out his last breath amid Alice's blood-curdling laughter.

Using the cruelest methods, Alice transformed her contemptuous parents into slaves of the Blood Demons, bound forever by her will. She took the crown of Antalus and mockingly wore it on her leg as decoration - shattering the hypocritical illusions of the family and the so-called honor of the nobility.
She is reborn from the ashes of a dead love. The Blood Queen had arrived.
Now the queen asks: "What is love?"

Love is a prize, love is a desire, love is a lie... Love is only an ornament under authority, a bloodstain on the crown, an echo when the chess player makes his move. Having witnessed so much "love", she instinctively masters the game of power and desire. On her throne, Alice holds out an empty hand, but within her reach are the desire of countless souls. With this power, she left the Moniyan Empire, leading the Blood Demons to the Abyss, where they claimed their domain.

But that is not enough: the Queen hears the voice in her heart, the whispers of her human part: that is not enough. She had enough of the deception and manipulation. Rather than remaining a pawn that others could control, she would become the player who controls everything.
She is the Queen of the Blood Demons, the Mistress of Sanguine Lair, the wrath of the Abyss and the one who will turn her claws against the Moniyan Empire and rise to the pinnacle of power.
Love and hate are long dead; only power and desire can forge eternity.
anecdotes: The name Alice comes from the old French name "Aalis", itself derived from the Germanic name "Adalheidis" (Adelaide). It means “noble” or “of noble type.”
She is mainly based on Lilith the Vampiress from Magic Rush; and they are both vampire queens with tremendous regenerative abilities.
Her full name is Alice Antalus.
Alice is often seen as the main antagonist of Land of Dawn and Mobile Legends: Adventure alongside Balmond, appearing in various hero traditions as an antagonist.
Alice's design shares some similarities with Maleficent, the iconic Disney villain, particularly in her dark, elegant and sinister aesthetic.

Although not explicitly called a vampire, Alice's blood draining abilities and immortality make her the vampire equivalent of MLBB. His lifesteal mechanic allows him to sustain himself in combat, much like classic vampire lore.
Currently, Alice and Esmeralda are the only heroes in the game classified as both a Mage and a Tank.

alpha.accroche: A pure cyborg made by Laboratory 1718.
lore: The birth of human life is generally a hopeful matter. Yet to the artificial life created by Lab 1718, what lay behind their creation was little more than an evil conspiracy and murder, without blessing or joy. And the pure cyborg Alpha is the extreme form of the blasphemy against life forged by Laboratory 1718.

Fifty years ago, due to his differences of ideas on human experimentation, the great scientist Dr. Baker parted ways with Eruditio. Fueled by dreams of human augmentation as a means to advance the human race, he founded Laboratory 1718 on an island.
For him, even though he and his laboratory separated from Eruditio, their ultimate goals were the same: to ensure a prosperous future for the human race.

Yet what he never expected was that the addition of additional mad scientists to his laboratory team would lead to a gradual loss of control. In the end, the extremely idealistic scientist was stabbed in the back by his colleague, Professor Giraad, and the scientism fanatic stole all control of the 1718 Laboratory from him.
Yet his prestige and appeal were nothing compared to Dr. Baker, the founder of the Laboratory. A conflict of interest then began with many parties with divergent ideas.

Octavius ​​was another scientist driven out of Eruditio, and different from the others obsessed with human and biological experimentation, he had a more ambitious goal: to create a human composed entirely of mechanical materials with his own conscious mind. He proposed Project "Alpha-Beta", a plan in which a set of superpowered twins would be created - Alpha and Beta.

However, those responsible for the 1718 Laboratory were not interested in such ideas and Octavius ​​​​'s project was rejected by all. However, he continued to wait patiently until the opportunity presented itself.
Until that day finally came, Octavian was almost completely destroyed.

During this deep night, the augmented human Saber could no longer withstand the torment of the system that manipulated his nervous system. He devastated much of Laboratory 1718 and fled, with Octavius's own Laboratory not spared in the chaos. A huge amount of expensive scientific equipment was damaged and Beta, which was still in development, completely destroyed. Only Alpha, who had not yet settled into his own body, was unaffected. Almost all of Octave's countless years of sweat and toil went up in flames.
Rushing to the scene, Octave howled with laughter – everyone assumed he had finally given in to madness. Yet only he knew that a brighter dawn was yet to come.

Saber's chaotic escape had been a disaster for the 'human weapons' plan. These were the experiments presided over by Professor Giraad, the most important of Lab 1718's projects. These scientists, seething with rage towards Eruditio, planned to use Saber to devastate the city that had so humiliated them.

With the plan having failed and all hope lost, Professor Giraad came under heavy criticism and was forced to leave the spotlight. It was at this time that Octavius ​​seized the opportunity that had presented itself and presented his own proposal: "The self-aware cyborgs will bring only betrayal, but a pure, man-made human: they will always be faithful to the ideals of Laboratory 1718."
And so, with the unprecedented financial and technical superpower that was Laboratory 1718, Alpha was born.

His appearance was similar to that of a knight adorned with heavy armor. Just as his creator had intended, he was blessed with an unwavering loyalty to Lab 1718. Furthermore, he also possessed the latest technology in terms of power and weapon systems, far surpassing that of other robotic beings created by scientists, a true Alpha in both name and nature: a superior mechanical fighter.
Alpha had a flesh body and cortex identical to that of a young adult male, but at the same time, he was actually still a newborn being. Like a puppet, he leaned on Octave and was at his disposal.
Alpha's first mission was to destroy the traitor Saber.

Alpha brought with him a special companion: the transformed fighting machine, Beta. So they went looking for Saber. What even their creator Octavius ​​did not predict, however, was that the seeds of sentient thought had begun to germinate in the recesses of Alpha's mind.
Alpha remembered as clearly as day the night Saber had betrayed them: he and Beta had attained consciousness at the exact same moment, and they were even connected together on a deeper level.

When Saber burst her way into the lab and attacked Beta, Alpha had felt every ounce of Beta's crushing terror as if it were his own, and a new sense of dread too – even though he didn't even know what it was at that moment…

From humanity's perspective, this feeling could be described as "hate." The consciousness connection between Beta and Alpha was so strong that it was as if they were a single entity. It was a bond that extended far beyond the simple blood relationships experienced by humanity. More than just machines from the same batch, they were true brothers born together. However, Saber had taken Alpha's brother from her...
On a dark and stormy night, similar to that of Saber's escape, Alpha found the traitor.
The first time they crossed swords, Alpha was heavily damaged and Saber prepared the killing blow. Yet that's when Beta charged between them to block him.

More unexpectedly, Saber sheathed her blade. He looked at Alpha and Beta, both in a terrible state. He had once viewed them as mere puppets, controlled by the scientists of Lab 1718. Now, however, he sees that beneath their flesh and mechanical skeletons lie greater possibilities. He smiled, as if to provoke 'Alpha, and said in a mocking voice, "You soulless pieces can never hope to defeat me in battle.
Disappearing into the rainy night, a question tormented Alpha's brain: what exactly is the soul?
Alpha has not lost hope of revenge. Still, he thought that the secrets of this "soul" Saber mentioned must surely lie in making himself stronger.
When the violent storm finally cleared, Alpha was staggering with Beta in her arms, the results of the calculations flickering wildly throughout her heart: soul is power. I must find my soul!
anecdotes: The name Alpha comes from the Greek alphabet, where it is the first letter (Α, α). It symbolizes “the beginning” or “first”, often associated with leadership, dominance and superiority.

Alpha's name reflects his origin as one of the first advanced cyborg warriors. This also hints at his strength and resilience as a fighter. His robotic companion, Beta, follows the naming pattern, with "Beta" being the second letter of the Greek alphabet, reinforcing their bond as a duo.
His old design is based on the character Saizo from another Moonton game, Magic Rush: Heroes.
Old version, Alpha was a kind and loving cyborg.
Alpha was created alongside Beta in a laboratory of Dr. Baker, intended to be a biological weapon.
Its story reflects themes seen in franchises like Metal Gear Solid and Halo, where warriors are created through unethical experiments.
His weapons and robotic upgrades are inspired by Raiden (Metal Gear Rising) and Gray Fox (Metal Gear Solid).

lore: The last great war is a glorious memory for the Moniyans. The mighty Order of Light, along with the Imperial Border Guards, annihilated the demon strongholds of Moniyan Pass and the Barren Lands, driving the demons into the hinterland of the Forsaken Wastes. But for young Alucard, the war was only a terrible memory of pain and misery. His father's second regiment suffered heavy losses due to a solitary and reckless advance. Alucard's father went missing in the battle and was later declared dead by the Order of Light.

As they had disobeyed orders, the second regiment was not honored and praised for its sacrifice but called "disobedient" and criticized for its lack of discipline. This was a big blow for Alucard, who had always considered his father a hero and a role model. Facing shame and ridicule everywhere he went, the flames of vengeance burned in his chest and he became determined to bring honor to his father's name and eliminate all demons from the Land of Dawn. So he left his hometown and went to the ancient and mysterious Monastery of Light. As the orphaned son of a deceased soldier, Alucard was soon accepted into the Monastery of Light.

Over the next few years, Alucard studied various combat skills at the Monastery of Light. Thanks to his natural talent and unwavering determination, he quickly became the most promising student among his peers. During his training, Tigreal, the Commander of the Order of Light, who had once fought in the Second Regiment with his father, often visited Alucard at the Monastery of Light, teaching him various advanced combat techniques and telling him of his father's heroic deeds.

Tigreal was already famous throughout the Empire at this time, and Alucard greatly respected him, considering him a sort of older brother. However, whenever he spoke of his father's final battle, Tigreal always remained silent, his eyes filled with a wave of complex emotions. Alucard was skeptical that his father had died in battle. He was convinced that his father was still alive and waiting for him somewhere.

At the age of eighteen, Alucard finally completed all of his formal studies and preparations. Encouraged by Tigreal, he becomes the Arbitrator of Light of the monastery. He was ordered to go and eliminate demons and heretics hidden throughout the world. So he picked up his father's old sword, given by Tigreal, and left. In the name of his father, and fueled by his deep hatred of demons, Alucard quickly became the world's greatest demon hunter.

An unexpected incident occurred during a demon hunting operation on the border of the Badlands. Alucard was injured by a magical blade, sustaining a wound that could not be healed. Darkness took over his body from the injury, and his arm began to undergo a strange transformation... In order to prevent the mutation from spreading throughout his body, Alucard asked an old blacksmith to help him forge a pair of gauntlets. He was no ordinary blacksmith: he was a survivor of that fateful battle, a member of the Order of Light who covered the retreat of his allies alongside Alucard's father.

He recognized the enormous sword in Alucard's hand. After learning who he was, the old man told Alucard that the reason the Second Regiment had been forced so deep into enemy territory was because the high-level knights of the time were greedy for glory and too impulsive, leading the Second Regiment to become trapped in a tight encirclement. In a moment of desperation, Alucard's father led a few soldiers to cover the retreat of the main force led by Tigreal, then was overrun by a tide of demons and disappeared. He was the only survivor saved by Alucard's father.

After learning the truth, Alucard returned to the capital and questioned Tigreal about the battle and why he did not tell him what really happened that day. Seeing the anger that engulfed Alucard, Tigreal confessed the guilt he felt for abandoning his allies and the silence he was forced to keep at the request of his family. He expressed his willingness to make up for it in any way possible, saying he would give his own life if he had to. However, in front of Tigreal, who was once like a brother to him, young Alucard was entangled in a web of confusion. He couldn't bear to kill Tigreal, but he couldn't forgive her either.

For the sake of his father's honor, Alucard demanded that the Empire reveal the truth about the Second Regiment and restore his father's name. However, the knights from this battle had become some of the most powerful figures in the Empire. They refused Alucard's request and kicked him out of the capital. On top of that, the Puritan Monastery of Light was staunchly opposed to Alucard's unnatural right hand, getting him into trouble on several occasions and even calling him a heretic. For the longest time, Alucard's deep hatred of demons and his desire to regain his father's honor had spurred him on in his mission to serve as Arbiter of Light. But now, facing the Empire that had betrayed his father and a church that treated him with contempt, Alucard made an unthinkable decision: to betray the Monastery of Light and fight for himself.

Over the next few years, Alucard began wandering the Land of Dawn, annihilating demons wherever he went on his own terms and searching for clues to his father's whereabouts. His demonic right hand not only gave him great strength, but also became an unstable element that he was forced to hide under his heavy armor every day.

After a series of epic battles, Alucard became one of Moniyan's most legendary fighters. Soon, everyone knew that wherever demons were rampant, the dark right-handed demon hunter would undoubtedly descend from the sky and leave no one alive.
anecdotes: His name, Alucard, spells Dracula backwards.
Alucard is a name popularized by the Castlevania video game franchise with the character of the same name.

When MLBB was released as Mobile Legends: 5v5 MOBA in mid-2016, Alucard was named Dante, whose name is based on the video game character of the same name and Nero's appearance from the Devil May Cry video game franchise.
His Legend Skin "Obsidian Blade" skill icons are the same as his old skill icon before the overhaul.
His "Child of the Fall" skin is based on Sephiroth but his sword is based on Buster Sword from Final Fantasy.
His Lightborn skin has armor and a sword similar to Saber from Fate/Stay Night.
In earlier MLBB artwork, Alucard wielded two swords instead of a single greatsword. This was later changed to make his weapon style more distinct from other sword-wielding heroes.
His demonic hand can be seen in MLA and in his older models and portraits.
In earlier versions of Alucard, his lifesteal was amplified beyond 100%, making him almost impossible to kill in combat.

relations: Tigreal, Harith, Fanny, Silvanna (co-members of Lightborn)

lore: Dr. Baker was one of the co-founders of the 1718 Laboratory, an institution created with the aim of bringing world peace. But as his colleagues, that is, other scientists, delved deeper and deeper into their depraved human weaponry experiments, Dr. Baker felt he had no choice but to leave it all behind him and pursue a new project. Renouncing the questionable ethics of human experimentation, he endeavored to create a new type of life form, using nothing but a mechanical skeleton, puppet strings, and synthetic skin. Finally, a new generation of artificial life is born. Dr. Baker firmly believed that love and hope were humanity's greatest inventions. So he programmed the world's most moving stories into the heart of his new creation, transforming it into an Android-based robot intended to help others.

One fine morning, Peace Android Prototype 1 woke up from his bed and Dr. Baker named this adorable mechanical angel Angela. Angela followed the tutelage of Dr. Baker, studying hard to understand the world and hoping to live up to the inventor's high expectations. However, their peaceful life together was soon interrupted. When the mad scientist at Lab 1718 heard rumors that Dr. Baker had created a living soul outside of a human body, which did not fit with their ideas of creating flesh weapons, they could not bear to believe it. They were convinced among themselves that Baker had betrayed them, keeping this knowledge to himself before fleeing, and so they ordered Dr. Baker's past creations, Alpha|Alpha and Beta, to hunt down Dr. Baker and his creation. As their pursuers were about to close in on them, Dr. Baker placed Angela in a flight pod, ordering her to search for her good friend Rooney.
anecdotes: Angela is a female first name. It is derived from the Greek word ángelos (ἄγγελος), which means angel in Greek belief systems.
She is the first hero that can be attached to a hero using her Ultimate, the second is Gloo.

She wears a separate doll for each skin that resembles her appearance on the hero selection screen. She used to throw the puppet as a basic attack when it was still in development, but the animation was eventually changed to simple heart-shaped projectiles. This doll can now only be visible in the game when using her Heartguard to possess an ally. The doll will be seen on top of the Allied Hero model.
Because some users found her old eyes disturbing and distressing, Angela's splash art was changed.
Her Starlight skin was renamed from China Doll to Shanghai Maiden.

arlott.accroche: A human-demon hybrid wielding two spears and thirsting for vengeance against the Church and demons.
lore: A human-demon hybrid wielding two spears and thirsting for vengeance against the Church and demons. Ostracized for this half-demon and half-human lineage, young Arlott joined the Demons in the Barren Lands but was betrayed by his demonic brothers during the battle. However, after being seriously injured, he was saved by a human named Mila. During their time together, Mila's innocence and sincerity gradually changed her view of humans. This did not last, however, as the Church of Light executed Mila for heresy. Arlott massacred every living soul in the Church before dumping Mila's body in the forest by the lake. ===Quo Vadis?=== What did the half-demon Arlott endure that turned him against the Church and demons? While grievously injured, Arlott met someone who redeemed his wandering, demonic heart, and gave him the only warmth and light he had ever known in his life... What is the story between them? Let’s unravel Arlott’s story together to find out more! This road was familiar to him.

The path divides into three distinct directions. To the south are the Drylands. To the north, Lumina City, the place he had left. Clusters of stars twinkled in the sky above him. A year before, he had laid down in the grass and observed these same stars. Everything became blurry. A cart stopped in front of him. Someone, or something, was trying to shake him out of his stupor. His eyes refused to focus. Was it a human or some demon? Never mind. Lying there, on death's doorstep, everything he had ever seen in this world began to converge into one.
The figure was human. Finally, it was clear. He tried to raise his hand and brush the strands of hair from their faces, but his hand was like an anvil and remained pinned to the ground.

He did not have a great affinity with humans, as his appearance often led to him being ridiculed. They denigrated his mother, saying that only a most filthy woman would sleep with a beast and give birth to someone like him. In truth, he had never known his mother and had no memories of her. His father was also unknown to him. For as long as he could remember, he had spent his life drifting from village to village within the borders of the Moniyan Empire. The villagers had descended into mass hysteria and chased him from his final resting place, forcing him into the predicament he is in now.

He headed south to the Drylands, where he was accepted into a small group of demons. Thus, he spent his childhood training with the other demons and fighting in their battles. Not once did he ask a question of any kind. He was alive and that was all that mattered.

He became a warrior, always searching for a place he could belong. Double spears were his weapon of choice. Combat becomes his only occupation, his reason for existing. When Alice arrived in the Drylands to recruit members for the demonic forces, he chose to enlist. It didn't take long for his bravery in battle to make him a captain. Under Alice's command, he successfully besieged Lumina City. Despite this, he once again found himself at death's door, this time because of the enchantment.

He remembered every inch of his body as if it were on fire. As the armed forces stormed the city, the sound of disheveled footsteps rang in his ears. With great effort, he turned his head in search of his companion and found that it was they who had pierced his body with a long pike.
He had been betrayed. First by humans, then by demons.

Exhausted to the point of collapse, he allowed himself to be bandaged by the human and thrown onto their cart. The flour stored on top of the cart assaulted his nostrils and caused a coughing fit. Blood from his wounds stained the area in which he lay.

For three days and three nights, he lost consciousness and lost consciousness. It was a young girl who saved him. A large birthmark spread across his face. He guessed her to be around 13 or 14, although he had no talent for guessing the ages of humans. All he knew was that she was a little weird, like him.

Seeing that he had regained consciousness, the young girl took a smoking baguette out of the oven. She tried to hand it to him, but he pushed it away and the wand fell to the ground. The girl picked up the bread, ate half of it and tried to give him the remaining half again.
With some effort, he lifted his heavy eyelids. On the girl's face, he saw a smile that he didn't really know what to think of.

He initially decided to leave, but the girl insisted that he stay until he was fully recovered. There was no room for him in Lumina City, and the half-eaten baguette was starting to look more and more tempting. He chose to stay at the girl's bakery.
And the girl's name was Mila.

His spears had been heavily damaged, but he nonetheless kept them at his side as he always had. At the slightest disturbance in the night, he would wake up with a start. One day, when Mila was going to put a blanket on him, he was surprised and pointed his spear at her. With the tip less than an inch from her throat, Mila only smiled. It was clear that she had no ill will towards him and he lowered his weapons. He looked a lot like a small child learning to be part of the human world.

During his time at the bakery, Arlott went from initially refusing to allow Mila to change her bandages, to becoming his apprentice of sorts. In addition to helping around the store by sweeping the store, moving heavy objects, and feeding the five cats and three dogs raised by Mila, Arlott also learned to read and write. Mila was a girl of great faith and he looked after the store whenever she attended church services.
He came to enjoy all this.

His pikes lay in the warehouse, gathering dust. In time, they would have started to rust... if not for the sudden attack on the business district by demons from the abyss. Hearing Mila's shrill cry, Arlott ran as fast as his legs could carry him.

Between a small child and a demon, she stood, trembling, her bread skin raised in her hand defiantly. After quickly eliminating the invading beasts before the knights arrived, Arlott took Mila back to the bakery. Once there, she took the necklace she always wore and placed it around Arlott's neck. He had to repair his pikes. He had to protect Mila.

As Mila placed the collar on Arlott, she declared that he was a good person, even if he wasn't exactly cheerful, and that the collar would keep him safe. She held out her finger as part of a small promise.
"Arlott, let's promise to protect as many people as possible."
At the sound of Mila's words, one of the spears began to emit a warm, bright light. It was then that Arlott finally understood why he had not been destroyed by the enchantment.

To him, however, a peaceful and happy life was like a mere grain of sand in an hourglass; impossible to grasp and forever out of reach. Somehow the Church found out about how Mila had harbored Arlott and she was accused of heresy. Several children who frequented the bakery ran to him sobbing and told him what had happened. By the time he arrived, all he found was her lifeless body. This wonderful girl, once so full of life, who had said goodbye to him this morning only with a smile on her lips, would never smile again.

In a state of fugue, he suddenly finds himself inside the Church, as if he had been transported there. Mila's cold, limp body was cradled in his arms; he had carried her all the way, and yet she felt light as a feather. As darkness spread across the sky, he gently placed Mila on the raised altar. Surely, in death, someone as pious as she deserved the kind of miracle she had planned in life.
Several knights held him back. He could see the disdain in their eyes as they looked at Mila's body, and he heard them begin to throw mocking and mocking remarks at her.

In an instant, he began to quiver with a rage unlike anything he had experienced since the moment he was betrayed by his fellow demons. In his hand, the pike he held trembled with fury. How much he wanted to free her, how much he wanted to ruin those who had hurt her.
Before he knew it, his pike was stained with the blood of the knights.

Red slowly enveloped his vision. He covered his right eye with one hand and held the two spears with the other. As if by divine providence, his weapons had found their target and buried themselves in the flesh of his enemies. Among the purple-red mist, he saw a white spot. Her.

As he picked up Mila and left the church, other knights blocked the way. Arlott did not remember how long he had fought, but when the last knight fell, his armor was covered in blood and his footprints left crimson imprints with every step he took. However, snuggled against his chest, Mila's body remained clean and stainless.

Back at the bakery, the flames in the oven had already been extinguished for a long time. The smell of the bread Mila had baked that morning still lingered in the air. Cats and dogs surrounded him, oblivious to what had happened. Because he was partially human, he had been betrayed by demons. Because he was a demon, Mila had been executed. Ultimately, he was neither a man nor a demon. He was nothing, for what he had most wanted to protect now lay dead and broken before him.

Once again he found himself on the same path. He stopped the cart where the road divided into three paths. To the north, Lumina City. To the south, the Arid Lands. The tides of destiny had carried him and led to these two places before. Today he would choose the third way and he would take Mila with him. It led to a forest with a lake far from the beaten track. One day, under a fruit tree in this forest, he and Mila had celebrated his birthday. They promised to make it an annual event.
This would be her eternal resting place, where no one would disturb her.

He lit a fire and sat leaning against his coffin, wiping his pikes. As he looked up at the stars above, he remembered something Mila had once said. On a clear night at the lake, the stars are especially bright and lead the way for lost and weary travelers, guiding them home.
If she woke up right now, she would definitely want to spend the whole night stargazing.
Starlight reflected off its spikes. He caressed the necklace she had given him and slowly began to open the coffin.
"Look, Mila. The stars are shining for you."
===The best day===
===Glow in the middle of the freezing night===
anecdotes: Arlott is the male counterpart of Charlotte. Arlott is primarily a gender-neutral English name meaning tramp or rascal. The name Arlott could also be inspired by "Arlottus", which may have origins in medieval knightly or knightly names.
The developers originally wanted him to be a werewolf, but he was later transformed into half demon and half human.
He loves cooking with Mila from time to time.
Arlott suffers from heterochromia, which means he has two different eye colors. Its dual spearmen and different colored eyes represent half demonic and half human nature.
At the start of the test phase, his second skill (Revenge) had almost no cooldown, which meant it was too easy to chain stuns repeatedly.

His English and Japanese voice actors, John Patneaude and Ōtsuka Takeo, are both known for voicing Doughael from Cookie Run: Kingdom, making him the first and only MLBB hero to have 2 voice actors in different languages ​​voicing the same character from other media.

relations: Mila (friend, executed by the Church of Light for heresy)

atlas.accroche: Creature from the deep seas that broke free from the seal.
lore: Ocean Gladiator

The dark, cold and mysterious deep sea is the last unexplored frontier of the Land of Dawn. From the surface, the sun fades and the temperature drops, then it is total darkness. It is called the Abyssal Sea, where the currents and high pressures are strong enough to destroy all the advanced materials invented by Eruditio. This place is a forbidden living zone, where no human has ever set foot. Only the remains of these abandoned and eliminated civilizations sink and pile up.

However, there is not only death here. Many incredible and indescribable creatures, including Atlas, have been struggling and breeding in this dangerous zone for ages. They were among the oldest living beings in the Land of Dawn, devouring elemental creatures for power, causing them to be imprisoned in this deepest place by the Ancients. The powerful Injunction blocked light, heat and their path upwards. In order to adapt to the high-pressure environment, they removed their redundant shells and structures and developed a variety of fluid shapes. In the endless darkness, there is no fight or conflict, only the law of survival: existence, alternation and circulation.

However, over the centuries, some things have gradually changed. Changes are not born under the ocean but from above. The succession of civilizations and incessant wars have affected not only the land but also the seas. Everything started to deteriorate. The creatures of the Abyssal Sea could no longer adapt to an even worse situation. Withering and death came without warning. The biggest among them were the first to fight. These giant fibrous creatures moved their tentacles and bodies to rush upwards, only to be torn apart by the Injunction.

The others couldn't understand their plight, but they knew they needed change – it's an instinct of all living things. So they started thinking about workarounds. They began trying to break the injunction. The only prisoner who finally got rid of the Abyssal Sea was Atlas. As the most experienced individual, he sensed the change sooner than anyone of his species when the Abyssal Sea was involved. He was the first to prepare the escape.

The torn flesh warned other creatures that their bodies were vulnerable to this overwhelming power. To break the Injunction, he must find a rigid shell. Atlas continued to wander and search in the depths. Until one day, in a pile of remains of civilization, he found his destined shell: the Mecha Sentry, a set of giant ancient machine armors. These large objects were made as war machines by the Icelandic Golems who once ruled the North Valley. After the ancient golems disappeared, they were abandoned by later civilizations, thrown into the ocean and completely forgotten by the world.

Atlas slowly approached the Mecha Sentry and found that it was decaying on the seabed like a stiff piece of iron due to the absence of the control core. He then entered the center of the machine, stretched his tentacles, injected them into each joint and began to take control of it. Accompanied by a rumbling sound, the Mecha Sentry who had slept for thousands of years lit his eyes again. The forgotten body and the abandoned soul were perfectly combined and unified.
The giant Mecha Sentry broke the Injunction, rushed from the depths to the surface, then leapt above the sea. It was the moment when the world welcomed a new player: Atlas, the Ironclad Kraken.

Atlas felt strange and curious about this world. He visited wherever the seas could reach, driven by the desire to learn and grow stronger. He frantically drew his knowledge from creatures, races and civilizations. During this time, his control of the Mecha Sentry became more and more effective. As if the machine was initially made for him. But no matter how much time passes, Atlas is always haunted by one thought: his people are still fighting in the Abyssal Sea, the largest prison and most isolated place in the world.

Now Atlas not only has tough armor, but also a plan. He will break the injunction between the Abyssal Sea and the world, saving his species from eternal imprisonment. There is a secret treasure that only pirates believe is hidden somewhere in the sea of ​​Northern Vale. It has the power to regenerate itself, powerful enough to change the ecology of an entire ocean. Atlas wants it, from the first time he learned the story.
anecdotes: The first name Atlas is a male first name of Greek origin and means "to carry". Atlas was the king of Mauretania and a Titan who, after losing in the Titanomachy, was forced to carry the weight of Uranus (the sky) on his shoulders for eternity in North Africa, hence his name suggests great strength.
Fittingly, this Atlas's Ultimate involves a feat of great strength, jumping first and hard enough to cause a shockwave upon landing, even with up to 5 potentially heavy enemies attached to him.

Atlas' design is inspired by advanced technology and the sea, so he could also be inspired by the king of Atlantis, Atlas. Atlantis was a highly advanced civilization with unprecedented technology and linked to the sea.
Atlas is a kraken creature from the deep seas.

Atlas is the second hero in Mobile Legends to have the ability to freeze enemies, but this is specifically linked to his ultimate skill, Fatal Links. Although Atlas' primary function is not to freeze enemies in the traditional sense (such as freezing in place), his Ultimate can disable and immobilize enemies by drawing them towards him, rendering them temporarily stunned and immobilized, which can be considered a form of control or "freeze" in teamfights. The first hero to freeze enemies in Mobile Legends is Aurora.
The first hero capable of “packing and shipping” enemies.

aulus.accroche: A Leonine warrior who inherited the determination of his predecessor, blazing his own path with burning ferocity.
lore: To be determined
anecdotes: He is the 3rd Leonin to be introduced in the game along with Nana and Harith.
He speaks with a Scottish accent.
The War Ax item is his weapon. If you sell a battle ax in the game, he will say "Goodbye, old friend."
The Aulus redesign is unique because the new and old Aulus are separate characters. After his overhaul, the old Aulus retired definitively and gave his hatchet to the new Aulus, who is his successor.
His revamped base skin "Berserker" has the same weapon as his pre-rework base skin. This is the only skin that did not receive its War Ax weapon rework rather than its current rework default skin.
His other revamped skins (except his base skin) have the same entrance animation as his pre-revamp and retain the new Aulus model.

aurora.accroche: The Virgin of the Glacier who grants eternal memory in the legends of the North.
lore: The Madian of the Glacier who grants the sternal remebrane in the legends of the North. Aurora, the Glacier Maiden, who commands the unwavering faith of countless northern mortals, grants eternity to the world. In her youth, she endured the torment of her innate prowess for Frost Magic until the disciples of the Light brought her to Queen's Peak, after which she received an infusion of light that granted her immortality. In tears, her mother bid her farewell as she succumbed to the cold embrace of the blizzard. Aurora slept for a thousand years atop the peak. When he woke up, the truth dawned on him: true eternity lay in fleeting emotions, like his mother's last comforting smile. Thus, Aurora resolved to grant this eternity to the world. It was at this moment that a legend was born in the North. Legend spoke of people near death who would climb Queen's Peak, seeking the icy embrace of the goddess. If this were granted, all of the person's memories, desires, and emotions would be left to the goddess, who would cherish them until the end of time. And so, they would live for eternity. === The Ballad of the Glaciers === As the embers of the campfire die down and the incessant snowy night begins to unfold, the story of the Glacier Maiden returns to form in immortal hymns. Aurora's fingertips possess the power of freezing snow, but how come she possesses such power? What kind of past is hidden in the memories she lost?

As the embers of the campfire die down and the relentless snowy night begins to unfold, the history of Northern Vale takes shape again in immortal hymns. Raise your voices, children, and let the echoes resonate. For we sing of frozen realms, of eternity unleashed, of the majestic birth of Queen's Peak, all in the embrace of a single day. The saga takes root in the wake of a distant war where, with our dreams held close to our breasts, we shared sleep. The fiery blaze of the Iceland Golem challenged the divine, and the deity of light summoned the power of glaciers, all adorned with sublime design. The passage of four millennia, the colossal hand of time, has swept away the deities and rebels of the land. The glaciers remained silent, the icy expanse so still, until a young girl awoke, freeing herself from her bonds. His fingers governed the icy reign of snow, his veil was the frost, where the light would remain. Aurora, the young girl of the glacier, eternal and grandiose. His memory was blank, flooded by the icy call of the night, but the divinity's command resonated with the echoes of the roar of the avalanches. "Grant eternity to the world and descend, fair goddess, from the icy lair of Queen's Peak." In the vast snowfields of the North Valley lies the path of the Glacier Maiden. Mortals sang praises, prayers fervent and bold, tales etched in snowflakes, a story to behold. “Send eternity, O goddess above!” “Let the winds and snow purify our destinies forever!” A divine decree, a mission veiled in mist, but Aurora found the words enigmatic and unpredictable. Ephemeral snowflakes, in search of eternal grace. But what is “eternity”? In the frozen lands, the answer lies in its hiding place.

In the labyrinth of the heart, like snowflakes dancing in disorder, prayers to the goddess linger, but her hands must not swing in despair. Unwilling to bear the painful tears, Aurora sets out on a quest for eternity, through untamed realms, which she will travel until her last day. As glaciers reflect the purest icy glow, the goddess rushes where destinies flow. In the icy path she wanders, searching, however, Aurora returns to her primordial home below. The burdens of the world, broken by the power of the blizzard, once prosperous villages, now lie in ruins in the night. No hearth fire, their ancient warm delight. The snowflakes on his cheek sing, the memories disappear in the blink of an eye. The glaciers of the North, dazzlingly pure, a divine miracle, a radiant spectacle. A millennium has passed, pious souls have gathered on this sacred land, with invisible respect. They chose a gifted child, in the serene sacred light, to forge celestial wings. Glory, the greatest lure, in the wake of temptation, mother confided to Aurora, with complete confidence, the summit of the glacier, secrets still invisible. A tender abandoned girl, the ephemeral sparkle of love. Here, memories arise as the goddess reveals the enigmatic screen of eternity, cold but vivid. If eternity is insensible in its icy pride, what it grants to mortals are endless farewells for the whole world. Why not seal eternity within you, O divine goddess, and return to the mountains, according to the design of destiny. Aurora heads to claim the glacier, through snow and storm, as tears intertwine. The North Valley, in the vibrant flame of empathy, reveals an enigma, an assigned truth. While icy winds reveal an ancient snowy path, a millennium past, the evil destiny of the mother, an icy prison, a sad claim. The frozen tendrils glow with radiant flame, Aurora contemplates the last memory of her mother. A thousand years ago, in such a fragile village, snow and storms threatened the roofs, a sad story. Fragile frame, gift of frost, her strength would weaken, Aurore, sick, would become a spectral trail. “Heavens, have mercy, may not my snowflake be fragile,” a helpless mother prayed to the glaciers, but to no avail. The faithful disciples, like angels, set sail. Up to Queen's Peak, they carried Aurora without fail. Cold, biting winds could neither deter nor slow her down. A resolute mother, she braved the frost, the work of her heart. Under a hundred supplications, a poignant and tearful revelation, the mother met her beloved daughter, in the smallest details of the ice. Of ice and snow, an ethereal dress, beyond the pale, a radiant veil of light, in the grand design of destiny. No more pain, no more affliction, in the eternal trail, Aurora, pure and beautiful, beyond the fragility of life. The faithful of the light, with the divine voice, declared to the mother, in a solemn tone: "Beside you, her life, ephemeral design, in the embrace of the glacier, Aurora will shine!" A brief goodbye kiss, left behind, with tears in his eyes, his mother's heart embraced. She would not deprive her daughter of her light, so kind, alone on her journey, against the snow. A thousand years of snow, an epic grid, a mother and a glacier, combined into eternity. In the frozen tomb, their souls aligned.

Snowflakes fall like the whispered rhyme of glaciers. “O Aurora, O Dawn”, through the chime of eternities, the heritage of a daughter, the prayer of a mother at her peak. In the eternal ice, an ephemeral goodbye frozen in time. Queen's Peak holds the truth, a story of hope and filth, a mother torn between despair and hope, in the prime of her life. In the glacial hold, where the lights of the aurora shine, her dress, a shimmering dance, her braids, icy tendrils in a frigid climate. Aurora's Frost Magic, in her resplendent bloom, the goddess of the glacier, dispelling the icy darkness. She grasped the deep suit of eternity to listen to the prayers of humanity and the melody of its heart. No enigma, this enigma, in an ancient heritage, a gift from his mother, beyond the earthly tomb. “What makes the glacier eternal are myriads of ephemeral snowflakes and the sweet scent of emotions.” As the embers of the bonfire die out, through the endless snow-filled night, faith in the Glacier Maiden spreads everywhere. Mortal lives, an ephemeral tide, like sparks in flight, only his presence endures, in eternal power. With her fingertips, she guides the icy bite of the snow, its veil, a shimmering coat of light, one might imply. Although the glaciers disappear and the ice fields begin to slide, the goddess of Queen's Peak stands tall with unwavering pride. Back up the glacier, oh souls about to fly away, carry your memories, your thoughts, your laughter and much more. In his presence, O souls, your wishes implore, for the refuge of your spirits, to explore forever. She will grant you snow, ice and warmth, in Her embrace your essence will be restored, a home in eternity, to worship forever... === Glaciated Echo ===
anecdotes: The Northern Lights, also known as the Northern Lights, are naturally associated with the northern regions of the world, particularly in places like Scandinavia, Canada, and Alaska. This geographic connection reinforces the idea that Aurora's abilities and powers are linked to the north, to ice and cold, just like the superb light shows characteristic of the northern hemisphere.
Aurora could be based on the main character of the story "Frozen" by Hans Christian Andersen.
The pattern where her clothing exposed her right hip was retained on her official portrait, while her official artwork and 3D models covered it up in 2018 to comply with app store guidelines.
Although revamped, its old model is still visible in the game's "Back Off" emote.
She is the only hero capable of freezing turrets.
Aurora's passive, Pride of Ice shares a similar function with Nana's passive in that both heroes have a mechanic that allows them to heal themselves at low HP.

Aurora's revamped design bears a strong resemblance to Elsa from Frozen, capturing the same regal, ice-wielding aesthetic and control over the cold elements. Her palace is located on top of the mountain (Queens Peak), just like Elsa who also built her palace on top of the mountain.

The name Aurora is derived from the Latin word "aurora", meaning "dawn" or "sunrise". In mythology, Aurora is the Roman goddess of dawn, symbolizing the arrival of light and a new day. This connection fits well with Aurora's role as a powerful mage associated with ice and cold, bringing light and clarity through her abilities, just as dawn brings light to the world.

Aurora is a hero deeply connected to ice and the cold elements, and the Aurora Borealis, with its fascinating icy colors (especially greens, purples, and blues), serves as a perfect visual metaphor for her control over frost. Just like the northern lights illuminate the northern sky with their icy glow.

badang.accroche: Island hero who gained supernatural power after defeating the water monster.
lore: A long time ago, there was a small village, surrounded on all sides by water, which rested in the southern regions of the Land of Dawn. The villagers worked very hard, fishing day and night to earn a living. Among them was a strong man, a mighty warrior, named Badang. Badang was said to be able to lift a kart filled with firewood with just one arm. He has a great sense of justice and a heart full of courage.
Badang was known for fighting beasts that seemed to pose a threat to his village. Enthusiastic and courageous, he tirelessly helped everyone resolve their life difficulties.

One day, a strange thing happened in the peaceful village, shortly after. The villagers got up early to catch a lot of fish. However, in the evening they returned empty-handed and even the fishing tools were broken. Everyone was shocked and panicked, thinking it was the curse of a mystical water monster. As food supplies dwindled, Badang decided to help them find the truth, as he did not believe the stories of the water monster.

Early in the morning, Badang went out fishing, as usual. He came to the river near the village to set up a fishing trap. He not only placed a lot of fish, but he also hid them with a giant pre-prepared fishing net, trying to find out who or what was causing all these problems. Soon after, the river suddenly began to roll, a strange creature lurking in the river appeared next to its trap. Devilish and formidable, he began to swallow the fish and destroy its trap. His eyes were fierce, with long hair and a slimy octopus structure. Badang decisively threw a giant fishing net, trying to trap the monster. However, the monster pierced the fishing net with its giant blade-like teeth and broke free. It constantly attacked him, but the intrepid Badang threw himself into battle against this fearsome beast, without any hesitation. The power of this monster was surprisingly strong, and Badang's arms were seriously injured in the bloody battle. As the beast was about to devour Badang, he used all his remaining strength and pierced its eye with a fishing spear, then dragged the monster to the river's edge. After leaving the river, the monster gradually lost its moisture and began to dry out. He was having trouble breathing. Badang had never seen such a creature and was somewhat surprised.

He noticed a magical gem glistening in his body. Having difficulty speaking, the water monster begged Badang to let it go, swearing that it was an elf who lived in the river but had undergone a horrible transformation. Once the beast headed to the southern mountains to prey on fish, it accidentally ate fish caught by the fisherman, corrupted by hunger and evil energy. As he spoke, Badang gently released him from the pain of the spear, advising him to seek a pure life. Touched by this kindness, the beast's body gradually began to change. The aquatic beast began to regurgitate all the fish it had consumed, along with the evil energy. Returning to his natural state, the water elf deeply appreciated Badang.

After that, he blessed Badang with a flow of powerful energy and not only were his injured arms restored, but they became much more powerful than before. Badang's good heart pushed him to finally let go of the monster. Badang began helping the villagers day and night, whose lives slowly returned to normal. However, Badang could not let go of the southern mountains that the monster spoke of. For the safety of his village, Badang was determined to find the source of this evil energy, in the mountains, across the islands and all the way to the Land of Dawn.
anecdotes: It is based on Badang, a legendary strongman in Malay legend (see in Malaysian version or English version due to page in different languages).
Badang is the second hero in the game capable of manipulating the map layout after Grock, being able to create walls with his name = Fist Break.
Her Susanoo skin is based on Susanoo-no-Mikoto (スサノオ; historical spelling: スサノヲ, Susanowo), a kami associated with the sea, storms, fields, harvests, marriage, and love in Japanese mythology.

balmond.accroche: One day, the Orcs will free themselves from their chains.
lore: Orcs are a race with a long history and perhaps the most widespread among those in the Land of Dawn. Throughout the mists of time, they served under the Lord of the Abyss as they fought throughout the fierce endless war; and also engaged humanity in savage battle during the Golden Age. A series of successive defeats left the once-strong United Demi-Humans divided into Orcs, Minotaurs, and Centaurs, among other peoples. It also left them deprived of their homes, forced into exile and to the southern lands where they led a meager existence.

Despite all of this, it seemed that fate had not yet finished playing with this ancient race. As the Abyss encroached once again, powerful demons once again emerged from the south, posing a perilous threat to their dwindling orc populations. Under the oppression of the demons, the Orcs were divided into several small clans scattered across the vast expanse of the roaring desert, exploited to the maximum.

Balmond was born into a traditional orc tribe in the Roaring Wilderness, and from a young age his father had always taught him all kinds of fighting techniques. Along with this, he would also regale her with tiles of the Orcs' ancient glories; how they once resided in their homeland north of the Lantis Mountains and their millennia of fierce battles fought against elves and humans. He hoped that Balmond would, one day, be able to become a true Orc leader and restore them to their former glory.

Over twenty years later, Balmond had become a powerful Orc under his father's teaching. And all the while, the brutality of the demons had instilled deep, dark memories in Balmond, only making him yearn even more for the day when the Orcs could return to power, bringing back their once great kingdom. To this end, young Balmond not only trained tirelessly, but also devoted himself to the study of all kinds of ancient orc tomes, which gave him astute strategic knowledge.

But that was when the flames of war were just beginning to ignite. In order to amass the strength necessary to attack the Empire, the terrible demons tirelessly invaded the Orc tribes, plundering and plundering their resources, causing the Orcs untold suffering. Before this, the Orcs were powerless to resist the demonic forces and had no choice but to submit to preserve peace, however short it may be. But this time, Balmond led the warriors of his clan into battle and killed the demon leader who had come to steal their resources, thus triggering the Orc rebellion. The Orc race had had enough of the oppression of the demons, and now each tribe lent their strength to Balmond: they were no longer scattered clans, instead becoming a truly powerful force to be reckoned with. The rebellion spread across the Roaring Wilderness like wildfire.
Under Balmond's command, the fierce orc warriors successfully repelled the demonic armies that came to suppress them, dealing them a heavy blow.

This gigantic counterattack launched by the Orcs shocked the demons, angering Lord Lava, Thamuz. He sent many terrible troops composed of blood demons and demons into the roaring desert, for he would never resist his demons in the miserable wastes.

Despite the disparity in power, a constant fight to the death between the Orcs and the demons raged, but the demons were surging like a tidal wave and things were starting to get worse for the Orcs. Their power diminished day by day, their defensive lines narrowed until they were entirely surrounded.

To protect his race from extinction, Balmond decided to fight to the end and led an effort to break through their ranks. In this fierce battle, the demons poured in again, their numbers seemingly endless, and the bodies of the orc warriors were scattered all around as they advanced. Balmond trembled in fury and threw aside his now dull battle ax as he grabbed a demon by the neck to bite its throat, severing its head with his teeth.

Yet this attack sent large amounts of demonic blood into Balmond's body, resulting in an incredible transformation. This fueled him as he went completely berserk, with unimaginable power he used to break through enemy lines. The Orcs were flooded with demonic blood, unleashing within them a fearsome fighting power that shook their demonic oppressors to the very core. New possibilities had presented themselves, causing them to change their plans to eliminate the Orcs.

To this end, the cunning Alice managed to track down Balmond and present him with an offer: once the Empire was defeated, the entire Roaring Wilderness would be returned to the Orc peoples in exchange for Balmond's loyalty to the demons. In order to preserve the power of his Orc brothers, Balmond reached an agreement with Alice and his forces swore fealty to the Abyss. They would then serve as the vanguard forces of the demons as they stormed Azrya.

However, even Alice could never have imagined that an even bigger plan was brewing deep within Balmond's mind. First, he would order demonic forces to enter the Moonlight Forest and occupy the elven kingdom, where he would steadily build up his strength.
Following this, the union of the Orcs and the rebirth of their kingdom for which they had aspired for millennia would finally come true.
anecdotes: Balmond's old design is still visible in his "Bloodlust" skill icon.
The previous iteration of Balmond was likely inspired by the character Ax from Dota: Allstars, itself based on Grommash Hellscream from World of Warcraft in its 2021 lore.

His current voice actor, Patrick Seitz, is famous for his voice as Garrosh Hellscream, the son of Grommash Hellscream and the leader of the Warsong clan before his death. The similarity of these characters is that they are both axe-wielding orcs.
In his old lore, he went from being Alice's slave to being a mutually exploited ally in his 2021 lore. However, his lore was changed in the Season 40 update.

Balmond's "Heavenly General" (now "Mountain God") is the skin with the longest release delay; it was supposed to release in 2018 but the skin was released in August 2021 for the Grand Collection event.
He is known within the community as he can be seen in almost every MLBB Google ad.
