bane.accroche: Cruel pirate leader, sworn enemy of Franco.
lore: The excellent jewelry and leather products of the people of the North Valley not only gave rise to their booming maritime trade economy, but also gave rise to many illegal transactions, such as with the notorious pirates of the North Valley. For a long time, pirates of the frozen seas and other maritime regions existed in bands. They divided territories between them and stuck to a principle of non-interference, plundering only merchant ships that crossed their own territories, to enrich themselves. This has become the de facto rule of the hacker community.

This largely respected order lasted until the arrival of Bane and his men. Cruel, cunning, violent and tyrannical... No list of adjectives commonly given to pirates would be enough to describe Bane's terrible reputation. Born into a pirate family, Bane was raised and trained in the strictest manner from childhood. By the time he became an adult, Bane was already the most feared pirate of his time.

But young Bane's ambition was much greater than that. Shortly after, Bane murdered his uncle and took control of the Behemoth, a sea fortress with a massive battering ram and dozens of cannons, truly becoming Captain Bane. He then broke the old pirate rule and began encroaching on other pirates' territories.

Faced with Bane's incredible firepower and terrible cruelty, the other pirates had only two options: submit or be annihilated. More and more fugitives and opportunists gathered under Bane's flag, which brought him enough money to establish a massive pirate fleet, known as the Black Sharks. For many years, Bane dominated all sea routes of the frozen seas, literally ruling the inhabitants of the northern coast of Vale with an iron fist, and the ever-victorious sea dweller named himself Lord of the Seven Seas. Some people from Northern Vale who could no longer stand Bane's despotic rule armed themselves and gathered under the banner of his archenemy Franco, to wage a war of resistance against Bane.

Desperate, Bane ordered his men to risk everything to sink Franco's fleet, but after several hours of battle, he still failed to gain the advantage. Around this time, Bane learned a secret: the Aurora Heart, one of the fragments of the mysterious and powerful Twilight Orb, was located somewhere in the depths of the Frozen Sea, and contained a powerful regenerative power that could help him realize his dream of conquering the world.

Bane has come up with a cunning plan to kill two birds with one stone. First, he would leak the information in order to attract the attention of the Moniyan Empire navy. Then, he would pretend to sue for peace with Franco, revealing the location of the Aurora Heart and falsely expressing his intention to jointly rule the frozen sea. However, the true intent of his goal was to use the forces of Franco and the Moniyan Empire to help him locate the Ionic Heart, while provoking a battle between them, so that the Empire would likely destroy its nemesis. He would then dive into the chaos to claim the Aurora Heart for himself.

Everything happened exactly as Bane had planned. The massive navy of the Moniyan Empire had left the port of Castle Grandrock. Meanwhile, Franco seemed to have believed in himself and led his fleet in search of the Aurora Heart. The two parties finally met in a narrow region on the eastern edge of the frozen sea. As each was unaware of the existence of the other, Moniyan's fleet and Franco's fleet were caught in a tense face-off. Bane's opportunity had arrived. He ordered his men to sneak up on both fleets with fast, stealthy boats and suddenly open fire, triggering a massive naval battle.

After both sides were heavily decimated in the ensuing battle, mastermind Bane arrived aboard the massive Behemoth. He watched with glee as the terrible consequences of his plan, while ordering his men to destroy the surviving ships and seize the Aurora Heart. Bane smiled contemptuously as he enjoyed the "beautiful" scene before him and savored the hateful curses of the Moniyans. With almost no effort, he had manipulated the Moniyans and eradicated Franco. All he needed now was to find the Aurora Heart, and he would have enough power to take over the world. Then, neither the Moniyan Empire nor the demons of the Abyss could resist him...

Just as Bane exalted his victory, a massive cannon fired from the fleet behind the Behemoth, hitting the flagship directly. The battle-hardened Behemoth and its owner exploded into pieces that sank to the bottom of the sea and were never seen again.

Bane suffered a tragic death, or so those who witnessed the Behemoth's explosion and sinking believed. His massive pirate fleet disintegrated and scattered, and peace was restored to the Frozen Sea. The man who fired the cannon was none other than Bane's archenemy, Franco. Franco had never trusted Bane and was wary of his sudden peaceful overtures. So he ordered his men to pretend to take the bait and search the seas, while he led a small contingent of sailors to infiltrate and seize one of Bane's ships during the night. With Bane at his most complacent, Franco gave the order to fire on his flagship, dealing Bane a fatal blow.

Bane's era of piracy was over and would gradually be forgotten, while Franco would become the new ruler of the northern coast of Vale. But in the depths of the ocean, a broken Captain Bane suddenly opened his eyes in the middle of an ancient and abandoned ruin, awakened by a bright light. The strange object in front of him exuded a fascinating power. As if possessed, his broken body regained consciousness. He was brought back to life and he could now have his [long-lost] revenge, thanks to the Aurora Heart that Bane had spent so much effort searching for. Despairing at his utter defeat, Bane smiled sinisterly as he approached the Aurora Heart. Upon touching him, enormous power flowed through him, completely repairing his broken body. Even though Bane was resurrected, he looked like a zombie, as his body was torn apart during the explosion and many parts were missing.

What Bane couldn't imagine was that a giant octopus had just chosen him as prey, reaching out its hand to him as he placed his hand on the Aurora Heart. While fighting the octopus, Bane was forced to release his hold on the Aurora Heart, letting it fly from his hands and sink into the sea. However, its residual energy enveloped Bane and the octopus and began to merge them into one, transforming him into an anthropomorphic octopus.

On the banks of the North Valley, merchant ships coming and going were busy loading and unloading their goods. In the distant waters, the resurrected Captain Bane no longer lamented his repeated failures. Looking at his new cursed body and the familiar seas, he smiled once more. He had finally awakened from the briny depths, and, bringing his tattered Black Pearl, he was ready to announce his return and renew his reign as the unworthy pirate that he was. This was just the beginning of the game.
anecdotes: Bane is a male first name of Slavic and English origin, Bane, means "glorious defender".
His voice and quotes for 2016-2021 come from the character Pandarus from Magic Rush: Heroes. Bane and Pandarus have nothing in common or any similarity in design or playstyle.
When Bane's redesign was first leaked, he had the face of an anglerfish.
His character design, as well as his background, is somewhat based on Davy Jones from the Pirates of the Caribbean film series.
His season 11 skin, "Warlord", was changed to "Dictator", but it was secretly changed again as the name of Valir's then-recently released starlight skin is also "Dictator".

lore: name = Detona The Politans who live between Albata and the Moniyan Empire are very similar to humanity. They are small creatures, but extraordinarily intelligent. These dwarves have built their homeland in a low mountain basin and are constantly obsessed with money and wealth.

Barats was born in such a Politan village, and he was born a naughty boy. Everyone in the village was annoyed by his difficulty in creating nature. And such a childish personality did not change even after Barats grew up. He had the same thirst for money as his people, but Barats hated learning and working. He spent his entire day and free time dreaming that he could miraculously become rich overnight.

The villagers disliked Barats because of his laziness and subsequently planned to drive him out. This greatly angered Barats, who then sneaked into the village's sacred place, stole a precious item that was considered sacred by everyone, and fled the scene. What he stole was a treasure map. Guided by this treasure map, Barats arrived at distant Albata. However, upon his arrival, he was disappointed by what he saw.

There was nothing in sight but desert sand and desolate ruins. All locations marked on the treasure map were now covered in sand dunes and impossible to find. Barats didn't want to give up like that. He continued to move forward in his search for the legendary Los Pecados. He wanted to try his luck there. But Barats got lost during the journey. He hadn't eaten or drunk anything in days, and now he lay on the ground, tired and waiting to die.

But that's when a small dragon lizard appeared in front of him and guided Barats towards a body of water. Perhaps it was the gratitude he felt for her help, perhaps it was the same loneliness they shared together, or perhaps it was simply the fact that he needed a companion on his boring journey. Barats took this dragon lizard with him and agreed to put it on his backpack. Barats even named it Detona.

With Detona's company, Barats's adventure hunt was no longer lonely or boring. He often shared his ambition with this little guy, promising that he would impress everyone in his villager and do something truly amazing. However, over time, Barats was shocked by how quickly and how much this little lizard grew. He was growing bigger and heavier every day and the rate of his growth was unusually rapid.

Only a few months had passed, but Detona had already become much bigger than Barats. Barats was delighted and he often rode on Detona's back and explored the desert. Together, they have encountered and overcome many difficulties but unfortunately, the good times never last long. A sandstorm came out of nowhere, and Barats and Detona were separated by gusts of wind and raging desert sands. They couldn't find each other.

After the sandstorm ended, Barats searched and searched in the desert. But he never found any trace of Detona, and his water and food supplies were about to run out. They had built strong bonds and relationships with each other in those difficult days. But faced with a dire situation, Barats had to make a difficult decision. He half-heartedly stopped looking for Detona and headed towards Los Pecados.

Years later, Barats had learned a few things at Los Pecados. He used his skills to gather information for a local gang and made a living doing it. He got by through the days and gradually forgot his friend Detona. There was one time when Barats found his chance to succeed. He sneaked into the famous hunting group "Steel Hands" and went with them into the desert, searching for monsters and giant beasts. Their target was apparently a rare dinosaur. This lizard was strangely large and had the ability to breathe and absorb energy.

The “Steel Hands” hunting group had been tracking this enormous lizard for around twenty days. They used every weapon in their armory and, after suffering great losses in men and weapons, they finally managed to capture the tired dragon lizard. Everyone was rejoicing, including Barats, because the person who hired them had put a big bounty on this dragon lizard's head. His share of this reward would be very important and everyone would respect his success.

As the group reveled in joy, Barats approached the giant beast and examined it more closely. When their eyes met, Barats recognized that it was in fact his long-lost friend, Detona! Barats didn't know what to do. Detona was his friend, who had saved his life several times, but this bounty would give him enough wealth to live the carefree life he dreamed of. He hesitated for a long time, then he did something a Politan would never do. Friendship triumphed over his desire for wealth and Barats began to free Detona from the chains by breaking the chains. Now freed, Detona roared fiercely and Barats jumped onto her back. It was like old times, except Detona had gotten even bigger.

The dinosaur strode forward and knocked down the surprised hunters. And just like that, Detona and Barats disappeared into the distance. A few months later, Barats showed up at the gates of his dreams, Los Pecados, riding the intimidating giant lizard. He brought hidden treasures from the desert that he had discovered with Detona's help. Amazed by such riches, the hunters and gangsters of Los Pecados began to respect Barats and began calling him the Dino Rider.

Over the next two years, Barats and Detona traveled between Los Pecados and the desert lands. They had become the most famous black market traders in the entire region. There is a common saying in the desert: if you have good things to sell or want to find a way to join the Los Pecados gang, then you should look for Barats the Dino Rider. But be careful, you will have to offer a good price.
anecdotes: The name "Barats" has no official in-game meaning, but it may be a play on the word "barricade", reflecting its role as a resilient tank against its enemies. Alternatively, this could be inspired by the word "barrage", as Barats is a hero who often takes a lot of hits and deals constant damage in return.
Barats is also a dwarf.
Barats is the third and recent hero to possess a crowd control skill, before Franco and Kaja.
Barats speaks with a New York accent.
His Baratstein skin is a variant of Frankenstein.

baxia.accroche: The mystical turtle of the oriental fighters, an unstoppable wheel of flame wielding a shield.
lore: The mystical turtle of the oriental fighters, an unstoppable wheel of flame that welds shields together. After losing his master and comrades during the Battle of the Twin Dragons, Baxia, the mystical turtle spirit, took on the responsibility of protecting the river lands of Cadia. Although unshakable like a mountain on the outside, the weight of the deaths took a heavy toll on his life.

But the appearance of Yu Zhong and the new Oriental Fighters opened a new chapter in its history. Baxia reflected on the choices he had made and realized that he could no longer hold on to the past. So, he decided to abandon his burdens and focus on a new path.
The roads he traveled will always be there, but the future is decided today.
=== A thousand-year journey === Baxia has almost finished packing her things.

When the Black Dragon's seal was broken, a chapter in Baxia's life ended. Yu Zhong had regained his powers and went after the evil god Lieh. Ling and Wanwan returned to their lives while Baxia and Zilong remained at the dragon altar. It was around this time that Baxia suddenly felt the need to go on a trip. Since he awoke from his long sleep, he had been tested many times. First there was the appearance of Yu Zhong, then Ling and Zilong, and finally the battle at the Dragon Altar. He felt that he had done his duty and honored his promise, and that it was now time to see what had become of the river lands of Cadia at that time.
A chipped piece of shell slipped off the table.
As Baxia went to pick him up, he heard an angry cry that seemed surreal.
"This kid has the temper of a wild boar! How could he shoulder such power and responsibility!"

By this time, the Four Immortals had returned to the great cycle and the Twin Dragons were choosing suitable successors from among their disciples to inherit their power. Baxia's selection as the Mystic Turtle's successor was met with dissent from his fellow students.

The river lands of Cadia were then very tormented due to the imbalance of Yin and Yang, and demons and beasts roamed the land freely. There was a nature spirit named Baxia who was born in human form. He held two shields and moved like a wheel of fire. Wherever it went, its flames burned the vegetation and split the earth. Neighboring villagers believed Baxia to be a demonic beast and repeatedly tried to subdue him. Unbeknownst to them, Baxia himself resented his existence. He never wanted to be born with these flames which only caused fear and destruction. No matter how hard he tried to smother the flames or avoid others, he could never find peace.

When Baxia's consciousness first awakened, he was a wild and unruly nature spirit. Anyone or anything that got too close would suffer his wrath, until they were visited by the White Dragon. Instead of punishing the upstart, the dragon had come because the Mystic Turtle of the Four Immortals had chosen Baxia as his successor. The White Dragon erected a barrier and personally instructed Baxia for ten days, helping him control his flames and move in ways he never thought he could.
Baxia was deeply honored to have the White Dragon as his master, but he was still apprehensive about his future.

The White Dragon remarked, "The Four Immortals are sworn to protect the Riverlands of Cadia, and their power has been passed down from disciple to disciple. Once an Eastern Fighter has been chosen, he must assume the same responsibility.
“I don’t know what I can do, but I promise to honor this responsibility!” » Young Baxia proclaimed loudly.

Over the next few years, Baxia and his fellow Eastern fighters set about eradicating homesickness. He was the youngest among them and often sought their advice. Growing up, he traveled to almost every corner of the Riverlands of Cadia. He witnessed all the good that the Twin Dragons had brought to the land, and his admiration for them grew stronger.

But everything changed after the Battle of the Twin Dragons. The Eastern Fighters sealed the Inverted Black Dragon Scale before three of them succumbed to their wounds and perished. In order to keep the Riverlands of Cadia safe and keep its twin contained, the White Dragon transformed into the Dragon Altar and became known as the Great Dragon. Baxia was the only survivor. He packed up the belongings of his fallen comrades, hid the Dragon Altar, and set about repairing the destruction caused by the Black Dragon. Over time, Baxia became more and more withdrawn.

Baxia was also seriously injured during the battle and would have also perished if the other oriental fighters had not protected him. He was now the only one who could honor his promise to the Great Dragon.
Baxia silently carried her burdens and performed her duty. Once the work was finished, he fell into a long sleep.
When Baxia woke up from his sleep, he felt like he had just been born into a new world.
There was a new Black Dragon and new Oriental Fighters. Baxia was now the eldest and continued to carry the weight of the world.

During the fateful encounter at the Dragon Altar, Yu Zhong managed to absorb the powers of the Black Dragon. When Yu Zhong stepped out of the enchantment circle, Baxia burst into flames and hit him with all his strength. However, with his newfound power, Yu Zhong was able to easily stop the attack.
"I am not the corrupted Black Dragon. I am Yu Zhong. Stop living in the past, Baxia."
Baxia froze.
A chipped piece of shell fell to the ground.

Thousands of years ago, young Baxia dropped a piece of shell after finally extinguishing its flames. Thousands of years later, a piece of shell fell to the ground because of the Black Dragon's aura and Yu Zhong's words. At the same time, Baxia heard a loud crash, as if many heavy weights were falling to the ground.
Baxia walked towards the exit of the Dragon Altar and found a young man holding a spear leaning nearby.
“So are you leaving?” » Zilong asked.
"Yes, I intend to visit every corner of the Riverlands of Cadia...to understand the path I have chosen."

He had always kept his promise and shouldered the responsibilities of the Great Dragon and his fallen comrades, but now it was time for the new Eastern Fighters to shine. Maybe it was like Yu Zhong said, Baxia had always lived in the past and never tried to live in the present, that's why...
“You never strayed from your path, Baxia.”
The Cloud Dragon's new successor interrupted Baxia's thoughts by greeting him with his spear.
"Thank you for watching over the Riverlands of Cadia over the past millennia. We will await your return."
At this time, a dragon roar screamed from the dragon altar, as if echoing Zilong's words.
Baxia walked past Zilong with a wave and a slight smile as he walked down the mountain. === Secret History of the Dragon Altar ===
=== Eastern fighters gather ===

lore: A year and a half ago, the Union of Scholars welcomed a new student into its ranks. Unlike the other newcomers, this young girl named Beatrix seemed to possess extensive knowledge and an astonishing talent for science. In a short time, she has risen head and shoulders above her peers, becoming one of the most promising scholars in the entire Union of Scholars. Even Dr. Rooney, who watched quietly from afar, was impressed by his progress. He believed that if she applied herself to her studies, Beatrix could one day become the greatest scientist Eruditio had ever seen.

However, becoming the best scientist was not something that Beatrix placed great importance on. She was born in Castle Gorge, in the Moniyan Empire, into a merchant family. For generations, his family had already been well established as a wealthy merchant family business in the empire. In order to maintain their extensive trading network, Beatrix's parents often had no choice but to travel all over the Land of Dawn on business, leaving young Beatrix in the care of their loyal butler, Morgan.

Thanks to the financial means and freedom granted by her family, Beatrix spent her free childhood under the devoted care of Morgan. As such, she acquired a penchant for evil and became a stubborn and often temperamental person.

One day, Beatrix's parents returned from the far west, bringing with them a range of Eruditio's advanced gadgets to give to her. Beatrix had long had enough of the mundane and uninteresting toys around her, and so she began to be obsessed with these new things. They sparked in her a deep interest in technology itself. Over the next few years, Morgan regularly shuttled between Eruditio and Castle Gorge to bring Beatrix the latest inventions, which proved to be an extremely expensive undertaking. By studying them tirelessly, Beatrix began to nurture within her an incredible natural talent for science. She digested many complex mechanical concepts and structures as if they were child's play. Before long, she had built her own laboratory within the castle grounds and conducted extensive research into various technologies and weapons.

Beatrix devoted herself to the study of technology, which only deepened her obsession until she reached a bottleneck in her studies. After her 16th birthday, Beatrix packed her bags and headed to Eruditio, where she will seriously pursue her studies. She yearned to learn more about the most advanced technology in the Land of Dawn: Leviathan technologies.

And so Beatrix embarked on a year-long learning quest at Eruditio. The speed with which she absorbed and mastered knowledge was praised by everyone around her. However, his obsession and stubbornness, driven by his thirst for technological knowledge, caused much distress to some union members, who were stuck in their archaic ways and very attached to the rules. She started to get bored of her boring and tedious schedule. She needed a new approach to technology – something wild and unreserved. However, Dr. Rooney's doors and those of the Leviathan Workshop remained firmly closed and closed to her.

To demonstrate her technological prowess, she put forward a wild and imaginative proposition during a debate: that the human body could be connected to communications terminals in order to establish a direct neurological connection with others. Such a sensitive topic bore some resemblance to the ideas propagated by the evil faction of Lab 1718 scholars at the time. Therefore, before she had a chance to finish, Beatrix was interrupted by other Union members and kicked out of the discussion.

She felt unfairly treated and it left her seething with rage. Without saying goodbye, Beatrix left Eruditio and returned to her laboratory in Castle Gorge. With Morgan's help, she used her family's wealth and resources and began to bring her invention concepts to fruition.

About six months had passed and a competition known as "Survival: Nexus" began to host Eruditio. Handy terminals allowed participants to virtually control avatars with just their brainwaves, immersing themselves in a virtual realm. Here they could participate in a tactical competition without real physical harm. The creator of this technological marvel was none other than the student who had left Eruditio six months earlier: Beatrix. Thanks to the huge prize money she had offered to the winner of the competition, scholars and citizens of Eruditio were lining up to participate in "Operation Dawnbreak".

Beatrix watched with joy as her precious project dominated the conservative thinkers of the Scholars' Union. But then disaster struck. The network of terminals she designed was maliciously hacked by the nefarious Lab 1718. Everyone neurologically connected to the system was now under their control, and Lab 1718 stole the "Iron Guardians": an army of robots that had been locked underground, beneath the Eruditio Congress building.

The people trapped in the terminals were linked to these robots. With their consciousness still immersed in virtual battles and ignoring the real world, they led the robot army to wreak destruction on the streets of Eruditio. Ultra-advanced technological capital has been plundered and plunged into an unprecedented crisis.

The remaining scholars joined forces with the city guard of Eruditio, under the command of Dr. Rooney, and retreated to the Leviathan Workshop. Against their previous past, they knew they had to defend the greatest fruits of the city's technological research.

The robots kept popping up and things looked extremely bleak for the Leviathan Workshop. But it was then, at the most crucial moment, that the young and hardworking Beatrix roared into the skies aboard her airship, unleashing enormous, suppressing firepower. She couldn't stand to see these selfish power seekers exploit her own invention to destroy the city.

With Beatrix's help, Eruditio's city guard managed to repel the robotic forces that had besieged the Leviathan Workshop. Together, they charged into the Eruditio Congress building to take control of the robots and the virtual network away from the author Octavius, the mad biochemist. And finally, peace was restored to Eruditio.

Responsible for averting a crisis in Eruditio, Beatrix was finally granted an audience with Dr. Rooney. Under his tutelage, she managed to understand the true essence of technology. In the days that followed, she donated her "Operation Dawnbreak" terminal system to the Scholars' Union and ultimately decided to stay at Eruditio to continue her studies. And this time, the doors of Atelier Leviathan – an embodiment of the pinnacle of technology itself – were no longer closed to Beatrix.
anecdotes: The name Beatrix comes from the name Viatrix, originating from the late Latin name Viator, meaning "Traveler" or "Wayman".
In the New Items Store, Beatrix's hero description is "A skilled marksman with a variety of powerful and sharp weapons."

According to one of the tips given during her in-game loading screen, carrying different weapons puts Beatrix in different moods; explaining her different tones of voice when she picks up certain weapons.
The Mechanical Genius (Nibiru) is represented by a smiling emoticon, hence the name of the Ultimate "The Passion of Nibiru".
Mechanical Genius (Wesker) is represented by a winking eye with a tongue sticking out emoticon, hence the Ultimate's name "Wesker's Elation".
Mechanical Genius (Renner) is represented by an expressionless or apathetic emoticon, hence the Ultimate's name "Renner's Apathy".
Mechanical Genius (Bennett) is represented by a sulking or angry emoticon, hence the Ultimate's name "Bennett's Rage".
According to her Lethal Nexus character page, Beatrix is ​​17 years old and develops strange inventions for her hobby.
According to a question asked in the April 2021 Trial of Knowledge, Beatrix doesn't like the number four.

Interestingly, "4" is considered a "negative" number in the Sinosphere or East Asian cultures because 四 (sì in Chinese, shi in Japanese on'yomi, sa in Korean, tứ in Vietnamese) meaning "4" is a homophone of 死 (sǐ in Chinese, shi in Japanese, sa in Korean, tử in Vietnamese) meaning "Death", The number "4" " has been avoided in building floors, telephone numbers and addresses in China, Hong Kong and Japan due to the superstition that this number could lead to death, but it is less extreme in South Korea and Vietnam, it is considered the Eastern equivalent of "13" being a negative number in the Western world.
Beatrix is ​​the first hero with different multiple death animations (up to four).
Dying while using Mechanical Genius (Nibiru) causes Beatrix to fall into a crawling position before lying face down on the ground.
Upon dying while using Mechanical Genius (Wesker), Beatrix is ​​quickly knocked onto her back with both legs extended.
While dying using Mechanical Genius (Renner), Beatrix slowly falls backwards and lies on her left side.
Dying while using Mechanical Genius (Bennett) causes Beatrix to kneel on both knees before lying face down on the ground.
Beatrix's skills do not benefit from Spell Vamp, but from Physical Lifesteal.
Along with name=Alucard and Ruby, Beatrix is ​​one of the game's heroines whose skills benefit from Physical Lifesteal.

Beatrix is ​​the fifth hero in the game whose passive converts one stat (Critical Chance) into another stat (Physical Attack). She is also the only hero, besides Marcel, not to benefit from critical hits.
Other heroes with stat conversion mechanics are Lesley, Lunox, Kimmy, Terizla, Marcel, and name=Natan.
Beatrix is ​​the second sniper without mana or energy, the first being Granger (before her rework).
Beatrix is ​​the fourth hero capable of attacking turrets out of range, using Mechanical Genius (Renner) or Mechanical Genius (Bennett).
The other heroes are Layla after reaching the maximum level of her Destruction Rush, Clint with her Double Shot activated and Lesley with her Lethal Shot activated.
Using Mechanical Genius (Renner) or Mechanical Genius (Bennett), Beatrix is ​​the second hero whose basic attack requires manual aim, the first being Kimmy.
Beatrix is ​​the second sniper with a bullet reloading mechanism, the first being Granger.
Including Survival: Nexus and Ravage modes, Beatrix has a total of 10 weapons.

Beatrix's weapons are a pair of Mechanical Genie (Nibiru), a Mechanical Genie (Wesker), a Mechanical Genie (Renner), a Mechanical Genie (Bennett), a heavy machine gun, a boomerang, a laser gun, an energy gun, a flamethrower, and a sword.
Aside from Mechanical Genius (Nibiru), Mechanical Genius (Wesker), Mechanical Genius (Renner), and Mechanical Genius (Bennett), the rest of Beatrix's weapons currently have no known names.
Béatrix was originally called Boudicca.
In the advanced server, Wesker's Elation was previously an AoE damage circular skill before being revamped.
Beatrix's previous Ultimate line was Bullets around!" before being replaced by her current line.
Beatrix initially saluted with her right hand and did not use any weapons at the end of her hero animation.
This is replaced as Beatrix currently salutes with her left hand while her right hand wields Mechanical Genius (Bennett).
Beatrix was born in Castle Gorge within the Moniyan Empire, but currently resides in Eruditio.
Beatrix's type name = Basic 'X Factor', lexically refers to a particular talent/quality of note as well as a variable in a given situation that could have the most significant impact on the outcome.
The term “X factor” also refers to several different things; the most popular being The X Factor, a television music and singing competition franchise.
Its type = Elite, "Blitz Attack" was originally called "Hawkeye Bolt" during testing on Advanced Server.
His Elite Blitz Attack skin referenced Dante from Devil May Cry with the first hero Alucard bearing the same reference from 2016.

belerick.accroche: A kind and brotherly elemental creature.
lore: Many races have risen or fallen during the long history of the Land of Dawn. Belerick is one of the few who has witnessed all of this throughout the mists of time. When the world was formed, the mysterious Old Ones aided the ancestors as they created all things in this universe. Together, they built the great and massive Heavenly Palace and the myriad of elemental creatures, who would live on as the successors of their bloodlines.

When Belerick was just a sapling, he was chosen by the Ancients and given the essence of life and Mother Nature; this bestowed upon him the powers of intelligent thought, profound wisdom, and the wondrous ability of reincarnation. Under the protection of the Ancients, he lived with the elemental creatures in the Lantis mountain ranges, a place thriving with life and vitality.

However, this happy existence will not last long. The Ancestors left and the Endless War descended on the lands, plunging the Land of Dawn into the throes of fierce battle and massacre: the Ancients retreated into the Heavenly Palace and the elemental creatures thus lost the protection that had once been granted to them. The creatures were left without shelter and killed en masse as the fires of war blazed unceasingly.

They were forced to wander the lands for an entire period. Belerick watched as the Land of Dawn was ravaged by the raging war, with no corner untouched by the fighting. In doing so, Belerick grew from a sapling to a mighty tree. The war had stripped him of his old life and hardened his will; Even though he lost many of his companions, he still refused to give up the hope he had in life. He sought to use his power to the best of his ability to help those weaker than himself. In the latter stages of the Age of Strife, the Ancients who had returned to their celestial palace long ago could no longer bear the pitiful state of the world below and went against the orders of the ancestors by recklessly using the power of the Twilight Orbs to attempt to end the war.
anecdotes: The name Belerick has no direct real-world meaning, but it could draw inspiration from botanical and mythical themes. It resembles "Beleriand", an ancient and lush land from Lord of the Rings, fitting its guardian of the forest theme. His name could be derived from "bark" or "bel" (a common prefix in fantasy names), further reinforcing his identity as a living tree warrior.
Its design and abilities resemble treants (tree-like beings in fantasy worlds).
The old Belerick model is a younger version of the current one.
His old model is still visible in the hero's intro.
His "Torched Guardian" skin is the evil version of himself.

Belerick is considered one of the best heroes when it comes to damage reflection. Its passive, Deadly Thorns, allows it to reflect damage back to attackers, making it one of the best anti-shooter tanks in MLBB.
Many MLBB players compare Belerick to Groot, as both are giant tree creatures with a protective nature.
After being indirectly killed by Thamuz, Belerick's skills were retooled to better counter opponents who deal continuous damage, including Thamuz.
Whether or not it grew specifically to adapt, there are many real cases of plants adapting to specific threats in nature.

relations: Lunox, Natan Uranus, Aamon, Gusion, Valentina, Sora (companions)

benedetta.accroche: Warrior defending the Arid Lands against the invasion of demons.
lore: ===Revenge on the Monsters=== The bio of Benedetta, the 100th hero known as the "Shadow Ranger" is revealed for the first time. Beneath the Rantha Mountains, his “Alecto” symbolizes both honor and vengeance. After returning from the Abyss, our land is plagued by plague and the entire southern part of the Land of Dawn turns into a barren place. Although the high mountains of Rantha block the corruption of the Abyss, Mother Nature in the southern realm continues to wither. This once prosperous land is now a silent place filled with death, and people call it the “Place of Despair.” The only passage connecting the Moniyan Empire is broken, separating trapped refugees and exiled wanderers from the rest of the world. They now live in fear and despair, haunted by monsters, but still struggle to survive.

For these people, the name Benedetta brings hope and a feeling of security. This brave and persistent ranger leads a team and fights in the lands south of the Rantha Mountains, protecting the scattered colony established by the last survivors of Despair Place.

This is the fourth year since Benedetta and her team launched their campaign in the Rantha region. Every time she draws "Alecto", the raging monsters scatter, frightened by this long, sharp sword imbued with unstoppable power. People call him the leader of the Rangers who walks in the shadows, the protector of the place of despair. She has won the admiration and respect of everyone in this desolate desert.

However, the distant Moniyan Empire leaves a deep scar in Benedetta's heart, and the wound may never heal. Alucard is not the only person whose life was changed by the war that took place years ago, Benedetta is also one of the victims. But Benedetta's family is not like Alucard's. His father was not an officer, he was just a common soldier.

Unfortunately, the Second Division was found guilty of "rebellion" after being defeated in battle, and therefore no honor or glory was given to the soldiers who gave their lives for the country. As the child of an officer, Alucard was sent to the Monastery of Light with several other children and grew up with the blessing of the Light. But Benedetta, who did not enjoy such privilege because she was the child of a low-ranking soldier, had to struggle to earn a living without her parents by her side.

Ever since Benedetta was little, she had always wished that she could one day become a Warrior of Light, take back the glory that rightfully belonged to her father, and avenge her father's death by killing those monsters. To this end, she continued to train and treat herself as a warrior, constantly honing her combat skills, and inherited the long sword left by her father, preparing for the battles to come.

However, the passionate Benedetta was rejected when she signed up for the Empire's Army trial because the powerful men who led the Order of Knights were furious because of Alucard's betrayal and ordered that no descendant of a "rebel" could ever join the Empire's Army, so that they would never seek the truth as Alucard did.
Disappointed and enraged by the empire, Benedetta took her long sword and left the Moniyan Empire, heading to the Barren Lands and preparing to wipe out the monsters and take revenge on her own.

Although she was mentally prepared, Benedetta was shocked by the corruption and desolation the first time she saw the Wastelands. But what surprised Benedetta even more was that there were people who lived near the foothills of the Rantha Mountains, in a hostile environment. Life there was hard, but these people were optimistic and hardworking, fighting for everything they needed to survive. And they did: they improved the soil, raised the next generation, and defeated the monsters.

At first, Benedetta wasn't interested in these people at all. She wandered aimlessly in the Drylands and gave her longsword a new name, Alecto. She then unleashed her anger on the monsters and slaughtered them all. But as time passed, Benedetta slowly realized that this land was truly a vast area, and the power of the Abyss and the monsters was more formidable than she had imagined. She could never have saved the Despair Place or changed anything on her own.

One day, Benedetta comes across a squad of rangers who were in the middle of fighting against the monsters. The odds were against them, but they fought bravely together and repelled the monsters that tried to attack the human camp several times.

During the campaign, Benedetta and the rangers established friendship and trust through their joint efforts. And these people who lived in a lost place showed courage and a strong will to survive, which eventually touched Benedetta's soul and made her believe that it was not the weapon in their hands that would one day triumph over the Abyss, but the eternal hope in their hearts.
Subsequently, Benedetta chose to stay and formed a team of rangers, each member of which shared the same vision but had different skills. They helped these people defend their homeland.

One by one, the monsters throughout the southern foothills of the Rantha Mountains were defeated by Benedetta and her comrades. Benedetta always left a mark on the battlefield after slaughtering enemies, reminding the monsters that Benedetta never forgot what they did to her. More and more settlements sprang up around the Rantha Mountains and human civilization was able to flourish thanks to their protection.

They went through hell, they made sacrifices. But nothing could shake their will and stop this squad of rangers from marching in the shadows. Under Benedetta's leadership, they believed that while there was still hope, they would one day see flowers blooming in the Barren Lands.

Meanwhile, Benedetta had another, greater ambition: to eliminate monsters and reclaim her father's glory to prove a simple fact to the foolish rulers of the Moniyan Empire, letting them know that honor was never bestowed by anyone, it was hard earned.
It's not just a battle between her and the Abyss, it's also a war between her and the Empire. ===The demons are approaching===
anecdotes: Benedetta is the 100th hero in the game in chronological order of release on the original server. Brody is the 100th hero released on the advanced server.
The name Benedetta comes from Italian and derives from the Latin word benedictus, which means blessed. It is the feminine form of the name “Benedetto”, related to “Benedict”.
Benedetta's weapon is called Alecto, which is one of the Furies (vengeful spirits) of Greek mythology.
Alecto: Final Blow is one of the longest dashes in MLBB, covering a huge distance while dealing continuous damage.

Benedetta is the only hero with all blink skills, even her passive is blink. Most heroes stay still when attacking, but Benedetta can move while charging her passive attack, making her fighting style very fluid.
She was named "Bella" early in her development.

Benedetta is one of the few heroes in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang with a special attack icon, thanks to her Sword Intent charging mechanic. The symbol inside the attack icon resembles a sword arc, indicating its large slash when the attack is performed.
The default attack icon starts in blue, matching Benedetta's dark and murderous theme. When his sword intent reaches full charge, the icon turns red, symbolizing his willingness to strike.

pouvoirs: Rushes as she pulls out Alecto

brody.accroche: Mysterious man whose right hand was corroded and who lost his memory.
lore: No one knew where Brody came from.

When he arrived in this village, he was covered in blood and his right hand seemed to have been eaten away by the abyss. You could tell by his dark face that he was lost. The kind villagers didn't dare to let him enter the village, so they put water and food next to him instead.
After waking up, Brody realized that the villagers were afraid of him. He had forgotten everything, only faint memories crossing his mind from time to time.
In the dream he had over and over again, someone was shouting to him, “Brody, hurry up! But hurry for what? He didn't know the answer.

In his faint memories, there was always a big fire. And his right hand… looked quite ordinary at the time. So what happened to him? Every time he tried to remember the past, Brody felt an intense headache. He didn't know his purpose. He wandered the lands aimlessly. The torn memories and the pain in his right arm constantly tortured him.
The villagers thought he was a monster and stayed away from him. Brody knew people feared him. He was a stranger, someone who had no memories or past.

One day, an elder chased by demons got lost in the mountain. Brody didn't think much. He tried to save the old man out of pure instinct. The fierce demons didn't care about Brody because he looked thin and weak. However, he projected a strong wave of energy from his right hand and completely wiped out the demons. The power was incredible, but Brody also realized that every time he used this power, his right hand would feel unbearable pain and this pain would spread throughout his body. This pain did not paralyze him nor did it take away his strength to fight. But this pain was eternal, pushing him to rediscover his lost past.

The elder he saved thought he was a nice boy, so he invited him to stay with him in the village. Encouraged by the old man, the other villagers also began to open their arms to this quiet young man. It was in that moment that Brody suddenly realized that, even without memories, he loved this feeling, the feeling of being needed. Brody figured it was probably because he could finally feel like he had a purpose when he was needed.
This idea calmed Brody and eased the burden on his mind. But that voice still existed in his head, screaming, “Help! Help me!

He became the village guardian and peace was briefly restored. He repelled the demons of the Abyss wave after wave. It is for this reason that the villagers began to appreciate this quiet boy. Brody grew stronger and stronger as he fought battle after battle. And in every battle, he saw things that seemed to be his past memories.
He wanted to find out about his past, but at the same time, he was also afraid of the truth. What happened to him?

Brody fought like a soulless machine, until he met Benedetta, who was also a poor homeless soul. Benedetta was fighting against a group of demons. And that's when Brody came out of nowhere and intervened.

They were near the Abyss Fissure, and countless demons were appearing through the portals. The battle was becoming more and more intense. Brody evacuated the villagers to a safer location and fought alongside Benedetta.
It was when they nearly achieved victory that a group of demons sneaked into the wine cellar and captured the elder Brody had once saved. They threatened Brody to murder all the villagers.

Looking at the villagers being held hostage, Brody felt a severe headache. He could feel his right arm burning with anger. He could no longer contain the energy within him. Before anyone could react, Brody had rushed to the side of the last surviving demon who was trying to fight back. He struck this demon's chest with his right hand and removed its beating heart.
Blood blurred his eyes as Brody fell asleep from the extreme pain and fatigue caused by this intense battle.
The faint memories were finally coming together. The history that happened will never be forgotten. he would eventually call them back.
In his dream, Brody saw his past: he was born in a village at the foot of a volcano. The village was haunted by the Abyss, the people who lived there had to be very careful to survive.
Brody was the most optimistic young man in the village. Everyone loved him and he wanted to help too. The naive Brody thought he could fight demons and rid the village of terror and fear.

One day, the arrogant boy took a weapon and went to challenge the demons. He grew stronger the more he fought. But in the meantime, he realized that demons were indeed fearsome monsters. He couldn't fight them alone.
Brody got homesick so he returned home. But he didn't notice that a group of demons were following his trail to the village.
The demons destroyed the village. Some villagers were killed trying to defend themselves, and others were corrupted by foul energy.

When Brody finally defeated the demons around him, it was too late. The surviving villagers had all been corrupted by demonic power and were beginning to lose their minds. The oldest man in the village who was losing his last piece of humanity begged Brody to kill everyone. They would rather die than wander this world, soulless creatures.
The old man approached Brody and gave him one last hug, his strength was weakening. He once again begged Brody to do them a favor.
"Good boy, we missed you. And we will always look out for you."

A devastated Brody put the villagers out of their misery, then turned his attention to the last remaining demon hiding in the shadows. Agony, regret and hatred transformed into unbreakable power. Brody's right hand reached out, pierced this demon's chest and crushed its heart.
The demon's blood corrupted Brody's arm, giving him the power he now possessed. He could have gotten rid of corruption. But Brody let the pain take over his body until he passed out from the agony.
He knew the price he had to pay in doing this, for every strike he landed on his enemy would trigger the same pain, reminding him of the mistakes he had once made.
He had always been the same. When Brody opened his eyes, Benedetta and the villagers were there for him. And for the first time, he truly felt peace.
All his loved ones, friends and family have passed away. And his homeland will never be the same for him again.
But fortunately, he still has someone to protect.
Brody will continue to fight for his second homeland.
anecdotes: Brody is the 100th hero in the game, according to the game files and chronological order of release on Advanced Server. Benedetta is the 100th hero released on the original server.
The name Brody has a Jewish and British origin whose meaning is still uncertain. Additionally, a Hungarian surname Bródy, meaning "from Bród", is associated with the Ukrainian town of Brody.
Brody's name in the game files is Chargingshooter.
Brody was originally named "Protti".
Aside from name=Edith, Brody is the only sniper who doesn't wield a weapon.
In the advanced server, Brody's Name = Basic Attack move animation was a walking move before being replaced by his current move animation, levitate.

Brody is the fifth hero to receive an exclusive M-Series champion skin after AP Bren won the M5 World Championship, his second M-Series title as an organization. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Harith, Lancelot, Estes, Chou, and Joy.

bruno.accroche: The captain of the Eruditio Rangers who protects the city with his incredible football skills.
lore: Bruno's duties as captain of the Eruditio Rangers kept him very busy, but what little free time he had was spent playing football with the children at the market. He was always happy and enthusiastic and brought gifts and treats to the children. He was a superstar in their eyes and they loved hearing him tell stories about his past and how he became so good at football.
Bruno always began his stories with a quote from a children's song.
“If you have not felt every grain of sand beneath your feet, then you have not known true freedom.”

This song was popular throughout the barren lands of Agelta and Bruno had memorized it from a young age. It shaped the man he would become. He sang the lyrics while looking up at the desert sky. He vowed to walk every corner of the Land of Dawn on his own two feet, touch every grain of sand, and find true freedom.

When he was old enough to work, Bruno accepted a job in a caravan owned by his old friend Thiago. The caravan traveled between Agelta and the Moniyan Empire every year and even occasionally did business at the Frozen Sea port.

The work was boring and exhausting, involving moving heavy goods, caring for camels, cleaning sand from tarpaulins, and other arduous work. But that didn't bother Bruno. For him, the excitement of traveling with the caravan far outweighed the difficulties.
But a cruel fate would soon befall him.

The caravan had stopped near Firewind Valley to rest after traveling for more than half the day under the scorching sun and against strong winds. The workers were going about their usual tasks when a huge gust of wind and sand suddenly hit the caravan. The ruckus startled the camels and sent them running, pulling a loaded cart to the side. Thiago, who was working on the cart, could only watch as it tipped towards him.
BOOM!

The cart landed on its side and sent a huge cloud of dust into the air. The crew shouted if anyone was hurt and heard Thiago shouting back. When the dust settled, they saw him lying on the ground next to the cart, unharmed but visibly shaken. Thiago immediately pointed to the cart with a horrified look on his face. In the split second before the cart fell, Bruno had rushed and pushed Thiago to safety, but he had been unable to escape the same fate.
Everyone came together in a frantic effort to pull Bruno out from under the cart. His life was saved that day, but he will never walk again.
The owners of the caravan were moved by Bruno's selflessness and unanimously decided to let him stay in the caravan from now on. They would be Bruno's legs and would carry him to see the world.

Over time, Bruno tried his best to be optimistic. He was always chatting and joking with others and always had a cheerful expression, but Thiago could see that his once bright eyes were turning gray. The fire inside the young man was slowly dying out.
One night, the caravan stopped to rest alongside a traveling troupe. As everyone sat around the campfire, a bard began singing a familiar tune.
“If you have not felt every grain of sand beneath your feet, then you have not known true freedom.”
A surge of emotion suddenly struck Bruno. He turned around silently to hide his pain from the others. Thiago, who was sitting nearby, turned the other way to hide his own tears.

The next day, the caravan set out for Eruditio, the center of the trade route between Agelta and the Moniyan Empire. Each year, the caravan passed through Eruditio and stayed there for almost a month while carrying out most of its trade for the year.

One morning, Thiago arrives at Bruno's tent with an air of excitement that Bruno had not seen since the accident. A well-dressed man walked in behind him and introduced himself as Eruditio's main robotics researcher. He was looking for someone to test a prosthetic prototype based on their new Starlium technology. The scholar heard about Bruno's inspiring story and praised him for his courage. After examining Bruno's sturdy and resilient structure, he decided that Bruno was the ideal candidate for the project.
At that moment, Bruno's eyes lit up. The dream he had almost given up on was now right in front of him.
However, the academic went on to explain that this new technology was still experimental and that even if the operation was successful, Bruno might not be able to run like before.

Bruno started to have doubts, then he looked at Thiago and saw tears of joy coming to his eyes. Bruno had never seen Thiago like this, even when business was at its best. Not wanting to disappoint his old friend, he agreed to accompany the scholar and see their research for himself.

Upon arriving at the establishment, Bruno immediately noticed that the atmosphere was completely different from what he had imagined. As the scholars and researchers moved with passion and vigor, he remembered the bustling caravan and couldn't help but smile.

He therefore accepted the operation. After a particularly busy day at the facility, the scholar pushed Bruno's wheelchair up to a lookout to view the Spire of Knowledge at sunset. Bruno had been there for several days, but this was the first time he really stopped to look at the city.
As he watched the people of the city walking briskly and brimming with energy, Bruno couldn't help but ask:
“Why do you work so hard for someone like me?”
The scholar replied without hesitation:

"Because that is the spirit of Eruditio! Everything we do, every inch of progress we make goes toward making the dreams of others come true! With the power of science and technology, one day we will no longer be bound by our destiny. This is the true meaning of freedom. It is our privilege as scholars to be able to contribute to this cause."
As he said this, the scholar's eyes looked far away, as if looking into the future.

The very day the caravan was to leave Eruditio, the operation was finally over and Bruno got up for the first time in a long time. At that moment, he decided to stay in Eruditio and protect everything the city stood for. Bruno heads to the caravan to say goodbye to Thiago. As Thiago approached, he saw Bruno standing with a rekindled fire in his eyes, and he understood immediately and just smiled and nodded.
This is where the story ends.
"So you understand? The key to playing football is to pass the ball!" » Bruno said with a straight face.

“What did that have to do with football?!”, the children protest before running away muttering that they have been tricked again. Bruno smiled as he admired the inspiring sight of the Spire of Knowledge under the glow of the sunset.
anecdotes: The first name Bruno has Germanic origins and comes from the old High German word "brun", meaning "brown". It was traditionally used to describe a person with brown hair, brown eyes, or a strong, protective nature. Bruno's name is also common among famous soccer players, which is linked to his soccer-inspired skills.

Currently the only hero in the sports-themed game, while other heroes use magic or weapons, Bruno fights with pure skill and a soccer ball. His volley shot is a true life skill. His flying tackle talent is also real.
He is the first and only hero to possess abilities based on a sport (football). He is also the only hero who never uses his hands to attack.
His ultimate skill name, Worldie, is also based on a real-life football club.
He is one of the heroes who does not have a base skin.
Before his redesign, his "Vanguard Elite" skin featured the colors of the Brazilian national football team and closely resembled Brazilian footballer Neymar.
