carmilla.accroche: The girl who became a Blood Demon for love.
lore: Many years ago, Carmilla was born in Ansaac House in Aberleen Castle. As the Count's only daughter, she was loved by her entire family since birth. When she grew up, her distinguished family background coupled with her captivating beauty made her one of the most popular noble ladies in Aberleen Castle, and perhaps even in the entire Empire. However, her royal origin was inevitably linked to tragedy and would become a political tool of her father, Count Anssac, consolidating power by betrothing her to another powerful family.

Although countless aristocrats tried to woo Carmilla, none of them pleased her. Her innate pride made her refuse to bow to mediocrity. What she wanted was someone who could connect with her soul. But his father, Earl Ansaac, had already made up his mind. As the threat of the Abyss grew closer, he knew that the new class of military nobles would dominate the country's politics. Thus, he had to establish good relationships with them in order to maintain his family's social status. However, a rather insignificant man in the eyes of the old count foiled this plan. This man was Cecilion, the best opera singer in the Southern Empire. Carmilla has become his most loyal audience since the first day he came to Aberleen Castle. In Carmilla's eyes, he was so elegant and talented, but she could also see the melancholy and mystery in his eyes. For each performance of Cecilion, Carmilla would sit in the right middle of the auditorium, quietly enjoying the performance of her song.

One day, as the curtains were calling, Cecilion and Carmilla's eyes met. The flames of passion ignited between them. And like a bolt of lightning splitting the dark night sky, they instantly fell in love.

The days that followed were the happiest of Carmilla's life. At nightfall, Cécile got dressed and came to invite him to the opera, singing songs he had composed for her. And Carmilla watched his performance intently, never taking her eyes off him. At the end of the show, they met backstage, dancing in the moonlight. And early in the morning, Cecilion placed a rose on Carmilla's windowsill, nourished by the morning dew, and quietly left.

As time passed, Carmilla noticed something unusual about Cecilion. He lived in solitude and never had unnecessary contact with others. His skin was always pale, even when he didn't wear makeup; and it seemed like he was always trying to avoid something. In his eyes, Carmilla could sense his desire for a normal life, and she could vaguely see that Cecilion might have a connection to the legendary blood demon species. Although Cecilion never told him about his origins, she still chose to believe in him, because she felt his love was real. It didn't matter if he was a man or a blood demon, it was just a matter of love between them, and Carmilla believed that she would always belong to Cecilion and spend the rest of her life with him.

Although they loved each other so deeply, Carmilla's father, the Earl, forbade her from marrying this humble singer. He imprisoned her and forced her to marry Baron Tawil, general of the imperial army, stationed near Aberleen Castle. In order to make Carmilla forget about Cecilion, the count even sent his men to close the opera house. In Cecilion's mind, he knew that the love between the blood demon and humanity would never be true. Even though he loved Carmilla, he ultimately decided to give up. The day he left, he wrote her a letter in which he told her everything, his origins, his story, and left her with a rose on her window sill.

Carmilla didn't stop fighting, she wasn't ready to succumb to her father's will. But his heart broke when he read his farewell letter. To Carmilla, it didn't matter what species he belonged to. She loved him and without him her life would no longer have meaning.

She stood at the window, looking in the direction Cecilion was going. As dawn broke, she slit her wrist with a sharp dagger. The world fell into endless darkness. And Carmilla buried her love in her own way.

When Carmilla woke up, she found herself in Cecilion's arms again. His eyes were full of kindness and he looked at her. Then she discovered that his touch was so cold, as if she were lifeless, and that her skin was as pale as Cecilion's. She knew it, her lover did not abandon her, he came back and revived her with his blood. These two lonely souls were finally together again and could live together forever.

After that day, the people of Aberleen Castle never saw Cecilion or Carmilla again, only the legendary tales of the night, which passed from mouth to mouth over time. When night came, Carmilla snuggled into Cecilion's arms above the upper tower of Aberleen Castle, as if time had stood still.
anecdotes: It may be based on Carmilla, an 1872 Gothic short story written by Sheridan Le Fanu and also one of the first works of vampire fiction.
His ultimate skill "Curse of Blood" is the first skill to bind enemies by spreading damage and crowd control effects.
His quote: “Whoever wrote my lines is an endless bastard. » is the first canon quote that includes profanity.
His epic skin "Astral Arcana" is his only skin that does not have an equivalent with Cecilion.
Early in development, Carmilla was designed as a mage, similar to Alice, with abilities focused on damage and life loss.
Carmilla's final design resembles a noble vampire, but early concept art made her look more like a ghostly spirit.
His voice "Don't go gentle into that good night" is a reference to the poem of the same title written by a Welsh poet named Dylan Thomas.
Carmilla shares her Japanese voice actor, Takada Sakie, with her fellow Moniyan heroes, Lesley and Silvanna.

lore: Many years ago, attending the nightly opera performed by Cecilion was the most popular form of entertainment for the people of Avalor. The theater was always full every time this famous Opera actor performed. Everyone was attracted by her indescribable beauty and talent. However, the applause, love and cheers of human beings did not make Cecilion happy. He was a Blood Demon, and it was difficult for him to open his mind to humans. He had always tried to hide his true identity and blend into human society.

For as long as Cecilion can remember, her species has lived far from human beings. Lord Lava's oppression of the Blood Demons meant a dark future for them. So, some demons decided to leave the Place of Despair and came to live among humans. They were eager to ask the God of Light for forgiveness, live normally, and integrate into human society. But the fact was that they not only suffered from the hostility of human society, but they were also hunted by the Abyss. When Cecilion became an adult, he was the only one left of his kind.

In order to hide his true identity, Cecilion lived in Avalor as an opera actor and attempted to conceal all abilities and characteristics related to the Blood Demons. He looked magnificent and elegant on stage, surrounded by thousands of enthusiasts. But at night, Cecilion spent his nights alone, night after night.

The lonely days continued, but that was until Cecilion gave an unforgettable performance. When he walked to the center of the stage to bow, he saw Carmilla. And this beautiful lady was looking at him too. In that moment, the two lonely souls instantly fell in love.

Although Cecilion always warned himself against unnecessary contact with human beings, he could not resist his love for Carmilla. So, faced with love, he decided to follow his heart. At each of her performances, Cecilion sang a song for Carmilla and they never stopped looking into each other's eyes. When speaking about her past, Carmilla chose to keep it a secret. Even when Carmilla had doubts about his lifestyle, he still said nothing. However, they swore to be faithful to each other.

As the flames of love grew stronger, unbeknownst to others, they met more frequently. But Carmilla's father, Earl Ansaac, knew everything they were doing. In his eyes, Earl saw Cecilion as nothing more than a humble opera actor. He thought Carmilla should marry a more powerful man. When this couple's love deepened, Earl Ansaac violently interrupted the relationship between the two, imprisoned Carmilla, sealed the Opera House, and exiled Cecilion.

Soon after, a rumor circulated that Count Ansaac was about to marry his only daughter, Carmilla, to Baron Tawil, a general in the Imperial Army. At that moment, Cecilion was so tempted to overthrow the guards and take Carmilla away. However, he knew he couldn't bring her happiness because she would become a fugitive on the run. After much thought, he realized that the love between a blood demon and a human could never be true and he thought it best to give up.

The night was drawing to a close, and at dawn Carmilla was to marry Baron Tawil. But before the first light of dawn, Cecilion placed a rose and a letter with her name in Carmilla's window and turned away. But what Cecilion didn't know was that his strange lifestyle wasn't important to Carmilla and she didn't care whether he was a blood demon or a human. She loved Cecilion for who he was. After donning the white wedding dress, Carmilla cut her wrist with a sharp dagger, losing her life to her lover, Cecilion.
Abandoning Carmilla made Cecilion terribly sad and his life seemed to return to what it had been. After two lonely nights, Cecilion went to see Carmilla, from afar.

But when Cecilion arrived, he found Carmilla's cold corpse, motionless in a solemn burial. For a moment, looking at Carmilla's cold skin, Cecilion felt only pain and regret, flowing vaguely into his chest. How could he live without Carmilla? As the new moon rose, Cecilion spread his wings and swept across the city in the cold night, carrying his love with him. He then resurrected Carmilla, using his own blood; but this kind of power comes at a price. And thus, Carmilla was also forever transformed into a blood demon. To protect this eternal love, Cecilion decided that he would never let anyone separate them.

After that day, the people of Aberleen Castle never saw Cecilion or Carmilla again. Only the legend of the night, which has passed from mouth to mouth over time. It is said that when night came, Carmilla snuggled into Cecilion's arms above the upper tower of Aberleen Castle, as if time had stood still.

Over time, their bond grew stronger and Cecilion realized that being a blood demon made no difference to Carmilla. She loved him for who he was and would always remain her beloved. However, the betrayal of the Blood Demons and the hatred of humans forced Cecilion and Carmilla to choose a path, that of turning their backs on their past. Endless vagrancy and wandering awaited them, but at least they were destined to stay together, wherever they went.

Since his youth, Cecilion had always chosen to hide behind the darkness and stay away from the crowd. Leaving all the cheers, chants and popularity behind, the fame of yesteryear seemed unusually meaningless. His identity as a Blood Demon had constantly prevented him from opening his mind to humans. But now, he had decided to share each of his secrets with the one he loved. Running away with Carmilla meant that his identity, which he had tried so hard to hide, was at risk of being revealed. What was left was a life of flight, both from humans and from Abyssal demons. Cecilion, who had already tolerated much throughout his life, could no longer accept any oppression, determined to no longer remain silent in times of crisis. He had begged for forgiveness from the Lord of Light, however, faced with those who were about to kill him and his lover, Cecilion would certainly worship the pool of blood with them.

Every detail of their lives embodied their love. With love, Cecilion believed he could endure anything and everything. To prevent Carmilla's father, Earl Ansaac, from discovering the truth about their deep love and to avoid interference from the Abyssal Demons, they had to disguise themselves as ordinary humans and integrate into human society. However, accidents happen. Once, due to unavoidable circumstances, their identities were discovered and Cecilion had to kill everyone who knew the truth. It is believed that once Cecilion unleashes his true Blood Demon power, no one, whether Abyssal Demons or humans, could even dream of escaping.
anecdotes: Cecilion is the only hero whose skills scale with magic power and mana.
Cecilion's Starlight skin "Stargazer" and collector's skin "Crimson Wings" are the only skins that do not have an equivalent in Carmilla.

chang-e.accroche: Naughty and cute disciple of the Great Dragon.
lore: Chang'e is the Great Dragon's youngest disciple and from a young age, she has demonstrated incredible magical potential, quickly mastering the Great Dragon's greatest spell: the Sacred Satellite. From then on, Chang'e won the eternal love of the Great Dragon. However, Chang'e had an energetic and cheerful personality that gave the Great Dragon quite a few headaches.

Every time the Great Dragon enjoyed a peaceful afternoon, he would most likely smell the rotten stench of trouble and soon enough, some of the servants of the Sanctuary would run up to him, only to tell him that Chang'e had once again gotten into some mischief, either by breaking an ancient vase, very dear to the Great Dragon's collection, or running around with his jade rabbit, making a mess of everything in his path.

Eventually, he realized that his old bones would be trampled in all this ruckus and asked Zilong, his adopted son, to look after Chang'e. The Great Dragon knew that only Zilong's patience could handle Chang'e and also hoped that Zilong's diligent and determined character could help guide Chang'e.

Zilong came to love the dynamic and intelligent little rascal, Chang'e. They often spent countless hours together, practicing magic and finding divine creatures to play with and Zilong would occasionally play silly games with her, even if it meant a complete waste of time, for Zilong. Chang'e also enjoyed spending time with his older brother, Zilong. To make things productive, Zilong started teaching him the art of Kung Fu and other things like meditation and archery. However, Chang'e's favorite part of the day was the end of practice, when Zilong carried her on his back on the way home.

During the Second War of the Planes, Zilong was ordered to aid the wise rulers of the land, traveling between the Land of Dawn. After she left, Chang'e returned to her naughty and childish ways. At one point, the Great Dragon was unsure if there would ever be another day of peace, until something big happened and the servants rushed to him. Chang'e had swallowed all of his Holy Immortality Pills by accident, thinking they were candy. The Great Dragon was furious, transforming into his dragon form, he frightened Chang'e and immediately chased Chang'e from her sanctuary, ordering her to travel to the Planes, aid Zilong and atone for her mistakes, before she could return to Sanctuary.

Even then, the Great Dragon felt compelled to give Chang'e, his precious crescent moon, to protect her. Letting Chang'e go brought peace to the Great Dragon, but not happiness. He hoped she wouldn't consider him too cold and hate him forever. However, Chang'e was excited to venture into the Land of Dawn, which she saw as a place filled with many new things. But above all, she couldn't wait to see her big brother, Zilong, again.
anecdotes: Chang'e (嫦娥) is based on the moon goddess of Chinese mythology, in which she is the subject of several legends. The large crescent moon halo she rides on is proof of this.

In the Chinese zodiac, the Rabbit (兔) is the fourth in the 12-year cycle of animals that appear in the Chinese zodiac linked to the Chinese calendar. These are the Lapin years in the 20th and 21st centuries: 1903, 1915, 1927, 1939, 1951, 1963, 1975, 1987, 1999, 2011, 2023, 2035, 2047, 2059, 2071, 2083 and 2095.
Chang'e's rabbit companion is named Jade.
Due to a bug, his first skill before rework was able to deal damage to turrets.

In one of his quotes, Chang'e mentions name = Roger when addressing his fellow rabbits; this is a reference to its wolf form, since wolves are known to prey on many animals, including rabbits. This hostile relationship is one of the most popular relationships in fiction.
His laugh that can be heard during hero selection for Crimson Moon was reused from his old hero selection quote.

chip.accroche: A carefree, genetically enhanced fox who uses advanced portal technology.
lore: A carefree, genetically enhanced fox who uses advanced portal technology, Chip was once a little fox just trying to survive in the harsh wastes of Agelta. By chance, he was found by Dr. Baker and brought to Laboratory 1718 where he was genetically enhanced with superior intelligence and tasked with testing the laboratory's portal technology. However, he was always lazy by nature and just wanted to enjoy a carefree life. When an inner power struggle took place in the secret laboratory, Chip's life was turned upside down and he was forced to make a difficult decision. To be able to return to his carefree life, he had to work hard one last time... ===Dear Dr. Baker=== The laid-back Chip only wants to enjoy a carefree and peaceful fox life, but the problems keep coming. Once again, Chip's dream of a relaxed existence is disrupted. How can he escape these troubles and embrace a life of leisure?
Dear Dr. Baker:
You must be shocked that I, the happy-go-lucky Chip, ever wrote a letter, right?

After all, normally I just lie in my flying chair and snack on chips all day. But I can't do this anymore, my old friend, because your indecision has interfered with my carefree life, which is why we need to have a long talk.

Once upon a time, before I met you, I was just an ordinary little fox, no different from the thousands of other foxes in Agelta. I slept every day in my burrow under the sand and foraged for food when necessary, until one day I came across a bag of half-eaten chips kindly left by a traveler.
My world was never the same after that. This unique taste and crispy texture was surely the pinnacle of human ingenuity, I thought; their miracle for the world of flea-free peasants.

After this divine experience, I waited day after day along the trade routes, but never had the opportunity to taste this golden delight again. I even stole potatoes from a village and was almost mauled by their mangy dogs, but what are potatoes compared to chips! Alas, the gods did not send a second bag of chips, but a calamity: an earthquake threatening to collapse my burrow. I didn't panic like the rest of my loved ones. I made the softest bed out of hay, put the empty chip bag over my head and was ready for whatever came next.

But it turns out that you happened to be walking past my burrow at that very moment. The sight of my calmness, or perhaps the bag on my head, must have piqued your curiosity, so you took me back to your laboratory. When I woke up, I discovered that I had been modified by your strange science. I had acquired extraordinary intelligence and was soon tasked with testing the laboratory's portal technology.

I was so naive back then. The great Dr. Baker had granted this little fox the opportunity to get his own chips! From that day on, I became a being of higher intelligence, I called myself “Chip,” and I was free to enjoy all my life chips that I could reach from anywhere. Surely the portal I was testing was meant to reach the snack locker while lounging around the house, right? I was grateful, Dr. Baker.

But if only things were that simple. You later informed me that in addition to eating chips, we smart "scholars" also have to do endless scientific research, record experimental data, assemble robots, and even catch those slimy energy jellyfish in the sea around the island. In other words… work. What a terrible concept! Wasting my life, that’s what it is! I was devastated by this revelation and from that point on all I could do at work was find ways to relax and eat chips. I know you blame yourself, thinking it was an error in your calculations that made me so lazy... but you're wrong. I've always been lazy.
Don't be angry, I finished my speech. What follows is just an account of a few events.

Soon after, Dr. Octavius ​​became the new head of the laboratory. He transformed it into a weapons factory and used your technology intended for the benefit of the world to manufacture weapons of war and sell them to Los Pecados. At that moment you couldn't accept what was happening and you ran away. I originally thought you were taking a break from the island, but it turns out you were secretly working on an android, Angela!

Once Octavius ​​discovered it, he made us all work overtime to develop an even better android; to surpass you, he wanted to mass produce weapons equipped with artificial souls. The workload for all of us increased tenfold...we worked from dawn to dusk, without a single break to enjoy even a single chip. This is not a working condition for man or fox. I couldn't take this for another second, so I was forced to do something drastic.

I took the initiative and volunteered to lead the search and recovery team for you. I used the portals to find your residence and brought you back. I hope you're not too angry. It's not that the chips are more important than you, but I had to bring you back so everyone could finally get a break.

Anyway, you were captured and brought back to the lab, but Angela escaped. You were so worried about her that you fell into a depression, while I received a hundred bags of original flavored chips as a bonus. But life likes to play cruel tricks on us, as I have learned. That damn Octave gave me a promotion and a raise, but above all gave me even more work and responsibilities!
Will this nightmare ever end? I want to retire with my stash of chips!

So you need to get back on your feet, my friend. Think of those who suffer from war, the victims of the weapons manufactured in this laboratory and the poor little fox forced to work overtime! Listen, I'm going to help you regain control of your laboratory. I thought it didn't matter who ran this lab as long as it wasn't me, but now I know it has to be you! Otherwise, people will expect me to work!

As for your "daughter" Angela, don't worry, I will find her and bring her back but promise you will keep her away from me. She forced me to wear a frilly pink dress the last time we met... Truly one of your most terrifying creations.

In conclusion, pull yourself together, Dr. Baker! I know your technology will bring joy to all living creatures, and I should be first on that list! I can already see the golden beaches of the Agelta coast. I hid all my chips there, waiting for this day.

One last thing. You didn't think I wrote that letter myself, did you? I hope the ChipBot AI program I developed did a good job conveying my thoughts... or the thoughts the real Chip should have according to my algorithm... Whatever. If you miss me, just contact ChipBot.
Although he only responds that he is not on duty.
- Your good friend, Chip
===Chip's acceptance speech===
anecdotes: Chip has a unique passive skill that allows him to eat chips outside of combat, regenerating his HP to 150. Health regeneration increases by 15% once he takes at least five consecutive bites.
It has the tag number. 5 on his ear, implying that other foxes or animals of different species were tested or improved before Chip.
The flavor of the chips changes depending on the skin.

chou.accroche: A talented fighter with a heart of chivalry.
lore: Chou was born in an isolated slum in the heart of poverty, living the lowest quality of life. Despite the terrible conditions, Chou kept his heart of kindness, while continuing to care for the old and young with passion day after day. During this period there was great unrest and unrest in the Land of Dawn; chaos spread throughout the country and eventually began to affect this small, isolated area.

One day, Chou rescued a mystical monk being chased by his captors and brought him back to his slum to take care of him. In return, the monk passed on to Chou the ancient Asian skill of Kung Fu and told him that the world needed a true hero to rise up and end the chaos. Chou then made a vow to begin his journey to the Land of Dawn to become a true hero without looking back. As Chou left, the monk nodded and disappeared into the shadows.
anecdotes: Chou's design is heavily based on Bruce Lee.
His ultimate ability, Way of the Dragon, is a direct reference to the 1972 film starring Bruce Lee.
His quotes “The man who can beat me is not yet born”, “Empty your cup to fill it again”, “Knowing is not enough, we must apply” are the famous Bruce Lee quotes. The last quote is also said by Goethe.
Jeet Kune Do is a famous martial art developed by Bruce Lee.
Shunpo (瞬歩) is a word meaning quick steps.
His quote “In the world of Kungfu, speed defines the winner.” is a direct quote from The Beast in the 2004 film Kung Fu Hustle.
The name "Chou" (周) is commonly found in Chinese and East Asian names and could mean "cycle" or "universe" in Chinese.
His Ultimate (Way of the Dragon) is one of the few non-tank skills capable of suppressing enemies, making it deadly for isolating carries.
He is one of the heroes with the most skins.
He is the first hero to receive more than one collaboration which is the King of Fighters - Iori Yagami and Saint Seiya - Shiryu.
Before his remodel, his default skin was based on Hong Kong martial artist Bruce Lee.

Chou is the fourth hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin when ECHO Philippines won the M4 World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Harith, Lancelot, Estes, Brody, and Joy.

cici.accroche: A joyful artist who spreads fun and wonder wherever she goes.
lore: name=Yoyo A joyful artist who spreads fun and wonder wherever she goes. Cici, the lead actor of the Whimsical Wonders theater troupe, accompanied by her magical companion Yoyo, began their annual tour. She chose Aberleen Castle, the town where her aunt was once called the Queen of Revelry, as her first destination. But upon arrival, Cici discovered that the town had banned unauthorized performances of any kind, especially folkloric performances, and that her aunt had been exiled when the law was enacted. Intrepid, she decided to bring pleasure and wonder back to the city. Inspired by his spirit, the long-muted artists of Aberleen Castle emerged from the shadows and took part in the most magnificent spectacle the castle has ever seen. === Opening Night === Why did 16-year-old Cici choose Castle Aberleen for her show tour? The place screams “No Entertainment Allowed,” but why? Cici appears to have a complex connection with Aberleen. Hit the link below to dig deeper into Cici's story!

Here is the dazzling star of the show! Oh, how hypnotized I am once again! Let us welcome the young girl who frolics in the clouds, on the roofs and in the middle of the meadows. From his hands, Yoyo, his spinning companion, is launched high into the sky, igniting a celestial firework that floods the sky and paints every eye with wonder.
"Now let's give a round of applause to say goodbye to Miss Cici of the Fantasy Wonder Troops!"
Our beloved performer is about to embark on her annual performance tour, destined to illuminate another city with her dazzling light!
As for me, her loyal follower, it is my duty to track her... er... I mean, record her on her journey. Don't pine for me, because I'll send you all the highlights of my live performances.

I must admit that his choice is truly daring; to make the light of the stars walk in the cold heart of Aberleen Castle. It is the birthplace of whimsical wonder, but now stands in stark contrast to the once bustling city. Legend has it that the founder of the troupe, Madame Mimi, who is also Miss Cici's aunt, made her reputation there and left with great grandeur while leaving behind her an influence that will last as long as possible. Aberleen Castle has since been plunged into silence, a testimony to its genius, with no one daring to desecrate its glory with folklore shows.
"Didn't you promise your aunt not to go to Aberleen Castle? He's already had his Queen of Revelry."
Yoyo, his magical companion and, in many ways, the brains of the operation, stopped his steps.
"My aunt's era is over. The future now belongs to you and me!"
Yoyo followed him, leaving a trail of stardust.
Oh, Cici, my Cici. This year's tour will undoubtedly be the grandest of all. Now follow me, camera! Let's enter Aberleen Castle!

Aberleen Castle, a most disturbing and frightening place. This did not deter Miss Cici at all, however. After a few boisterous calls from her, curious children appeared from every nook and cranny and followed her. Soon after, his famous performance began to unfold. She tossed Yoyo into the sky for what seemed like an eternity before he returned to the string in her hand. She was jumping from place to place, as if walking on clouds, while spinning Yoyo. that night, the stars were a humble witness to their majestic presence.

Applause rang out through the streets of Aberleen Castle. The series was a smash hit in every way, but why do I have this unsettling feeling? Since I followed Miss Cici into the city, a red-eyed crow has been circling above me...
Not only that, but unless my eyes deceive me, the statues in the walls slowly come to life, transforming into armored soldiers and advancing towards...Miss Cici!
The crowd dispersed like cockroaches. I followed Miss Cici down a dark and strange street. A decrepit hand pulled Cici beyond the curtains – it was an old man who quickly gestured to be quiet.

Following Miss Cici's gaze, I turned around and saw the strange shop. Everything seemed so familiar, yet out of place. The big curtain was definitely an old theater set. Ornate opera masks have been transformed into flower pots. and various costumes were cut out and hung above the windows to provide a slight respite from the perpetual rains of Aberleen Castle.
"What happened here?" Are you an artist?
The old man grabbed the sunflower pendant hanging around Cici's neck, the troupe's symbol of fanciful wonders that each member possessed.
“Here…”
Does he know his name? Could he be another one of her devoted fans?
“I held you once when you were little.”
Seriously? Is that his opening line? Now I'm as perplexed as you.

"You remind me so much of your aunt. In her prime, she feared nothing and no one and vehemently opposed aristocarty. Then she found you. To keep you safe, she had no choice but to leave Aberleen Castle. I never thought I would see you again. Has Mimi returned too?"
"No, she didn't. But did you just say that Castle Aberleen banned performances? Was my aunt exiled?"
"Exiled? I guess you could say that, but she didn't go down without a fight."

Cici's expression darkened. it was therefore the truth that the troop was hiding. A not-so-glorious past of a failed uprising. Yet there is no shame in their efforts. They had the courage to stand up for what they believed in. Cici, you must be strong and believe too! but alas, I cannot reveal myself, I cannot let him know that I am here, I...
"Then I must continue what she couldn't finish!" Sir, please tell everyone you know that the show starts tomorrow at midnight!
She could barely contain her excitement. Of course, Miss Cici's shine can never be extinguished!
With Yoyo's help, they worked through the night to finish the promotional flyers. At dawn, a colorful sea of ​​posters adorned the entire city.
“Where does this madness come from?”

The elders of Aberleen Castle had never faced such a difficult, but undeniably vibrant, morning. Mingled in the crowd was a man wearing a hood...could this be Aamon, the lord of Aberleen Castle? What a scoop! Ah, the young lord of Castle Aberleen must expect, like everyone else, a splendid performance. Well, Miss Cici will definitely not disappoint!

The red-eyed crows circled in the sky, screeching. The soldiers who came to life on the facades of buildings were mobilized en masse, their rigid joints clicking with determination. Yes yes ! They are now part of the show!
A lasting chase took place at Aberleen Castle. The flow of dark magic and the excitement of the Yoyo spread through the streets and poured into the sky.
"You idiots couldn't even catch one girl?!"

Oh, angry elders, I know your red-eyed crows all too well – they are like the cameras that feed our fans. Disturbing them is just a trifle for me. Furthermore, the lord of your own city has given a bad order, forcing your soldiers to search the empty river banks.
But faced with the ever-increasing number of pursuers, Cici eventually found herself stuck in an alley late at night.
“My dear daughter, who sent you to Aberleen Castle alone?”
That seductive voice! It could only belong to a person of equal splendor, Madame Mimi! The doves flew away as Mr. Anton led a group of dancers toward the soldiers.
Dancing in unison with the doves, they circled around the leader of the soldiers.
Bubbles slowly descended from the sky, trapping the soldiers inside – it was the sea boy, Binny.

And the once dark alley suddenly lit up, revealing an elderly man dressed in an exquisite suit and an operatic mask. Behind him was a troupe of artists marching in step. Like him, they were old but had clear and melodious voices. Their songs brilliantly broke the silence that had reigned for decades at Aberleen Castle.
The real show was about to begin!
“Go ahead, girl. We take care of everything here!
With a boost from Yoyo, Cici gracefully scaled the mountain of soldiers before reaching the rooftops and escaping.
Everywhere she went, the night sky lit up and the free-falling Yoyo spread its exuberant energy to every window she passed.
“Don’t be afraid to have fun!”
The windows that were once shrouded in darkness now glowed with the light of a lit candle. In the candlelight, people smiled and began to dance and kiss their loved ones.
Cici headed towards the horizon.
From the highest point of Aberleen Castle, fireworks erupted and the entire town was ablaze with a radiant spectacle.
From this night on, Aberleen Castle will no longer be afraid to have fun!
What a most splendid night it was for Cici!
And there you have it, the curtain falls.
=== Glow in the middle of the freezing night ===
anecdotes: In Chinese, Cici's official hanzi name, "茜茜", which has no meaning and is used to transliterate foreign names, is a homophone of the word "嘻嘻" meaning "laughter" or "laughter", which matches her cheerful nature. His fighting style also has Wushu (Chinese martial arts) influences, reinforcing this connection.

It is possible that her name is a shortened form of "Cecilia". The name is a feminine form of "Caecilius" derived from the Latin word "Caecus" meaning "Blind", but it more likely derives from Saint Cecilia, the patroness of music.
It was originally scheduled to release on December 23, but due to a gameplay issue, they decided to move its release date to December 27.
Unlike other fighters who use common weapons, Cici uses a yo-yo, allowing her to attack while moving, improving her kiting abilities and sustained damage.
Her skills mimic real yo-yo techniques like looping, bouncing, and spinning. The way she controls her yo-yo reflects the speed and skill required for real-life Yo-Yo tricks.
Unlike most fighters who rely on heavy single strikes, Cici focuses on quick strikes.

claude.accroche: An excellent thief who comes and goes without leaving a trace.
lore: Claude was born in Los Pecados, a western town in the Land of Dawn. An infamous city of sins, without ruler or order, lawless and ravaged by crime.

Growing up as an orphan, Claude quickly learned to fight, lie, gamble, and steal: tricks of the trade he had to rely on to survive. He was particularly talented in the latter area, and no purser he ever met matched him in his keen eye and nimble fingers.

It wasn't long before he became the leader of a band of wanderers, relying on his "skills" and making a name for himself in Los Pecados. He found one who would offer him and his gang protection: Waldo Kane. Kane had not yet obtained the Los Pecados monopoly he had dreamed of. Wild ambition and conspiracy brewed deep within him. For him, this motley band of homeless vagabonds was the perfect tool to achieve his goals. Behind a mask of kindness, he manipulated these children, with sweet lies and false compassion leading them down a dark path. He molded them to become members of his criminal group, with each wayward child calling him "Father."

At the age of 18, Claude is given a monumental task: travel to Grandrock Castle, north of Moniyan, and sneak into the Duke of Vance's house. Then he pretended to steal secret accounts, while blaming another gang. Kane promised Claude that people would be waiting for him once he got inside. Once his mission was accomplished, Claude and his team would be rewarded with housing of their own. They would no longer need to live in slums.

The truth, however, was nothing Claude could have imagined. No one expected him: he was just a simple pawn, and neither he nor his brothers would receive any reward. Like Claude, they were only stepping stones for their “Father” to become king of Los Pecados.

So when he slipped into the Duke's mansion, he found an unavoidable trap waiting for him. Claude could only accept his fate and was taken into police custody. Following a rushed trial, he was quickly found guilty of all charges and thrown into a cold, dark cell.
Chained, Claude burned with regret. The only thing in his mind that kept him going was his band of brothers, lost and with nowhere to go.

The days passed slowly. One day, Claude was forced to change cells, his new cell shared with an old man with a beard and snow-white hair. This particular old man was none other than the master thief of legend: Merlin. Merlin, powerful and incredibly resourceful, had a reason to be locked in a cell. One reason that left Claude speechless: he just wanted a quiet place to retire.

The cunning Claude reminded Merlin of his younger self. He therefore decides to pass on his inheritance to her. Yet, in return, Claude would have to acquiesce to one of Merlin's strangest requests. Once released from prison, he must pillage every town in the Land of Dawn, leaving his name behind as his calling card.

Over the next two years, Claude inherited every one of Merlin's wonderful techniques of deception, evasion, and combat, among others. His abilities grew until he was ready to steal anything he could imagine. One night, Claude put his perfect prison escape plan into action, stealing his freedom.

To keep his promise, Claude traveled throughout the Land of Dawn over the next few years. The streets were bristling with whispers about the master thief Claude, his charm and his incredible talent. With his carefree smile, Claude was your man if you ever needed something stolen, no matter what. All he asked was that the pay be generous, and that the one from whom it was stolen should be evil.

As this continued, Claude was joined by the perfect partner: the mysterious Dexter. This mischievous little monkey first met Claude in Moniyan, when he stole a lucky gold coin right from under his nose. After a brief chase, their friendship blossomed and Claude took on Dexter as his partner in crime. And this is how their adventures began.
In the fifth year of his departure from Los Pecados, Claude finally kept the promise he made to Merlin. He had left his traces in every town in the Land of Dawn.

Then he would return to Los Pecados. However, nothing could have prepared Claude for what he saw upon his return after his five years of absence. His brothers of old had not risen through the ranks of the underworld, had not escaped poverty thanks to their manipulative “Father”. No, a completely different fate had befallen them. Instead, he found that not only were there still pitiful street children on every corner of this dilapidated city, people like the Claude of the past; there were even more than before.

Claude had been deceived and this sent him into a violent rage. He began to plan his revenge as she swirled within him. Waldo Kane had acquired his monopoly on the city, thus becoming the kingpin of Los Pecados. In order to take revenge, Claude slipped into Eruditio and, with Dexter's help, pretended to be captured, entering prison. He then stole Dr. Rooney's latest invention: a strange holographic mirror.

Satisfied with his success, it was then that Claude noticed a line of text on the device: "I hope this device serves you well. If you have any ideas or suggestions for improving it, contact me immediately!—Rooney."

Thanks to this "gift" from Dr. Rooney, Claude and Dexter created songs for Los Pecados. In this chaotic city of nefarious outlaw dealings, he would make the one who deceived him in the past pay the price.

clint.accroche: A sniper full of righteousness and justice.
lore: On the desolate border of Moniyan, border with Agelta, there was an ordinary town. The people here lived a peaceful and stable life, far from the hustle and bustle of human society. They worked during the day and in the evening they went to the town tavern to have a few drinks to relax.

Such an orderly and stable life was thanks to Clint, the town sheriff. Clint was a famous fast shooter, blessed with unrivaled marksmanship, and was known for his fastest draw speed. The dedicated Clint always considered the safety of the city his duty. He loved his work and his duty and believed in the fairness and justice of the law. He hated evil as his enemy and had protected the city from all kinds of thieves and bandits for many years. This is why he was loved by the people of the city.

On an ordinary night, Clint went about his daily patrol with his gun as usual. In the middle of his patrol, he suddenly heard gunshots and disgusting screams coming from the tavern. Clint instinctively knew that a group of uninvited guests had broken into the peaceful town.

Clint immediately rushed to the tavern, where a group of oddly dressed drunks were rampaging wildly. Many locals were beaten to death by them, while the tavern owner was shot dead by the gangster boss. Faced with Clint's warning, the gangsters were not afraid, but openly declared that the city would soon be taken by them and advised Clint not to get involved.

What the gangsters did made Clint angry, so he took out his gun and fought a fierce battle with them. Finally, except for one servant who escaped by chance, the rest of the gangsters were either killed by Clint's gun or lost their combat effectiveness and were captured without any resistance.

The next day at noon, Clint took the captured villains to the center of the city, preparing to give the criminals a just punishment as all the residents witnessed. The angry people also demanded that these foreigners be severely punished. But at that moment, the leader of the villains suddenly revealed his identity: it was Blandy, the nephew of Waldo Kane, the most powerful boss of Los Pecados. His men had fled to Los Pecados last night to deliver a message that if anything happened to him, his uncle would raze this little town to the ground for good and everyone would be buried with him.

Blandy had just finished his words, the angry crowd suddenly calmed down. They knew Sin City and Waldo Kane, and they knew their way of doing things better. Very quickly, the inhabitants hesitated. They advocated for Blandy's release and hoped that Blandy would "forget" his unpleasant experience in town.

In the eyes of Clint, who hated evil the most, it was nothing more than a compromise to criminals and a trampling on justice. Despite opposition from the locals, he throws Blandy into prison and announces that he will hang him three days later to comfort the tavern owner who was shot by him.

After just three days, a large number of gangsters had arrived on the outskirts of the city. They brought a lot of weapons, demanding that the locals immediately hand over Blandy to them and offer a large ransom as an apology.

The security of the city was greatly threatened by these criminals. Clint boldly came out and called on everyone to take up arms to fight the gangs and defend their homeland. But what Clint didn't expect was that the residents and colleagues he had tried to protect in the past had no plans to live and die with him. Instead, they blamed Clint for his stubbornness and inflexibility, which brought disaster to the city. After a hasty vote, the townspeople relieve Clint of his post as sheriff and run him out of town.
The locals then released Blandy and handed over a large ransom. But even so, the fierce Blandy still chose betrayal, leading the gangs to occupy the city and preparing to burn it down.

By then, Clint had carried his bags and walked away from town. However, as the fire in the small town rose into the sky, Clint couldn't ignore it. Even if the people he had protected with his life and blood betrayed him, the law of justice in his mind could not be erased by this, let alone stand by and watch the gangsters massacre the city. Even if he was alone, Clint would fight crime until the end.

At the time when the gangsters were unscrupulously destroying the city, Clint appeared in the city as if a soldier came from the sky. His invincible marksmanship and incredible drawing speed have become the most terrible nightmare of night criminals. After a fierce battle, Clint was marked and the gangsters also suffered heavy losses, protecting Blandy, who was injured by Clint, to escape.
The surviving residents realized their mistakes and asked Clint for forgiveness, hoping that Clint would stay and protect the town.
But Clint just smiled and didn't answer. That night, Clint got on his old donkey, quietly left town and headed to Sin City.
He knew that if he didn't go find Kane, Kane would come find him.

He shares the same Japanese voice actor with Roger, Tsuyuzaki Wataru.

cyclops.accroche: A celestial traveler in the universe.
lore: In the far east of the Land of Dawn lies the uncharted Land of Giants, home to Cyclops, a one-eyed giant dwarf with a surprisingly small figure. As Cyclops grew he proved to be very different from the other giants, not only was he small in size but he was also unique. As such, unlike the other Giants, he couldn't really rely on brute strength.

However, Cyclops was obsessed with the stars and the sky since he was little. He looked at the sky day and night and, as a result, he discovered the truth: the planets were always in orbital motion. And he also realized that these kinds of movements contained incredible magical power. Equipped with an hourglass to charge and control this type of power, he became the famous "Starsoul Magician" of his homeland, granting him the ability to travel between space. The planetary movement would never stop, thus making Cyclops extremely powerful and invincible. Unfortunately, this realization made him feel quite alone.

One day, during Cyclops' space travel, he arrived in the Land of Dawn and found, to his surprise, that there were many powerful adversaries waiting for him to be defeated. Cyclops believed that wherever he went and what he saw, he would overcome. With the powerful magical powers of the planetary movement at his side, Cyclops ventured into the Land of Dawn, deciding that he would bring down his name as one of the greatest heroes who ever lived.
anecdotes: !This part should be read to those who don't read history and believe everything the internet says! The rumors that Cyclops held the galax are false and Moonton never mentioned that he was a great hero. Moonton only said that he holds concentrated energy and even stated that Cyclops is the smallest of his species. (Maybe the same height or a little taller than Harith). There were no old lore for him either, as he never received any changes related to his lore or backstory and his lore has been the same since his release. You can check his actual height and weight in MLA for more specific information.
Cyclops owes his name to the one-eyed giants of Greek mythology.

The term "dwarf-giant" is a size description used in astronomy to describe the size of a star. “Dwarf-Giant” refers to a star that is small compared to a normal star. This term can be used metaphorically to describe Cyclops as a dwarf, indicating that he is short compared to a normal Cyclops.

The item "Focused Energy" was once linked to Cyclops lore. In his splash art, you can see Cyclops holding this swirling energy, which is actually a gem causing destruction. After sealing it, the gem is now contained and called "Focused Energy".
He is the only mage in MLBB that does not rely on mana management, as his passive reduces cooldowns instead of using energy.
His skill names (Stardust Shock, Planets Attack, Star Power Lockdown) all relate to space and celestial bodies.

diggie.accroche: The owl scholar who can control the weather.
lore: It is known that scholars and thinkers from all over the world are finally coming together in the city of Antoinerei. This is where the often overlooked Diggie lives. Many don't take five seconds to turn to Diggie because of his small size, until they come across his research in chronoscience. Diggie loves clocks, he thinks these little mechanical toys hide many more secrets yet to be discovered.

Through the use of his "Time Nest", Diggie can control the flow of time. He is also able to free his friends from the physical chains of time, taking them with him. Be careful though, because if you make him angry, prepare yourself for the taste of a Hoot Hoot "Time Bomb!"
anecdotes: He, Akai, Bane, Sun and Chip are the only anthropomorphic heroes in the game.
Its design is inspired by owls, symbolizing wisdom and intelligence.

Diggie held the record for longest gap between hero release and new skin at almost 18 months (November 2017 - May 2019), but this record was later broken by Vale, who has not had a new skin since its release in January 2019 (Cerulean Wind) and was officially announced in January 2021 (Kannagi).
Diggie is the only hero where he can still be controlled by the player, even after death.
Its in-game file name is "digger".
Although Diggie's description states that he is male, he is voiced by a voice actress, Feena Glynn.
His vocal lines. “I have a clumsy new apprentice named Einstein,” refers to a famous scientist named Albert Einstein.
His vocal lines break the fourth wall.
Before Marcel's release, Diggie was the only pure support hero whose primary abilities did not include healing.

dyrroth.accroche: Once a noble prince of the Moniyan Empire, he was kidnapped by Alice, the Blood Demon Queen, and transformed into the Prince of the Abyss.
lore: Once a noble prince of the Moniyan Empire, he was kidnapped by Alice, the Blood Demon Queen and transformed into the Prince of the Abyss. Dyrroth, once the Prince of Light of the Moniyan Empire, has become the most defiant son of darkness in the Abyss. Bound by blood, his sister Silvanna never gave up her vigilant search for him, while Alice, his captor, meticulously shaped him into the fiercest and most loyal companion in the Abyss. Although not born of demonic blood, Dyrroth thrived in the depths of the Abyss by embracing its wild nature. In a realm where power is revered above all else, he deliberately precipitated his own corruption to prove his allegiance, reforging his flesh in darkness and severing all ties to the light. ===Blood and Birth=== Blood, everything in sight was bathed in crimson. At the highest point of the Sanguine Lair, a huge droplet of blood hung, suspended in the air like a still-beating heart. Sucking and pumping, drop by drop, until the flowing blood gathered in a pool, flooding everything in sight – this was Alice's pool to feed the Blood Demons.
Years later, Dyrroth returned here for the first time.

As he entered the pool, the crimson inside resonated with the blood in his body, bringing him back to the recent "Dawnbreak" plan – what should have been the perfect invasion. Leading the Abyssal forces as vanguard, Dyrroth had nearly submerged the entire Moniyan Empire in darkness during this moonless time. starless night.

Until her appearance, Princess Silvanna of the Empire, whose features subtly resembled her own, emerged amid the terrified prayers of countless citizens. Wielding her sacred spear, she called him "brother"....

Brother – a completely foreign word, but like a spell woven by fate, it made Dyrroth hesitate. It was just a fleeting moment, but Silvanna didn't hesitate. Victory was decided in that moment, as foreign as the word was to the dull pain of cold steel piercing his chest.
How laughable. This so-called blood bond... the first thing it brought to Dyrroth was bloodshed.
Blood trickling down his ankles, Dyrroth looked down at his legs, now twisted masses of grotesque muscle and bulging bone. Legs that could never belong to a human.

His body had long since completed its transformation, but the holy spear wound in his chest refused to heal... He had been seriously injured and was still alive only because Alice had taken him away from the battlefield. She had left him to recover alone in the Blood Lair, his stronghold in the Abyss where she had fed the Blood Demons – the very place where he had grown up.
Years ago, Alice had snatched him from the Empire when he was still a baby, and in doing so, she had also presented him with all of the Abyss as his birthright.

The past in Dyrroth's memories was not the justice his "sister" proclaimed while brandishing her sacred spear; what he remembered was the constant companionship of Alice, the teachings of Thamuz, and all of the Abyss rejoicing at the birth of the "Son of Darkness" – and all that had been destined since then.
Dyrroth would fight for the Abyss

He was not born a demon but those Moniyans who claimed to yearn for his return have already revealed it through their looks of terror and hatred. The Empire could never be his home. He had grown up in the Abyss and had long adopted its wild ways. The child of the Abyss was destined to fight for this.

Dyrroth threw his wrist blades into the pool of demonic blood. The transformation of the pool was supposed to be irreversible: it was birth and death. Blood Demons who had already been transformed had no reason to return, but Dyrroth craved power. Whether it was to get revenge on his "sister" or to return to the Abyss... The Abyss worshiped strength, and he knew he had to become stronger.
Dyrroth went down into the pool.

The crimson liquid surged, engulfing his body. His wrist blades, now filled with the power of the Abyss, pierced his still wounded chest. Suspended between life and death, the light of the Empire and the darkness of the Abyss clashed within him, tearing and tearing before finally merging into one. The boundary between death and rebirth dissipated and the light and darkness within him became forever inseparable.
Drop by drop, the hanging orb of blood projected its crimson essence into the pool, gradually synchronizing with Dyrroth's heartbeat.

Before dawn broke, Dyrroth opened his eyes and looked towards the Empire. Soon, he would return to the Moniyan Empire and show the world the might of the "Prince of the Abyss" with his overwhelming power. No longer hesitating, he would break with his own hands the blood ties that chained him, with blood in tribute to complete this great reunion.
"I awoke from the Abyss to extinguish the Light"
====Remarks====
anecdotes: Dyrroth's English voice actor, Joe Goffeney, reprises his role until February 2023 for providing exclusive voices of Dyrroth's Collector skin, making him the longest-running recurring voice actor for a single character in almost five years.
Dyrroth is one of the only heroes in the game to share a sibling buff with a specific opposing hero.

According to a Facebook post from MLBB, Dyrroth conquered and defeated Balmond and the orcs. Balmond surrendered to him, causing Balmond to fall to the power of Dyrroth. Balmond and the orcs were dominated, tormented and tyrannized by Dyrroth.
Dyrroth was called Dyrus, then Darius when he first released on the advanced server.
Its input voice was modified before being released to the original server.
His second skill, Specter Step, could previously throw the enemy, but it has been changed to reduce physical defense.
His Abysm Strike was called Destruction Rush before being changed to Abysm Strike. Probably because the name was already used for Layla's Destruction Rush.
Since Dyrroth is Silvanna's younger brother, all of his relatives are also his relatives.

lore: In the distant past, when the world was just being created, the Ancients built the Heavenly Palace above Sanctum Island in the Sea of ​​Hope.

The island was part of an underwater volcano. Submerged rocks and atolls were scattered around the island, and the waters nearby were often shrouded in thick sea fog, causing the wreck of many ships that ventured to pass by.

Isolated and unspoiled, the island was the ideal location for ancient wonders. The Ancients began building temples and workshops using their incredible skills and technologies. When the Heavenly Palace began to operate, the mechanisms of the temple on the island received energy waves from the palace, and thus the island on the ground began to coordinate with the palace above the sky.

Before the Endless War broke out, the Ancients attempted to control orders in the Land of Dawn. They sent Kaja and Uranus to arrest the unruly evil gods and imprison them in the Temple of Thunder on Sanctum Island, where a priestess loyal to the Ancients would lead her mecha guard "Phylax" and watch over them.

The mecha was powered by Primal Lightning, a unique magic that could control lightning with the power of the Ancients, and could only be performed by those specifically created by the Ancients. Among them are Kaja and Uranus at the top of the Heavenly Palace, as well as the priestess below on Sanctum Island.

The priestess was named Edith. She accepted the eternal youth and divine power granted by her masters and punished the prisoners with the merciless Primal Lightning. Hearing his name alone could make the most powerful evil gods cower in fear.

However, after the outbreak of the Endless War, the Ancients no longer used the Twilight Orb to seal darkness and light. Edith, the immortal Primal Warden, fell into a deep sleep as her masters disappeared.

Times have changed and survivors of the shipwreck have appeared on Sanctum Island. These poor people struggled to survive on this barren island, and many of them trudged across the island just to find scarce resources.

After a devastating earthquake, the ruins of a temple have been revealed. It was buried at the bottom of the valley and burned by lightning. While searching for metal debris, an old rag picker discovered the place, but instead found a blonde girl lying in the rubble. She could be struck by lightning at any moment!

The old man risked his life and brought the girl back to the seaside fishing village. Having been injured in the head, the girl only remembered her name: Edith. The childless old man took her in and they lived together in the small village.

Edith's adoptive father adored the girl he had miraculously found and spared no effort to take care of her. Edith could walk around the village when she didn't have to help with the household chores, but the old man had a rule: she couldn't go near the valley, he had a feeling that one day he would lose his daughter there...

When Edith was bored, she often looked up at the Heavenly Palace above: the villagers said it was the temple of the gods, and sometimes she could see strange bird-like people hovering in the sky with lightning. But every time she saw them, a strong feeling of uneasiness invaded her heart, because the past she had forgotten seemed linked to the sparks of lightning. So she always ran home and buried herself in her father's arms, calming down when the old man patted her hand.
Ten years have passed and the old man has become more fragile. The other children all grew up, except Edith who remained as young as when she was first found.
Eventually, his adoptive father was too old for physical labor. To survive, he had to break his self-imposed rule: he took Edith with him to collect metal debris from the ruins of the valley.

After searching the exterior in vain, the old man had to take the risk and enter the temple with Edith. As they sank deeper, Edith felt her memories resurface once again, and suddenly lightning struck as giant flying blades were fired at her father! Edith rushed forward and instinctively stopped the blades with her power, the blades plunging into the ground and splitting rocks with sparks of lightning.
Amidst the fire and dust, an elemental giant in golden armor appeared in front of Edith: “You have left your post, Edith!

It was... Uranus, the Guardian of the Heavenly Palace! At that precise moment, countless memories flooded Edith's mind: the Elders, the priests and priestesses, the temple, the evil gods... She screamed to dismiss the memories, but her mind was already absorbed in the past: the earthquake accidentally woke me up from my sleep, and it was the old man who raised me when I knew almost nothing...

“Die, invader!” Uranus waves its giant arm towards the old man, a series of flying blades shooting towards the ground! Quick as lightning, "Phylax" arrived as summoned and extended his powerful metal arm to catch the blades.
Edith spoke from "Phylax" the mech, "Let my father go." Uranus shouted at the mecha in front: “Traitor!
And Edith calmly replied: "Or let us fight to the death."

Among the ruins of the temple at the bottom of the valley, Edith and Uranus fought a fierce battle, roars of thunder echoing through the mountains as lightning crashed against each other, shattering stone pillars and statues.

While the two were still in a stalemate, a bird-like guardian of the Heavenly Palace, Kaja, closed its wings and descended upon the ruins, "Stop this senseless fight! The Heavenly Palace is in peril!" They looked up to the sky, and as expected, Edith could no longer feel the energy of the holy city. And soon, pieces began to fall from the sky – in the blink of an eye, the great Heavenly Palace began to collapse!
Since the fall of the palace, the temple on Sanctuary Island could no longer receive energy from above and the sealed evil gods began to flee.
Uranus ordered in a thunderous voice: "Kaja, we will stay and repair the seals!" Edith, stop the evil gods!
To this Edith replied: “I understand my duty. Let me send my father away first!
Kaja and Uranus remained in the temple valley to watch over the rest of the evil gods, while Edith drove her "Phylax" and took her adoptive father back to the village.

As Edith looked at her senile and trembling father, she could not stop the tears that ran down her cheeks. After ten years of living in a family, she was no longer the cold and heartless Primary Guardian.
I am his only child, his hope for the future. How will he continue to live if I leave now?
But the country was facing new crises due to the fall of the Heavenly Palace. Edith had to fulfill her duty as guardian and hunt down the fleeing evil gods.
Farewell, dear father! Please trust me, I will come back to you one day…
I promise!
Edith drove "Phylax" and flew to the Land of Dawn.

Later, many people in the Land of Dawn would claim to have seen a giant Mecha Guard. Whenever an evil God wreaked havoc on the world, Edith and her "Phylax" were there in an instant, punishing the dark forces mercilessly.

Between battles, the girl would break away from “Phylax” and look to the far-off northeast. On the horizon, mountains, rivers and seas, on an isolated island, an old man would also look longingly in the direction of his daughter...
anecdotes: Edith is a female given name derived from the Old English ēad, meaning wealth or prosperity, in combination with the Old English gȳð, meaning conflict or war. Technically, its name would mean “prosperous in war.”
Edith is the first hero to have the role of Tank/Marksman.

Edith was the 9th hero offered free to players upon release. The other free heroes are name = Faramis, name = Belerick, name = Silvana, name = Luo Yi, name = Benedetta, name = Mathilda, name = Phoveus and name = Floryn.

In ancient Greek, phylax (φύλαξ) means “observer, guard, sentinel, guardian, gatekeeper, or protector.”
Phylax was first introduced on an advanced server. It was later revealed that Edith was on his side following the leaks and early access servers.

According to the former character Phylax ("A former machine guard who executes all intruders on Sanctuary Island"), he is described as an executioner of all intruders. Phylax/Edith were also believed to come from Sanctuary Island, which she was later named Sanctuary Island.
Additionally, Phylax is described as an ancient machine rather than an ancient guard before indicating that Phylax is primarily focused.

lore: Astrologers, who constantly observe astrospace, possess the occult abilities to explain and predict everything that happens in the world, including its processes and outcomes. To become an astrologer, candidates must pass rigorous assessments, which will test both their willpower and their astrological abilities. As generations pass, the elders eventually choose Esmeralda, a young girl living in the Western Desert, to be a new successor in the Land of Dawn.

After becoming the successor of the astrologers, Esmeralda guards the coffin of Starmoon which is passed down from generation to generation. Hoping to open it and gain the mysterious power of ancient times, Esmeralda sets off for Minos' Labyrinth to discover the secrets of Starmoon's coffin. But unfortunately, as she heads towards the Labyrinth of Minos, the ground suddenly shakes and the desert collapses, followed by a storm of black sand. Suddenly, Starmoon's coffin opens and a flood of mysterious power fills Esmeralda. Under the protection of the mysterious power, Esmeralda suffers no harm and feels old memories returning to her mind. She feels Starmoon's coffin calling to her, reminding her that Khufra, the ruthless tyrant of the Western Desert long ago, has recovered. Following the lead of Starmoon's coffin, Esmeralda changes direction towards the deep desert, where there is an ancient city. After Starmoon's coffin is opened, two streams of power emanating from it begin to concentrate around Esmeralda: Frostmoon, enriched with magic, and Stardust, filled with great power. Impressed by the power of Starmoon's coffin, previously only spoken of in tales, Esmeralda recalls the memories of the first generation of astrologers. When Esmeralda approaches the ancient city, she vaguely senses an unknown love affair between Khufra and astrologers. Seeing the end of their love, Esmeralda feels sad and desolate. But his mission is to seal Khufra and bring peace to the Western Desert.
anecdotes: The name Esmeralda is of Spanish and Portuguese origin, meaning "emerald" (the precious green gemstone). It comes from the Spanish word esmeralda, itself derived from the Greek smaragdos (σμάραγδος), meaning “green gem”.
Its name complements its Starmoon Casket passive, representing the combination of stars (Stardust) and the moon (Frostmoon).

Esmeralda's name and character design are somewhat inspired by the character of the same name in the 1996 Disney film The Hunchback of Notre Dame, which itself is an adaptation of the 1831 novel by Victor Hugo.
Esmeralda is one of the heroes whose active skills can be launched using a joystick.
Esmeralda is the only hero capable of giving the enemy a shield.
Esmeralda wears gold jewelry, including bracelets, earrings, and a headpiece, which resemble traditional Middle Eastern fashion, especially Egyptian.
Her skin name "Cleopatra" is based on Queen Cleopatra of Egypt.
Her skin "Poison Vine" is based on Poison Ivy from the DC Universe.
Alongside Khufra, she has the first voice lines which can only be activated by interacting with a specific opposing hero (Khufra in this case).
Currently, Alice and Esmeralda are the only heroes in the game classified as both a Mage and a Tank.
She shares her Tank classification, as well as her Japanese language voice actor, Deguchi Mika, with Masha.

The current generation's elven king is the unique Estes, who was seriously injured in the Second Plain War and had to fall asleep deeply in the Emerald Forest. Since that day, the moon elves have lost the guidance of their king. When the flames of war between humans and orcs burned over this peaceful forest, the young Moonlight Archer, Miya, rose and gathered the rest of the elves to protect their homeland.

However, the dominator of the Dark Abyss is hungry for more believers, and the dark force has become stronger in secret. Seduced by the Blood Queen, Alice, young elves fell. The moon elf race was once again at stake, which outraged the great elf king! During a night of great thunder and lightning, Estes awoke. He is strict but caring and blessed with the power of sacred moonlight to protect his people and support his allies. With the Moonlight Code in his hands, he swore to repel any enemy who dared violate his homeland.

eudora.accroche: The elven mage who commands lightning with her fingertips to pierce prejudices and light the way forward.
lore: Although they have been integrated into human civilization for many years and their appearance and habits approximate those of humans, many Moniyan still show hostility and distrust towards the Light Elves. It was in a village where such racial tensions reigned that Eudora grew up.

Due to its proximity to the Monastery of Light, most of the inhabitants of this village followed the obsolete teachings of the monastery and were hostile towards the Elves of Light. The prejudices of the older generation also affected the children of the village, and Eudora was bullied and insulted by her peers for her unusual eyes and pointy ears for as long as she could remember, leading her to become a sensitive and withdrawn young elf. She had no friends and her only companion was a humble flower Silver Song.
Little lonely Eudora sat next to this flower for hours, sharing with it all her misfortunes and joys.

However, her only friend was ultimately destroyed by the cruel children of the village. A group of boys, who often teased Eudora, spotted Eudora talking to her floral friend one day and uprooted her on a cloudy afternoon, then bragged about it to anyone who would listen. When Eudora saw what they had done, she could no longer hold back her emotions. All the years of indignation and insults poured out of her body as pure rage, condensed into the power of lightning, and she nearly leveled the surrounding houses.
This was the awakening of Eudora's latent magical power, but because of this incident, her family had to leave the village and find a new home.

Eudora carried the burden of this painful memory with her as she grew up, and this emotional imbalance eventually became a huge obstacle in her struggle to control her magical power. Every time someone tried to insult her because of her appearance, the magical power in Eudora's body would spiral out of control, leaving her family with no choice but to leave to find another home.

Their nomadic lifestyle finally ended when they arrived in northern Moniyan. A tutor at the Magic Academy, named Theresa, discovered Eudora's magical talent and decided to bring her to the school to begin her formal training in the arcane arts. Although she did not want to be separated from her family, Eudora gladly accepted Theresa's invitation and enrolled in the Magic Academy, becoming an apprentice at the Ulturia School.

Under Theresa's guidance, Eudora absorbed all kinds of magical knowledge and quickly mastered the most powerful magic Theresa had to teach her. Over time, she gradually grew from a young apprentice to one of Ulturia School's most notable magic instructors. She let her hair grow long to try to hide her elven ears. Although she was respected by all who knew her, the scars of her youth remained hidden in her heart.

When Eudora's mentor Theresa, principal of Ulturia School, was about to retire, she announced to the public that Eudora would be taking over. But unexpectedly, this decision sparked intense controversy. Never in the history of the Magic Academy had an Elf headed a magic school and entered the academic committee. Many even thought it was a betrayal of the great prophet.

All this time, Eudora had believed that she would never face prejudice from the Magic Academy, but the doubts that surfaced upon hearing this news sent her heart into turmoil. The shadow of her childhood fell on her. Huge balls of lightning, carrying her heavy memories, crashed to the ground, bringing an abrupt end to the handover ceremony and all the trust Eudora had tried to build over the years.

She decided to give up her role as headmistress of Ulturia School and was ready to leave the Magic Academy and look for a new home where she could live without prejudice. But Theresa stopped Eudora in her tracks and gave her a true-seeing mirror that allowed her to see herself.
“Only what you care about can truly hurt you.”
“You care about your race, you care about your appearance…and therefore, you care about what other people say.”

Eudora stood in front of the mirror for a day and a night. These nightmarish childhood experiences and all the doubts surrounding the handover ceremony appeared to him one by one. The light in her eyes shone brightly, the electricity within her surging with no end in sight. Just as she was about to explode, it slowly dissipated, and all that remained when she looked in the mirror again was the calm, pointy-eared Elf she had been running from.
She now knew herself and had finally learned to face herself with peace in her heart.

Eudora cut off her long hair, which she had let grow for many years, and raised her elven ears high and proud. She vowed to return to Ulturia School and tell all those who could not accept her: I know who I am, and you will one day find out who I will become.
anecdotes: Eudora is the cheapest hero in the game, costing only 2000, along with Layla and Zilong.
Its name refers to one of the Hyades from Greek mythology. It is a brotherhood of nymphs who bring the rain.

As the name suggests, his skill, Ball Lightning, is based on the real and rare phenomenon, ball lightning, described as luminescent spherical objects that range in diameter from the size of a pea to several meters. Descriptions of ball lightning appear in various stories over the centuries and have captured the attention of scientists.
