grock.accroche: The stone man woke up from sleep.
lore: Deep in the mountains of the Land of Dawn lies an ancient fortress. Although its owner is unknown, rumor has it that it may be a descendant of the legendary race that once roamed the Dawnlands. It said that this race is older than the earth itself and that having a special affinity with nature, they were capable of forming deep bonds and relationships with various beings of nature, particularly the Stone Titans.

These friendly giants possess rocky skin almost impervious to any physical force, but due to their benevolent nature, they primarily use their physical prowess to sleep safely. These stone giants love to sleep so much that they sometimes hibernate for up to six months. However, once they wake up, it is difficult for them to go back to sleep. One day, when Grock woke up, he found himself alone with the long-lost keepers of the fortress. He then saddled the fortress on his back to find the owners, traveling throughout the Land of Dawn to find news of their fate, so that he could one day return their home to them.
anecdotes: Grock's design is heavily influenced by golems, which are stone or earth-based protectors in mythology and fantasy.
Grock is the first hero in the game to summon a physical wall.

guinevere.accroche: Aristocratic girl with a strange temperament, loved by her older brother Lancelot.
lore: The Baroque family is one of the few nobles in the Land of Dawn. Their most prestigious skill, swordsmanship, the family's strong suit, discourages countless opponents from even thinking about attacking. In addition, beauty and wisdom are also the most perfect genetic signs of the Baroque family, just like Violette's eternal beauty and love.

As famous as the Baroque family's fencing is, young Guinevere doesn't like it at all. Just like other girls, she naturally loves beautiful things. From her youth, she was sent to the Magic Academy. Relying on her own sensitive spiritual perception and anti-gravity magic, when Guinevere was 10 years old, she successfully combined mental perception with super energy and invented multiple magical effects - super magical power. Such a breakthrough made Guinevere more passionate about magic and she often experimented with her new magic on her brother Lancelot. No matter how Lancelot hides, he will be found by his sister. Therefore, Lancelot is often caught in an unknown thrill. As a child, his sister always gave him headaches. Regardless, Lancelot still loves Guinevere. He always shows a smile to his beloved sister. But every time Lancelot thought of his little sister's magical experience, he wore a bitter smile.

Recently, something has been tormenting Guinevere, making her uncomfortable. It is said that the Paxley nobles, who have very high magical status, proposed marriage to the Baroque family. Guinevere is undoubtedly the most suitable choice and Guinevere's father seems very amenable to this marriage. But Guinevere, reluctant, suddenly has an idea: she hopes to find her brother Lancelot...
anecdotes: Originally in the Arthurian tales, the character Guinevere is supposed to be the wife of King Arthur and is said to have had an illicit affair with one of his knights, Lancelot. However, in the game, they are siblings.
Guinièvre's "Fleur de Bleau" means "Blue Flower" in French.
Even though her "Fleur de Bleau" hair color is brown on the splash art, the hair color on the model is actually blonde.
Guinevere was officially released on February 21, 2019 on the official server and is the 80th hero.
Guinevere has one of the longest CC chain durations in the game at around 3.5 seconds to 4 seconds.

While still on the advanced server, 2-3 days before Guinevere's initial release, she could ignore turret damage reduction and deal massive damage to turrets with Space Migration and Purple Requiem. But this controlled bug was fixed shortly after.
Guinevere uses two different types of unique magic called Super Magic and Anti-Gravity Magic.

According to one of the VFX artists who worked on the effects of Guinevere's KOF skill, her space migration (KOF) originally had a trace when she dashed; it was scrapped because it would destroy the style of the King of Fighters franchise and didn't really fit Athena's character.

The name Guinevere has its roots in Welsh and is derived from the elements “gwen” and “ever”. "Gwen" means "fair", "white" or "blessed" in Welsh. It is often associated with purity, beauty and goodness. “Ever” comes from the Welsh word “hwyfar”, meaning “smooth” or “soft”.

Given her regal and noble characteristics, combined with the historical context of King Arthur's reign, Guinevere's nationality would most likely align with that of the British, representing the royal aristocracy and legendary nature of Arthurian tales.
The Baroque house is the oldest ducal family having existed since the beginning of the Moniyan empire.

lore: Rebellious Son of House Paxley Although born into the most powerful magical family on the continent, Gusion has no interest in magic. He is keen to draw inspiration from the sacred light to develop new combat skills. Eventually, Gusion left the family. ===Patriarchs and big brother... Do you really know me?===
House Paxley ruled Aberleen Castle, south of Moniyan. Generations of the house had guarded these areas for the Moniyan Empire, defending against invasion from the Abyss.
About a thousand years ago, House Paxley was granted the dukedom during the reign of the legendary mage Valentina.
Many horrible stories were told across the Moniyan Empire of House Paxley's use of forbidden magic, and so people avoided any Paxley they encountered.
But Gusion Paxley was an exception.

He was naturally skilled with blades and daggers, and before he could speak, he had been able to accurately strike his nanny in the forehead with a toy dagger in revenge for disciplining her. And when he began to read and write, the ink-dipped quill always flew toward the back of his personal tutor's head as if it had eyes.

His unruly behaviors continued until his older brother Aamon took control of the duchy – young Gusion was showing off his dagger skills at the party when he accidentally missed his target, the dagger instead leaving a deep cut on Aamon's face.

Aamon did not blame his careless younger brother, but word quickly spread throughout the Moniyan Empire that the fourth child of House Paxley was a blade-wielder - for the Paxley family who were famous for their magical skills, only lower-class citizens who did not know magic would fight with daggers and swords.

The Paxley elders who actually controlled the family soon ordered Gusion to stop playing with daggers and concentrate on practicing magic. And Gusion actually inherited the family's magical talent. He had a strong affinity for the element of light and quickly awakened his potential while learning magic. But he hated memorizing tedious spells and writing complicated scrolls. When the other students were researching magic indoors all day, Gusion powered himself with sunlight so he could run faster than a leopard, or used candlelight to move knives and cut an entire table's dishes into pieces.

Gusion was the only upperclassman who spoke with the servants at their family academy, and he was a naughty but friendly child, so the servants always covered up his incessant violation of the rules; even when he was kept in solitary confinement, the guards pretended not to see the desserts that the servants slipped under the door...

Eventually, these exasperated elders asked young Aamon to discipline his desperate brother. Gusion hoped his brother would be on his side, but Aamon instead began lecturing him as the head of the family.

Gusion was disappointed and completely ignored his brother's lessons, while feeling deeply sorry for the big brother who was close to him – Aamon in front of him was clearly one of the elders, only the youngest...

And during their dinner together, Aamon persuaded Gusion to follow family traditions and accept training in magic, as Valentina, the first duchess of their family, was a great mage herself. Aamon also told Gusion that he could become an assassin like him, transforming magic into sharp blades.
Gusion felt strongly reluctant and instead asked, "Can't a Paxley become an assassin who fights with blades?"
Aamon had no choice but to say, “As a noble, sometimes you will have to hide what you truly love…”
Gusion looked at his brother and did not speak further.

A few years later, during his coming-of-age ceremony, a family fighting competition, the 18-year-old Gusion appeared in the arena in a unique style: he used bizarre and fanciful movements to dodge projectiles fired by the other young mages, while his swift and mysterious dagger precisely struck his opponents before they could even cast their spells. The elders of House Paxley were stunned: Gusion was an unconventional blade wielder, but he did indeed use magical powers to control the dagger...

The other young mages lost to Gusion began to accuse him of "cheating", but he instead provoked them further, claiming that those who felt unfair could challenge him together, as he was capable of defeating ten cocky Paxley mages!

The provoked competitors rushed towards him, when Gusion suddenly used a move no one had seen before: he swung his arm and sent daggers flying towards the fan-shaped area ahead, hitting any enemies that charged him. Then he jumped onto the spectator stand, before throwing a dagger at the statue of House Paxley ancestor Valentina and hitting her in the forehead to provoke the others!
“It’s what you want – it’s just like the motto of House Paxley: fear over love.”

After Gusion shouted these angry words, the exasperated elders began chanting spells, attempting to punish the rebel of House Paxley with magic. Aamon, who had remained silent, then stood out and announced loudly: Gusion was going to be kicked out of the family for seriously breaking their rules!
Now that Aamon had expelled his brother, the elders who were ready to kill Gusion had to stop their dark magic spells, watching Gusion walk out of the arena without sparing them a glance.

What would its future be? Gusion had never thought about it. He felt a heavy weight lifted from his shoulders, confident that with his abilities, he would one day make a name for himself in the Land of Dawn.
Aamon thought as he watched Gusion walk away: “What I can do is give you your freedom back…”
===Destiny Deniers===
anecdotes: In the initial version of Gusion, he was originally known as Gossen. His name was later changed to Gusion in later updates.
In demonology, Gusion is the eleventh of the 72 demons of Goetia. He is a powerful Grand Duke of Hell and rules over forty legions of demons.
The names of Gusion and his brother Aamon are derived from the writings of The Lesser Key of Solomon.
Gusion was the first hero to deal physical and magical damage with his skills. (Physical: passive skill; Magic: all active skills) His rework allowed his passive to deal magic damage.
Gusion is the first hero whose active skills include second phases.

In 2018, Gusion used the word "bullshit" in the now-deleted cinematic trailer (only removed on the official MLBB YouTube page, but the official Facebook page is still up as of June 6, 2023), marking the first time profanity has appeared in official Mobile Legends media, which would thankfully be par for the course for a game rated T by the ESRB for the Americas.
The Elders who know the prophecy wanted to kill Gusion to prevent the God from being reborn. This is because Gusion is cursed by the god of trickery "Kalon".

hanabi.accroche: Leader of the Scarlet Sect, in the Scarlet Shadow of the Riverlands of Cadia.
lore: Leader of the Scarlet Sect, in the Scarlet Shadow in the Riverlands of Cadia. As the owner of the Higanbana, one of the Seven Great Armaments of the Scarlet Shadow Clan, Hanabi is the pride of the Scarlet Sect. To perpetuate her father's will, she has sought power since childhood. Because of her single-minded focus, she closed herself off from all feelings and emotions. Despite this, she was never truly accepted by Higanbana. One day, while pursuing an enemy spy and losing ground, she accidentally entered Higanbana's world and lingered between illusion and reality. Eventually, she understood that power without emotion was volatile and fleeting. She came to terms with herself and embraced her feelings and desires by becoming one with Higanbana. === The shore ===

"The Higanbana blooms on the shore, as if consumed by flames. Unable to let go of their obsessions, lost souls plunge into the abyss. They no longer remember their past lives and the future is a mystery. They are drawn to this place, which condemns them to hell." —Higanbana, Seven Armaments of the Scarlet Shadow
Hanabi knew the river well.

Dark and icy, but peaceful. She floated above the water as if suspended in mid-air. A thick, impenetrable mist swirled all around her. In the darkness, the only light was a group of Higanbana in the distance. They were a bright, piercing purple, red as hellfire, like fire burning on a distant shore she would never reach.

It was a recurring nightmare that Hanabi had been experiencing since she was 7 years old. This was the year when, due to her inherent talent for cultivation, she unintentionally activated the Scarlet's ancient weaponry, "Higanbana". All she remembered was being swallowed up by the weapon and falling into a vast, nightmarish abyss. When she woke up, her eyes were filled with tears, but despite this, the crowd that had gathered before her were cheering and congratulating her for becoming the one deemed worthy of being Scarlet's successor.

Even at her young age, Hanabi realized what this meant: within the Scarlet Shadow, there was the Scarlet Sect, which favored the use of weapons, and the Shadow Sect, with a predilection for Ninjutsu. For generations, each fought to dominate the other. And if the Scarlet Leader wins, the Scarlet Sect wins. All young Hanabi could do was place her trust in the sect and its plan. So she took on this solemn duty and did her best to hold her head high. Day after day she trained, rivulets of sweat running down her body from sunrise to sunset. In competition, Hanabi was undefeated. Over time, she grew accustomed to victory and the dark river that bloomed in her dreams. She knew that when she reached this shore, she would harness the power of Higanbana and then truly become the leader of the Scarlet Sect.
This all ended with the appearance of Hayabusa.

Of all the notable individuals in the Shadow Sect, Hayabusa was the most distinguished. Like an apparition, he appeared during competitions, quickly defeated his opponents and left without uttering a single word. It was like he wasn't even interested in competitions. Hanabi often stalked Hayabusa and challenged him to a fight. As they clashed, they both fled across mountain streams and over thatched roofs, their blades clashing and clanging more times than could be counted. However, in the end, Hanabi would still be defeated and the Black River would begin to swell, with water reaching its banks. With each defeat, Hanabi, filled with resignation, asked Hayabusa how he managed to surpass her, and each time he only shrugged his shoulders and said:
“Because… the moon is beautiful tonight.”

The unfettered arrogance and utter frivolity of his response made Hanabi blinded with rage. She couldn't lose, just like the Scarlet Sect. She threw herself even further into her training; she would do whatever it took to reach that distant shore.
Then, one day, disaster struck.

Hanzo, one of Scarlet Shadow's most powerful ninjas, fled with Ame no Habakiri, making himself an enemy of both Scarlet and Shadow. Together, the two sects sent their best warriors to hunt Hanzo. This was Hanabi's first time fighting with Hayabusa on the same side, and she wasn't going to miss this opportunity to redeem herself. She would find Hanzo alone, without any help from Hayabusa. However, after locating Hanzo, he proved more pernicious than Hanabi anticipated. Unable to withstand a frontal attack from the Ame no Habakiri, Hanabi struggled to continue escaping. She could feel herself slipping, and as the blade passed through her throat, she remembered the dark river.
She couldn't lose, just like the Scarlet Sect. She had to win.
Pledging her eternal allegiance to Higanbana, Hanabi offered her own body.

At the moment of his death, an immense power swept away Hanabi like a raging tsunami, and in that moment, she understood that Hanzo had pledged allegiance to Ame no Habakiri in exchange for this power. I didn't have time to think any further. Hanabi rushed towards Hanzo. Amidst a flurry of cuts, cuts, and stabs, Hanabi's vision began to blur, but she could make out her opponent stumbling backwards. She had won! However, the waters began to surge and she found herself submerged once again in that familiar dark river.

Far from calming down, the river raged with greater ferocity as monstrous waves crashed one after another, dragging Hanabi to the bottom of the riverbed. Such was the fate of countless souls who had been locked within this weapon. Every ounce of their pain and resentment turned into an insurmountable power that enslaved all who entered, keeping them trapped inside forever. It was the land of the dead, a land from which there was no escape.
Earn! Earn! Earn!

The crashing waves echoed in his ears, the sound almost like a chorus. She fought with all her strength, but Hanabi was unable to escape. This burning flower that was once so far away was now so close, but it still remained out of his reach. Little by little, she sank deeper...
Hanabi! Hanabi! Hanabi!
The sound of Hayabusa's voice pierced the void, bringing Hanabi back from the abyss. Ignoring the souls of the dead pressed against her throat, she raised her head.
The moonlight reflected off the surface of the river. It was magnificent.

What was once pure darkness was now exposed to light. The dead retreated and the raging waters calmed until all was calm again. The first Scarlet Chieftain was the first owner of the armaments. In his incessant quest for power, he was not there for his wife in her final moments. The world was his, but he had lost everything. Therefore, he went crazy. In his mania, he locked all his power and all his sorrow into Higanbana.

Hanabi could finally see that the shore was no longer far away. It was before his eyes. She had won. In the distance, she looked at the flowers that grew at the end of the river. Hidden among them, she could see the faint figure of the first scarlet chief and his wife, standing side by side in the moonlight. The Scarlet Shadow had sacrificed everything for victory. Now, at that moment, it was clear that their sacrifices had not been in vain.
As Hanabi gradually came to his senses, Hayabusa took her away, while Hanzo managed to escape. They were in no condition to pursue them, but it was just a simple setback, nothing more.

Higanbana rested gently in Hanabi's hand. She had unlocked its secrets and become its owner. Freed from her obsessions and inner demons, Hanabi was able to truly see Hayabusa, her former adversary, clearly for the first time. She finally understood what he had been telling her all along: there are things in this world more precious than winning.
Although she didn't know exactly how to proceed, she also knew that she no longer needed advice from others. Whichever direction she took, all paths led to her shore.
She raised her head and looked up at the night sky. The moon was beautiful this evening. »
===Higanbana ===
anecdotes: The name Hanabi (花火) is of Japanese origin and means "fireworks" (花 = "flower", 火 = "fire"). It symbolizes beauty, fleeting moments and explosive power.
Her petal-shaped energy shurikens resemble fireworks as they bounce between enemies. His ultimate, Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana, explodes like fireworks, stunning several enemies.
The name of Hanabi and Ultimate's weapon, Higanbana, refers to the Japanese common name of the plant Lycoris radiata, known in English as the red spider lily or equinox flower.

Hanabi and name = entry quote from Hayabusa, Sanjou (in the English and Japanese audios), as well as Hanzo (in the Japanese audio, pre-recast), is a Japanese term that roughly translates to "I have arrived" or "I am here". In the context of ninjas, "Sanjou" is often used as a declaration of arrival or as a means of announcing one's presence. It is a way for the ninja to assert his presence and let others know that he is ready to take action.
Hanabi's "Fiery Moth" skin is inspired by Japanese folklore. Moths are sometimes thought to carry the spirits of the dead, which fits Hanabi's Higanbana (flower of death) theme.
Hanabi's Rakshesha skin is inspired by the Rakshasa (राक्षस), which are demonic entities in Hindu and Buddhist mythology.
She is somewhat inspired by Coco from Magic Rush: Heroes.

Hanabi's design is inspired by the kunoichi (female ninja) from Japanese folklore. His rival, Hayabusa, has samurai-like discipline, while Hanabi embodies the archetypal rogue ninja who pursues forbidden techniques.
She shares her Japanese voice actor, Ono Saki, with Fanny.

hanzo.accroche: Awesome Shadow Sect ninja who is at a crossroads.
lore: Shadow Sect genius ninja at a crossroads A Shadow Sect genius ninja in the Scarlet Shadow. In order to pursue great power, he absorbed the "Hanekage" into his body and used the enemy's flesh and blood to nourish the "Hanekage". After gaining power, he took the strongest supreme ninjutsu and Ame no Habakiri into the Scarlet Shadow, and went further and further on the path of killing. ===Nindo's End=== "Protecting the secrets of the Sacred Tools is your duty; value it more than your life."

As Hanzo awoke in the middle of the night from the pain inflicted by the Ame no Habakiri, he remembered this teaching that had led him down this path of no return. Before turning his back on Scarlet Shadow, Hanzo was the sharpest blade in the Shadow Sect.

Adopted by the Shadow Sect at a young age, Hanzo was lucky to escape the fate of a wandering beggar. He learned the ways of Nindo, to “uphold justice and endure hardship,” and lived his new life according to his teachings. For the Scarlet Shadow, his beloved home, he was ready to do anything.

Fierce and tenacious like a wolf, Hanzo has always embarked on the most perilous missions. Even when he returned with serious injuries, he made his full report before seeking treatment. Failure was something even Hanzo's greatest rivals wouldn't dare think about. They knew Hanzo would stop at nothing to achieve his goals.

Over the course of a decade, Hanzo accumulated so much merit that his peers considered him, a commoner by birth, second only to Kurēn, the next heir of the clan. Hanzo recognized Kurēn's unparalleled wisdom. If Kurēn swore to defend Nindo after taking power, then Hanzo would become his sharpest blade.
Until now, Hanzo had never thought his past was wrong, but it was his near-obsessive persistence that brought him to this point.

Some time ago, Hanzo, while immersed in the Nindo scriptures, suddenly realized that his peers, other orphans adopted by the clan, had been regularly disappearing without any explanation. Very perplexed, Hanzo began to investigate alone. During his research, he came across several elders, which resulted in him being stripped of all rank in the clan. The merits he acquired at the risk of his life were erased overnight. Hanzo cared little for fame, but he knew something sinister was being concealed. Eventually, he discovered that the ancients had sent ninjas on a mission to the Forbidden Grounds to steal a cursed tool that was supposedly sealed within: the demon blade Ame no Habakiri.
Countless lives were sacrificed to the demonic blade. Hanzo couldn't bear to think how many members of the Scarlet Shadow who simply sought to uphold justice ended up with this fate.
A momentary lapse in concentration led to Hanzo being discovered by another ninja in the Forbidden Grounds: it was Kurēn.

In the dark, stone chamber, Kurēn revealed the truth about the Scarlet Shadow: the two factions of the clan vied for control of the Seven Sacred Tools, each attempting to tip the balance of power in their favor. The elders of the Shadow Sect sacrificed their own to the Ame no Habakiri in order to awaken its true power.

Kurēn had secretly gained influence to abolish this vile practice once he became the leader of the clan, and seeing Hanzo, he was eager for a ninja from Nindo to help him change the future of the clan.
“Those who were sacrificed to Ame no Habakiri...what about their future?”

Kurēn had no answer to his question, which made Hanzo angry. He had seen too many hypocrites pretending to act for the common good, and in that moment he realized that the Scarlet Shadow was no different. His Nindo did not tolerate bad deeds, so the Scarlet Shadow should not exist. If they craved Ame no Habakiri's power so much, he would show them his true might.
As Hanzo grabbed the demon blade from the pedestal, he thought, "Come, either devour me, or let me devour everything!"

The moment he grabbed the Ame no Habakiri, its unbridled demonic power invaded his body. In a trance, he saw a whirlwind swallowing ships, or was it a leviathan devouring entire islands? Quickly he realized what he was really seeing:

It was a vortex of souls; the ninjas who had been sacrificed, and countless others before them. Their wills had long since been erased, leaving only insatiable hunger and restless darkness within the blade; a madness that was neither human nor demonic.
Demonic power invaded Hanzo's very being, but his pride refused to be consumed. Feeding on his rage and obsession, he eventually tamed the Ame no Habakiri.
“Naive President, you will witness my reign from this blade.”

And with that, Hanzo swung the blade at his former comrade Kurēn. "Gaining influence"... is just a cowardly compromise of the weak. Without the courage to take the first step, change would never happen.

After devouring Kurēn, Hanzo left the forbidden grounds. He knew that his path as a Shadow Sect ninja was broken forever. But what about it? This Akuma will eliminate the Scarlet Shadow's rot once and for all.
anecdotes: The name Hanzo was borne by the infamous ninja Hanzō Hattori, nicknamed Oni no Hanzō (Demon Hanzō).
The name is derived from the letter 半 (han) meaning "half" and 蔵 (zō/zou) meaning "to hide".

Its title, Akuma Ninja, is derived from the word "Akuma" (悪魔), which translates to devil, demon or evil spirit in English. It is formed from the combination of two Japanese characters: "aku" (悪), which means "bad" or "evil", and "ma" (魔), which means "spirit", "magic" or "ghost". This perfectly shows his power-hungry character as an evil ninja.
According to Japanese mythology, Ame no Habakiri is one of the 4 Totsuka swords. Ame no Habakiri was used by Susanoo to kill Yamata no Orochi.
The Japanese word written on its back is Fū which translates to “seal”.
Certain aspects of Hanzo's armor and mask resemble the Tengu, mythical creatures who were feared and respected as powerful ninja-like beings.
Hanzo has one of the fastest jungles as his first skill (Ninjutsu: Demon Feast) instantly eats jungle monsters, gaining buffs faster than most heroes.

harith.accroche: Leonine boy from Azrya in the Moniyan Empire.
lore: Legends say that an ancient race of elves reside in the enchanted forest of the Land of Dawn. Stories often describe this feline breed as small, agile, playful, independent, and very intelligent. However, few people know of the long-standing alliance between the Leonine Elves and the Moon Elves.

From a young age, Harith surpassed his peers in talent and wisdom. He quickly became the most powerful mage among the Leonins, perhaps as strong as the other mages in the Land of Dawn. However, the Leonins never leave the Enchanted Forest, living a peaceful and safe life alone. The Leonines became so complacent with their happy existence that they no longer indulged in the magical arts, a hallmark of their people. Harith became very unhappy with this trend and confidently left the Enchanted Forest to see the outside world at the young age of 15. Harith was driven by his passion for the magical arts, aspiring to become the leader of his people in matters of magic.

Harith arrived in the Moniyan Empire, where he joined the armies to fight the orcish invaders. Proving himself in battle, Harith gained the recognition of Tigreal, who came to appreciate Harith's beautiful spirit and strong abilities. People say that Harith has been given the rank of lieutenant and will soon be appointed as the Imperial Magic Master of the Moniyan Empire. That said, Harith has Imperial permission to use magic to control space and time to unlock the secrets of the dawn to seal away evil and protect justice.

Full of enthusiasm and fervor, Harith also knew that once named Master of Magic, he would become the target of public criticism. True to his dream of becoming the leader of his people in matters of magic, Harith moved forward alone and without fear. As time passed, Harith found his life consumed by his mission and the empire. Harith slowly became lonely and reclusive. Even when he met his comrade Léonine, Nana, he was unable to maintain a normal conversation. Although Nana showed signs of affection towards him, he could not express his feelings, believing that the best way to protect her from criticism was for him to be alone. After all, whenever the empire needed magical aid, the Master of Magic was there to ward off the dangers of evil.
anecdotes: Harith's passive "Key Insight" was capable of increasing his resilience.
Although Harith is a mage, his primary role is often played in the Gold Lane rather than the Mid Lane.

Harith is the first hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin when EVOS Legends won the M1 World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Lancelot, Estes, Chou, Brody, and Joy.

Harith also has a Hunter × Hunter collaboration skin with Killua, whose English voice in the 2011 anime, Cristina Vee, is shared with the game's announcer and with older versions of Kagura and Lolita.

harley.accroche: The young mage whose awakened powers were once put in danger and who now arrives at the Magic Academy to study.
lore: The young mage whose awakened powers were once put in danger and who now arrives at the Magic Academy to study the heir to Castle Grandrock, Harley was of average talent and was not regarded with any importance by the Duke of Vance, his father. However, he was always very close to his sister Lesley. To attract his father's attention, he practiced conjuring to make it appear as if he had magical abilities. However, this had the unexpected result of getting him kidnapped. Lesley rushed to his aid, and in the midst of his crisis, his powerful magical powers awoke. The two men then fought their way out. Eventually, Leslie sent Harley to live and study at the Magic Academy. === Magic Awakens === As the only son of Duke Vance, Harley lost his mother shortly after his birth; and in this political battle, Lesley's father, the leader of the Duke's guards, also gave his life to protect the Duke.
In order to repay her kindness, Duke Vance adopted Lesley as his own daughter and trained her to become the best sniper in the Moniyan Empire.

Harley, on the other hand, as the only heir of the Vance family for whom people had high hopes, possessed neither the talent for magic nor combat. Duke Vance was extremely disappointed in him. He rarely paid attention to Harley. Instead, he turned to marrying allies to consolidate his power and cultivate new heirs, a series of actions that amounted to abandoning Harley altogether.
But the innocent Harley did not understand the complex methods of adults, and he took full advantage of a carefree childhood.

Harley's personality was a bit eccentric. He preferred to do things that interested him alone rather than play with others, but Lesley was an exception. Harley saw that almost everyone was avoiding Lesley and she seemed worried all day. Harley always stayed by Lesley's side, doing her best to make her happy.

By being together day after day, the relationship between the two deepened. Harley also noticed that although Lesley had a serious personality and rarely smiled, she was actually a very gentle person, especially towards him. She has always been extremely tolerant and forgiving.

But despite this, Harley still desperately needed her father's love. He always asked Lesley how he could make his father like him, but Lesley never had the heart to tell him that the cold-blooded Duke Vance had long since cast him aside.
One day, excited little Harley found Lesley and said, "Lesley! I can do magic!"
Lesley was very surprised. If this were true, then Duke Vance might change his mind. She told Harley, "Really? Show me now!"

Harley proudly straightened his bow tie and stood in front of Lesley. He took out a hat, gently tapped the hat with a "magic wand", and dozens of little birds came out. Harley then reached into the hat with her hand and, unbelievably, pulled out a cute little white bunny. Then he put down the hat, walked over to Lesley, and took out a dazzling red rose from behind her ear. Lesley smiled, accepted Harley's rose and said, "That's amazing!"
Despite all this, the sharp-eyed Lesley had realized that these were just tricks Harley was doing. It wasn't real magic.
"What do you think? If my father found out that I can do magic, would he start to like me?" Harley asked Lesley excitedly. He was very satisfied with his performance.
"Certainly, but your magic isn't fully developed yet. You should practice more." Lesley couldn't bear to hurt Harley and didn't want him to be scolded by Duke Vance, so that was all she could say.
Harley also felt that what Lesley said made sense, and he returned happily holding the rabbit.

After that, Harley would often drag others to watch her "magical" performances together. Everyone saw that his magic was just tricks, but they didn't say anything. They were just pleasing little Harley to make him happy.
But the news that little Harley could do “magic” was spread by malicious people. One rainy and windy night, Duke Vance's political opponents sent someone to take Harley away.

Little Harley's tricks were of no use in a real fight. He cried, wanting to escape, but was gagged with a piece of cotton cloth. He was blindfolded, had his hands and feet tied, and was locked in a dark dungeon.

Harley's captors made Harley a hostage and wanted to negotiate terms with Duke Vance. What they didn't expect was that Duke Vance would immediately refuse them. To him, Harley was just a pawn who could be sacrificed at any time. But Lesley wasn't ready to give up on Harley. For the first time, she violated the Duke's orders and broke into the dungeon where Harley was being held alone.
In the darkness, Harley heard the sound of a sniper rifle and Lesley's cry: "Don't worry! Harley! I'll save you no matter what!"

Harley struggled to lower her blindfold and saw Lesley standing firmly in front of the cell door, accurately shooting any enemies that tried to approach. But even so, the enemies still managed to hurt Lesley one after another. Harley deeply regretted pretending to know magic and causing all this trouble. He was even more afraid of being the one who could cause the death of the only parent he cared about.
At that moment, a dark arrow struck out of nowhere, blinding Lesley's left eye. Seeing this, Harley cried and wanted to come to Lesley's side, but her bound hands and feet made him helpless.

In the darkness, Harley felt a force surge from her body. At this moment, a violent fire burned the ropes on his body. Harley got up and ran towards Lesley. With a simple wave of his hand, he managed to reduce all approaching enemies to ashes. Contrary to expectations, Harley truly had a gift for magic. This ability awakened at a time of crisis and the power was enormous.
Eventually, the two siblings worked together to break out of the encirclement.
Lesley took Harley all the way north to the northern port of Castle Grandrock and boarded a large ship for the Magic Academy.
“Lesley, aren’t we going home?” Harley was surprised by Lesley's action.
“Do you like this house?” Lesley did not answer his question.
Harley lowered her head, thought for a long time, and said, "I love my sister more."
Lesley smiled and rubbed Harley's head, "Then we won't go home. The Magic Academy is a sacred place for all magicians in the world. You will live a very happy life there."
“Will you come with me?”
“We will always be together.”
Harley, arriving at the Magic Academy, woke up and found that Lesley was missing, and only a note was left behind:
Live well and wait for me to come and get you.
Lesley returned to Grandrock Castle and reported the entire incident to Duke Vance. She tried to bear the blame as best she could, but to her surprise, Duke Vance did not punish her.
He told Lesley to step down, then he hired more assistants.
"The plan has changed. Our next plan will revolve around Harley..."
anecdotes: The name Harley is of Old English origin and means "hare's meadow" or "rocky glade". He is commonly associated with being playful and mischievous, which fits with his trickster magician theme.
His name may be inspired by Harlequin, a classic jester and trickster character from European theater and Western comics.
His hat, cape and cards resemble famous stage magicians like Harry Houdini.
Harley “Naughty Joker” skin resembles the medieval court jesters who entertained kings with tricks and performances. She also recalls the Joker from the Batman series.

Harley's "Royal Magister" skin is heavily inspired by European royal court magicians, noble wizards, and fantasy aristocrats. Harley's fancy coat, tie, and gold ornaments resemble the European aristocracy of the Baroque and Rococo periods.
His aesthetic and abilities resemble other playing card-based characters in games and media, such as Twisted Fate from League of Legends or the trickster theme from Joker.
The pre-redesign Harley had an adult voice, which was the same voice as the pre-2020 Alucard. Although her Dream Caster skin still had adult voice lines.
He shares his Japanese voice actor, Matsumoto Sachi, with Diggie and Rafaela.

hayabusa.accroche: The young leader of the Shadow Sect who wields his blade during moonless nights, traveling the path of nindo without fear.
lore: Leader of the Shadow Sect of the Scarlet Shadow, in the Riverlands of Cadia. As the second heir of the Crimson Shadow Sect, Hayabusa had always looked up to his brother, a figure he viewed as the moon itself. To preserve the delicate balance of power between the Shadow and Scarlet Sects, Hayabusa willingly took his brother's place to be a political pawn and hostage, to be raised within the rival Scarlet Sect. Every day spent in the Scarlet Sect, Hayabusa lived by his brother's principles. He mastered his unique Shadow Shuriken technique and forged an unbreakable bond with Hanabi, a kunoichi of the Scarlet Sect. But when Hanzo's betrayal and his brother's disappearance shattered their hopes for peace, Hayabusa realized that the moonlight that had always guided him was gone. Yet he held his blade tightly, determined to advance through the shadows, following his brother's nindo. ===Shadow and Moon=== When the clouds obscure the moon,
Where will the shadows find their place?

As descendants of the Shadow Sect, Hayabusa and his brother underwent rigorous training from childhood. Even as a young boy, Hayabusa knew that his brother's skills far exceeded his own. But what really seemed beyond his reach was his brother's vision of nindo, ninja-style: integrating ninja tools with ninjutsu to end hostility between ninja clans.
In Hayabusa's eyes, his brother shone as bright as the moon, illuminating not only himself but the entire Scarlet Shadow. Hayabusa only wished to be his shadow.

However, his brother wasn't the only genius in the Shadow Sect: there was another one named Hanzo. Soon, the Scarlet Sect, the other half of Scarlet Shadow, sent a warning to the Shadow Sect: the balance of power in Scarlet Shadow must not be questioned. Hayabusa learned that the two sects would use their own bloodlines as pawns to control each other, and that he or his brother would have to become that pawn.
On the roof, Hayabusa found his brother. Although no words were spoken, the moonlight filled their hearts.
For Hayabusa, the world could survive without shadows, but without moonlight, night would reign forever...
Sitting next to his brother, Hayabusa took off his mask. A childish smile broke out on his stern face.

During his early years in the Scarlet Sect, Hayabusa, as a pawn, was met with contempt. He found companionship only in his own shadow. During training, he constantly worked to integrate ninja tools into his ninjutsu, creating his unique Shadow Shuriken technique. Little by little, more and more people came to challenge him. Hayabusa calmly accepted each challenge and left silently after each victory. For him, winning or losing was less important than fulfilling his brother's will: ending the hostility between the two sects.

Until the day he met a girl whose beliefs rivaled his own: Hanabi. As the successor to "Scarlet", Hanabi has always held her head high. She considered her victories as victories for the Scarlet Sect, and her fierce competitive spirit drove her to challenge Hayabusa again and again.

Hidden valleys, bamboo forests, rooftops... Every corner of the Scarlet Shadow bore witness to their battles. Every time Hayabusa won, Hanabi would ask, "Why did I lose...", but he would only shrug in return.

Hayabusa had long admitted that he possessed no extraordinary talents. Pursuing his brother's nindo, he trained alone, until he finally understood that the relationship between ninja tools and ninjutsu was like that of scarlet and shadow, two sides of the same coin. They were inseparable. The Scarlet Sect and the Shadow Sect surely knew this too, but they chose to remain determined to defeat each other.
But the illusions will eventually be shattered.

Ninja genius Hanzo broke into the Forbidden Lands, stole the sealed weapon Ame no Habakiri and fled. Hayabusa's brother, who accompanied him, disappeared without a trace. Overnight, Hanzo became the Scarlet Shadow's greatest threat, and peace teetered on the blade's edge.
To capture Hanzo and retrieve the cursed weapon, both sects did their best, and Hayabusa and Hanabi were among them.

Before leaving, Hayabusa received a secret order from his father: "Recover the Soul no Habakiri for the Shadow Sect and kill Hanzo and anyone who gets in your way." Strangely, the order made no mention of his brother. Filled with doubt, Hayabusa followed Hanzo's trail: he had to find him.

During his pursuit, Hayabusa discovered Hanabi lying on the ground, surrounded by ninjas from both sects writhing in agony. As Hayabusa tried to wake Hanabi, a malevolent aura hit him. He gripped his blade tightly. Then, he saw a familiar but strange figure: it was his brother, radiating murderous intent.
He saw blood staining his brother's hands... He saw that the light had disappeared from his eyes...
No matter how Hayabusa called, he was only met with increasingly violent attacks, each aimed at killing.
Hayabusa never imagined that the moon could turn so blood red.
Darkness engulfed Hayabusa's heart. He lowered his blade as his brother rushed towards him.
"Hayabusa, don't you dare lose to anyone other than me!"
Hanabi's voice echoed in his memory, like a flame igniting in his heart.
Deep inside, Hayabusa saw the moonlight, and beneath it, Hanabi.
Hanabi's eyes burned as she looked at Hayabusa while gently twirling her Higanbana, "I'm going to surpass you."

At this moment, Hayabusa regained consciousness. With one hand, he formed a seal, activating Quad Shadow to send four shadows that restrained his opponent with lightning speed. He grabbed his blade and struck without a moment's hesitation.
Hayabusa watched as the murderous aura gradually dissipated along with the image of his brother, revealing Ame no Habakiri's true form, glaring at him in rage and laughing maniacally.

The cunning Ame no Habakiri had tried to use illusions to exploit the weakness of the human heart, only to be met with such resilience. Freeing himself from the illusion, Hayabusa was no longer bound by darkness. Even though he knew Ame no Habakiri was powerful, behind him stood Hanabi, Kagura, and his brother's unknown fate. He had no choice but to get up.
Even without the guidance of the moon, a shadow must carve its own path.
“Wherever I go, I do so without fear.”
anecdotes: “Hayabusa” (隼) literally means “peregrine falcon,” a bird known for its incredible speed and deadly precision.
In his first hero model, Hayabusa's headgear is inspired by Kabuto helmets, worn by samurai and elite ninja warriors.

His ultimate "Shadow Kill" resembles the "Shunshin" (Body Flicker) technique, a legendary ninja ability that allows a warrior to move so fast that they appear to attack from multiple directions at once.

His Ultimate, "Ougi: Shadow Kill", also resembles classic ninja assassination techniques. In Japanese ninja stories, a "finishing blow" (奥義 / Ougi) is a secret assassination technique passed down from generation to generation.
Hayabusa is probably inspired by Ryu Hayabusa from the Ninja Gaiden and Dead or Alive series.
Hayabusa's early concept art featured simpler, more traditional ninja attire, closer to common Japanese historical depictions of ninjas.
Hayabusa's Quad Shadow skill is similar to Zed's skill from League of Legends "Living Shadow", which involves placing a clone that he can teleport to and attack from different angles.
His current English voice actor in 2021, Gaku Space, is known for his voice as Genji from Overwatch, both of whom have rivals of the same name.

helcurt.accroche: The nightmare from the Abyss who is willing to betray anyone to survive.
lore: The nightmare from the Abyss ready to betray anyone to survive. Helcurt was born into the Styx clan of the Abyss and bore the scars of his clan's betrayal of the Lord of the Abyss. However, by a twist of fate, he was appointed to the Tribunal responsible for executing traitors to the Lord. To survive, Helcurt was willing to do anything, including hunting his own parents. However, during the great uprising against the Lord of the Abyss, it was Helcurt who killed him. He was born a traitor and never knew the honor of loyalty, but even as a traitor he had the right to live.

=== Born in Darkness === Born in darkness, Helcurt was blessed with a genius for stalking and ambushes. He lived in the shadows, only looking for his prey. Enslaved by the Abyss, he waited for the split second when his prey would weaken. Now Helcurt emerges from the darkness, his blade ready. The time of hiding is over and the hunt will begin. Official MLBB Social Media They were traitors from birth.
In the darkest depths of the Abyss, the Styx Clan once bared its fangs against the Lord of the Abyss.

Clan Styx were the deadliest hunters who roamed the shadows, born to spread darkness. They could stalk their enemies for days in complete silence before finally slitting their throats and disappearing into the night. Their talents made them the most feared assassins in the Abyss. But their bestial nature was even more terrifying, because when survival is at stake, it's impossible to predict what a beast would do.
"Survive..."
Facing the rebellion of the Styx Clan, even the mighty Lord of the Abyss felt fear. But he could not allow such transgressions against the name of darkness.

Against the sheer might of the Lord of the Abyss, the Styx Clan was defeated. They were branded traitors and suffered a most cruel punishment: they received the blood of the Lord of the Abyss, to be chained forever to his will. This not only physically prevented them from raising their claws against the Lord of the Abyss, but was also the greatest form of humiliation. The beasts of the Abyss were thus tamed like dogs.

Helcurt was the descendant of this clan of traitors. He was born in the middle of the Great War and saw his loved ones used as cannon fodder. Their broken bodies filled the battlefields, and eventually, it would be his turn.
"Survive..."

The only thought running through Helcurt's mind was surviving. He ran and fought with all his might across the battlefield and emerged victorious from the merciless meat grinder. After the battle, he was summoned by the Lord of the Abyss. Seeing Helcurt's small, wild stature, the Lord mockingly declared Helcurt to be the "most faithful dog" of his clan, and placed him at the Tribunal to judge and execute traitors.
“You miserable thing. do what I want and you will have your share of leftovers.

Helcurt obeyed. The first traitor tried was a member of his clan. A veil of darkness shrouded his path that night. and amid the fearful expressions of those close to him, Helcurt slit the traitors' throats with a flash of his blade, thus accomplishing his mission. Blood flowed silently as he dropped the lifeless body. He carried out the execution without hesitation, but in that moment he felt an eternity of anguish.
"Survive..."

He was born with the stigma of a traitor, and now he must live up to that name and cast out his own. He became the Tribunal Blade, slaughtering his brothers who had betrayed the Lord of the Abyss, even if they were only trying to survive. No one knew what Helcurt was thinking during these hunts. All he knew was that he had to live. Even though he was born in darkness, walked in darkness, and would stay there forever, he was still alive.

In the dark swamps where he could alone, Helcurt marked each passing year by tying a knot on a rope. This was his proof that he was alive. To live was his humblest and proudest desire, even if he did it like a dog in the shadows......

Helcurt had survived until the end of the war, but with the absence of the gods. madness spreads across the Abyss. The source of all this was the Lord of the Abyss, who had gone astray without his dark god. For thousands of years he controlled the Abyss using his corrupted blood, and now his madness was infecting them in the same way. This was the curse of the 310CX-i. Having no choice, the demons of the Abyss, led by Thamuz. turned against the Lord of the Abyss, they rushed towards the palace of the Lord of the Abyss. and Helcurt. at the head of the Tribunal, constituted the last line of defense, like an imposing wall.
Amidst the chaos, Helcurt held his tightly.
"A thousand knots, a thousand years..."
The gross feel of the object reminded him that he was still alive.
Although born in darkness, born a traitor, he had the right to live.
"Survive..."

Helcurt turned around and found himself face to face with the imposing Lord of the Abyss before emitting a bestial roar. With all his strength, he purged the cursed blood and made it flow from his body. The sheer force caused his bones to burst from his skin like blades. In an instant, he was at the peak of the Lord of the Abyss, slashing with his blades, breaking free from the shackles of the Blood Curse in the most appropriate way.
"When you decided my fate, you should have remembered that I was born a traitor..."
He had revealed his weapons against the Lord of the Abyss. Just like his ancestors a thousand years ago.
He was born a traitor.
He has always been a traitor. === Help! I almost got killed in the Abyss! ===
anecdotes: Helcurt is one of the heroes who does not walk, but crawls.
If you look closely at Helcurt's portrait, you will notice his white, cat-like pupils.
It is heavily inspired by Alma from Magic Rush, another game developed by Moonton.
He was banned due to a significant bug for 41 days and 21 hours from May 16, 2023 at 01:00:00 to June 26, 2023 at 22:00:00, which is the longest official ban in MLBB history.
