These are the heroes that were only nerfed in patch 1.5.32, which removed Silence 1.5s and replaced it with Slow 1.5s in name=Shadow Transition)}} to make the Silence only during name=Dark Night Falls effect active when using name=Shadow Transition.
Helcurt is the latest hero to receive “Zodiac” (Scorpio) skins.
Helcurt also shares his Japanese voice actor, Abe Daiki, with Gatotkaca, who shares his recommendation on the Roaming route, and Martis, who shares his recommendation on the Jungle route.

hilda.accroche: Heir to the power of the megalith.
lore: Nestled between the tundras of the North Valley and the Moniyan Plain lies a unique land with a massive, ancient stone formation that has earned it the name Megalith Wasteland. The Megalith Desert must be crossed if one wants to reach Northern Vale. It was also Hilda’s homeland.

In the resource-scarce North Valley, tribal conflict was as constant as year-round ice and snow. The strongest tribes would gain the right to own the largest and easiest hunting grounds. This was even more true for the Garland tribe of the Megalith Wasteland. The perilous geography and barren soil of the Jad Wasteland made it incredibly inhospitable to human habitation. Yet, thanks to the protection of the Power of the Megaliths, this tribe tenaciously survived for many years.

The ancient megalith stood here for many centuries. Its creators hoped to use its magical powers to confine the Golems of Iceland to the north of the continent, thus preventing them from coming south. As time passed and the Golems disappeared, the magic of the megalith also lost its original purpose. All that remained were ancient ruins, brimming with the power of the megalith passed down through the centuries.

Legend has it that only he who leads the purest lineage of the Garland clan can lift the stone disc plate, located in the center of the megalith, and inherit its power. So, when each successor as head of the tribe was 20 years old, they went to the Megalith and received its incredible power, becoming the Power of the Megalith. They would then be ready to lead their tribe against foreign incursions.

Since she was a child, Hilda had been the subject of great expectations, since her mother, the former Megalith Power, had been killed in battle while defending the tribe ten years ago. Having lost the protection of the Megalith, the tribe had fallen into deep crisis, enduring constant pillaging and harassment. Therefore, the tribesmen pinned all their hopes on Hilda, praying that she would become strong and take on the important task of protecting the tribe.
Hilda did not disappoint them. From a young age, she demonstrated exceptional talent for combat and strength far beyond her years. Over time, she became the tribe's most powerful warrior.

Eventually, Hilda was to turn 20, and the languid Garland tribe held a grand ceremony for the event. They prayed day and night for the power of the megalith to be reborn and hoped that it would restore the tribe to its former glory.

Yet while many watched with bated breath, Hilda was unable to lift the stone disk even with all her strength. There was stunned silence until a tribe elder stepped forward to tell the truth: Hilda was not the biological daughter of the previous Megalith Power, but was adopted after being found as an abandoned baby in the wild.

The tribesmen, so full of hope and anticipation before, now fell into despair. The faith that had sustained them over the years collapsed in an instant. Their immense, simmering disappointment quickly led to rage and prejudice, and they began to shove and curse Hilda, declaring that she was worthless. Hearing this, Hilda found it difficult to remain stable.

As disappointed as the others, Hilda suddenly remembered her adoptive mother's last words to her: "The power of the megalith is not simply inherited. One must truly understand its inner meaning. The power of the megalith of each generation has had its own unique meaning. To me, the power of the megalith is a heart, as resilient and indomitable as a giant rock."

Hilda, filled with frustration, left the Megalith Desert, which had been her home for many years, and began a long period of wandering life. During these years, she became a wandering mercenary and traveled throughout the Moniyan Empire and most of the Land of Dawn.

Her mother's words never left her during these times. However, she never backed down, no matter what danger she faced. The constant trials and tribulations she endured greatly strengthened her, making her a warrior as fearsome as stone.

And even though she had left the Megalith Desert behind, Hilda knew that this was where her heart belonged. Years later, Hilda saved a slave girl from torture and recognized her as a member of the Garland tribe. From her, Hilda learned of the current state of the tribe: after Hilda left, the Garland tribe chose a new megalith power, who was truly from the line of leaders. However, this new power of the megalith was not leadership material. His foolish and childish ways caused the Garland tribe to decline even further, until it was completely subjugated by another tribe and all its inhabitants reduced to slavery.

Despite her tribe's treatment of her, Hilda returned to the Megalith Desert without hesitation, freeing her people from brutal enemies, fighting them with her bare fists, and leading them to rebuild their home. It was only then that the tribesmen finally understood that true leadership has nothing to do with a person's ancestry. Coming to their senses, they accepted Hilda as their leader and hoped that she would stay with them and continue to pass on the glorious power of the megalith.

This time, however, Hilda refused their invitation, deciding to return to a foreign country. His mother's words weighed constantly on his mind: the power of each generation's megaliths had its own meaning. She had received an indomitable heart from her mother, but she still had not found her own meaning. But one day, she thought, she would.
anecdotes: Hilda is a name of Germanic/Nordic origin, meaning "battle" or "warrior". It comes from the Old Norse word Hildr, meaning battle, war or combat.
Hilda is also a valkyrie like Freya.
Unlike most female heroes who are mages, assassins, or supports, Hilda was one of the first to be designed as a brawler in her own right.
Hilda is also the only fighter with a "Bush Healing" passive. Hilda can heal herself simply by hiding in bushes, allowing her to reset fights without remembering.

hirara.accroche: A geisha ninja from Scarlet Shadow, armed with two fans and adorned with crimson maple and meisen. In his twisted mind, death is the ultimate salvation.
lore: I'm just a dancer under the Meisen. Life is as fleeting as the morning dew and death, serene as the autumn leaves. I only wish to burn the purple leaves, sculpt your incomparable beauty into eternity.

Hirara knew this “sky” only too well. In the illusion created by the Great Armament "Ukifune", there were no stars, only a river, the "Meisen", hanging upside down in the sky. She walked barefoot across the scorched earth, the searing pain sending tremors of ecstasy through her body – the same feeling as when crimson stained her gaze as she gazed upon the Higanbana.

In the hellscape of fans, the world's most magnificent Noh play was performed endlessly. “Come on, it’s the first part tonight.” Hirara opened her fans and evil spirits descended on her. Captivated by Hirara's dance, they sought to tear her apart and claim this eternal beauty. Hirara, smiling amidst her swirls, gently shredded them before absorbing their essence. On this scorched ground, cruelty was the height of elegance.

The madness of this scene always reminded Hirara of her teacher, once the most famous geisha in the Flower District. Her teacher lived in terror of growing old, until one night she set fire to the tea room. “Never forget that erosion is the vilest curse of this world,” the professor said as he held young Hirara in his arms. “Only by becoming ashes can fleeting beauty be saved.” As the silk turned to ashes in the fire, Hirara did not scream; instead, she eagerly inhaled the charred smell – she seemed to understand the lesson of this destruction.

Suddenly, a crimson figure walked across the sea of ​​fire. It was Hanabi, covered in soot. Although they had never met, she grabbed Hirara's wrist without hesitation. The heat from his hand was hotter than any flame in this infernal inferno.

Afterwards, Hirara was brought to the Scarlet Sect where she volunteered to become Hanabi's personal guard. When Hirara asked her about that night again, Hanabi replied that she was just saving her. To repay this grace, Hirara wanted to save Hanabi in the deepest sense of the word. Protecting her from the blades wasn't enough; it must save it from “erosion”, from the inevitability of decadence.

One moonlit night, an inexplicable obsession drove Hirara to push open the forbidden door and reach the fans of "Ukifune", the infernal weaponry forged from "Kaerazu" and "Meisen-e". If she could control them, she could save Hanabi, she thought.

Power coursed through her the moment she touched them. Hirara got his wish, but his physical body fell into an illusion: a hell under the Meisen, born of the Great Armaments. Here, in the midst of endless slaughter, she found herself in ecstasy. The connection between the Great Armaments gave her, the mistress of “Ukifune”, the privilege of freely spying on the “Higanbana” which flourish above the Meisen.

At first, his look was only frightened. As the heir of the Scarlet Sect, Hanabi was as dazzling as the sun. But as time passed, she saw Hanabi stumble through the rain and snow for the "honor" of the Scarlet Sect, pursuing the ghost called "victory" while being knocked down again and again, only to get back up again... The cruelty of this fleeting world was like a dull blade, eating away at her. It was “erosion,” the vile curse his teacher spoke of. It had entangled Hanabi after all.

How could this be allowed? Higanbana should never be allowed to wither. Hirara was devastated. She must return to the world of the living. And to do so, she used “Kaerazu” and “Meisen-e” to slaughter countless evil spirits and assimilate their power. It was during this carnage that the twisted words of his teacher became his illusion: beauty will erode; only death can stop it.

When Hanzo betrayed the Shadow Sect, Hanabi was seriously injured during their confrontation. Desperately seeking the power to protect her clan, she submitted to the weapon in her hand: the Higanbana. As her consciousness sank into this pitch-black river, Hanabi thought it was the dead that were dragging her down. No. It was, in truth, Hirara's “softest” embrace.

"Let me save you from this crude and fleeting world," Hirara called softly from the depths of the Meisen. But Hanabi didn't hear him. A ray of moonlight suddenly woke her and she broke the illusion of weaponry to return to the world of the living.

Watching the Meisen return to dead silence, a smile appeared on Hirara's face. This was the Hanabi she adored: the girl whose soul was fiercer than fire, who would do anything to protect others. Since her embrace could not hold one of such determination, she would sail against the tide, break the chains of the fleeting world, and carry Hanabi to a place free from erosion: "hell."

Hirara gave himself entirely to the weaponry, letting his soul sink into his hell. She was no longer herself, but a spirit roaming the world of the living, a calamity existing solely to "save" Hanabi.

Finally, the weapon seal broke. Hirara stepped over the corpses of her Scarlet Sect parents and stood in front of Hanabi, as she had wished. The childhood companion who was thought to be dead had returned. The shock and sorrow in Hanabi's eyes finally solidified into cold, murderous intent. For the sake of the Scarlet Sect, Hanabi launched her Higanbana without hesitation.
Ah, it was everything Hirara had dreamed of. She spread her fans, adorned herself with crimson maple and Meisen, and rushed toward a reunion she dared not disappoint.

“Please kiss me!” Hirara opened her arms to the cold glow. Since her gentle appeal had been rejected, she would fill that void with the shock of flesh and blood. This pain that pierced my body was the embrace that you refused me in the depths of Meisen.

“Please save me!” Facing the impending blade, Hirara's tears trembled with emotion. I understand now: just as I sought to seal your beauty with death, you also could not bear to see me erode. This fatal blow is your deepest and most merciful protection.

“Please kill me!” Hirara screamed in happiness, offering her frantically beating heart to the edge of the blade. Her fans hugged each other and walked towards Hanabi... Now that I have received your kindness, please... accept my devotion, Hanabi-sama!
anecdotes: In the Japanese language, kanji are characters from Chinese writing and the meaning of a name changes depending on the kanji characters chosen. Names with many kanji variations are generally more common in Japan, while names with only a few variations are considered more unique and rare. Here are some of the popular kanji variations for the name "Hirara" (which is one "nanori"), each with a different meaning.

Hirara (舞) means "to dance" or "to dance". It can refer to rhythmic movement to music, often as part of a group performance. It also conveys the idea of ​​graceful, fluid movement, like leaves or petals dancing in the wind.
Hirara (華) means "flower", "blooming" or "splendid". It symbolizes beauty, flourishing growth, elegance and magnificence.
Hirara (姫) ​​means "princess", "lady" or "beautiful". It symbolizes nobility, grace, elegance and feminine beauty.
Hirara (妃) means "wife", "queen" or "empress". A consort is the wife of a monarch, a queen is a female ruler or the wife of a king, and an empress is a female emperor or the wife of an emperor.
Hirara is the first hero to only have two skills.
She is also the third hero after Julian and Suyou without Ultimate.
For this reason, it is impossible for Valentina to copy Hirara's Ult.

She was initially supposed to be the most difficult hero alongside Fanny, but after her ultimate was removed, her difficulty was reduced to that of the other Cadia Riverlands heroes, Yi Sun-shin, Ling, Yu Zhong, and Suyou.

lore: Amid the misty mountains of the northern reaches of the Land of Dawn, reside the ancient and mysterious race of Centaurs, half-man, half-horse creatures. The Centaurs guard a fountain which is located at the highest peak of the mountain. This fountain is said to give the gift of immortality and infinite wisdom. Dark forces have relentlessly attempted to gain the power found in the waters of this fountain, but only to be thwarted time and time again by the centaurs.

However, over time, the centaurs grew tired and attrition quickly set in. It was only after the arrival of Hylos, where he unleashed his mastery over nature's wrath, that he was able to crush and punish all the fountain's invaders. He had become a legendary figure in the annals of the Land of Dawn.
anecdotes: Hylos dons the Chastise Pauldron.
He is a centaur, based on the creature from Greek mythology. The Minotaur is the other.
It is inspired by Malachi from Magic Rush by Moonton.
Alongside Masha and X.Borg, Hylos is the only hero capable of reducing his own HP with a skill.
Belerick's Natural Strike consumed some of his HP, but this was removed during his second recast.
Hylos' Ring of Punishment is the first of the only toggle skills in the game.

irithel.accroche: A red-haired elf who lives and fights alongside her companion Leo.
lore: Hunters finally discovered the fatal weakness of these creatures. As elusive as they were, smilodons were always drawn to the cries of an infant because it sounded so similar to the cries of their own young. Hunters were quick to exploit this weakness. They kidnapped the infants of other races to use as bait and ambushed unsuspecting smilodons. Irithel had once been one of those babies. Born under a menacing red moon, the forsaken elf entered the world with strange crimson markings on her skin and was feared from her first breath. Those around her considered her existence a bad omen and rejected her without hesitation. Greed and wickedness had almost swallowed her up. Yet, in the end, she managed to survive.

The smilodon that followed her cries happened to be the Primary Matriarch who had recently lost her young. This little one had fallen into the hands of hunters not long before. The sight of such a crude trap sent the matriarch into a frenzy, baring her fangs. But the smell of milk on the matriarch attracted the hungry child to the smilodon. Little Irithel crawled towards her, staggering. At this moment, the smilodon's rage weakened. Looking at the little elf, maternal instinct began to take over. But the hunters had already lost patience. They approached from all sides, determined to take the bones of the smilodon for themselves. They understood the power of a smilodon, but knew nothing of the ferocity of a mother. Keeping little Irithel at her side, the matriarch rushed forward and roared at every hunter who dared to approach. The hunters were completely disoriented by his attacks and, when failure seemed imminent, they fled the forest in panic.

Irithel had a mother that day. She was not a graceful elf. The matriarch gave her everything a mother could: milk to feed her, shelter under the wild canopy, the skills to hunt and survive... and a dear companion, her only surviving cub. Irithel returned this love in kind. As the matriarch had hoped, Irithel grew up alongside the cub and learned to chase away intruders from the forest. Bow in hand and barely able to stand, she climbed on the little one's back and sent arrows into every corner of the forest. Over time, Irithel came to understand the truth about her own origins. Having endured such cruelty herself, she could not calm her distrust of outsiders, especially humans.

This only began to change after meeting Nana, a kind-hearted Leonine girl. Irithel didn't understand his words, but she could feel the warmth of Nana's smile. Even though Irithel could only respond with grunts, little Leonine happily took both of his hands in hers. Only heat could melt the ice to such a depth, and little by little, Nana's perseverance began to change it. Proudly calling herself Irithel's "little teacher", she set about teaching her the language of humans. Unable to refuse such kindness, Irithel followed Nana's patient advice and, for the first time, managed to clumsily reconstruct her first word: "F-nothing." Together they named Irithel's companion Leo, and they walked the forest paths laughing and singing. But this simple happiness ended too soon with Nana's departure.

Irithel had to learn and grow on her own. Before Irithel knew it, her mother had aged. Increasingly, the matriarch looked at her daughter with quiet expectation in her eyes. When her fangs could no longer protect what she loved, she led Irithel to one last place. They arrived deep in the forest, where countless white bones lay silently. This was the graveyard of the smilodons, the place these hunters had been searching for for a long time. Before Irithel knew what was happening, her mother gently lay down on the bed of bones. Like any mother, she wanted to leave a gift for her child when Irithel reached the age of majority. But the matriarch had no treasure to pass on. The only gift she could leave her child was... her own bones. Under Irithel's gaze, the matriarch slowly closed her eyes. The proud head that had never bowed in her life rested on her daughter's knees, and in that final calm, Irithel understood the secret of the smilodons: when they died, their spirit bones released their immense magic into the forest, nourishing the earth and continuing the endless cycle of life.

The matriarch's breathing gradually weakened and Irithel's vision blurred from tears. When those tears finally fell, a glow crossed her mother's translucent, weathered bones, as if urging her not to stop there. Irithel therefore set off in search of the Tree of Life in the Moonlight Forest. With the gentle blessing of Estes and Miya, she forged her weapon from one of her strong silver branches and her mother's bones, shaping them into the crossbow she now carried. It was proof that his mother would always be with them. From that day on, any hunter who dared to set foot in the forest would learn to fear the roar of Leo and the fierce elf on his back with the magic crossbow. Together, they would chase away all intruders from the forest.

Irithel watched the hunters flee in panic as she gently placed her hand on her crossbow. Leo leaned against her, the feeling warm and familiar. Under his fingers, his crossbow gave off the same warmth, as if the years had never passed and his mother was still there at their side.
anecdotes: The name Irithel is of Turkish origin and means "Goddess of hunting and prayer. Strong bow and bow".
When Irithel was first released on the Advanced Server, she was named Mona and had the hero title "Descendant of the Forest".
She is the first hero to ride permanently with a mount, the second being Barats.
She called Leo a "tiger" in one of her quotes, but he is biologically a smilodon.
She is the first hero capable of performing basic attacks while moving with a joystick. Kimmy and Leomord (while riding Barbiel in his Phantom Steed) are the other heroes to do so.
She is the only ranged hero with an explosive basic attack, where the damage from her basic attack while using the Heavy Crossbow can hit multiple enemies in a small area at once.
When his "Night Arrow" skin was released, Leo's appearance closely resembled Toothless from How to Train Your Dragon; it was later edited to look more feline, presumably to avoid copyright issues.
She is the fourth hero to have two StarLight skins ("Nightarrow" and "Checkered Knight").

ixia.accroche: Leader of Bad Soul and self-proclaimed inventor, she wields a homemade weapon powered by a stolen Starlium reactor.
lore: Leader of Bad Soul and self-proclaimed inventor, she wields a homemade weapon powered by a Starlium reactor. Born into a tribe of sand hunters, Ixia was shaped by the harsh desert environment to become a cunning leader from a young age. While most Sand Hunters only care about plundering, Ixia has always had a penchant for inventing gadgets and believed that science should not be a tool reserved only for scholars in Eruditio. Ixia has always lived by its own rules, like the ever-changing sands of Agelta's barren lands. ===Sandstorm at SnakeboneTavern === "It's a heist, hands where I can see!" "These beautiful books, I will take them from your hands. She is the leader of Bad Soul who "takes" the books of others only to invent them. She has been shaped into a cunning leader by the harsh desert environment. While believing that science should not be a tool for only a few, she is determined to make her way! How will she continue to invent her gadgets and live by her own rules like the ever-changing sands of the barren lands from Agelta? Hit the link below and discover the story of Bad.

It's a stick, hands where I can see! Put away your gold, it's no use to me. But these beautiful books, I will take them from your hands. Now go this way, before you get lost in these sands. —Ixia, boss of Bad Soul (7 years)

The whole place looked like it was about to collapse. Gravel seeped through the cracks in the windows, hitting the cups like bullets. But at that moment, the traveler would rather brave the sandstorm outside than spend another second at Snakebone Tavern. The traveler had come from the Moniyan Empire, intending to take advantage of the Festival of Lights to study at Eruditio. He couldn't believe his luck in finding a place to spend the night this far out in the desert. Until a group of sand hunters sat down at the table next to him and started complaining about their latest job. He wrapped himself tightly in his cloak and pretended to enjoy the gritty soup in front of him, trying not to look like their next victim.

"That's enough alcohol... I'm not in the mood. You know, I don't regret shooting that kid, but now it's coming to me suddenly, like a sandworm crawling through my head. The last time we had a sandstorm this bad was when Ixia was born. It was sixteen years ago, on a night so dark you couldn't even see your own gun in your hands. Her mother, then the boss of Bad Soul, had gotten lost in the desert and was about to give birth But as things happened, a shooting star flew over Eruditio and lit the way to Ixia's birth.

Ixia has always been a smart child. She learned how to load a gun before she could even walk straight. Sigh... It's a shame she got into such bad habits. She was only seven years old when she flew for the first time. And what was his loot? A stack of books! Can you believe this? What kind of sand hunter steals books? And from then on, she would always target caravans heading to Eruditio, just to return with bags of dusty books. She said she wanted to be an inventor... What a naive little fool! She kept inventing all this useless crap... A grill made with a guitar, a swimming contraption in the desert... Damn, my boy almost drowned in that quicksand! And... Huh?! Who is making this noise? »

The traveler pretended to choke on his soup to hide his sudden burst of laughter. An outlaw who loved to read? He had never heard of such a thing. Filled with curiosity about this person from Ixia, the traveler silently moved his stool closer to the noisy table.

"It had nothing to do with her inventions anyway. I took this shot to uphold the customs of this country. I couldn't believe it when her mother passed the leadership of Bad Soul to Ixia. She was smaller than my rifle, but she dared to sit so high above her predecessors. I often encountered her on our hunts. She was fearless and a natural marksman, and as the eldest, I planned to watch over her, but she despised us for taking unarmed civilians! She even went out of her way to return everything we stole! A crook with a conscience... That girl really doesn't know what's best for her until she comes face to face with the barrel of a gun.
The traveler was recaptured because he had a keen interest in medical devices. Maybe he could exchange knowledge with this Ixia...
KNOCK! A knife fell and nearly split the table as the leader of the group cleared his throat angrily.

"Idiots! You deserve to have suffered under her thumb all these years. Who cares about her inventions, or even the dishonor among thieves? Ixia's greatest mistake was incurring Eruditio's wrath. Think about it! When did the winds of this desert turn against us? Eruditio's Rangers spent years trying to hold us back, but courage and gunfire got us through the worst. But since then that they found out that Ixia was inventing things, they They thought we were out to take what was theirs! They came to our land, installed pumps and generators, then lured our men into taking their so-called "stable jobs". exhibition. What a laugh she was stopped by a guard before she could even enter. They broke her craft and made her the laughing stock of these lands.
BOOM! The tavern door opened suddenly, and the onslaught of wind and sand almost knocked the traveler off his stool.
“These are my stories to tell.”
The traveler adjusted his glasses just in time to see the figure pull out a pair of strange gadgets.
“But I’ll give your widows something to tell!”

And that's when the bullets started flying. Making an exquisite arc around the traveler, Ixia's shots were aimed at the three Sand Hunters behind him. The traveler dove under the table and kept his mouth shut. He watched in terror as a pair of spiked boots approached and stopped right in front of his table.
"Bullets that can arc, inspired by the sandworms of this desert. What do you think, stranger?"
With great interest, Ixia half-bent down and lifted the cloak that tightly enveloped the traveler, as if to admire a new invention.
"Hmm... The smell of shoe polish and leather. It hasn't gone away even after coming all this way, has it Mr. Moniyan shoemaker?"

As Ixia vividly revealed her identity, the traveler's face blushed a bright red. The template was in place. How could a simple shoemaker hope to become an academic? Eruditio would definitely have made fun of him the same way they made fun of Ixia. He should just go home and leave this terrible journey behind him.
But on the spur of the moment, the traveler found the courage to ask a question.
“D-D-Do you think I can become an academic at Eruditio?”

"Hell if I know," Ixia shrugged as she grabbed the traveler's bag. "But in this wilderness, no one can tell you which way is right or wrong. It is said that sand hunters cannot be inventors, and inventors cannot be outlaws." Ixia smirked and took out a few books from the bag for herself. “But who are they to define us?”
The traveler was taken back by his words and lost himself for a moment in his thoughts. Collecting her loot, Ixia was halfway to the door when she turned around one last time.
“You must carve your own path, just like the ever-changing sands.”

jawhead.accroche: Intelligent robot used to protect little Ailee.
lore: Clandestine organizations have existed throughout the many eras of the Land of Dawn's history. No one knows the true purpose of these organizations, but one thing is certain: whenever a crisis arises, mysterious figures emerge from the shadows to restore order to the world.

Professor Henry and his wife worked for the Dawn Council, known for its research into cutting-edge technologies, providing an endless and varied stream of high-tech products to government agencies and mysterious, anonymous clients. But when they finally finished developing the "SMART-01", everything changed, as their new creation was more intelligent and powerful than any android the world had seen before. It was designed such that once a genetically compatible host controlled it, it could act according to the controller's consciousness. The leaders of the Dawn Council saw the potential of this technology for warfare and ordered the Henrys to transfer the technology to selected government agencies for a mass production program. The Henrys refused.

After ordering their Prototype One to destroy all data from the experiment, the Henrys mysteriously disappeared. To this day, little Ailee has no knowledge of these events. All she knows and cares about is that this special robot has always been there to protect and accompany her, and that he calls her "Honey" like her father once did, while she affectionately calls him "Jawhead" in return. The only clue left by her parents was a pocket watch that she carries with her wherever she goes. Finally, Ailee decides to travel with her robot friend to find the whereabouts of her parents...
anecdotes: Jawhead is the only hero who carries a companion (Ailee) who doesn't help in battle.
Revisions to Ailee's name were made from Alice and Ellie.
Almost all Jawhead skins have two eyes/lenses that are different from the default one.
Victory Loader is the first skin to use Ailee's face in the avatar icon instead of using Jawhead's face.

johnson.accroche: A super cyborg who can transform into a car and lead his teammates into battle.
lore: Johnson was a legend in the world of Varis, a place where speed is everything. Here, the sport of auto racing was monopolized by the rich and elite until Johnson became the first commoner to break that mold. But just when he shocked the world by winning his first official race, he disappeared without a trace.

The only person who had any idea where Johnson was was an old man who claimed to have gotten into his car. According to him, Johnson was driving so fast that he was tearing the fabric of space and going beyond the stars. However, everyone who heard the story simply dismissed the old man as senile.

This old man led an ordinary life and spent most of his life in the city's slums. He worked in construction in his youth and helped build many of the city's extravagant landmarks, including the famous Varis Speedway. He earned a meager salary for his work, but loved gazing at the lights of downtown and getting lost in their promises of a better life. The years passed and he grew older. He could no longer work as before, but his debts continued to accumulate. The debt collectors' visits became increasingly frequent and violent, and one night they came looking for blood.

The old man was running with everything he had, but he felt like he was sinking into the mud. Surely this city he helped build would give him a way out, right? Little did he know that his salute was heading towards him at 180 miles an hour...
“Hey, get in the car!”

The old man was suddenly pulled into the passenger seat by a firm grip as his pursuers disappeared in the rearview mirror. Everything happened so quickly that the old man only saw a flash of light and believed that he was finally going to meet his maker.
When he came to his senses, he realized that the driver was only a child. A young boy who took up almost the entire driver's seat.

It was the first time the old man had ridden in Johnson's car. He had spent his whole life in Varis, but he had never seen the city like this; at least not at this speed. Johnson drove like he was possessed, speeding through every corner of the city. They were moving so fast that the outside world seemed to move in slow motion.
“My dad always told me to be fast!”

The old man did not know what kind of father this boy had, but the boy spoke about him with a sparkle in his eyes and kept these words dear to his heart. For the first time, the old man began to understand why the people of Varis kept saying that speed was a passion and that the pinnacle of speed was the limits of the universe. After experiencing such extreme speed, he gained a deeper understanding of the city.
People were always coming and going in a hurry, and all this was illustrated by the words of Johnson's father: "Be quick!" »

The old man did not see the boy again for many years after that fateful ride. He returned to the construction site even though he was too old and sick for the job. He looked up just as a pipe fell from the upper floors. He closed his eyes and believed that he would finally be free of his debts.

Suddenly there was another flash of light, and a silhouette, or rather the silhouette of a car, appeared at full speed and grabbed the old man. For a moment, he couldn't understand what he was seeing...
"I've gotten faster, haven't I? Hahaha!"

It was Johnson! He has become... half machine, half car? A roaring engine was now Johnson's new heart, and a carbon frame was his body. On both sides of him were exhaust pipes that looked like bottle rockets. In this world where speed is everything, the old man couldn't think of a body more suitable for Johnson.

But it was tragedy that led to this moment. Johnson and his father were in a terrible car accident and only Johnson survived the accident. He had no money to pay for expensive prosthetics, so he allowed doctors to perform an experimental procedure to fuse him with his car.
The old man frowned. This child had managed to escape death. And not once, but twice! Despite his age, he saw in Johnson the true meaning of speed. It was strange, but real.
As the old man said goodbye to Johnson for the second time, he had the feeling that they would one day meet at the ends of the universe.

The old man's life then passed uneventfully, until the day he saw Johnson on a jumbotron, crossing the finish line at Varis Speedway. This kid had performed a miracle! He was the first commoner to win an official race. He became a pioneer and a beacon of hope for the lower class; the catalyst that will change this world forever.
Excitement rose in the old man's veins and he began to dream of becoming like Johnson; having passion pumped through a roaring engine in his soul.

Johnson did not appear on the podium after his victory. As he crossed the finish line, something triggered in his mechanical body and a blinding light appeared in front of him, like a door to another world. And just like that, Johnson, who had just become a legend in his world, disappeared into the light.
"Johnson was my apprentice, you know. Now he's among the stars. There! It's him!"

The old man got his wish and became like Johnson, and now lives his life at breakneck speed. In his free time, the old man would tell stories about his time with Johnson. He still believes that if you can move fast enough, you can leave this mundane world and soar into the cosmos, just like Johnson did.
Johnson, at that time, had just arrived in a strange new world. For him, it simply meant new faces to meet, new places to explore, and new speed limits to exceed.
"Hey, you with the ponytails. Want to race?"
The roar of its engine echoed throughout Eruditio.

joy.accroche: The “Miracle Child” returned to the Leonins after years of wandering.
lore: The “Miracle Child” returned to the Leonins after years of wandering. Agile and cunning, known as Lumina City's most infamous "little thief", Joy had longed to have her stomach filled and her heart warmed. In a fortunate turn of events, Joy returned to the land of the Leonines, her wandering heart healed by the simple, unconditional love of her loved ones. She was no longer afraid of losing love again and swore to protect those around her, to transform into a golden lightning resonating with the house... === Me, Joy === Who am I?
The moment the lightning struck her chest, the Leonine girl couldn't help but think about this question.
She had been looking for an answer all this time.

“You are Grandma’s favorite love bunny.” This was the response she received from her adoptive grandmother. For as long as she could remember, they had lived in the slums of Lumina City. Even though grandmother was poor, she always found a way to feed the girl and put her to sleep. Meanwhile, the magic necklace on the girl's chest was still beating lightly to the rhythm of the lullaby. According to her grandmother, she was already wearing the necklace when she was discovered. One, two, three, four! It was like the beats of love.

One day, grandmother never woke up again... The girl stood by the frozen body for days, but could not find a way to wake her grandmother. The beating of the necklace on the girl's chest became slower and lighter.
One... Two... Three... Four...

It was as if her heart was being gripped tightly by a pair of large hands, and she would never be able to hear the lullaby again. It was on that day that the young girl learned about death, the impermanence of love. No matter how hard he tried, it would always disappear eventually. For no reason!
As she wiped away her tears, she thought about where she would find warm bread.

The girl began to wander. Although life had always been sad, it had also taught him many things. She learned to sneak into stores to steal food, evade city guards, and even fight off stray cats for food. His leonine magic was strong enough to protect the girl, turning the bitterness of her life into a sweet cake.
At that time, the answer she heard most often was "a thief who brings shame to the Leonin clan."

She remembered these words from Harith, a henchman of the Imperial army. He was upset that the girl would tarnish the clan's reputation for honesty and kindness. Despite all attempts at reprimands and punishments, the girl never changed. Harith's anger grew greater and greater, until one day he discovered that the girl had never returned to the Leonin clan... never knew who she was.

Lumina City was large enough that wanderers often lost sight of each other. Young Leonine didn't know she had any choice but to wander. After several battles, Harith finally managed to bring the girl back to her homeland, Bright Marsh.

Located in the central forests of Azrya, the Glittering Swamp has been home to generations of Leonins. Years of wandering had put the young girl on her guard. Always vigilant, she was like a stray cat forcefully adopted. All she wanted was to escape from her new home.
The patriarch of the Leonins gave the young girl his third answer: “a miracle child, the one who will fulfill the prophecy of the Leonin clan”.

Years ago, on a stormy night, a girl was born in the swamp, holding the "Leonine Crystal". In the clan's ancient prophecies, she was known as the "miracle child" who would save their people. But when the little girl was only three years old, she accidentally fell into a river...
The patriarch took the girl to the Leonine temple, where the Leonine crystal was enshrined... The shape was the same as that of the necklace on the girl's chest. They began to resonate.
One, two, three, four!
It was like Grandma's song was being sung again.

But even the prophecy could not change the girl's habits. She continued to play tricks on those around her and lie to get her hands on delicious food. She even organized a barbecue party in the Leonin temple! Even the other kids who didn't like the girl had no way to deal with her. Whenever the kind and simple Leonin villagers showed concern or kindness towards her, they always reminded the girl of that moment when she felt her heart beating slowly... Of the tingling sensation that she never wanted to feel again.
“I don’t need to worry about who I am here…I hope things can stay this way forever.”
But thunder in the middle of the night shattered the girl's dreams.

This abysmal storm seemed to want to erase everything. The girl was terrified... She was the "miracle child", the one who had been given so much drink and food for free... They were definitely going to ask her to save them!

But the patriarch's request was that she flee to a safe place. The Leonins had no intention of sacrificing a child in the name of prophecy. They didn't care about her because they wanted something... but rather because they felt sorry for an orphan. The Leonins released the young girl, as if she were a child who had left home.

Looking up, the girl saw that the temple was about to collapse under the pressure of the storm. The shivering Leonins had surrounded the temple, doing their best to keep it propped up by magic. Closing their eyes and praying, they thought of their families for peace of mind.
The collar on his chest began to beat again, slowly and lightly. Was she going to lose her new home the same way she lost her grandmother?

As another bright bolt of lightning came from the sky, the temple began to collapse. Suddenly... this girl managed to resist the lightning! Running back and forth through the storm, she absorbed the lightning into her body, preventing it from further damaging the temple. She continued to run and roll at high speed, until a bolt of lightning struck her in the chest.
“Who am I?”
That's when she found her answer.
The Leonine crystal in the temple vibrated with the necklace. One, two, three, four!
“I was an orphan.”
The Leonins and the Crystal emerged with magical energy oozing from the girl, as if it were a blessing from the house. The light spread to his ears and legs...illuminating his entire body.
"I stole food and did a lot of bad things..."
The girl continued to run, getting faster and faster, to the point where nothing could stop her.
“But right now, I am a child loved by everyone... The miracle child of the Leonins!”

She was no longer afraid of losing love...Instead, she would use her life to protect those she loved. The light on the girl's body became brighter and brighter. Like golden lightning, it shot towards the dark clouds overhead.
"I! AM! JOY!"

=== Glow in the middle of the freezing night ===

julian.accroche: A Raven assassin from the Church of Light, a young boy searching for his home…
lore: A Raven assassin from the Church of Light, a young boy searching for his home... A member of the secret force of the Church of Light on the path to self-awakening. Julian was the son of Terizla, the leader of the Free Blacksmiths' Guild. The guild was exterminated by the Church of Light on charges of heresy when Julian was very young. The poor child was then adopted by the Archbishop, trained and molded into an elite member of the Ravens, a secret force that only listened to the Archbishop's orders. Later, during his mission to “purify” Xavier, he glimpsed the secret buried in time… ===Awakening: Nirvana===
Ten years ago, one winter night, a snowstorm raged on the citadel of the Free Blacksmiths Guild.

The Freesmiths' Guild of Terizla was accused of pledging allegiance to the Abyss and destroyed by the Church of Light. The only survivor was the ruler's six-year-old son, who wandered the streets for days until the Church found the starving boy. The archbishop saw in him a special talent, bestowed upon him the name of an ancient saint – Julian, and sent him to the special academy of the Church of Light – Raven's Nest.

Situated on top of a cliff, the school housed orphans with special talents. The Archbishop told them that children abandoned by their families were not worthy of love, but that he would give them love and rebirth, which must be repaid with gratitude and loyalty: they must become Ravens, a secret special force that answers directly to the Archbishop and cleanses the world of all heretics and evils for the Lord of Light.

Julian forced himself to forget his past, but despite all his efforts, he could not erase the nightmare from his mind: his mother left him behind and begged for mercy for herself, without even sparing him a glance...

Julian also remembered a strange gesture accompanying the nightmare: he always raised the corners of his mouth with his hands and forced himself to smile unconsciously. But other than that, he didn't remember anything else. He didn't know who taught him how to do that or what happened back then.
The children of Raven's Nest were called Nestlings. They performed arduous tasks and studied books and combat skills during the day, then stayed in their separate caves to rest and rest at night.

The life of Nestlings is lonely. But Julian started a family with the other guests of his cave: a rodent who loves breadcrumbs, a chirping sparrow and a goat he took care of. Every windy night, they listened to Julian talk about his loneliness and his doubts. For him, it was his family who didn't speak.

With their company, Julian worked diligently at the Academy and was one of the most excellent students when it came to work, study, and combat. He was congratulated by the Archbishop but did not notice another Nestling's jealousy towards him.
One night, Julian retired to his room and found three stiff animal carcasses on the stone bed.
Behind him came the evil sneers of the other Nestling, "Rodents represent infidelity, sparrows ignorance and the weakness of goats... Julian, you are not worthy of the love or revival of the Church!"
His vision blurred in a sudden rush of blood, as he clenched his fists, his mind blank.

After a bloody fight, Julien was taken away by members of the Church, and the archbishop who was there to review their work also arrived – the consequences would be serious. Nestling, seriously injured, lay unconscious on the ground. Julian almost lost his balance against the wall, as if his heart had fallen into freezing water.
He closed his eyes, waiting for the archbishop's punishment.
"Jealousy... Such a dirty and weak Nestling. Excommunicate this failure!"
The punishment was more terrifying than the execution! But how would the archbishop punish Julien? Much to Julian's surprise, the archbishop patted him on the shoulder.
"Julian, you did well. And you cleaned those things in that corner, didn't you?"

Julian was at a loss for words. He looked at the carcasses in the corner: they were dirty, cold and insignificant. The other Nestling's words still rang in his ears: Julian, you are not worthy of the Church's love or revival!

“Isn’t that right!?” The archbishop's voice was that of a pair of hands clasped around his neck, while Julian trembled slightly. After what seemed like a century, he turned up the corners of his mouth and forced a stiff smile onto his cheeks.
A sliver of morning light shone from the east, half of Julian's face exposed to the sun while the other half was hidden in the darkness. He nodded slightly.
"...Yes. I killed them, for my rebirth."

The archbishop stroked Julian's head, slowly chanting the scripture: "Your fear and your dread will be on every beast and every bird." Your verdict will be accepted by every soul that walks the earth. And every path on which the Light shines, by your hand they will be traced.
A strange light shone in Julian's dark pupils. He raised his hand to summon his weapon, proving himself to the archbishop.
Julian knew he would become the strongest Raven of all.

The years passed, and at the age of 15, these Nestlings faced their last trials before becoming Ravens: some infiltrated the enemy base, others explored the Abyss, others eliminated the heretics... After the perilous challenges, even the most elite Nestlings would be exhausted. But once they passed the tests, they would return to the Church of Light. The luminous arrow would be in front of them, as their faces lit up with hope – just one step before rebirth!
But this was only the beginning of the most difficult test.

At the turn in front of the church, someone called a nest by its birth name. If they could not stop themselves from turning back, they would be excommunicated and considered heretics. This step was to test if a Nestling was loyal enough to forget the person they once were.

Julien passed the test. All these years, he lived in fear of being abandoned by the Church and even heard in dreams the words of the Archbishop: A Raven must forget himself! But... he wasn't a pure Raven. A voice in the back of his head had always resisted the archbishop's voice. He had no idea what that voice was and was confused about the two conflicting voices.
Late that night, Julian made that gesture again: turning up the corners of his mouth into a forced smile.
Why should he smile? Julian didn't know that, but it didn't matter because he was the strongest Raven.

When Xavier blew up the city gate and fled with Yin and Melissa, the archbishop sent Julien on a mission: poor Xavier's mind had been poisoned by heretics and he had to be given mercy. Julian chased them for seven days in the mountains and finally caught up with Xavier and the other two who had exhausted their strength.

A battle was inevitable, and there was no clear winner between the strongest Raven and the greatest Arbiter of Light. But by accident, Julian's Raven hood fell off, and at the sight of his red hair, Xavier stood stunned for a moment as if he had recognized something. Then he took Julian's next blow.
Xavier could no longer fight but still protected Yin and Melissa. He laughed: "It was you who came to purify me. Very good. After all, your mother..."
Julian's gun didn't fall. His eyes were wide, "You know my past!?"

Xavier hesitated for a moment before telling the truth: on that snowy night, young Julian was hidden in a corner by his mother. She held Julian's face and forced a smile as she said, "Stay here. Everything will be fine. When you don't know what to do... Smile..."

Frightened, Julian clung to his mother before she cruelly pushed him away and ran away to attract enemies... After Julian's mother was killed by the Ravens, Xavier keenly noticed Julian hiding behind some crates.
Julian didn't know what was happening or what reaction he should have. At that very moment, he remembered the way his mother raised the corners of her mouth.
He forced a shaky smile.
The smile tugged on Xavier's heartstrings, and so he left with the Ravens.
"It's the truth."

The face of Julian's mother, whom he had forgotten for ten years, suddenly became clear, as did all the walls of the Artisans' Union, the fires inside the furnaces, and the wooden toys that his father had given him... Julian's hands were shaking violently. A Raven who found himself could no longer wield his sword without hesitation. His mother loved him deeply and even risked her life to prove it. He was never abandoned by his family.

At this moment, Alice appeared at the entrance of the cave with demons. Xavier and the other two were out of breath after days of battle. It was at this desperate moment that Julian stood between them and Alice. He gave Xavier and the others time to cross the rope bridge over the cliffs, before cutting the bridge and confronting Alice alone.

This did not protect them in Julian's book. Eliminating heretics was one of the Ravens' missions, but it wasn't just a mission for Julian. He would only be able to find Xavier and learn more about his past if he won this fight.
Despite the powerful demons before him, Julian still saw his mother's smile in his mind, and for the first time, her smile wasn't forced.
He finally found himself and learned to smile too.

lore: The Queen of the South Seas, Kadita, was once the princess of a small island nation. Admired by all, Kadita was considered by all to be authentic, intelligent and caring. However, fate often finds a way to hit people with conflicts. Kadita was no different. As the king's heir apparent, a member of the royal family became jealous of Kadita and conspired to ruin her. An unknown mage wielding the power of dark magic viciously attacked the princess. Kadita was subjected to a powerful spell that stole all her beauty, giving her a strange skin disease.

The people of the kingdom tried everything they could to help their beloved princess, but no one could break the spell. Over time, people's love for Kadita faded, causing her to lose power and confidence. Driven by immense despair, Kadita threw herself into the stormy seas of the South. However, Kadita was saved by the ocean demons. Using the Sea Trident, the ocean demons were able to break Kadita's powerful spell, but due to her skin disease, her skin was never able to return to its original tone. That day, Kadita becomes the legendary Queen of the South Seas.

Assuming new powers, Kadita became expert in controlling ocean waters and the weather. Sailors around the world came to fear the South Seas because they were bound to face Kadita's wrath. No one dared to conquer the South Seas anymore. The survivors renounce their experiences in front of Kadita. In some ways she had the appearance of a strange mermaid, while others said she was more beautiful than the princess they knew before. As stories of Kadita began to spread, legends say that she possessed seven legendary spears, each with their own unique abilities, used to punish any invaders intending to rape the South Seas.
anecdotes: Kadita is inspired by Indonesian folklore, notably the legend of Nyi Roro Kidul, the Queen of the South Seas. In myth, Nyi Roro Kidul is said to rule the Indian Ocean and have the power to control the waters and command sea creatures.
Kadita is one of the few heroes in Mobile Legends whose powers are purely water-based, and this is reflected in both her abilities and her appearance.

Kadita's headwear and accessories have designs inspired by the sea goddess, resembling coral crowns and sea creature motifs, emphasizing her divine and supernatural status. She has shell designs on her attire, which further connects her to the beauty and mystery of the ocean.
In patch 1.4.94, Kadita underwent role adjustments, moving from Mage to Mage/Assassin.
His passive “thalassophobia” is based on a real phobia, that is to say an intense fear of deep bodies of water.

kagura.accroche: A young spirit born from the deep desires stored in the Seimei umbrella, she finally emerged from her dream, like a radiant bloom, in defiance of the dark night.
lore: Although the Scarlet Shadow gave her a name and Hayabusa taught her peace, the young Kagura remained unsure of her true path. When she opened her umbrella in contemplation, she saw not gentle rain but visions of calamity, eons of regret, and a past seen through her umbrella. Kagura finally understood: although born of persistent attachments, her path led to freedom. She would carry both the regrets and hopes of those who had died to experience the beauty of the mortal realm that they had never been able to enjoy, and embrace the future that had been stolen from them but graciously granted to her. ===Spring stirs as dreams fade===

Kagura's origin story was sketchy at best. The old man who had brought her to the Scarlet Shadow was well beyond his years, and whenever he was asked, he simply repeated the same memory: on a rainy spring day over ten years ago, he found an abandoned baby under an umbrella and named it Kagura. Nothing more could be gained from it. The Shadow Sect sensed a mysterious power within her and, after much deliberation, decided to raise the child. Yet Kagura was destined to stay away from them – the power within her rejected their ninjutsu, and she could not understand why these warriors lived and died by their nindo. Only the umbrella, whose origins were equally mysterious, kept him company, in joy and in sadness.

Over time, Kagura learned to find her own peace within the Scarlet Shadow. She observed the manners of the ninjas and took care of those exhausted from training. A young member of the Shadow Sect named Hayabusa told her that they fought tirelessly for honor, and although Kagura nodded in response, she could not understand the meaning of those words.

On spring days, when the cherry blossoms fell like rain, Kagura would sit in the trees, watching the people rushing by below. Everyone had a destination and their steps were hurried but determined. But not knowing where she came from, she never knew where her destination was. She could only brush the fallen petals and fall asleep.

Kagura had always sensed another world beneath her umbrella, but despite countless attempts, she could never unravel its mysteries. Until one late spring day, when she fell asleep as usual among the flowers of a tree. As the spring breeze curled around her fingers and soft petals rested in her hair, her umbrella suddenly seemed different.

It was a dream like no other. Kagura could only watch as things unfolded around her; before his eyes was a young spiritualist who exuded a familiar feeling. He called for his sister, with both sadness and joy so real that it was as if she were there. However, Kagura couldn't answer him. His gaze passed through her and landed on a figure in the distance.

Kagura watched the young man work on his spiritual tools and soon learned his name: Seimei, the legendary spiritual artisan. The young man expressed his sorrows while working hard at his profession: when the imbalance of Yin and Yang caused widespread calamity in the riverlands of Cadia, Seimei went in search of the Great Dragon to quell the unrest. But when he returned with the Great Dragon, he was greeted by the lifeless body of his sister. But he refused to accept this cruel fate. He would do anything to see his sister again, so he created a special spirit tool made of spirit insects: the Seimei Umbrella.
When Seimei opened the umbrella, he could see his sister, smiling and calling to him. But how could a simple illusion born from his desire, a puppet constructed from his memory, be enough?

A tear of blood fell on Kagura as darkness consumed Seimei's once bright eyes. A fragment of the Twilight Orb had unconsciously resonated with his obsession, driving him to madness. Kagura could only watch helplessly as the balance of Yin and Yang collapsed, and countless souls erupted from the Lanterns of Infinite Lights, causing catastrophe once again. The Great Dragon had no choice but to overpower Seimei. In the end, Seimei spat out his last breath of blood as his eyes glowed with defiance. Kagura's vision blurred from tears before fading into darkness.

When she opened her eyes, Kagura found herself near the Lantern of Infinite Lights. As the souls continued to rage, Seimei's apprentice, Akazawa, exhausted himself creating small spirit lanterns to contain them all, but their unrest could not be calmed.

Legend has it that it was the Seimei Umbrella that appeared in the sky at that critical moment, but now it was Kagura instead. She finally understood: it wasn't a dream, but the memories of the umbrella, and she was the spirit of the Seimei umbrella.

Souls gathered around her, whispering. As she listened, these victims of the calamities explained to her why they lingered in the mortal realm. It was not because of worldly desires or bloody revenge, but because of regrets and unfulfilled wishes. They simply wanted to see more of the beauty of the Riverlands of Cadia, witness the spring flowers bloom. They hoped that the umbrella that had accepted all their regrets would see these spectacles for them.

And so, through the accumulation of these lingering thoughts, the umbrella spirit took the form of a young girl, carrying the regrets of all those who still had attachments, born amidst the spring rain of falling cherry blossoms.
Now open your eyes, Kagura.

The dream ended here. Familiarity returned as the flailing of Scarlet Shadow's limbs and falling cherry blossoms filled his vision. But the lingering warmth in her palm and the tears on her face told Kagura that this wasn't just a dream. She looked at the umbrella in her hands, turning it gently. Even though the voices no longer resonated, the spring breeze chose this moment to brush past her, the petals gently wiping away the tears, as if to deliver their unspoken message:

Those born of desire need not be bound by the past; It is only through the young girl's blossoming growth that these lingering regrets can find their answer. Dwelling on past sorrows would only lead to finding yourself trapped in despair like Seimei. These past regrets can never truly be repaired, but now that you know where you came from, use those eyes to witness the beauty in this world that they couldn't.

As the dream faded and spring returned, Kagura understood where his path would take him. She would see, hear and feel all the beauty this world had to offer. She would blossom with her own brilliance – only then could she truly honor their kindness.
Under the tree, voices were calling out his name. Kagura looked down to see Hayabusa and Hanabi ready to catch her.
The mortal realm was rich in splendor, and there was always someone waiting for her to return. Perhaps that was what made life so precious: these simple moments of happiness.
anecdotes: Kagura is the first hero to use the concept of yin and yang.
In the context of Kagura's name, it represents "divine music" or "sacred dance". This suits her character, as she wields the Seimei Umbrella, a magical artifact linked to spiritual power and rituals.

Cultural Significance: Kagura (神楽) refers to traditional Shinto ritual dances performed to honor the gods and invoke blessings. These dances are highly symbolic and were meant to invite spiritual energy. This concept reflects Kagura's role as guardian of the Seimei Shrine, where her actions and abilities also invoke spiritual forces.

Kagura's visual design takes inspiration from traditional Japanese clothing, with her kimono-style dress and elegant, mystical aura fitting the theme of a guardian priestess. Its design incorporates traditional elements while emphasizing its magical nature.
Kagura is the only hero in Mobile Legends whose primary weapon is an umbrella, specifically the Seimei Umbrella.
She is one of the heroes who speaks Japanese along with the Scarlet Shadow heroes.
His voice: kagura.revamp.move14.ogg is indeed a trick to master Kagura. When the umbrella returns to him, it stuns enemies by triggering the reversal of Yin and Yang, as if Yin and Yang reunited.
His abilities without the umbrella (yang) in hand are primarily offensive, while his abilities with the umbrella in hand (yin) are defensive (purify, rush, push back).
She shares her Japanese language voice actor, Gōto Ayasa, with Floryn, another hero with a Poke specialty and a high level of control effects.

kaja.accroche: Chief of Nazar who guards the Heavenly Palace.
lore: The Heavenly Palace, home of the gods, was once a bustling city patrolled by countless Nazar guardians. Any demon that dared to approach the city would be overwhelmed by its unrivaled flying speed and bound by its fearsome lightning whips that would rob its victims of all magical abilities. No demon could escape when pursued by these divine warriors, and thus perpetual peace was maintained in the Heavenly Palace.

As a leader, Kaja was able to refine the power of lighting into pure energy to control as he wished, dealing catastrophic damage to any enemies that faced him, and was responsible for directly protecting the city's ruler. Countless centuries ago, after the city's ruler created the Nazar Guardians and left, the city gradually fell into a state of ruin. When Uranus was activated, the ruler of the Heavenly Palace gave new orders to the Nazar: drive the evil demons out of the city and rebuild the Heavenly Palace in anticipation of the master's return.
anecdotes: Kaja has a particularly close relationship with Uranus, being depicted as being extremely loyal to him in his bending code, paralleling their interactions in Edith's storyline.

kalea.accroche: With her serpent's tail, this proud descendant of the Great Serpent swims gracefully in the Sea of ​​Vonetis, aspiring to one day carry the full power of her heritage.
lore: Unbound tide
In the Sea of ​​Vonetis, an island called Solari Isle was facing the storm of the century. As the waves rose higher and higher, dull thunder rumbled through the gray clouds.

The villagers on the island were panicked: the typhoon had arrived without warning and no fishing boats had yet returned from the sea. They prayed to an ancient idol, hoping that the maiden with the blood of the Great Serpent would hear them and bring their loved ones back safely.
This girl's name was Kalea.
The children, hugging their toys made with the image of the Great Serpent, began to sing a song.
"The wind howls, the waves roar. O Great Serpent, powerful as a mountain, hold back the raging tides..."
Their songs gradually faded away in the increasingly violent storm. Suddenly, a snake tail swept across the waves and headed towards the depths.

Legend has it that a thousand years ago, a gigantic serpent came out of the ocean to protect this island. He swallowed typhoons and withstood waves as high as mountains with his body until he exhausted all his power. Before dying, the Great Serpent left an egg. A thousand years later, a girl miraculously emerged from the egg. She had a human body, a gift from the earth, and a sea serpent's tail, a blessing from the ocean. The goddess Kadita named her Kalea and took her to the sea where she secretly watched her grow.

“Oh Mr. Sea Turtle, why are you swimming so slowly?” Kalea joked as she wrapped her tail around the sea turtle and launched it across the sea with surprising force. After seeing the splashes in the distance, she nodded with satisfaction. "You are welcome!"

“Idiot sharks, why are you so weak?” Kalea spun her tail at high speed, stirring up a strong undercurrent. The sharks were tossed up and down, but Kalea swam effortlessly. “Oh, that must be because your cocks are so small!”

Kalea had awakened the power of the Great Serpent from a young age, but she was never able to control it. Its power surged without warning, turning the seas upside down, much to the dismay of the creatures that lived there. Even Kalea was starting to worry. Every time she tried to channel the full power of the Great Serpent, it slipped out of her control.

Kalea firmly believed that it was her weak, human-like body that was holding her back: "Look at these weak humans. They are slower than turtles and are even afraid of sharks!" If only she didn't have those troublesome arms and legs, she thought, she could swim even faster! If she could finally take the form of the Great Serpent, no sea or land monster would be a match for her! Oh, how she longed for this day. Kadita, who was secretly watching over her, appeared and explained that she couldn't just shed her skin like a snake. Unwilling to accept Kadita's words, Kalea challenged all manner of powerful creatures, hoping to prove herself worthy of the Great Serpent's power.

One day, while wandering the beaches of Solari Island, Kalea was attacked by a swarm of corrupted elementals. Hearing the commotion, the villagers, led by Badang, came to his aid. Badang erected giant walls of sand with his fists to divide the enemy, while villagers threw spears and fishing nets to subdue them. In the end, their combined efforts succeeded in defeating the rogue elementals.
"These humans...maybe they're not so weak after all..."

Kalea began secretly studying how Badang fought with his fists while quietly learning to peel bananas with his fingers. As a descendant of the Great Serpent, she was always reluctant to stoop to learn from mortals, but she couldn't help but be curious about their special lives. Although she tried to keep her distance from the villagers, she found that her power was inexplicably linked to them. Whenever his power grew, he always sought out those in need and healed them.

"I'm just here to test my strength against Badang!" Kalea explained as she appeared more and more often around Solari Island. Badang still smiled helplessly and acted defeated. He saw from their fight that the girl's heart was no longer simply determined to prove her strength.

Cutting down an entire coconut tree with a single punch, freeing a stranded fishing boat with its tail: such acts were not just for his pride. When the villagers gathered to thank her, Kalea would always put her hands on her hips and proudly say something like, "I wasn't trying to help you, I was just bored and exercising my cock!" But all the while, the villagers could see his face redden from the attention.

No matter how hard she tried, Kalea was no closer to becoming the Great Serpent. Her body barely grew, but despite this, the villagers began to turn to her for help, just as they had once turned to her ancestor in times of need; times like now.

A tail cut through the waves at extreme speed. On the surface, the howling wind caused the waves to rise to dizzying heights. A lone fishing boat, caught in the storm, was lifted into the air by waves before being struck with great force.

With a splash, Kalea sprang into action. She grabbed the side of the boat and gently lowered the fallen fishermen aboard with her tail. "Humans are really fragile! But you're pretty brave to be here, even when you don't have a tail!" Kalea proclaimed, standing proudly and tapping the deck with her tail. The power of the Great Serpent burst from his body and spread through the fishermen, causing them to spit out the seawater they had swallowed. Miraculously, they regained their strength as if nothing had happened.

"I'm sorry the ship can't be saved, but you will both be able to witness the power of the Great Serpent!" Without waiting for a response, Kalea grabbed the fishermen's hands and dove from the boat as she made her way to shore.

With her tail, she bounced on the waves, riding the wind and crossing the waves. Kalea saw her reflection wavering in the parting waters; its tail, swinging with determination, and its hands, holding the fishermen tightly. It was who she was. She was no longer determined to become the Great Serpent. As for the power she once sought to contain, she finally realized that she had already found her purpose.
“I guess this body isn’t so bad after all!”
With the turbulent waves behind her, the shore came into view. A child hugging a toy of the Great Serpent enthusiastically pointed to the sea and shouted:
"Look! It's Kalea!"
anecdotes: The name Kalea is of Hawaiian origin and means "brightness" or "clear". It is often associated with Hawaiian culture and spirituality rather than a specific religion. In Hawaii, names often carry deep meanings and connections to nature, family and heritage. But its design and inspiration are drawn from Southeast Asian cultures.
Its design features an aquamarine color palette, reflecting the vibrant hues of the coastal waters and highlighting its role as protector of the Vonestis Sea.
Its position represents S which symbolizes the great serpent.
She loves coconuts and it's her favorite.

Although it has not been officially confirmed, Kalea is said to be one of the heroes created through an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou and Lukas for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
She and Kaja are the only heroes currently with a support/fighter role.
