karina.accroche: Slayer of the Dark Elf tribe who fights to save her sister Selena.
lore: Karina could barely stop herself from shaking as she looked at Selena before her, a woman now almost unrecognizable. Rage, regret, despair… A thousand different emotions invaded him. Yet, she knew that what mattered was that, at that precise moment, her little sister was holding against her like this. She never even imagined that this could happen.

Karina had once believed herself firmly capable of protecting her sister, Selena. They had always been inseparable, dependent on each other for as long as she could remember: elegant, gentle young Elves who roamed the lush forests. Yet with the spread of the corruption of the Abyss, the Shadow Swamp they called home was defiled and fell to evil; all remaining Elves were also corrupted when they became Dark Elves in bondage in the Abyss.

The Dark Elves are of particular importance to the demons, as they retain their ancient elven powers despite having been forced into submission by the Abyss. The Lord of the Abyss seeks them with great greed, determined to use the Dark Elves as stepping stones that will pave the way for him to devour this entire world. No one can escape it.
Karina was trained to be a cold-hearted assassin from a young age. As such, she does not hesitate to use any means necessary to achieve her goals, even if her target is a woman or a child.
But Karina, that cold-blooded killer, always treated her Selena with the greatest warmth and love.

In order to keep Selena safe, Karina asked the leader of their clan to stay current with her profession so as to never be involved in the massacre and murder. While Selena knew nothing of her older sister's adventures, Karina considered her the only comfort in her life otherwise full of murder and violence. Selena was a symbol for her that she could always go home, to be with her sister.

Karina knew very well that if they threw themselves into the battles between light and darkness in the endless war, chaos could be around the corner. Their lives would hang by a thread. She had no choice, but at least she could still protect her little sister.

Under Karina's protection, Selena was kept away from all the murders and plots. What Karina could never have expected, however, was that the barriers she had erected around her sister would gradually erode as she grew up. And the reason her defenses were failing was not from the outside world, but from Karina herself.

As Selena grew up, she realized that something was wrong with her sister. Sometimes Karina would leave the house abruptly, not returning for a long time – and when she did, more often than not, she would be injured from head to toe. Selena never knew how her sister could suffer such injuries, and it tormented her with deep unease.

This time, Karina had returned home, beaten and battered once again. Even in front of her anxious sister, she didn't want to say a word about it. Shortly after her injuries healed, Karina was already preparing to leave again, but now Selena stood in her way. She didn't know what her sister was going to do, but Selena knew that if she let her go again, she could lose her beloved sister forever.

However, Karina did not take into account her left. She knew it was a burden she had to bear alone. Watching her sister disappear into the distance, Selena swore to herself: she would no longer wait at home like a naive child.

Selena cautiously followed Karina, who quickly understood that she was being followed and tried to get her out of her tracks. However, as they left Shadow Marsh, Selena was suddenly attacked by a dark figure; Karina had to act and save her sister from her predicament.

It was the first time Selena saw her older sister in combat. Seeing Karina crush the enemy, Selena felt relieved but also realized that she and her sister lived in two very different worlds. Worlds very far from each other.

Selena sought to become powerful and therefore set out to find the leader of their clan. This was to be the start of Karina's nightmare. The leader had long since fallen into the clutches of the Abyss's corruption, and instead of giving Selena advice, he led her to be a sacrifice for the Abyss, setting the power-hungry girl on a tragic path.
Thanks to Karina's hasty arrival, Selena had changed beyond recognition. The girl hung from the attic, a thick nastiness permeating the air all around.

Selena's naivety led her to sacrifice herself to the Abyss. The Lord of the Abyss stole her entire sense of self, twisted her wishes to protect Karina, and turned her into a tool for world destruction.

Selena no longer heard her sister's desperate cries, Karina had no choice but to cross swords with her, to return her sister torn away by the Abyss. Never did Karina imagine that the combat skills she had worked to perfect would have to be used against her younger sister, nor that Selena would unleash such explosive power against her sister.
Karina failed. Facing defeat at the sister so familiar, but now so foreign to her, she had no choice but to leave as her heart sank with regret.

With that, Karina left the Shadow Marsh to travel through the Land of Despair. She is reborn from the darkness, unleashing all her fury of vengeance on the Abyss and the demons who had taken her dear sister. She swore she would make them pay.
All the while, she held on to this belief: that one day, she could finally bring Selena home.
anecdotes: The name Karina has multiple origins and meanings in different cultures. Of Scandinavian and Latin origin, it is derived from the name Katherine, which means "pure" or "beloved". In Slavic languages, Karina translates to "dear" or "affectionate", while in Arabic it is related to "Karim" (كريم), meaning "generous" or "kind".
His first design looked more human-like, but was later changed to look more like the Dark Elves.
She often says things like "I shouldn't let my emotions show", showing that she is trying to suppress her feelings. Some of his unused lines also referenced his guilt over Selena's fate.
His previous vocal lines were reused from those of Magic Rush hero Seeley. Some quotes are still used after Karina's recast, despite being voiced by a new person.
When initially released, Karina's Leona skin was free.
She and her younger sister, Selena, share their Japanese voice actor, Nokubi Naoko.

lore: Alaghat is a mysterious technical empire. There is a strange humanoid race: Yasson. They are in human form while having a pair of deformed feet. They are agile and born to fight. They also master the techniques that allow them to create a significant civilization and invade others. Since Karrie was a child, she was very talented and trained to become an excellent and arrogant warrior leader. But at the same time, she lost her feelings and became a machine. During a battle, she became overconfident and was seriously injured. But a prophet from another race saved her and injected his consciousness into her brain. Since then, there has been a voice in his head; the prophet told him that the ruin of his empire is about to come and that there will be no more Yasson. After escaping death, Karrie couldn't believe the voice in her head. But she began to suspect that it was just after she returned to her empire. In order to save her empire and for her own redemption, Karrie chose to believe and came to the Land of Dawn. What kind of fate awaits him?
anecdotes: The name Karrie is a female given name, primarily an alternate form of Carrie, and a diminutive of Caroline or Carol, meaning "beloved" or "friend".
Karrie is one of the heroes who can deal more than one type of damage with her skills (physical and true).
His second skill "Phantom Step" is Clint's reused skill from the first generation.
Her Wheel of Justice skin is based on the Egyptian goddess Bastet.

Karrie was officially released in Mobile Legends in 2017. Her arrival marked a shift in the sniper role, as she was designed to be a tank destroyer hero capable of melting down thanks to the durability of tanky heroes, something few other snipers could do at the time.

khaleed.accroche: A fearless clan leader who walks on the sand.
lore: There was an ancient tribe that lived in the endless deserts of the barren lands of Agelta. They built villages along the Emerald Road and were able to pass down their civilization and heritage through countless generations.

As the prince of the Artha clan, Khaleed loved adventures. He longed to experience the once-glorious culture of the Emerald Road, dreaming of one day being able to visit the vast barren lands of Agelta and witness its prosperity. Since he was young, Khaleed often took his squires with him on an adventure along the Emerald Road.

During their adventure, Khaleed met Prince Moskov of the Wildsand clan. The two equally courageous young men shared the same passion for adventure, quickly bonded and developed a strong friendship. Together, they explored the entire barren lands of Agetla.

However, Khaleed and Moskov's adventure was short-lived. It wasn't long before disaster struck their clans. The wild leader of Clan Thornwolf has declared a war and planned to conquer all the barren lands of Agelta, just as the tyrant Khufra once did. Facing ruthless enemies, Khaleed and Moskov courageously decided to lead their people and fight against the invaders until the end.

During the war, Khaleed demonstrated strong leadership and great charisma. Each clan recognized his abilities and followed his example. Over time, the ambitious Moskov lost his limelight and gradually began to resent him. However, Khaleed did not notice his friend's feelings.

Khaleed and Moskov led the alliance of clans and repelled their enemies. But just as they were about to take control of this war, an accident happened. To turn the tide against their enemy, the retreating Thornwolf clan decided to go to Tihuacan, the ancient city, and break the seal that bound Khufra. Eventually, they succeeded and woke up the sleeping Tyrant.
When Khufra came back to life, sandstorms raged across Agelta. And then, the heinous sand monsters followed, rising from the depths of the desert.

Faced with Khufra and the sand monsters, Khaleed was decisive. He ordered his allies to withdraw and prepare for future conflicts. But a resentful Moskov viewed Khaleed's decision as an act lacking courage and responsibility. He challenged Khaleed in front of the crowd and criticized him for his cowardice. He asked the clans to follow him and end the terror of Khufra.

However, the leaders of each clan decided to listen to Khaleed and did not support his strategy. No one answered Moskov's call. The humiliated Moskov became even more irritated. Khaleed tried to stop him, but Moskov didn't listen. He led his people into the wilderness, eager to prove their abilities on the battlefield.

However, Moskov and his people were quickly surrounded and cornered by the fearsome Khufra and the sand monsters. It was a massacre, Khaleed was faced with a dilemma. He had to choose between the safety of the friend he had fought with for many years, or the lives and futures of all the clans.

But he couldn't have it both ways. Khaleed had no choice. After careful consideration, he decided to withdraw with the clan alliance. After reaching a safe location, Khaleed took his scimitar and returned to save Moskov, all alone.
But it was too late. The Wildsand clan has been wiped out. Bodies were scattered on the ground and Moskov was missing. Khaleed only managed to find his spear, which lay broken, amid the bloodbath.

Followed by Khufu's resurrection, the western part of the Land of Dawn once again fell into chaos. Most of the land has been devoured by violent sandstorms, and evil sand monsters have infested this once peaceful ancient place. Now, carrying the guilt of leaving Moscow behind, the determination for vengeance, and the expectation of his people, Khaleed led his warriors in many battles over the next few years. They fought against Khufra and the army of the Thornwolf clan, turning the tide in their favor step by step.

In the final battle, Khaleed charged into a sandstorm, wielding Moskov's Spear, and stabbed through the artifact Khufra held in his hand: the Sand Orb. The orb began leaking quicksand, most of which entered Khaleed's body and gave him the ability to command the sands.

The Sand Orb was shattered and the sandstorms that once darkened the blue sky no longer existed. The sand monsters dissolved into oblivion and Khufra, injured, retreated to Tihuacan, the ancient city. But as long as the Tyrant and his minions lived, Khaleed would always have the heavy responsibility of protecting the western region. He prepared himself and his warriors for a future battle against the malevolent Khufra. He made a solemn vow to restore peace to ancient Agelta.
However, deep in the shadows, a familiar figure lurked behind and spied on Khaleed's every move. His old friend Moskov had returned.
anecdotes: It is most likely that Khaleed took inspiration from modern Saudi Arabia's Arab general of the Rashidun Caliphate, Khalid ibn al-Walid. A famous general who fought against the Persians and Romans and won dozens of battles.
"Khaleed's Revenge. It's a clash between Khaleed, Moskov and Khufra. Will they fight side by side or against each other?"

lore: Sealed Ancient Tyrant The ruler of the ancient city of Tivacan was furious, cold-blooded, and greedy. In order to get help from astrologers, astrologer Esmeralda sets off on a wild chase. Esmeralda was initially bewitched by him, but she woke him up and locked him away. Now he is about to wake up and continue the battle of destiny with the descendants of the astrologers. === Bio === On the edge of the Western Desert, an ancient city hides among the sands. Despite the ages that have passed, the sands of the desert have failed to devour this city which stands proud and majestic in a sea of ​​emptiness. Scholars of antiquities have long spoken of this legendary city, whose most infamous ruler was none other than Khufra.

Khufra was a miserly ruler, colder than ice and infinitely miserly. In order to satisfy his personal desire to rule, he led Arnak's powerful army to invade the city and conquer the Western Desert. Tirelessly, Khufra expanded his domain and his riches beyond all comparison. Unfortunately, the Minoan Empire proved to be too difficult an enemy to conquer.

Despite this, Khufra yearned for more power. He sought the most famous astrologer in the Land of Dawn for help. Much to Khufra's dismay, the astrologer knew of Khufra's insidious aims, refused and was promptly killed. Only young Esmeralda felt deeply attracted to Khufra, who then became lovers. Khufra's insensitivity has thrown Esmeralda into a mess of internal conflict and love. Gradually, Esmeralda loved Khufra deeply and began to help Khufra in her rule. Over time, Esmeralda used her magical abilities to grant Khufra never before seen magical powers. However, Khufra became increasingly cruel and power-hungry. His conquests did not stop at the Western Desert, he sought to conquer the entire Land of Dawn. Seeing the cruelty of her love, Esmeralda decided to save Khufra from the hatred of the people. Even then, Khufra continued to use magic to enhance her powers.

He asked Esmeralda to give him all the spells. He must completely eliminate the Minoan Empire. No one could question his power. One night, Esmeralda came to Khufra and she kissed her lover deeply. She began to place Khufra under a powerful curse, as Khufra awaited the ultimate power given by Esmeralda. Suddenly, Khufra felt himself being suppressed by a powerful force. He turned his head and looked at Esmeralda. No matter how Khufra tried to free herself, Esmeralda kept chanting her curse. Khufra couldn't believe that his lover was punishing him. Esmeralda cried as she locked her love into an eternal sleep. She chose to personally lock her lover in the ancient city and built a grand monument. Esmeralda believed it was best to put an end to Khufra before he was despised by the people, going down in history as a cruel king who only loved power. Since then, the smoke of war in the Western Desert has disappeared.

However, hundreds of years later, a cataclysmic event occurred in the Western Desert. A wave of energy from an orb woke Khufra from her sleep, who was swelling with hatred and anger. Back to the world. Khufra could not accept her lover's betrayal in the past. His abilities and desires were stronger than ever. He vowed to find Esmeralda and continue to conquer the centuries-old wish to hold the Land of Dawn in his hands.
anecdotes: The name Khufra may be based on the Kufra basin and group of oases in Libya.
The story of Khufra's conception and origin is loosely based on a mummy.

Whenever he and Esmeralda meet as opponents during a match, the two share special dialogues, the first in MLBB. Dialogue can be triggered by one of the two killing or helping each other kill each other, or randomly throughout the match.

kimmy.accroche: Born into a military family, she gained recognition on her own merit as the bold yet laid-back “tough girl” of the border guards.
lore: A cool girl who loves technology and invention Born into a traditional military family in the Moniyan Empire, she received military education from a young age, so she was a bit of a tomboy. At the same time, Kimmy is not bound by tradition. She is obsessed with technology and inventions. In order to prove herself to her father, Kimmy retrieves her invention and joins the Imperial Expeditionary Army.

=== Aim for the sky === If you were to ask Kimmy about her most memorable childhood memory, she would tell you without hesitation: it was the weight of the medals adorning her father's military uniform. Born into a military family, the girl secretly vowed to become a greater soldier than her father.
But when she enthusiastically shared her dream with him, his usual gentle demeanor turned stern as he dismissed her aspirations. Put your calloused hand
above her little head he said, “I want my daughter to have a peaceful, carefree life.” »

Even though her wings were confined in the cage her father built, Kimmy never gave up her dream of soaring. She read military books in secret, looked through her family's military records, and even after being sent to Eruditio for her studies, she never stopped dreaming.

Perhaps Kimmy's most carefree and joyful days were spent at Eruditio. She cut her hair short and made many friends, one in particular, Beatrix, becoming her closest companion. The two men were united by the fierce determination they shared. Kimmy helped Beatrix test various weapons. No matter how complex their design or controls, it always seemed to bring out their true potential.
"Why don't you go? Enlist first and tell him later!" Kimmy's heart raced
Beatrix's suggestion. As their fists collided, their rebel alliance was officially sealed.

Kimmy packed her bags and left Eruditio to join the Moniyan Empire's Western Border Guards. The closer she got to the military outpost, the more desolate the surroundings became, but her heart was broken.
I have never felt more fulfilled. She reached upward, as if she could grasp the sky itself.

Kimmy's start in the border guards was anything but easy. Her time spent in Eruditio and her young age led many hardened soldiers to view her as a privileged girl who was simply looking for cheap thrills. She paid no attention to their gossip, instead throwing herself into her training, using her pent-up ambition as fuel to her fire, and the results were visible: she came first in the Imperial Joint Tactical Exercise and demonstrated extraordinary skill in both marksmanship and close-quarters combat. His achievements finally silenced the rumors and naysayers. Many began to see Kimmy in a new light, and some were even inspired to train harder.

That's when the Department of Weapons invented a new weapon: a Starlium-powered jetpack and rifle. However, its complex operation was too difficult for most testers, but Kimmy's talent and experience allowed her to master it almost immediately. The weapon found its full potential in his hands, shocking even researchers. Muzzle flashes lit Kimmy's path - the Hoverjet Blaster became her weapon, and together they would shine in battle.

Kimmy paid no attention to the cold stares of the others, focusing only on her own efforts. The flight had released her and was ready to spread its wings and fly away. Yet… thoughts of her father still filled her with doubts.

Shortly after, Kimmy was assigned to an elite team, deploying her weapon in combat for the first time during a major rescue mission. The enemy, very mobile and intimate with the terrain, had the upper hand. Despite this being Kimmy's first real combat mission, she remained remarkably calm. She quickly identified the enemy's movement patterns, followed them to a small outpost, and launched a successful first strike on her own.
Before the thrill of victory faded, the extent of the enemy's operations was revealed: they had kidnapped soldiers

researchers to force them to create new weapons. Worse, they had already used stolen weapons to ambush frontline troops, causing heavy casualties. With no time to call for reinforcements, Kimmy disguised herself in enemy clothing and infiltrated their fortress, quickly locating the holding cells.

Behind the iron bars were more than a dozen imprisoned allies. Kimmy acted decisively, opening the prison doors with her rifle. The sound alerted his comrades waiting to launch their attack outside. Thanks to their coordinated assault from within and without, chaos erupted within the enemy fortress, leading to their rapid defeat.

As Kimmy evacuated the prisoners, an older officer, slowed by his injuries, caught his attention. Those familiar shoulders, that short cut of gray hair – that was his father. Kimmy, usually fearless, felt her confidence waver. She had never told her strict father about enlisting. As their eyes met, Kimmy prepared herself for the worst. However, after a moment's pause, he simply gave her a formal military salute, pretending not to recognize his masked daughter. His voice was no longer as deep as he remembered, and his injured stature seemed smaller than he remembered. He advised the “new recruit” to do something in the army. Kimmy shouldered her gun and nodded solemnly while trying to keep her voice from shaking.
New missions expected on the horizon. Kimmy looked up at the sky, knowing that her wings now held her father's.
expectations. She was destined to reach even greater heights.
anecdotes: Kimmy is a feminine name derived from a diminutive form of Kimberly, which began as an English place name combining "Cyneburg" (royal fortress) and "leah" (glade). As a standalone name, Kimmy has a cheerful, friendly quality that retains the warmth of a nickname while functioning as a full name. Kimmy conveys approachability and youthful charm, making it appealing to parents looking for a name that is sweet without being too formal.
Kimmy is the first hero and currently the only hero to be a Marksman/Mage type.
She is the third hero in the game who can convert one stat (attack speed) into another stat (magic power).
When she plays Hero Voice in Japanese, instead of saying "Fighting 'Kimmy!" ”, she says “Fighting Jimmy!”
While still in development, Kimmy's first name and hero title was Mary the Ink Queen.
The name may refer to Marie who is an Inkling/Squid from Nintendo's Splatoon.
Kimmy is one of the heroes to receive an overhaul even before its release on the original server.
Its basic attack spread and pierced enemies similar to shotgun pellets.
She had 2 skill sources: one for her first skill and one for her second skill.
His second skill was another basic attack enhancement skill similar to his first skill, but was later transformed into a blink skill that consumes no energy.

Before her overhaul in the 1.6.10 patch notes, Kimmy had mixed damage alongside Esmeralda, but she was later replaced with a magic damage specialty, making Esmeralda the only hero specializing in mixed damage.
The melody she speaks when chosen with the Dragon Tamer skin is a parody of Hush Little Baby Don't Say A Word by The King's Singers 1987.
She is the third hero capable of performing basic attacks while moving with a joystick. Irithel and Leomord (while riding Barbiel in his Phantom Steed) are the other heroes to do so.

lancelot.accroche: Prodigal son and genius swordsman of House Baroque.
lore: To the [southwest] of the Moniyan Empire [is] Castle Gorge which had fallen into decline due to the depletion of its famous gold mines.

As the oldest noble in the Empire, House Baroque ruled over Castle Gorge. The Baroque Duke's eldest son, Lancelot, was a handsome young man with [unparalleled] swordsmanship. He received a good education in all areas, but also inherited his father's snobbery and haughtiness.

The Baroque house had been in decline for years and the Duke relied on loans to maintain a [façade]. To revive his family, the duke had a brilliant plan: choose a daughter-in-law with a nice dowry and make his fortune thanks to Lancelot's marriage. At least that's what he thought...

Lancelot was fascinated by charming knights and their heroic tales since childhood and believed that he was the most brilliant and charismatic knight of modern times. So, for him, it would tarnish his honor if he earned money from his own marriage. Thus, Lancelot left home after a ridiculous duel with his father leading to a serious falling out.

Although he had lost his father's financial support, Lancelot earned his living through his excellent swordsmanship by competing in competitions across the land. He never lost a battle in the arena and uttered his family motto "The thorns remain if the petals fall" while signing his initials on his opponent's body with his sword.

Freed from his father's control, Lancelot began to play with women and stories of his romantic adventures spread throughout the empire. People jokingly called it the Blade of Roses. But Duke Baroque clearly didn't think of it as a delightful story and was told that he had struck Lancelot's name from their family records in a fit of anger...

Lancelot played and traveled to Lake Azure, and after drinking his fill in a tavern, he held a harp, played and sang a song in its praise, secretly rejoicing in the cheers of the crowd. Then he suddenly saw a few drunks surrounding a young girl in a velvet coat. Immediately, he took out his sword to help the harassed girl out of the situation, but he was accidentally injured due to his intoxicated mind.
After chasing away the drunken hooligans, Lancelot stumbled out of the tavern, knowing his wound could be fatal, and he refused to collapse in a tavern so gracefully.

Covered in blood, he dragged himself towards a tree and fell to the ground. Before he lost consciousness, he saw a pair of glowing swan wings. Perhaps they were the angels who came to welcome his soul to paradise?

Lancelot awoke to find that he was lying on a bed with bandages wrapped around his chest, an elegant young girl smiling wearily at himself. The swan wings he saw before he passed out were actually the swan crown on the girl's head. Lancelot thought he had never seen such a beautiful and innocent face, but he could barely speak before falling back into a deep sleep...

The girl treated Lancelot with great care and continued to use magic to help him heal. After a few days of struggle, his life was finally no longer in danger. It was then that Lancelot learned that he lived in the swan castle of House Alvin and that the girl who saved him was Princess Odette of the noble family.

It was forbidden to let outsiders into Swan Castle, so Odette brought Lancelot in and hid him in a room at the top of the castle tower. As Lancelot gradually recovered from his injury, Odette delivered food to him every day with a young servant.
At first, Lancelot conceitedly thought that Odette had saved him because she had been seduced by his charisma. But later he found out that she was the girl he was helping at the tavern.

During the first days they spent together, Lancelot did not change his old habit of telling half-truths about his mastery of the sword and the great adventures he had experienced across the land. He hid his Baroque identity and called himself "Lancelot, the Romantic Knight of Castle Gorge". Odette believed in every poem he sang while playing the harp, whether it was about his hometown, Castle Gorge, or the Heavenly Palace he had never been to, the bandits and thieves he had defeated, or the dark deities he had only heard about on his travels. This young princess who had been locked inside the Swan Castle since she was a child was full of curiosity about the outside world.

Rather than his usual self, Lancelot began to feel guilty for lying. When he could no longer boast of his conquests in front of Odette, he realized that he had fallen madly in love with the pure princess. He regretted the promiscuity he led before but had difficulty revealing his feelings to Odette. So every time she came to visit him, Lancelot would hold the harp and sing passionate love songs. At first, Odette did not understand his intentions, then no longer knew how to react. Later, she remained silent, her cheeks blushing...

In the few days before Lancelot was fully healed, Odette, for some reason, never showed up once. Unable to see the object of his desire, Lancelot couldn't even stop his fingers from trembling while playing the harp...

Lancelot, agitated, had to question the servant who came to deliver him food what had happened to Odette. The girl replied with a cheerful smile: "Someone proposed to our princess. She was busy with that..."
The words hit him like thunder. At that very moment, Lancelot, completely shocked, broke a string of the harp.
After thinking about the situation, he asked the maid to send a letter to Odette:

Dear princess, forgive me for leaving without goodbye. I decided to travel to all the mythical countries like in the songs I sang. I promise you that the day I return to Swan Castle, I will appear before you as a true knight. I hope that with Lake Azure and the sunlight as my witness, I will finally be able to tell you what I have been whispering to myself...
By the time Odette dropped off the letter and rushed to look out the window, Lancelot had quietly left on a grand journey across the country.
As brutal wars raged across the Land of Dawn, the Blade of Roses was about to compose a song of praise that was truly her own...
anecdotes: Lancelot's fighting style is heavily inspired by fencing. He wields a rapier, the primary weapon of fencing, known for its speed and precision.
Along with his lover Odette, Gatotkaca, Kadita and Leomord, they are the only heroes based on literature.
It is based on the character of the same name in Arthurian legend; Described as King Arthur's greatest companion. Another hero based on Arthurian legend is Leomord.
In legend, her character's lover is supposed to be Guinevere, but this was changed in-game as she was revealed as his younger sister.
The letter "L" he draws in his old entrance animation is inspired by Zorro's signature "Z".
He seems to show a lot of love for his swords. This is evident from his quotes “my sword”, “Become one with the sword! »

Lancelot is the second hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin when Bren Esports won the M2 World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Harith, Estes, Chou, Brody, and Joy.
The Baroque house is the oldest ducal family existing since the beginning of the Moniyan Empire.

lapu-lapu.accroche: Hero who defends the Vonetis Islands against outsiders
lore: From the top of the summit, Lapu-Lapu contemplated the flames of the Moniyan camp, at the foot of the mountain. He never thought he would once again find himself on a battlefield, the kind of place he hated the most. But he knew that to protect what was most important, he could no longer run away.
From the middle of the Age of Strife, the Dorik people came to the Vonetis Islands, southeast of the mainland, where they prospered.

Just as turbulent waves are the normal state of the sea, this solitary archipelago was by no means peaceful. The protection of the sea and the isolated way of life made the Dorik forget the vows made by the different tribes hundreds of years before to join forces and resist the powerful Moniyan navy and there was constant conflict between the tribes large and small.

Lapu-Lapu was the most famous warrior of the Vonetis Islands. It was employed by various tribes for a long period, passing between islands. The endless fighting brought him weariness, dignity, honor and money... On the battlefield, human lives were worthless. So[,] what was the value of all this? After fighting countless wars, he returned to his hometown with his body and mind scarred.

Lapu-Lapu led a quiet life in his hometown as an ordinary hunter, working at sunrise and resting at sunset. But the peaceful life he hoped for did not last. Some warlords who had defected from the Moniyan Empire set their sights on this free land. Well-trained troops landed on the Vonetis Islands like a tidal wave. The scattered Dorik peoples were powerless to resist, and large areas of land fell to the enemy.

Various tribes sent invitations to Lapu-Lapu, hoping that he might join their camp. He was no longer willing to work for the interests of the tribal leaders, but under no circumstances could he become a contemptible capitulator. He therefore rejected the beliefs of the rulers and the Moniyan and simply wanted to remain a simple hunter, away from any worldly conflict.

Lapu-Lapu and the Moniyan entered into a non-aggression agreement. However, in the eyes of the greedy Moniyans, neutrality did not exist and everything in the Vonetis Islands belonged to them. Soon, the Moniyans broke the agreement and ransacked Lapu-Lapu's tribe in his absence.

This humiliating loss left him with nothing but mourning for his wife and children and a devastated home. Lapu-Lapu was furious. He wanted nothing more than to protect everything around him. If the Moniyan wanted to pay for his compromises with perfidy, he would show them his inviolable dignity in the form of their own blood.

Lapu-Lapu gathered the tribe's youth into a unit and began his resistance campaign. He knew the hometown under his feet better than anyone and knew how to attack, fight and retreat in the mountains and forests. The unit continued to attack Moniyan bases and supply lines, coming and going without a trace, leaving the Moniyan in constant confusion and panic.

When a Moniyan warlord discovered that all this was the work of Lapu-Lapu, the despicable invaders began to deliberately plunder the villages with which Lapu-Lapu had allied himself. They strengthened their defenses and hid supplies to force Lapu-Lapu to appear. The villages that once cordially welcomed Lapu-Lapu had become completely unrecognizable under the iron boot of the Moniyan.

Lapu-Lapu, heartbroken, understood that guerrilla warfare would not be enough to achieve final victory. The Dorik were destined to confront the powerful Moniyan Empire head-on; an arguably impossible task for him and his unit.
anecdotes: Lapu-Lapu's English voice includes the Tagalog line ("Umalis kayo sa aming lupain"), implying that he is bilingual and that the language of the Dorican people being Tagalog is canon.
The “Vulcan” skin owes its name to the god of the same name associated with fire in Roman mythology.
The “Imperial Champion” is based on the military personal equipment of ancient Rome.

The "Adlaw's Chosen" skin is likely inspired by the word "adlaw" in Cebuano and other Visayan languages, meaning "sun". The sun symbolizes power, heroism and strength, all of which represent Lapu-Lapu, the first Filipino hero who resisted Spanish colonization. “The skin resembles the ancient aesthetic of Visayan warriors, connecting it to pre-colonial Filipino culture.

layla.accroche: The backbone of the Eruditio Rangers, also known as the Shining Star.
lore: "Layla Grant, a prominent member of the Eruditio Rangers, bravely protected the heart of Eruditio technology, the Starlium Reactor, during a violent attack on Eruditio just a day earlier. While her actions protected civilization, they also proved that the city's youth possessed resilience and perseverance and that love and belonging in this home they shared was the life force that flowed through the veins of the Eruditios. Thus, the honorary title of “Bright Star” was given to her.”

This year, the title of Shining Star was not awarded to a scholar, but to a member of the Eruditio Rangers. and it was none other than the “daughter of Eruditio”. She grew up on the streets of Eruditio, and every scholar of the Spire of Knowledge had experienced her mischievous nature at one time or another. Somehow, the problems she caused would miraculously help scholars achieve a breakthrough in their research. Other times, Layla would suddenly try to close a deal on behalf of the traders with her funny accent when they had difficulty conversing with the foreign visitors. Every porter on the docks also benefited from his help in one way or another. Like an ever-assisted guardian, she watches over the city like a bright star.

Meanwhile, Layla's only blood relative; the old but still strong as a bull, former captain of the Eruditio Rangers, Thomas, had never shown signs of joy. Sitting in a backlit room, his figure resembled the distant shadow of high mountains. Fondling an old-fashioned pistol, he looked both imposing and desolate.

Holding a crying baby in her arms, Thomas's beloved daughter disappeared behind the "Infinite Gateway" which turned into stardust in the sky, leaving him with only this precious little thing. As if she knew what was happening, her screams echoed endlessly through the night sky. Hastily, he ran home with the child in his arms as the morning star in the east gradually rose. He didn't want the light of day to harm him because the protection of night was fading quickly. He had lost a daughter at the dawn of humanity, and the one in his arms was all he had left.
He wrapped the baby in the cloak of darkness to hide him, naming him after the night: Layla.

Over time, she grew and was a real pleasure to Thomas's barren life. She loved both heaven and earth, and her little life was always full of joyful energy. As a result, Thomas' face, once marked by pain, began to smile again. He collected the equipment from his youth while he was still a young Ranger, and together with Layla, he jumped off the ground and flew over the horizon of Eruditio, becoming the biggest headache for the young Rangers of Eruditio. What were these poor guys supposed to do, chase down and arrest the old man whose face is printed on the Ranger rulebook? She was everything to Thomas: dawn, noon and dusk. But deep down, she still wanted to know her parents.
"It's a tragedy that they had to die in the meteor crash. Hey, why don't we check out Grandpa's newly developed weapon for you? It has three times the firepower of the previous one!"

"When Layla's ponytails reached her shoulders, she stopped asking him about his parents because she could no longer stand to see the sadness and evasiveness in her grandfather's eyes. She soon realized that the grandfather who never left her side always left the house before dawn one day a year. So Layla quietly followed him and discovered the answer to her question. He had gone to a cemetery to pay his respects to a woman named Lillian, a name that Layla had seen in an old newspaper and which appeared in an official obituary of the Spire of Knowledge She was a great scholar who died for the advancement of the Eruditio Layla realized that this was her mother and that knowledge made her proud beyond measure, but she was also saddened by the thought that they could never be together. photo but just one line: I will hold your hand in the middle of the starry sky.

Layla understood that her grandfather wanted to erase all traces of her parents from her life so that she would never have to grieve. Even though Layla understood, she still wanted to leave a little door in her heart for the woman named Lillian, so that if she ever missed Lillian, she could always visit her in her dreams. As for the tombstone of the mysterious man, since she had no idea who he was, she hoped that one day he would walk through that little door with his mother and finally reveal his true identity.

In his heart. Layla swore that she would remember her mother no matter what and protect Eruditio, the city her mother had given her life for. In her grandfather's eyes, Layla was following a very different path from her mother. She didn't like studying and failed every exam she took, but she was strong, and no scoundrel ever left without learning a lesson. However. this was great news for her grandfather, because that way she would never end up a scholar, sacrificing herself for the future of humanity. And above all, she would never experience the same fate as... Lillian.

So when Thomas learned that Layla had almost died protecting Eruditio, he entered the room he had sealed for 15 years and sat there for a long time. Lillian's entire life flashed through her mind. She was incredibly passionate, intelligent, and brave, and she was also protective of Eruditio in her own way. She was the brightest star in the sky, and they were exactly the same.
“Hey, grandpa.”

The girl's shy voice echoed in the doorway and a belt could be seen hanging around her body. It seemed that the treatment at the Spire of Knowledge had perfectly restored his body. However, Layla was full of guilt because she knew how much her grandfather would do for her, even for a small scratch. So, this time, since she had been seriously injured while protecting Eruditio, she expected her grandfather to get really angry...
But he held her tightly to him, his whole body trembling violently.
“Your mother would be so proud of you.”

Thomas handed Layla the gun he had locked in the closet – a prototype gun left by Lillian. For 15 years, he couldn't bear to see any trace of Lillian, but he forgot that the girl in front of him was the deepest trace Lillian left on him.
"If you want to protect Eruditio, then you will have to do so with the strongest firepower. This is a weapon...that your mother and father made. So hold it tight and protect yourself with it!"

With the evil gun in Layla's hands, no evil stands a chance before her. As if the stars are always guiding her, every time Layla holds her gun, she feels like Lillian is right next to her. Even this nameless man is there for her.
anecdotes: Layla (ليلى) is an Arabic name meaning "night" or "dark beauty". This matches his midnight blue energy based attacks, which resemble cosmic or nocturnal elements.
Layla is the first hero to appear in official MLBB cinematics. Layla is one of the main protagonists in MLBB lore and appears in several animated trailers and official comics.
Layla's first original design was based on the main character from the Black Rock Shooter franchise.

She has the longest attack range in the game (perhaps tied only with Zhask, considering the attack range of her Nightmaric Spawn), unlocking her at level 12 she is able to attack enemy turrets outside of their own attack range, making her one of the best heroes for destroying enemy turrets.
From 2016 to 2020, she is the first hero that new players can get for free after completing the tutorial, but she was replaced by Eudora.
The sound of her projectile matches her evil gun (Layla); the further away the target is, the higher the intensity of the sound effect.

She is the fourth hero to have two Starlight skins ("Bunny Babe" and "Twilight Waltz"), after Moskov ("Snake Eye Commander" and "Violet Spear"), Saber ("Force Warrior" and "Iron Hound"), and Clint ("Rock and Roll" and "Operator CL").
Additionally, the names of his painted skins, "Midnight Waltz" and "Sunset Waltz", did not match their respective appearances upon release. This was fixed in an unknown update.
Layla's "Blue Specter" skin is considered the rarest and unobtainable skin in the game. It was Layla's first exclusive skin and was only available during early MLBB events in 2017.
Layla's "S.A.B.E.R. Breacher" skin is her default skin for Battleground Blitz.

Layla was one of the revamped heroes in the first batch of Project NEXT in September 2020, along with Miya, Eudora, Zilong, Alucard, and Saber. The goal was to balance the power gap between older and newer heroes, as the latter had better mechanics and animations.

relations: Diggie, Dr. Rooney, Johnson, Bruno, Lolita, Beatrix, Kimmy (companions)

leomord.accroche: A sworn knight who swore to guard Necrokeep until his last breath.
lore: A sworn knight who swore to guard Necrokeep until his last breath. Once a sworn knight of Ridgeburg, Leomord was forced to break the oath he took with his own sword in an unfortunate turn of events. Since then, he carried the curse of the Mist and guarded the lands abandoned even by death. The light had faded, and yet his guard had only just begun... === The Oath === Perched on the rocks of the Lantis Mountains, the colossal spiers of Ridgeburg overlooked the blackened plains of the Abyss. The rot had spread almost to the outskirts of the city, but no further. For thousands of years, fortified towers stood guard at the gates of the Abyss, keeping the Moniyan Empire safe from its scourge.

Léomord was born in this border fortress. Coming from a long line of royal guards under the Southern lords, he was hired as the personal squire of Atticus, the son of the Duke of Ridgeburg, shortly after his birth.

Together, the two boys trained under the best champions of Ridgeburg's army and listened to gray-bearded professors talk about history and politics. Atticus excelled in every lesson, showing remarkable maturity beyond his years, while Leomord struggled to keep up with his young master's pace. Reluctant to be left behind, he continued to train in secret, working alone day and night to perfect his skills.
Being slightly older, Atticus often helped young Léomord during his training. Leomord, in turn, considered Atticus not only his future lord, but also his older brother.

At the age of seven, both boys helped give birth to their horses, as was the custom among the people of Ridgeburg. Léomord named his pony Barbiel, with whom he became an ally and close friend. Although Léomord never expressed his feelings openly, Barbiel always seemed to know what was on his mind. And whenever Léomord felt depressed, Barbiel rubbed his head to offer him some relief.
Over the next few years, both boys became formidable fighters on the training ground, and that's when fate struck.

After the old duke's untimely death, Atticus was forced to assume his father's role as the new Duke of Ridgeburg, with Leomord at his side as captain of his royal guard. The boys had never tasted real combat, but seeing the gravity of the situation, they quickly set out to rid the border outposts of demonic intruders. For years, the two men fought endlessly, until they finally cleansed all traces of the Abyss from the Periphery.

Once the city had found some respite from the assault, Atticus decided it was time to begin building ties with other noble houses in the Empire. He sought an alliance with the royal house of Gaius, proposing to Princess Vexana. Lord Gaius welcomed the offer and quickly arranged for the princess to travel to Ridgeburg and meet her fiancé.

And yet, destiny had something else in mind for the young duke. Shortly before Vexana's expected arrival, he received a letter from one of the border towns. An unusually vicious race of demons had begun to appear along the border, and oddly enough, they carried traces of the same putrid magic that had once tormented his father. Some of the city's inhabitants had also disappeared, and the outpost requested the Duke's help in ridding the city of this threat.
Atticus immediately gathered his men. He had no doubt that this quest could finally unravel the mystery of his father's death. Léomord, on the other hand, only felt a terrible presentiment.

Before leaving, Atticus led Léomord to the top of the city walls. He drew his sword and motioned for Leomord to kneel on one knee. Knowing exactly what was going to happen, the young soldier took a deep breath and solemnly knelt before Atticus as he was told.

"Duke Atticus, I do hereby swear, in the name of my father and his house, that I will always lend my sword in your service, that I will give you advice when you ask for it, and that I will lay down my life if your safety requires it. I swear it this day, until the day of my death."

Atticus placed the blunt of his sword on Leomord's shoulder and declared him a sworn knight of Ridgeburg. The young soldier had difficulty containing himself. For over twenty years, they trained and fought together. And that day, Atticus had deemed him worthy of his trust.

As the Duke handed him the Sword of Oath, Leomord knew that this was his destiny: to ride alongside his lord in this battle that could very well be his last. Except that Atticus had a different task for him: Leomord was to stay and keep guard at Ridgeburg.

The knight couldn't believe what he had just heard, but Atticus's eyes were serious and stern. Princess Vexana would soon arrive; she would need all the help and protection she could get. And the Duke could count on no one else to carry this delicate burden than his closest friend, Leomord.

And so, at first light, the young knight watched Atticus and his party disappear into the horizon. He clutched the sword of the Duke's Oath, pondering the new task at hand, which he felt was far greater than any battle he had ever fought.
For two years, Léomord and Princess Vexana waited. The quest took much longer than expected, and at one point Atticus even stopped sending letters back.

And then one day, suddenly, a messenger arrived to announce the Duke's return. Leomord let out a long sigh, as his mind finally felt at ease. Except that instead of the joy he expected to see in Atticus' eyes, he saw only… emptiness.

The campaign must have been brutal and arduous, he could only assume. Leomord chose not to push further and quickly set about joining the townsfolk in preparing for the long-delayed wedding of Duke Atticus and Princess Vexana.

The people of Ridgeburg welcomed the evening with festivity and joy. The time had finally come for Atticus to give the alliance to Vexana. However, as the Duke opened the box, what came out was a pair of magical wings, as a deep, squeaky voice shook the stone walls of the fortress:

Embrace the world of death! » Atticus and his men transformed into demons at that very moment, their eyes burning with malice. They reeked of foul magic – rotten and vile – the putrid scourge of the Abyss. The city's once devoted guardians have become destroyers and the bane of their existence; sacred marriage turned into a massacre.

Leomord clutched the Sword of the Oath, his mind blank as blood-curdling screams pierced his ears and pierced his skull. He couldn't understand what was happening in front of him, and more importantly, why Atticus would wield his blade against the people he had loved as his own, against the girl he had sworn to protect until he died.
The furious duke threw himself at Princess Vexana.
"STOP!"
Vexana's voice echoed throughout the room. Atticus froze, his legs shaking as his labored breathing scraped his lungs.
“Kill me… Leo— K-kill me… I’m begging you—”
Léomord could only look at him in horror. All he could think about was the wish he made two years ago.
“I hereby swear…in the name of my father and his house, that I…will lay down my life if your safety requires it.
Does the Duke's security weigh more heavily than the security of the city? » the young knight wondered silently, just before gritting his teeth and driving his blade into Atticus' chest.
The duke's eyes brightened, as if freed from a curse. Gripping Léomord's vest, the words that came out of his mouth were hoarse and confused. "Brother...my brother...I am...free—"
And as he breathed his last, he turned his gaze to Vexana and whispered. “The Mist… If there is no other choice—”

Watching Atticus' body slowly burn to ashes, Leomord wanted nothing more than to follow his lord into death, but he could not die yet. He had a more important mission on his shoulders: Ridgeburg, besieged on both sides, needed his sword. Ridgeburg would fight to the end, even at the cost of freeing the Mist.

A hundred years had passed, and yet time in Ridgeburg seemed to stand still. Shrouded in a thick, dark fog, the city was known to be cursed, shunned by both light and darkness. Necrokeep, as they called it.

Leomord could sometimes be seen standing on one of its towers, looking into the distance towards the horizon. His skin was sickly pale, neither alive nor dead. His eyes were tired from a hundred years of half-death, but they still shone with a glimmer of hope. He knew in his heart that he and Vexana would eventually find a way to reverse the curse of the Mist.
Since that day, a hundred years ago, his life no longer belonged to himself, but to Ridgeburg. As long as there was still a soul in the city, he would keep it until his last breath. »
=== Wedding in the mist ===
anecdotes: Leomord's name is inspired by "Léon" (lion) and "Mord" (death/murder). This could symbolize his bravery (like a lion) and tragic fate (like an undead knight).
His name may be a reference to Sir Mordred from Arthurian legend – Mordred was a knight who betrayed King Arthur, although Leomord's story is more about loyalty and tragedy.
In lore, the Sword of Oath was originally used by Duke Atticus.
He is the only hero in the game who can summon a mount during battle, thus modifying his skills.
Leomord's "Diavel V4 Rider" skin had a bug where he was immune to the move effect, but it was later fixed.

Leomord bears strong similarities to Silent Salt Cookie from Cookie Run: Kingdom; both are tragic, brooding knight characters who had a steed as a companion, Barbiel and Nox Black Salt, which they can ride as part of their in-game skills. In the story, both have ties to the currently deceased characters and former rulers of their kingdoms, Duke Atticus of Ridgeburg and the former Faerie Cookie of the fairy kingdom, and allies with the female characters voiced by Erica Mendez, Vexana and White Lily Cookie.
Leomord has the highest base HP at level 1 (2908).
He is the second hero capable of performing basic attacks while moving with a joystick (this can only be done by riding Barbiel on his Phantom Steed). Kimmy and Irithel are the other heroes to do so.

relations: Anonymous ancestors of the royal guard

lesley.accroche: Adopted daughter of House Vance, an underground sniper.
lore: Lesley grew up in the Vance household, where her father presided over the security of the noble family. In an unexpected attack by a rival family, Lesley's father was killed. As the attackers approached the Vance house, Lesley took her father's long black rifle and fulfilled her late father's mission. Tears streamed down Lesley's cheeks as she fired shot after shot, amazingly, each one taking out an assassin. The final tear came as the final shot felled the last of the rival family's men.

Lesley was adopted by the Vance family, with the patriarch of the noble house even putting their sole heir, Harley, under his guardianship. Harley was a natural troublemaker, who used her magical talents to unintentionally cause trouble at the Vance household. Only Lesley could keep Harley in check. Harley's streak of trouble was the last bit of heat in Lesley's consciousness.

After learning how Harley had traveled to the dangerous Land of Dawn after defeating the Dark Magic Boss, Lesley followed him, with her trusty heirloom rifle. After meeting Harley during a long, arduous journey, she discovered that the once immature young boy [had] changed through the many life experiences he had experienced. She decided it would be best if her adopted little brother trained alone, while she silently protected him from the shadows. From that day on, all monsters inflicted by Harley's magic would also be struck by a black bullet, which would impeccably pierce their hearts. Tales of the magical youth being followed by a mysterious black sniper quickly spread across the Land of Dawn like wildfire.
anecdotes: The name Lesley has Scottish origins and means "holly garden" or "holly fortress". It comes from the Scottish surname Leslie, derived from a place name in Scotland. Its name could symbolize its precision, stealth and resilience, much like a strong fortress or a sniper hiding in the shadows.
Unlike other snipers, Lesley doesn't rely on attack speed, she focuses on high damage from critical hits.
Lesley is one of the few snipers in the game that uses energy instead of mana.
His passive, Lethal Shot, allows him to deal 100% critical damage after gaining extra energy, making him a sniper-type hero rather than a typical ADC (Attack Damage Carry).
The Royal House of Lesley and Harley "Vance" means "Marsh, Mud, and Fen" in Old English which is used as a male first and last name primarily in American usage.
Quote from Lesley; “Enemy in range, and so are you.” is a reference to Murphy's Law of Combat.
Lesley is the first and, so far, only Marksman/Assassin hero in the game, while Yi Sun-shin, who shares the same Japanese voice actor as her in-story crush Gusion, is an Assassin/Marksman.
Lesley also shares her Japanese voice actor, Takada Sakie, with fellow heroes Moniyan, Carmilla and Silvanna.
In her early designs, she had shorter hair and a more military-style outfit. The developers then gave her a long coat and a more assassin-like appearance, making her more elegant and deadly.

ling.accroche: A graceful and free finch and the oriental fighter who inherited the power of the vermilion bird.
lore: A graceful and free finch and the oriental fighter who inherited the power of the vermilion bird. Ling once belonged to the Finch Sect, a mysterious and feared order of assassins from the Riverlands of Cadia. During a mission, he almost lost his life but was saved by the Vermilion Bird; it was an encounter that would fuel his desire for freedom. In an effort to leave the Finch Sect, he undertook one final mission to infiltrate the Dragon Altar.

It was only when he joined forces with Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, to break the seal of the Dragon Altar, that the spirit of the Vermilion Bird saved his life again. Only then did he see the truth and understand the meaning of freedom. In this world, the Vermilion Bird had disappeared, leaving only Ling, a young man with wings to soar freely among the clouds like the Cyan Finch.
=== I am the Cyan Finch === "From now on, you are the Vermilion Bird. When the bird's cry echoes through the dragon altar, you will fly away."
Ling was not like the other members of the Finch sect: different in talent and circumstances. And he was treated differently by the elder.

The Finch Sect, an order of assassins from the Riverlands of Cadia, takes in orphans, training and honing them to become renowned assassins. The disciples of Finch Sect are numerous, each with their own reasons to fight. Some are blindly loyal to the Finch Sect, some never had a choice, and others are driven by the quest for power... Whatever the reason, once you become a Finch of the sect, your life is your own. Not a single finch has ever left the nest.

Ling became the prodigy of the Finch sect at a young age. His skills had quickly surpassed those of his peers and he was known for never failing a mission. The other members often whispered, “This man is not like us. Maybe one day he will leave the Finch Sect and spread his wings.
“But… so what?” A young Finch interjected hesitantly.
He was met with silence. That was a good question. If they left the Sect, where could they go?
At that moment, Ling sheathed his sword and leapt away. As the wind brushed against his face, he suddenly remembered something from the past.

When Ling was on a mission in his youth, he met a bird dealer. The merchant raised beautiful birds for others to enjoy. But these birds were caged from birth and never experienced the freedom that was their natural right. Even if the cage door was open, they wouldn't know where to go. At this time, a young man nearby suddenly said: “Something that is born with wings belongs to heaven. What a pity.
Later, Ling befriended this young man, who turned out to be a disciple of the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect named Zilong.
The next time he met Zilong, Ling had changed his identity.

That day, Sect Elder Finch summoned Ling and, behind heavy curtains, spoke only four words: “The time has come. The next day, Ling was sent on an impossible mission: to assassinate the guardian of the Dragon Altar, Baxia. Ling's sword was resolute, but Baxia was too formidable. Ling was no match for the veteran who had survived the Battle of the Twin Dragons, but he couldn't go back. On the verge of death, Ling suddenly heard birds chirping and saw a flicker of flames; a firebird appeared in front of him. His appearance even caused Baxia to take on his true form, the Mystic Turtle.
"...The vermilion bird?!"
It worked. As long as Baxia believed he was the Vermilion Bird, he would not kill Ling.
Ling soon lost consciousness.

He saw the firebird again. In the darkness, they looked at each other in silence. According to the elder, from Baxia and from the scriptures of the Finch sect, he knew that it was the vermilion bird. Since his childhood, whenever Ling was about to die, the bird would appear before him and protect him from disaster. Ling didn't know where it came from, because he never spoke. He only knew this dark, familiar space and this flickering flame.
When he woke up, Baxia took him to see Zilong, the successor of the Cloud Dragon. Together they returned to the Dragon Altar and became brothers.

Life at the Dragon Altar with Baxia and Zilong was peaceful, with most of the time spent practicing martial arts. Baxia was rarely seen, so Ling spent most of her time with Zilong. Zilong practiced his spear daily tirelessly, but whenever they practiced, Zilong rarely won. After a match, Ling couldn't help but ask Zilong why he was practicing his spear. Zilong had no answer. And in that moment, tumultuous waves surged through Ling's heart – did Zilong really have no reason...or did he never need one, because he simply followed his heart.
This feeling... was it envy? Resentment? Self-pity? Ling's expression remained calm as he changed the subject effortlessly.
The answer no longer mattered, as this game was coming to an end. That night, Ling was ordered by Sect Elder Finch to locate a forbidden seal in the back mountains of the Dragon Altar.

After some searching, Ling had found it. The moment Ling touched the seal, he heard a clear and long cry; a bird of fire suddenly illuminated the darkness. When he awoke from the apparent hallucination, he saw that Baxia had caught him in the act. Without exchanging words, they began a fierce battle until Zilong arrived and put an end to their confrontation with his spear.
This was the first time Ling had witnessed the power of the Cloud Dragon; the divine power of the Four Immortals.

The Four Immortals have protected the Riverlands of Cadia since the time of the Endless War. Since then, the four have been silent and their power has been passed down among the disciples of the Great Dragon. Once a mortal becomes an Eastern Fighter, they naturally take on the responsibility of protecting the Riverlands of Cadia. Baxia repeated these principles daily during morning classes, unaware that Ling had already read and memorized them in the Finch Sect archives.
Ling knew what the elder was looking for, just like he knew what Baxia was looking for, but Ling felt they were both wrong.
If a caged bird couldn't even save itself, how could it save others?

Ling returned to the Finch Sect. The elder did not ask if Ling had succeeded in his mission, nor was he surprised by Ling's return. The assassins of the Finch Sect all eventually return to their nest. But Ling returned with something lingering in his heart. A few years later, Yu Zhong and Luo Yi approached the Finch Sect to form an alliance with the Elder and attack the Dragon Altar. Ling volunteered to join us.
Zilong had become stronger. He had learned to fully control the power of the Cloud Dragon and Ling was defeated.
For the first time, Ling felt despair. He drew his sword again and launched attack after attack...
Zilong suddenly asked: "Are you wielding your sword for your mission?"
Ling had no response.
"I brandish my spear for myself. For whom do you draw your blade?"
Zilong stepped aside.
“Come on, he’s waiting for you.”
Ling found himself in this dark place again, facing the firebird from afar.

When the seal of the Dragon Altar was weakened, the successors of the Cloud Dragon and the Agile Tiger had already been found, but the Vermilion Bird was seriously injured in its struggle to escape. Only part of his mind managed to escape and was resting in the forest near Shanshui City. After encountering a young Ling on the verge of death, the Vermilion Bird decided to pass on his incomplete power to him to save his life, thus sealing his own fate.
“I’m not the one in the cage.” The Vermilion Bird spoke for the first time. "With a caged heart, everywhere is a prison. With a free heart, nothing can lock you up."

It wasn’t a mission or some sort of exchange. The last wish of the remaining spirit of the Vermilion Bird was that Ling could soar freely between heaven and earth, as a bird should. The seemingly heavy burden of the mission could also be handed down to the weight of a feather. Saving yourself from death and protecting the Riverlands of Cadia had the same meaning. The power granted to him by the Vermilion Bird was neither a weapon of death nor a symbol of salvation, but...

Ling heard the sound of something cracking. The bird flapped its wings one last time and the darkness began to crack. A light fell on Ling, igniting the blue flames within him which burst forth like a pair of wings.
It was the final dance of the Vermilion Bird...and the first flight of the Cyan Finch.

lolita.accroche: Member of the Eruditio Rangers and protector of the Leviathan Workshop.
lore: Member of the Eruditio Rangers and protector of the Leviathan Workshop. Lolita was a sweet and tenacious half-elf girl. After being rescued from the war and brought to Eruditio, she became a craftsman in the workshop. But she had an unusual ambition: to join the Eruditio Rangers and fight like those who rescued her. However, every battle proved overwhelming for her, because even though she was a good fighter, she couldn't bear to hurt anyone. During an attack on the workshop, Lolita protected Noumenon's energy core with her body and was seriously injured. It was through this incident that his courage was recognized by the Eruditio Rangers, and they decided to welcome him. Eventually, she understood that it doesn't matter if one has destructive powers, because protecting also requires courage, and gentleness itself is also strength. === How steel is forged ===
Are you curious about how steel is made?
"First of all, you will need raw materials and the best iron ores in the business district..."
After reading just one line, Lolita threw it away.
“Isn’t there a way to make steel without using iron ore?”

Just so you don't get me wrong, Lolita wasn't trying to be unreasonable. In fact, she generally comes across as gentle and understanding. Of course, she wasn't trying to invent a new way to make steel, but rather a way to "strengthen" herself. She was always looking for ways to make herself as powerful, fearsome and indestructible as steel...
Because then she would be able to protect everyone.

Lolita was a half-elf: except for her pointy ears, she was literally no different from an ordinary human. She was born in a village that was later destroyed by war and that devastating night. she was the only survivor. When she finally regained consciousness, the City of Scholars – Eruditio welcomed her with warmth, passion and freedom that protected her like a beast of steel for the rest of her life.

Later, the Leviathan Workshop welcomed her. This is the applied technology center of Eruditio, where the dreams of all scholars have come true. If the Arrow of Knowledge was the brains of the city. so the workshop was the heart. providing the blood of technology to the entire city. Even though the sophisticated concepts and small jobs of the craftsmen had little to do with Lolita, she occupied herself as much as she could every day, and even when the tasks were boring and insignificant, she always gave her best.

From time to time, she looked with fascination at Noumenon's flaming red energy core, the precious Starlium reactor, which was also the workshop's power source. This wasn't just any ordinary workshop furnace, as it also served as Eruditio's power generator. And as long as it remained burning, Eruditio would never stop moving forward.

Lolita lived in the workshop and the heat of the fire had always accompanied her in her sleep. Every time she remembered the night the war broke out, the souls of the dead always let out a painful wail that haunted her. And every time it happened. a tall, inscrutable figure of steel would always stand before her, leading her to the warmth of Eruditio.

Although Lolita didn't remember his face, she clearly remembered that he had an unknown mark on his back that looked like a tree. So, Lolita concluded that it must be a tree that grew in the desert and that this tree served as hope for a future oasis.
But when she learned that it was the symbol of the Eruditio Rangers. Lolita decided to join them and protect the city like they did.

So she had to train, and it took her exactly 49 tries to finally accept the cruel reality that she wasn't good at fighting. Her gentleness proved a disadvantage on the battlefield, she was not able to maneuver freely and repel merciless and destructive attacks, and even the shield magic of her elven blood did not make her a more intimidating opponent.

She looked at her thin little arms that couldn't even lift the slightly larger hammer, it was her – a 'piece of low-grade ore that probably didn't contain any iron'. She sighed deeply, disappointed in herself for having no talents.
She thought that since she didn't have the talent, she would make up for it with time, but destiny never waits for anyone.

Late at night, Lolita was awakened by an explosion and saw the workshop catching fire. An unidentified enemy had launched a surprise attack. Heavy gunfire erupted everywhere, even though all defense mechanisms were activated. they failed to repel the enemy invasion. The Guardian Artisans covered Lolita and retreated to the core, the last line of defense. If the Noumenon Energy Core is damaged. the consequences would be unthinkable.

Suddenly, Lolita saw her past flash before her eyes. It was as if she was back in the war-lit village of her childhood. The same moans of pain, the same helpless eyes and the same weakness that needed protection. Grief. guilt. cowardice, anger... a mix of emotions arose, but his body froze.
Indeed, a “low-grade ore” like this will never become “steel”...
She became determined and looked at the still blazing core.
“Is there really no way to make steel without iron ores?
"That's right. The element iron can be found everywhere in nature, but is only revealed in extreme heat... Can you stand it?"

Without a word. his body started to move. Everything around her remained still: the sound of gunshots, explosions and screams faded, and there was only one target in her eyes: Noumenon's energy core. No matter the cost, she will protect this land...
Suddenly, a blinding light burst into the sky. and they were the flames of life.
After an indeterminate time, Lolita had difficulty opening her eyes, and there stood before her this tree, the tall silhouette.
“What...did I do?” Lolita mumbled.
“You touched the core with your bare hands and it’s a miracle you’re still alive.” » said the man with admiration.
"The surging core energy penetrated your body and miraculously activated the shield magic in your blood that protected the workshop..."
"You saved us and you deserve to be recognized for your courage. As captain, I now welcome you to the Eruditio Rangers."
"But I am weak and I don't know how to fight..."
"Fighting isn't the only way...because protecting is just as important and we need you." After saying this, he turned around and walked out the door.
“Don’t worry about the rest.”
He smiled and said, “Eruditio is a place where miracles happen. »

Thanks to Eruditio's technology, Lolita received a mechanical glove with great powers. The workshop even made him a hammer from a fragment of Noumenon's energy core, a symbol of the workshop's will and affirmation of his courage. Since the core had been integrated with elven magic during the invasion, she could now use it effortlessly.

With the courage to use her body as a shield, Lolita became a member of the Eruditio Rangers. Even though she was the youngest, she took good care of everyone, and whenever danger arose, she always rushed to the front.
So, are you still curious about how steel is made? It's not important anymore. Because his courage and gentleness became stronger than steel, protecting the city forever. === Outlaw ===
=== Who is Nolan? ===
=== Savior ===
