lukas.accroche: A legendary sacred beast that can take the form of a turbulent young man.
lore: A legendary sacred beast that can take the form of a rambunctious young man, Lukas, is recently reanimated inside the Imperial Sanctuary. Blessed with a special bloodline that allows him to take human form, he once befriended Emperor Gaius and fought alongside him to create the glorious Moniyan Empire. After a thousand-year sleep, he was awakened by Silvanna and swore to announce a new era for the Empire at her side. Beneath his brash and boisterous appearance lies a pure and serious heart. For Lukas, fighting is not only his duty but the instinctive expression of his spirit. He firmly believes that he will create something as bright as the rising sun to illuminate every corner of the Moniyan Empire and rewrite the legend of the Beast of Light. ===The rising sun===

At the heart of the Imperial Shrine is a statue that has stood for a thousand years, symbolizing the past glories of the Moniyan Empire. But it has long been neglected and almost unrecognizable today.
Beneath the statue is a stone tablet recounting the history of the empire. As a historian sweeps away the dust, an age-old legend is revealed:

"After the Endless War, an ancient beast with a unique bloodline yearned to prove himself against the world. At the same time, a fiery young man vowed to establish a glorious nation where all war-torn people could live."

The beast and the young man were destined to meet, and that is what they did, in a titanic confrontation that lasted three days and three nights. In the end, although no winner could be decided, their unwavering spirit melted the divide.
“Together we will create something glorious!”

The man put down his spear and stretched out his hand towards the beast. It was his hope to fight alongside the beast and leave their mark on the world together. The beast would never have imagined that a human would be brazen enough to offer friendship, but as the young man held out his hand, the beast felt a strange sensation as its three tails began to wag.

And so, the two set out on their long journey, crossing the blood-curdling frozen sea, the sand-swept barren lands of Agelta, and the peaceful moonlit forest...struggling for unification amidst the chaos. They faced countless adversaries and obstacles, but their trials of combat had forged an unbreakable bond between them. Together they were invincible. Eventually, the young man and the beast founded the Moniyan Empire. This new nation has become the new sun in the Land of Dawn; a beacon of eternal glory that attracted war-weary people from all corners of the world. The young man was now revered as Emperor Gaius, and his most faithful companion became a sacred beast. He would be known as Lukas, the Beast of Light, in the hearts of all Moniyans.

During the empire's first knighting ceremony, Gaius infused the light of his lineage into Lukas's horns, causing them to glow a brilliant gold. From then on, wherever Lukas went, the radiance of the sun followed him.
But after the death of Gaius, the empire fell into disarray, the faith of the citizens wavered and the Beast of Light lost his mind...
"What?! What do you mean 'lost your mind'?!"

A young man suddenly appeared next to the historian, casually waving his emblematic weapons: two tonfa hammers. “Why was the Beast of Light here in his human form,” the historian wondered. As the subject of this story, Lukas had a vested interest in the tablet's inscription.
"To tell the glorious story of the Beast of Light, we need a personal touch..."
Lukas took the pen from the historian, only to realize that he had never learned to write.
"...On second thought, it's your job. Just write down what I say!"
Lukas sat casually on the stone tablet while the historian diligently recorded his words:

"Even the most powerful mortals cannot escape the inevitable. After Gaius passed away, the Beast of Light fell into deep grief for a very long time... but he never forgot his promise. He locked himself and Gaius's sacred spear in the Imperial Sanctuary, hoping that one day, a descendant of Gaius would awaken him to fight again for the glory of the empire. So Lukas waited and waited, and just like that, a thousand years had passed...

Then one day, a young princess burst into the Sanctuary. As a member of Gaius' bloodline, Silvanna was capable of drawing the sacred spear. But what was truly surprising was that, without fear or hesitation, she invited the intimidating Beast of Light to join her in repelling the invading legions of the Abyss. But Lukas could never recognize a human so easily!

Another titanic battle ensued, just like a thousand years ago. Silvanna faced the beast's powerful attacks and did not take a single step back. She carried the glory of Lumina City on her shoulders and swore to protect it and all the citizens in her care.

The Beast of Light looked into Silvanna's blue eyes, full of hope and determination, and remembered young Gaius. At that moment, the flame within him that had been cooling for a thousand years was ignited again. He stopped his attack and chose to stand alongside the princess! And so, they returned to Lumina City together. As a sacred beast of a new era, Lukas was striving to make up for everything he had missed. In order to raise funds for people who had lost everything due to the war, he organized a network in the streets and took on all challengers; to dispel the ghosts of the empire's past, he bravely braved a haunted house; To protect bullied children, he personally led an uprising in their imaginary war. Oh, and did I mention he won the eating competition 3 years in a row? Truly his greatest pride.

Even if the citizens of Lumina City found these feats too childish and unsuitable for the prestige of a Sacred Beast, Lukas didn't care! He did things his way and gave his all, whether it was playing with the children or defending the empire alongside Silvanna. Its roar would echo across the sky of Lumina City like a thousand years ago—
Together we will create something glorious! »
The court historian's pen eventually broke as he could barely follow the story. He let out a long sigh, only to be interrupted by a tug on his collar.
"Hey, in the part about Silvanna, add some adjectives like beautiful and inspiring. I don't want to be grounded again..."
“Oh...and find me something to clean this thing with.”
The statue, which had been there for a thousand years, was finally able to reveal its original appearance...
In front of the sun and sword emblem was a beast with golden horns, head held high, guarding Lumina City with utmost vigilance.
anecdotes: The name Lukas is of Greek and Latin origin, derived from the Greek name Loukas (Λουκᾶς), meaning "from Lucania", a region in southern Italy. It is also associated with the Latin name Lucas, meaning "light" or "light-bearer."
The designs and shape of Lukas' beast are likely influenced by the Pixiu (貔貅, píxiū), a beast in Chinese folklore described as "having wings, the head of a dragon, and the body of a lion".

Although it hasn't been officially confirmed, Lukas is said to be one of the heroes created through an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.

lunox.accroche: A miraculous creature born in Twilight Orb.
lore: Miraculous Creatures Born in Twilight Orb Lunox was born with magical powers, and her dream world reflects and changes the real world. With this power, she uses her dream world to temporarily maintain the energetic balance between order and chaos. But as the power of order and the power of chaos rushed into his dreams, Lunox fell into a long sleep and transformed into one of the "Twilight Orbs". === Bio === As the final battle began, the Orb of Twilight devoured the Mage's energies and opened, from which emerged a girl surrounded by the power of Chaos and Order. His eyes are as deep as the ancient lake.

The mysterious atmosphere it created then plunged all the heroes into the land of dreams... The powers of Chaos and Order have been fighting against each other since ancient times, and this struggle has plunged the world into despair. Lunox, the mysterious young girl, is the one who survived despair. Thanks to her unique talent, she can project her dream into reality and change it.

One day, a sound whispered to him and told him to balance the two powers with his dreamland ability. But the price to pay would be hunger more than ever. For the world she loves, she accepted this fate, channeled both powers into dreamland, and became one of the Twilight Orbs, at the cost of falling into an endless sleep. But the sound also told Lunox that one day she would awaken to pursue her destiny: to find more Twilight Orbs forgotten by history === Twilight Origins ===
anecdotes: The name Lunox is a portmanteau of two Latin words lumos and nox, respectively “light” and “dark” in English.
Lunox is currently the most powerful being (aside from the One God) in the MLBB universe.
Lunox is the only hero in the MLBB universe to ever encounter the One God and witness the true form of the Astral Realm.
Lunox Skill 3 (Cosmic Fission) officially dealt damage in a fan-shaped area.

When Lunox's passive still involved CDR, she was the only hero in the game capable of reaching up to 100% magic penetration. Even currently, she is still the hero with the real potential who can exceed over 70% magic penetration with enough penetration emblems and equipment and Vemp spells.
His ancient hero title is called "The Enlightened One", in reference to the name of Buddha.
She is the main protagonist of the Determination event with Belerick.
Lunox's Light and Dark concept was reused for Luo Yi.
Her companion skin "Bloody Mary" refers to Mary I of England, so called due to the execution of numerous Protestants during her 6-year reign. It is also the name of a popular drink.
Lunox's light powers come from his mother and his dark powers come from his father.
Lunox is God's unique gift to the world (Land of Dawn).
Lunox is the second hardest level to use (the first being Fanny) and the first hardest Mage hero.

luo-yi.accroche: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the only one to master the secrets of Yin and Yang.
lore: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the only one to master the secrets of Yin and Yang. Luo Yi was the only person in all of the Riverlands of Cadia who truly understood the concept of Yin and Yang.

Harmonizing Yin and Yang was not only his talent but also his worldview. She became the successor to the Great Witch of Zhu'an when she was just a child after accidentally following a spirit to the Cliff of Infinite Lights. There, she witnessed a vision of a utopia in the ancient past, when the Ancients lived among the pure energies of Yin and Yang. It was then that she discovered her true identity as a descendant of the ancient Cajuns.
Now Yu Zhong's loyal strategist, Luo Yi took his ambitions and meticulously implemented them. However, hidden beneath her veil is her own worldview.
===Yin and Yang=== What is Yin and what is Yang?
The first time Luo Yi asked the Great Witch this question, she sighed deeply and gently patted Luo Yi's head.
"The river lands of Cadia are born from Yin and Yang. And Zhu'an is the place where Yin energy is most concentrated, so it has become our eternal duty to safeguard this city."
Young Luo Yi was puzzled: “How can we watch over Yin without knowing Yang?
The Great Witch's hand stopped abruptly, clenched it tightly, and released it shakily. "It seems...you are different from others after all..."
Luo Yi was indeed different.
For as long as she can remember, she was the sole successor to the Great Witch of Zhu'an.

An orphan born with a vision, she had no friends. She was accompanied only by a sea of ​​books and endless training from her master. Even though she was a young genius, her mysterious past always made people tired of her presence.
However, none of this mattered to Luo Yi as she was only interested in one thing.
What is Yin and what is Yang?

The people of the waterlands of Cadia know that Yin and Yang are part of the endless cycle of life. However, Luo Yi knew the true answer and it had always haunted Luo Yi... until one day she wandered towards the Cliff of Infinite Lights.
Luo Yi witnessed a river of souls, a harmonious blend of white and black, emerging from the cave and circling around it.

The souls began to pick up speed as they merged into a bright, dazzling light. At the same time, a cacophony of voices rang in Luo Yi's ears: “The Ancients enlightened Yin and Yang to create life and shape the Riverlands of Cadia.
As the light faded, a scene appeared before Luo Yi's eyes.

People dressed in simple clothes sat around a man and a woman who exuded a celestial aura. Luo Yi instantly remembered the paintings of the Ancients she had seen in the ancient manuscripts, especially the couple Fu Yang and Su Yin, two of the Four Immortals and the ancestors of the Riverlands of Cadia.
Luo Yi felt the power of Yin and Yang surging within her, pushing her towards the group of people.

"What took you so long? Did you have fun?" » One of the women asked, noticing Luo Yi and motioning for him to come sit next to her. The others had no noticeable reaction, as if he belonged here. All their attention was on Fu Yang and Su Yin in the center.
Fu Yang spread his fingers and a golden Yang symbol floated above his palm; Next to him, Su Yin slowly beckoned with her index finger as a dark purple Yin symbol merged onto her fingertips.
The two slowly joined hands as the Yang and Yin symbols seemed naturally drawn to each other. The two symbols soon began to spin around each other like a vortex.
The black and white vortex released a huge amount of energy, once again flooding Luo Yi's vision with blinding light.

"It was feared that the sudden arrival of the Twin Gods would cause a great cataclysm in the world." Voices rose again as the broken pieces of the past gradually fell into place in front of Luo Yi. "Fu Yang and Su Yin led the Four Immortals and all the people of the land to the Heavenly Palace to fight the Twin Gods of Light and Darkness..."

The great battle shook the world and continued for endless days and nights. Ultimately, it was only through their self-sacrifice that Fu Yang and Su Yin managed to deal a significant blow to the twin gods. Upon their death, the Four Immortals swore to protect the Riverlands of Cadia forever, reincarnating as Eastern Fighters to watch over each generation. However, this did not end the conflicts. Even with the arrival of the dragons, the threat of the Twin Gods remained.
"In the decisive battle against the Twin Gods, the Black Dragon and the White Dragon created a massive explosion which created the Yin Yang Eye which still exists to this day..."

The explosion lingered in Luo Yi's eyes as she felt heartbreaking pain. This land was once a true utopia where Yin and Yang existed in perfect harmony. After everything that had happened, the Cadia Riverlands was nothing more than a poor imitation.
She had sought the truth about Yin and Yang and inadvertently witnessed its dissolution with her own eyes. Additionally, she was a direct descendant of the Ancients.

Luo Yi left the last traces of herself with her tears in Zhu'an. With the blood of the Ancients flowing through her body, she was able to quickly master the secrets of harmonizing Yin and Yang simply from her observations in her vision. She bid farewell to the Great Witch, left Zhu'an, and traveled alone through the Riverlands of Cadia for the sake of her new purpose.
But it was only after meeting Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, that his vision of restoring Yin and Yang came to fruition.
What is Yin and what is Yang?
Standing in front of the dignified Baxia and the other current oriental fighters, Luo Yi remained calm and collected.
"In ancient times, the duality of Yin and Yang gave birth to the Four Immortals and all living beings. Today, I will show you the true Yin and Yang."
She slowly lifted the hossu in her hand and a swirl of black and white energy surfaced around her.
First move: giving birth to the fiery kingdom of Yang. Second move: giving birth to the frozen realm of Yin. Third move: gather the power of Yin and Yang.

Baxia, Zilong and Ling suddenly found themselves trapped in a circle of enchantment. They could only watch as the Black Dragon's power burst out from its thousand-year seal before enveloping Luo Yi and Yu Zhong and disappearing.
Now that Yu Zhong had acquired the full power of the Black Dragon, he was one step closer to his ambitions of conquering the Riverlands of Cadia.
To this end, Luo Yi proclaimed: “If this is your will, then it is my duty to carry it out. »
And she spoke the truth without empty words, and yet...

The balance of Yin and Yang had not yet been achieved in the Riverlands of Cadia. And just as Yu Zhong needed Luo Yi to harmonize Yin and Yang, Luo Yi needed Yu Zhong's power to unify the Riverlands of Cadia.

But Luo Yi's own ambitions extended beyond all that: to the utopia created by Fu Yang and Su Yin. A world far beyond what the Twin Dragons can recreate; a world far beyond what the Four Immortals can protect. Thus, with her own hands, she will restore Yin and Yang to their original form and usher this world into true and eternal peace. ===Eastern fighters gather===

lylia.accroche: A funny and witty little witch.
lore: Hundreds of years ago, when Magic reigned in the Land of Dawn, the Dark Mages were important precursors to the creation of the Magic Academy. However, there had always been a big gap between them and White Magic. They had completely different opinions on magical ideas.

The heart of all these disputes was that Dark Magic possessed a mysterious power known as Alien Space Summoning. This magic could create a portal to unknown worlds, bringing alien monsters to the Land of Dawn. It was destructive and unpredictable, and also a great threat to the human world. The White Mages had always opposed Summoning experiments. However, the dark mages turned a deaf ear. Eventually, this dangerous magic went awry during a summoning, causing a disturbance at the Magic Academy. The incident ended with the death of a high-ranking white magician.

This sparked strong resentment from the white magicians and after the Senate's decision, the black magicians took full responsibility. They were permanently banished to the west of the Land. This decision also led to the end of black magic. The esoteric Alien Space Summoning was also permanently banned and the Magic Academy was under the control of White Magic.

Even after this incident, which people called the Rift War, ended, a crisis remained, hidden deep within the Land of Dawn. The remaining Void Monsters appeared everywhere and they continued to look for food to live on, especially Magical Powers and this time, they got closer to the Magic Academy.

At that time, there was a young girl named Lylia, who was one of the most gifted and best students at the Magic Academy, and who also happened to be the naughtiest girl. She also believed in dark magic and was the sole successor of Alien Space Summoning. She always used her powerful but dark magic to prove that she was right. She bought horrors rather than surprises for everyone, most of the time. Naturally, she was misunderstood by others, mainly because of her unusual characteristics and also, since she was a dark wizard and the Magic Academy's favorite magical genius, the idol of the apprentices. This also explains why Lylia was hated and isolated by all her friends, why she was exiled with other dark magicians and also why everyone called Lylia the "Little Witch". Overnight, she lost everything and became lonely.

Recently, however, there had been signs of Void Monsters in the Magic Academy. Magicians and teachers did their best to catch or at least stop these strange creatures. Lylia had managed to capture one of the most special creatures among these creatures. She not only felt his power, but also discovered how cute he was. The Void Monsters were fond of Dark Magic. After all, it was through the invocation of powerful dark magic that they were created.

Lylia gave her new pet a name: Gloom. She considered him her friend, probably the only friend Lylia ever had, and wanted to introduce him to everyone at the Magic Academy. But no one believed that Lylia could have tamed such a menacing creature single-handedly. They began to question and even taunt Lylia. Gloom sensed that his master was being provoked and began attacking the Academy's magicians. Some magicians were shocked to see Gloom's power, which was actually far greater than that of most Void monsters. They thought it was one of Lylia's plans, to destroy the Magic Academy. They decided to capture Lylia by force and also eliminate Gloom.

No matter what Lylia did, she couldn't stop these magicians from attacking Gloom. Other magicians gathered to fight Lylia, as she tried to protect Gloom, which made Gloom very angry. With the help of Lylia's dark magic, he summoned a portal to the outside world and summoned many other Void monsters to fight alongside him. Everything spiraled out of control when the Void Monsters began destroying the Magic Academy. A fierce battle ensued and many of these magicians were seriously injured. As a mentor and teacher, Eudora summoned her lightning powers and tried her best to resist these Void monsters, but nothing happened. She and the other magic teachers at the academy were surprised to see how these monsters had become so vicious.

Lylia, however, was enjoying the ambiance, as she felt she was having an exciting and fun time, commanding the void monsters and directing everything as if she were in charge. It was at that moment that Eudora realized that this was the powerful, ancient alien space summoning magic and that there was much more crisis to face. She warned the other teachers of this invasion and, with the remaining magicians, tried to repel the monsters. However, the monsters regrouped, as a huge wave of new monsters appeared from the rift and launched an attack on Eudora. Even though Lylia wanted everyone to suffer for distrusting and mistreating her, she realized that what she was doing was absolutely wrong. As the monsters charged to devour Eudora and the rest of the Magic Academy, Lylia hastily dove in front of Eudora and used her dark power to seal these monsters into Gloom. Lylia managed to save Eudora's life. Since then, Eudora has discovered that despite Lylia's indifference, she is much more courageous and powerful in magic. She also knew that Lylia's understanding of dark magic was superior to that of others, and realized that good and evil were determined by those who wielded the magic, not the nature of the magic itself.
anecdotes: The name Lylia is a variation of Lilia or Lilia, derived from the Latin word lilium, meaning "lily", a flower symbolizing purity, beauty and renewal. In Arabic, it is related to Layla, which means "night" or "dark beauty". In Hebrew, it can be associated with Lilah, meaning “night” or “sweet beauty.”
His pet Gloom belongs to the Snores species, a type of void monster that likes to devour magic.
Gloom resembles Tharz from Magic Chess.
In her tradition, Lylia is still part of the Magic Academy and is one of the best students there; but according to her code of mastery, she was expelled from the Academy along with her family.
She is probably inspired by an American pop singer, Melanie Martinez.
She had a split hair color, which is one of Melanie Martinez's signature hairstyles.
One of his voices mentioned "Cry Baby", which is an album and a character from Melanie Martinez's storyline.
Her default skin resembles Melanie's dollhouse outfit.
His black shoes (Ultimate) are one of the most unique skills in MLBB, allowing him to "go back in time".

marcel.accroche: Hailing from House Paxley, he is an elegant, mysterious and bizarre artist whose divided soul has merged with his camera.
lore: Hailing from House Paxley, he is an elegant, mysterious and bizarre artist whose divided soul has merged with his camera.
Marcel Paxley, the elegant but mysterious talent of Castle Aberleen.

Itself is a masterfully composed double exhibition: the first exhibition captured the refined character of the Paxley household: Marcel, the boy; the second exhibition captured a torn soul, fragmented by black magic: Clemar, his camera. Since then, they have looked at the world through two viewfinders.

One retains a veneer of impeccable elegance; the other carefully documents reality. Together, they believe that pain is the best chemical for development, while imperfection defines true depth of field. Yet a finished work always presents itself as its own individual “self”.
Instant

"In the entire Moniyan art circle, if you ask which name is the most searched for today, the answer is undoubtedly: Marcel! This art world darling has talent and a mysterious past! Our journalists dug deep and finally found the face behind the lens!"
On the cafe counter, a dark magic camera quivered wildly, its lens focused on the newspaper below – the front page of Lumina City Entertainment Weekly.
Indeed, the truth is hidden behind the lens.
"The greatest photographer of this century, from the illustrious house of Paxley, possesses superb talent and enviable favor..."

Marcel was born in the dark corridors of the House Paxley estate. He inherited his father's powerful dark magic, as well as his infamy: after a series of infighting within the family, his father committed suicide to escape judgment, and Marcel was labeled "the son of a traitor". The latter had tainted Marcel's childhood, as his peers used violence to "discipline" him, to turn him into a skilled person named Paxley, but Marcel always smiled kindly and stood up straight. He believed he was worthy of the name, not because of the pain he endured, but because of the deep love that guided him through it: his mother.

Marcel's mother came from a distant branch of the Paxley family, chained to House Paxley by marriage, but with a soul yearning for freedom. His mother loved embroidery and photography, and on one of her birthdays she gave Marcel a camera, teaching him how to frame and freeze moments, then take those photos and turn them into memories on film.

Mother was everything to Marcel, but she didn't reciprocate. After receiving a “discipline” that almost killed him, Marcel returned home covered in wounds, only to find the silhouette of his mother walking away. After his father's suicide, Marcel's mother had endured all sorts of exclusions and pressures, ultimately securing a chance to escape House Paxley. However, the family forced her to leave behind her magically gifted son... In the end, she was the only one to escape.
Departures from the Paxley House are always silent. With eyes blurred with tears, Marcel watched her leave, and she never looked back.
"...And his goal of soul capture comes from his gift of dark magic. Naturally, Marcel became Duke Aamon's right-hand man. It's undoubtedly a perfect 'hand and glove' story!"

After Marcel's mother left, the "discipline" intensified, but he no longer wanted to resist, letting himself be tormented and mocked like pouring rain. That is, until a moment near death, when consciousness was fading, Marcel glanced at the camera on the wall.
His mother didn't take it. He had watched him – watched his struggle, his madness, his pain beneath the surface –

Marcel felt himself break away and step into his lens, watching coldly as the little boy named Marcel Paxley stood up elegantly with a bloodied face. This objective perspective was clear and indifferent; all pain had been sealed away by the lens. When his consciousness returned to his body, his hand was already holding the camera next to him! The camera screamed and dark magic poured out, freezing everything around him.
Marcel's powers had fully awakened. Simultaneously, a soul named "Clemar" was born inside the camera.

Unlike the elegant Marcel, Clemar was direct and volatile, but the two became inseparable. Relying on dark magic, Marcel became an aide to his distant cousin, Aamon, paving the way to becoming leader of Paxley. Those who had harassed him in the past no longer dared to look this terrifying “enforcer” in the eyes, fearing his camera.
Alas, it is better to be feared than to be loved. This is the Paxley method.

"...Great art is often born from deep love. After the death of his mother, Marcel channeled his grief into creation. There you have it, a true flowering of talent! It's as if his camera had a spirit..."
In the years that followed, Marcel never felt like he had lost anything. Indeed, he felt neither pain nor anger. His emotions had long been locked away in his camera, Clemar.
That is, until the news of his mother's death came.
He had learned the truth: after leaving the Paxley household, his mother remarried, opened a tailoring shop and gave birth to a daughter named Melissa, before dying of illness seven years ago.
It was old news from years past, but fate and hatred hid it from him. Clemar roared in Marcel's ear: "She had a new life! A new child! What am I?! Why all my suffering?!"

Marcel thought he was impassive, but the dark magic within him was becoming even more uncontrollable. Clemar was no longer content to reside in the camera, frequently attempting to take over Marcel's body. Marcel began to suffer from memory loss and fainting spells. He would wake up unpredictably on street corners near Aberleen Castle, surrounded by crowds frozen in time. Even Aamon was left helpless, until Marcel, after studying every clue, returned the loan and directed it at himself!

The moment the shutter clicked, Marcel entered the camera. The interior was chaotic and desolate, with rolls of floating film sweeping like tidal waves, inflicting endless pain. As he walked past all his memories, a scarred figure stood alone at the end of the corridor...
Marcel saw himself.

It had been a means of escape, but also of self-protection. Years ago, Marcel split his soul, naming the new entity "Clemar". Two sides of the same soul were isolated inside and outside the camera, experiencing their own pain and sorrow. Marcel got rid of the pain time and time again, storing it in the Clemar camera.
The pain has not gone away; he was simply carried by another, in solitude.
Eventually, the camera caught the tragic news, causing chaos inside Aberleen Castle.
Years ago, step by step, his mother passed out and never looked back. Now Marcel looked at Clemar and advanced step by step towards him.
He reached out and embraced the self that was “frozen” in the past.
...His memories ended and Marcel gently pushed the newspaper away.
After their episode in front of the camera, Marcel and Clemar reconnected. Today, Clemar is no longer just Marcel's camera, but his witness, his companion and his peer. He is her other half.
“They don’t understand our art at all!”
Marcel patted Clemar: "It doesn't matter. We know what we are...and what art is."
Instant-
The shutter froze the moment: warm lights shone on the dark stone streets of Aberleen Castle. This world has many flaws, but it is precisely because of them that it seems incredibly real.

His mother chose freedom, even if it meant leaving him. He understood his limits and learned to accept his half-sister, Melissa. They had lives of their own, and how could the photographer who understood art best ruminate on the incompleteness of life?
Now he stands beside Clemar, looking through the viewfinder, ready to move forward into their future.
anecdotes: Marcel is a male first name of French and Latin origin, derived from the Roman first name Marcellus. It usually means "young warrior", "warrior", or "dedicated to Mars" (the Roman god of war).
The first name Clemar is an anagram of “Marcel”.

Marcel's father is not from the Paxley family; her father was a foreign dark mage from Aberleen Castle chosen by House Paxley for a political marriage. Since Marcel's mother is the Paxley and holds noble status, Marcel inherits her family name.
In early leaks, Marcel was codenamed “Lingshi.”
The Frozen Moment CC is one of the CCs that can inflict heroes even with CC immunity.
Marcel is the second hero capable of inflicting CC on allied heroes and units, the first being Jawhead's Ejector.
Marcel is the second hero who can stop turret damage for a short time, using his ultimate. Aurora can freeze turrets using her 2nd skill and her ultimate with her Pride of Ice.
He is the first hero whose damage increases with magic defense.
He is also the first hero whose damage scales with both physical and magical defense.
Marcel is the only hero who does not gain HP from items.
Diggie and Marcel are the only pure support heroes whose primary skills do not include healing.

lore: The Shura clan thrived in isolation for countless generations in the Arcapada universe. Their men, renowned for being the bravest fighters in the world, and their women, renowned for being the greatest beauties in the world. At the heart of the Shura clan's beliefs is the legend of the Three Thousand Worlds. Legends speak of three thousand secret worlds which, upon entering, one must face different levels of psychic and physical trials and advance from world to world after victory. Members of the Shura clan had discovered a way to access these worlds, and only those who had conquered more than three hundred worlds could be granted the title of Asura, elevating them to the rank of demigod in the eyes of their people. However, throughout the countless eons of Shura history, none managed to conquer the legendary world of three thousand, until Martis appeared.

With an ambition and determination capable of shaking the heavens, Martis trained every day of his life to become stronger, advancing tirelessly through the secret worlds, each personal breakthrough against the legions of demons providing him with a unique sense of personal satisfaction. No one knew how many years passed before Martis reached the final and hardest secret world. However, his desire for glory pushed him to move forward. After numerous defeats, he fell into despair, but despite this, he refused to give up. He transformed his thirst for victory into his twin blades of righteous fury, now known as the Teeth of Asura, and for countless days and nights he fought against the demons of the end world with strength and determination never before seen on the mortal plane. He eventually became the first Asura to defeat all three thousand secret worlds and has since been considered the "Asura King", ruling over tens of millions of Asura aspirants.

lore: There was a land in the far north called Northern Vale, which was covered in winter snow all year round. It was also known as the land closest to the frozen sea. During their long history, the Sarmi tribe and the bears have shared their lands. Having a common ancestor, they never attacked each other and lived in harmony. Over time, they developed a spiritual bond. This peace lasted a long time.

No one would have thought that the perilous natural environment of the North Valley would still invite invaders to these lands. A large number of pirates from the Frozen Sea arrived in the Northern Valley. They brought not only endless plunder, but also bitter wars. As formidable as they were, the pirates plundered and occupied these lands. As if that were not enough, the invaders began to hunt the bears. Every tribe in Northern Vale was threatened by these invaders - some of them were conquered, others were forced from their homes, having to fight homeless in the cold. As the leader of the Sarmi tribe, Masha protected her tribe from waves of attacks. As a tribal hunter, she had great combat skills, and this was the reason why she could defend the dignity of the Northern Valley.

She never forgot Sarmi’s wish: “Protect the bears! » She tried to find the bears. But when she found the bears' habitat, she found nothing but dead people and signs of violence everywhere. Suddenly, Marsha heard a loud roar. It was a familiar roar. As expected, a group of invaders were trying to hunt down the Bear King, who was constantly repeating "Beast Power". They launched attacks with their advanced weapons and unique hunting skills. The Bear King tried to protect the injured little bears by shielding them with his body, even though he had been seriously injured by those iron spears. Masha rushed to the battlefield to help the Bear King, but it was in vain. The Bear King, sensing Masha's intentions, decided to divert the attention of these hunters by moving away. Masha understood the goal of the Bear King, saved the little bears and ran into the mountains.

She used her own cloth to dress the bears' wounds and placed them safely in a secret cave. She returned to help the Bear King who was seriously injured. These hunters beat him and tried to capture him. This angered Masha who descended on them and tore them apart trying to save the Bear King. The Bear King then gathered all his remaining strength and unleashed his last "Beast Power". Masha and the Bear King fought together and let the hunters pay for their invasion with their blood. It was the first time the Sarmi and the Bears had fought together, and victory belonged to all of Northern Vale. What Masha didn't expect was that the Bear King was in his final moments. Masha could feel the grateful confidence in the Bear King's eyes. It seemed that the king was showing his deepest respect for what she had done. Finally, the king closed his eyes and endowed Masha with powerful energy. Masha felt this energy coursing through her body and she realized it was "Beast Power". His body has become extremely powerful. It seemed like she could withstand any type of attack with this body and beat any opponent with her superb attack speed.

Masha managed to save the little bears, hoping that the bears will be resurrected in the future. From that day forward, Marsha swore to guard the North Valley with her "Beast Power" and no invader would escape the wrath of her savage fists.
anecdotes: The name Masha is a Russian-language variant of the female name Mariya, equivalent to the English name Mary. She also speaks with a Russian accent.
Masha's name and her relationship with bears are likely inspired by the Russian folk tale Masha and the Bear.
Additionally, it was released on the 10th anniversary of the series.
His tribe is the only one based on a real tribe; according to tradition, she is a member of the Sami or Sarmi tribe, which could be the Land of Dawn equivalent of the Sami peoples of Northern Europe.
She is the only heroine to have three health bars.
She is the only hero without defense growth since version 1.8.30.
She was first introduced as a hunter/tank hero in patch 1.4.14, but was later transformed into a pure fighter in patch 1.4.94. However, it was restored in patch 1.6.66.

mathilda.accroche: A brave girl who stands up and is not afraid of power.
lore: In the vast western desert, on a barren land, with its backs to the mountains, lived an ancient and simple tribe. For generations, they preserved the traditions of their ancestors, guarded their sacred mountains and led a hard but quiet life. Mathilda and her family were members of this tribe.

Mathilda's father, Thasgard, was the leader of the entire tribe. He was courageous, upright and responsible, and firmly carried the burden of the tribe's survival on his shoulders. Under his influence, little Mathilda had developed a personality similar to that of her father and was deeply proud of him.

One day, a group of sand hunters from Los Pecados broke into this closed tribe and disrupted the peace they had maintained for hundreds of years. The group of sand hunters got lost in the desert in pursuit of giant beasts. They were discovered by Mathilda's tribesmen as they were about to die. The tribesmen took them back to the tribe.

However, the expectations of the innocent and kind members of the indigenous tribes were shattered when their good deeds were returned in the form of unforgivable atrocities. These were not ordinary sand hunters, but those from the "Iceberg Sand Hunting Group" led by Waldo Kane, the most powerful boss of Los Pecados. These guys not only sought life in the desert, but also did a lot of dirty work and sinful acts.

Although they were in a near-death state, some veterans of the sandhunting group developed an idea in their minds as soon as they saw the mountains behind the tribe: beneath this seemingly ordinary mountain range, there were countless gold mines that could bring them a steady stream of wealth.
Under the care of the aboriginal tribesmen, the sand hunters quickly recovered and left the tribe under their leadership. Before leaving, they promised to reimburse everyone.

However, Mathilda's tribesmen did not receive the reward they deserved, but were instead subjected to a sinful invasion. The sand hunters who came out of the desert quickly reported the news to Waldo Kane. On Kane's instruction, Kane's nephew Blandy returned to Mathilda's tribe with a large number of thugs, preparing to take the entire mountain range by force.

To the members of Mathilda's tribe, this was the tribe's sacred mountain range, and no one was allowed to walk there. The patriarch of the Thasgard tribe harshly rejected Blandy's coercion and temptation and demanded he and his thugs leave their homeland immediately.

Blandy, who had always passed through Los Pecados without worry, became furious. He pulled out a gun and shot Thasgard, wounding him. He then gave him an ultimatum: either leave the tribe's lands within a month and abandon the gold mine located behind the mountain range, or be wiped out along with his tribe.

Their patriarch now injured, the members of the tribe, having lost their leader, fell into panic and confusion. More and more people began to advocate leaving the village to avoid further losses. Facing the retreating tribe, little Mathilda stood up, denounced their weakness and called on everyone to take up arms and use their own strength to defend their homeland.

On one side was the small and weak Mathilda, and on the other, the powerful group of Sand Hunters and their band of thugs. The tribesmen chose to shut up one after another and began to quietly pack up their things and prepare to leave the tribe.

Little Mathilda left the tribe disappointed. She firmly believed that justice should exist in this world. For this reason, she began traveling the vast west, looking for people who could actually help the tribe. While walking towards a small town not far from Los Pecados, Mathilda's sense of justice took over and she found herself in an argument. Mathilda stood up and stood up to the bullies in front of her. Mathilda was outnumbered, but then an old, bald-faced cowboy appeared and fought off the bandits. He then teams up with Mathilda and leaves with her.

It was none other than Clint, an old cowboy who had come looking for Blandy for revenge. After learning what happened to Mathilda and her people, Clint, also with a strong sense of justice, decided to help Mathilda and fought alongside her to defend their homeland.

In the battle to defend her homeland, Mathilda formed a deep relationship with Clint, Claude and others. After a severe ordeal, the brutal Blandy was defeated and the bandits' greedy hopes of conquering the sacred mountain range were shattered.

The tribe restored the peace they once had and Mathilda was summoned by the sacred mountain range. Upon entering the sacred mountain, she inherited a mysterious power that no one had inherited for hundreds of years.

For Mathilda, a great adventure was only just beginning. As the sun set, she said goodbye to her family and chose to go on the road with Clint, because she firmly believed that in this world, there were even more oppressed people waiting for justice, and she would do everything she could to help them get it.
anecdotes: The name Mathilda has Germanic origins and is derived from the words "maht" (meaning "power" or "strength") and "hild" (meaning "battle" or "fight"). Thus, the name Mathilda can be interpreted to mean "powerful in battle" or "strength in battle".

Initially, Mathilda was conceptualized as a support hero focused on healing and helping her team. She wasn't originally an assassin support hybrid. His abilities focused on his more traditional support role, providing crowd control and healing.
When Mathilda was released, it was distributed free for a limited time.
Mathilda is the first hero designated as support and assassin.
The appearance of Mathilda and her tribe appear to be based on the indigenous people of North America, particularly the United States.
Swift Plume is a type of bird found in lowland tropical rainforests. which could be the inspiration for its design. The bird is visible on the icon of its skill 1.
The most unique feature is that if Mathilda is close to an ally, the bird will take that ally with it, allowing it to quickly reposition its allies on the map.
