melissa.accroche: A girl with cursed needles who runs a sewing workshop and solves customer problems.
lore: A girl with a cursed needle who runs a sewing workshop and solves customers' problems. A girl with a cursed needle who runs a sewing workshop and solves customers' problems in her "unique" way. The illegitimate child of a nobleman, Melissa grew up in Lumina City, capital of the Moniyan Empire, where she runs a small tailoring shop. Endowed with dark magic, she uses cursed needles to fight, solving her clients' problems in unique ways. === The Needle: Broken Doll ===

There was once a small, inconspicuous tailor shop on the bustling streets of Lumina City, capital of the Moniyan Empire. Its owner was an elegant woman, always with a tired smile on her face, who had an intelligent and original daughter named Melissa.

They lived a difficult life, but Melissa always wore a pretty dress and clean shoes, the worn parts of which were carefully patched into adorable patterns. She was mean, but she was also thoughtful and sensible. When she was at the store, she helped her mother with the needlework and put the shredded rags aside. When she was old enough and had enough experience of the world, she never asked where her father was again.
Melissa always wanted to have a beautiful rag doll, but she never told her mother about it, because she knew that her mother, despite her illness, could not even afford to go to the doctor.

Every time she passed the doll store, she raised her head to look inside, and the exasperated store owner tried to scare her several times with empty threats. Then the girl made a face instead of panicking, so the shopkeeper who was pretending to lose his temper gave up first.

One day, after their store closed, her mother magically created a rag doll sewn with shredded fabric from a fabric pile. Melissa was beyond happy, smiling and jumping up and down holding the doll and her mother.

Her happy childhood vanished and little Melissa who ran in the streets became a pretty young woman and was able to help her mother. Watching the girl grow up, her mother always expected to see Melissa get married in a beautiful wedding dress she had made for her, but unfortunately, she left Melissa forever before she could make her wish come true.
The small tailor shop closed its doors and the father Melissa had never met before suddenly appeared and took her with him.

They returned to her father's house and that's when she discovered that her mother was a Paxley. Renouncing her ties to the noble family, she fled for love with her father, who abandoned her and left her an illegitimate daughter.

Subsequently, although her father tried to compensate for her abandonment, he was unable to give her all the rights of a legitimate child. When Melissa was introduced to her half-sister, a cultured and graceful young woman, she became filled with hatred towards Melissa. She thought Melissa broke into her family, so she always bullied Melissa when their father wasn't home, and Melissa pretended not to care but remembered everything.

Every night, only the carpet doll accompanied Melissa in her sleep, which gave her the feeling that her mother was always there with her inside the doll, so when she felt the need to cry, she held back her tears and hugged the doll.

But her sister was also hostile towards the carpet doll. She once deliberately tore it up and falsely suggested that Melissa throw away the broken doll that didn't please her eyes and accept one of her old dolls.

Even though Melissa claimed she was okay with it, there was no way she was going to throw away her “mommy doll.” Afterwards, whenever she was bullied, she would often push the doll with her sister's favorite bow tie sewn on it, as if it were her sister herself.

One day, while venting her anger at the doll, she accidentally discovered that her actions seemed to have actually affected her sister! Her suspicions were confirmed after a few attempts, and an idea began to form in this little girl's mind...

It was soon her sister's coming-of-age ceremony, and important guests were gathered in their house, but as an illegitimate daughter who could not be seen by others, Melissa stayed in her room while her sister showed off her piano skills to everyone in the room. When her sister gracefully sat on the stool while people applauded, Melissa was also ready with a big smile on her face: she was following the rhythm of the song on the piano with one hand and the other hand was ready to push the "sister doll".

A melodious piano sound filled the room and soon reached the climax of the song. It was when her sister confidently pressed the keys that Melissa pushed the doll – she had practiced it to perfection when her sister was practicing the piano.
At that point, the song started to go wrong.

Her sister kept hitting the wrong notes, once, twice, and the guests started whispering to each other as they listened to the wrong melody. His sister's pale face gradually turned crimson, until she finally broke and smashed the piano while insulting him, and the whole audience was completely silent...
When her sister and the maid who raised the alarm rushed into Melissa's room, she had already changed into her old outfit and sneaked out of the house with her little luggage and dolls.
Melissa escaped from her father's house and returned to wander the familiar streets.

One night she dreamed of Cuddles speaking to her in her mother's voice, telling her not to be afraid because she would always protect her. Overwhelmed and ecstatic, Melissa threw herself at her mother, only to wake up alone on a rainy night just as she raised her hands. Suddenly, an inexplicit magical energy burst forth from her heart – her dark magic ability inherited from her mother had awakened, and a girl with nature's curse magic was born.

After that night, Melissa decided to settle down and opened a small sewing shop in the town of Lumina, inside which she recreated the layout of her mother's old shop, with various dolls hanging here and there. Sitting behind the counter, Melissa still had her feet on the table and coldly looked at the bustling world outside with a sneer.

Despite the appearance of a normal tailoring shop, Melissa's Tailor guarantees that all customer problems will be resolved, provided that the picky store owner does not refuse to accept your requests.

At only 16 years old, Melissa really manages to solve all her clients' problems. She always has unexpected ideas for taking care of targets: it's either swapping a bad contract with a loan shark or telling a homeless child to hug a groom who abandoned his former love and call him dad at his wedding.
When these targets came to get revenge on Melissa, she would smile and remind them what it feels like to miss your damn needles.
Soon after she opens the shop, even the nobles start talking about it: "Have you heard of Melissa's Tailor?"
"Yes. Is the owner really as good as they say?"
“Yeah, I have a tough job that needs help with…”
If you also find yourself in trouble in Lumina City, simply go to Melissa's Tailor and find its owner, Melissa…
=== The Needle: Lucky Day ===
anecdotes: Its name is a feminine first name coming from the Greek word μέλισσα (melissa) meaning "bee" which in turn comes from μέλι (meli), "honey" or "bee".
Descriptions of Melissa's skills are written in Melissa's first person with her character present.

Its concept revolves around cursed dolls and dark magic, giving it a unique identity among MLBB heroes. The voodoo theme is reflected in her skills, where she controls "Muddles", a cursed doll that attacks enemies. Melissa is the first sniper in the game to use a needle and a voodoo doll as part of her attack kit.

Although it has not been officially confirmed, Melissa is said to be one of the first heroes created due to an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou, Lukas and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.

Melissa from Mobile Legends: Bang Bang shares striking similarities with Nobara Kugisaki from Jujutsu Kaisen, both in design and personality. Although not officially confirmed, it is highly likely that Nobara was a major source of inspiration for Melissa. This shared voodoo-style magic suggests that Melissa's gameplay mechanics were inspired by Nobara's abilities.

Melissa is the first hero in the game to have three companions in-game at the same time! Her three companions are Muddles, Cuddles, and Giggles, although Muddles is the only companion who actively fights with her, functioning as a cursed bond mechanism.
Melissa is one of the few marksmen with a strong self-peeling ability outside of sprinting, thanks to her ultimate (Go Away!), which allows her to counter melee heroes like assassins and fighters.

relations: Yin, Xavier, Julian (co-members of Forsaken Light)

minotaur.accroche: The Minoan prince was determined to restore his homeland.
lore: Long ago, the Minoans founded a mysterious and prosperous state called Minoa in the barren lands of Agelta.
The ancient Emerald Road connected Minoa to other western cities, creating a network of trade routes, while Minoa stood out among all others for its advanced civilization and martial traditions.

Prince Minotaur of Minoa was then the most esteemed warrior. Passionate about fighting and often fueled by his rage, the Minotaur displayed terrifying bursts of strength in combat. Few could hope to last more than a few rounds against him.

People began to worship the Minotaur, but his father was deeply concerned about him. While achieving great success on the battlefield, the Minotaur's savagery and impulsive behavior were unworthy of the successor to the state.

To make the Minotaur a suitable heir to the throne, the old king has arranged a special trial in which the prince must defeat a mysterious figure from foreign lands to qualify for the throne of Minoa.

The Minotaur accepted this bare-handed duel without hesitation. He entered the arena with his head held high and attempted to crush his opponent with brute force, as he had always done. However, his opponent this time was much tougher, and the Minotaur quickly exhausted himself, losing his advantage.
In the end, the mysterious figure defeated the "invincible" Minotaur with measured counterattacks.
The crowd cheered the victor loud and graceful, but the Minotaur was overcome with rage and shame.

And when the mysterious figure reached out to help the Minotaur back to his feet, the Minotaur grabbed the unsuspecting hand and pinned the unsuspecting hand and pinned the mysterious figure to the ground, before throwing a series of vicious punches at him.

As his fists were covered in blood and the mysterious figure stopped struggling, the Minotaur tore off the latter's mask amid the jeers of the crowd, and that's when his entire body stiffened. The seriously injured figure on the ground was actually his father!
The old king grabbed the Minotaur's hand with his last strength and spoke his final words of instruction to his son: "You must learn to take responsibility as king and continue the glory of Minoa..."
Consumed by shame and regret, the Minotaur made his way to the Minoan Labyrinth, the burial place of the Minoan ancestors, and began his training and repentance.
Over time, Minotaur gradually gained control of his rage and became capable of harnessing his unleashed powers at will.

As the Minotaur embarked on this arduous training, an unexpected catastrophe occurred. The whole of Minoa. was flattened by the explosion of the Twilight Orb, and only the Minotaur remained unharmed under the protection of the Labyrinth. The Minotaur rushed to the State amidst the tremors, wanting to find out what had happened, when a broken piece of the Orb of Twilight fell into the Labyrinth and sealed it entirely. The Minotaur, who was half a step away from the Labyrinth, was completely sealed and put into a deep sleep.

The catastrophe erased all traces of Minoan civilization, leaving only the Minoan labyrinth half-hidden in the sand. After countless days and nights, the broken piece of the Twilight Orb transformed into Lunox and left.
The seal was then lifted. Time in the Labyrinth began to pass again, while the Minotaur slowly opened his eyes....

Aldous, the guardian of the Labyrinth, told the Minotaur that his state had long since turned to dust and that he and his memories were all that remained. The Minotaur, however, would believe none of this.
With his father's final mission still fresh in his mind, the prince vowed to find his lost parents and rebuild the Minoan civilization.
In the boundless sand, a set of hoof prints stretched to the horizon...
anecdotes: Its name comes from the Minotaur, a legendary creature from Greek mythology with the body of a man and the head of a bull.
The Minotaur's real name is Asterion, inspired and taken from Astraeus. His name Minotaur was given to him when he became the most powerful minotaur in Minoan.
The name Astraeus comes from the Greek word "Ἀστερίων" meaning Starry which suggests association with the Taurus constellation Taurus, hence its skin name.
The Minotaur is the only tank capable of healing its allies.
His Orbiter skin was originally called Taurus, but was later changed because it would collide with his Zodiac Taurus skin.
Early concept art showed a more primitive stone hammer, but later versions gave it a more refined and enchanted look, perhaps hinting at a magical origin.

He is the first hero with a "Rage Bar" mechanic in MLBB. Unlike most heroes who have a mana or energy system, the Minotaur's abilities become stronger when his rage bar is full, making him a unique tank. But this has been remade, so his skills are improved when he uses his previously upgraded Ultimate.

relations: King of Minoa (father, killed by the Minotaur)

minsitthar.accroche: A young king who led the people of Mahar Pura to victory against the invaders.
lore: I stood under the imposing castle wall, it was just another day in my mundane life as an unimportant servant. A sudden baby cry shook the sun but the birth of a prince could not awaken my stranded life. I stood under the imposing castle wall, praises and blessings reached my ears: some wished him to be kind; some wished him courage; some wished him a great future... I have seen so many royals and nobles in my life, their authorities are like knives to the throat. Just like at this moment, I am waiting for my masters to punish me because my senility made me break the dishes. A small figure stands before me with a short wooden sword – the praised prince protects me just as he has sworn to protect his subjects. Now I so wish it could grow safely and bring warmth to people like the sun on Mahar Pura.

Kneeling on the cracked farmlands, I prayed for rain to save our dying crops, our parched mouths, and our desperate hearts. But what came before the rain was our savior in golden armor, he brought us food and eased our suffering. When he looked at his subjects, I could see a whole world deep in his eyes, a world as beautiful as a landscape. When he looked up, he noticed the silhouette of a small rosewood flower, which made the world jump with joy in his eyes. Later, I was told that our savior, the crown prince of our kingdom, had fallen in love with a civilian girl. He got rid of his royal trifles and continued the free life with the girl. However, the free life is not limited to starry skies and love. It also means paddy, sackcloth and hard work in the fields. This time, the prince finally had the chance to see the truth about the world and the lives of his fellow citizens.

I marched toward the battlefield with my comrades as enemy warships once again breached our naval defenses. The black waves rushed towards us from the horizon and soon transformed into millions of blades. My comrades, my brothers, were pierced by the blades. They told me to bring their last smile back to our hometown. Black clouds rolled out from enemy ships, covering the sun. We fought desperately for our lives, but no hope could be seen. Suddenly, a golden light broke through the dark sky, driving away all the darkness from the battlefield. I recognized the Sacred Spear in the comer's hand. He was our crown prince! The sun of Mahar Pura! He blocked all enemy attacks with his sturdy body. He blew his horn to rally the desperate soldiers. Torches gathered all over the battlefield and formed a wildfire. Under his leadership, we dispelled all the darkness and pushed it back to where it came from. Later, we knelt before our new king and swore to be his feet and his spear. May Mahar Pura shine forever.

I saw him again at a very advanced age. He returned to the palace and once again enjoyed the splendor of the crown. I was told that he put aside his duties and lived the life of a farmer with his true love. However, he could not turn a blind eye to the bitterness of his people. He left his rosewood flower garden, reforged his sacred spear, and returned to the brutal battlefield. Now I live behind the castle walls, sheltered from the sound of battle horns. Thanks to warriors like him, I can still serve wine with care and respect. I offer him the cup of wine, he looks down, there is loneliness in his eyes. But the bright sun still shines as always on the unchanging land of Mahar Pura.
anecdotes: Minsitthar is based on King Kyansittha, a famous ruler of the pagan dynasty of Myanmar (Burma).
Minsitthar is the 4th hero based on a real historical character, with Zilong, Yi Sun-shin, Lapu-Lapu and Zetian.
He is the first hero to have Burmese bloodlines.

His Ultimate (King’s Calling) summons royal guards that form a phalanx-style barrier. This makes him the only MLBB hero to use a military training mechanic, preventing enemies from using blink skills within.
Minsitthar's story bears some resemblance to the 'Baahubali' film series.
It's also likely that its story is based largely on the life of the person it's based on.
He is one of two heroes capable of disabling enemies' sprint or blink skills, the other being Obsidia with his Bone Hunt.

Early leaks suggested that Minsitthar was meant to be a tank, but he was later developed into a fighter with strong crowd control abilities. It retains some tank-like features, such as damage reduction and sustain.

miya.accroche: The priestess of the Moon and protector of the moonlit forest.
lore: The Moon Priestess Guarding the Forests of Azrya Born at the end of the Age of Strife, Miya witnessed the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss desecrated the Marsh of Shadows and corrupted many of its inhabitants into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis on Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to prosper again under her protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded in the fog of war. From the moonlit forest, a call to war that has not been heard for thousands of years rings out again. Miya took her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people. === Bio === “What is war, brother?” "When the races of the Land of Dawn have clashed instead of embracing unity and mutual prosperity, it is war. When they have invaded their neighbors and razed cities, it is war. When they choose destruction over peace, cruelty over benevolence, and corruption over purity... that is war." “Peace, kindness and purity... is this your wish for the world?” Estes did not answer. The outstretched branches of the Tree of Life wrapped around him and he fell back into a deep sleep. This time he wouldn't wake up for many years. Long enough for Miya to grow from a little girl, who couldn't even reach the branches of the Tree of Life, to a fearless warrior and protector of the moonlit forest.

Miya stood atop the trees and watched for the enemy incursion. A warband of orcs and demons had just crossed the border, inflicting a wound on the Moon Aegis that caused the Tree of Life to tremble. Drawing his bow, three silver beams of moonlight danced gracefully through the branches before quickly killing the leader and sending the others fleeing in disarray. With the threat gone, the elves channeled the energy of the Tree of Life to repair the breach and restore the Aegis. Peace returned to the forest and all was well. Miya, nestled wearily in the trees, had taken on the responsibility of protecting the moonlit forest after her brother Estes had fallen asleep to preserve the energy of the lunar aegis. At first, Estes spoke to Miya through the Tree of Life, and it was through these conversations that she learned of the peace, kindness, and purity that her brother yearned for. And in Estes' absence, Miya watched over the forest according to the last words he spoke. As she relaxed and put down her bow, Miya noticed that she had injured her hand while dealing with the intruders. She began to remember the days when she practiced archery while her brother studied nearby. As a somewhat stubborn child, Miya would often shoot her bow, constantly trying to hit a leaf or branch, until her fingers bled. His brother would look up from his parchment and, with a wave of his hand, heal his wounds with the magic of the forest. Maybe Miya was too attached to the past. She often longed for a time when she could still hide under her brother's protection. Miya snapped back to attention and clenched her fist. Now was not the time to dwell on the past. She knew that the only direction for her was to move forward, for she had become the hope that her people turned to in their difficult times. But Miya knew deep down that she was only lying to herself. She turned a blind eye to the outside world as evil grew in power and only acted when the enemy encroached on her lands. Although this stopped the elves from waging war, how long would it last? Even a fool could see that she was delaying the inevitable. A war that has never been fought can never be won. But peace, goodwill and purity were his brother's wishes. How could she willingly plunge her people into the horrors of war? She couldn't; she wouldn't do it.

But war comes and goes as it pleases, and it would come suddenly for the Moon Elves, at a bloody dawn. Orc shock troops have destroyed the Aegis. But unlike previous attacks, this time the orcs seemed much more savage, as if they had been driven into an insane bloodlust by dark magic. Black smoke seeped into the forest as the elves awoke to the screams and crackling of burning trees. Large pillars of smoke could be seen from the direction of the Tree of Life. The war was there. "Run! Get out of the forest! Our house is lost, save yourself!" Miya heard the desperate cries, and before she could act, most of her people were already fleeing in panic.

"Brother...give me an answer!" Miya made a final appeal to the Tree of Life as the smoke enveloped her, hoping for salvation, but the tree remained silent amid the scorched Earth. Miya looked around her home, the place where the first oracle emerged from the Tree of Life; the place where elves first took root; the place where their branches grew into a great empire; the place where the last pure Moon Elves resisted the corruption of the Abyss. It was their most sacred land, blessed by the Moon Goddess herself, and Estes' hope for their future.

"What is war..." She finally found her answer. "When we have been pushed to the brink of destruction and finally taken up arms for our survival, it is war. When we must defend our final resting place, the Moonlight Forest, at all costs, it is war." The Moon Elves heard Miya's words and turned back towards their home. "My people! We have suffered for too long...have lived in fear for too long. There is nowhere left for us to escape. If the Moonlight Forest falls, then we truly will have lost everything. Who will support me one last time?" At first, a few dozen elven warriors came out of the trees. Then hundreds more followed, holding swords, spears and bows. As they rushed to Miya's side, their silver hair shimmered like moonlight cascading across the battlefield. The Tree of Life also responded to Miya's call. Using its precious energy, the tree spread its roots in all directions to quell the raging fires and reinvigorated the Moon Elves for a final counterattack. The Moon Elves rushed out of the trees and completely caught the Abyss Legion off guard. They quickly gained the upper hand and continued their attack until all invaders were driven from the moonlit forest. The surviving orcs came to their senses as their bloodlust subsided and gained a new respect for the elves.

“I understand now, brother.” "Peace, goodwill and purity are what you wished for, but if we lose our home, our way of life, then all our efforts will be in vain. If war is already upon us, then we will face it head on. We are ready to sacrifice everything for our home. Give me the strength, courage and faith to protect our people and our homeland!" === Side story ===
anecdotes: In Japanese, "Miya" (宮) means "shrine" or "palace", often referring to sacred places or nobility. This matches the elegant and mystical background of Miya's Moon Elf.
She is somewhat inspired by Lufia from Magic Rush, a game created by Moonton before MLBB. Miya's Jungle Ranger skin looks a bit similar to her.
In the game, Miya is the first hero and the first shooter released according to the sale time.
She is the first hero to have a running animation when he has a high movement speed attribute.

She is one of the three heroes who appear on the icons of the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang application, the other two are Layla for the Chinese version of the game and Gusion for the Indian version of the game.
Miya's Honor skin is a gift skin to celebrate the summer holidays in the Philippines.

Its skin, Suzuhime (鈴姫), is Japanese and can be broken down into two parts: 鈴 (Suzu) – Means "bell" or "chime", often associated with soft, pleasant sounds. 姫 (Hime) – Means “princess” or “young noble”.
One of her most famous lines: “Where there is life, there is hope” reflects her role as a guardian of nature and life.

Miya was one of the revamped heroes in the first batch of Project NEXT in September 2020, along with Layla, Eudora (with whom Miya also shares the same Japanese language voice actor, Morisaki Miho), Zilong, and Saber. The goal was to balance the power gap between older and newer heroes, as the latter had better mechanics and animations.

pouvoirs: Summons the shadows of moonlight and the lunar eclipse

moskov.accroche: A desert warrior who embraced the darkness for revenge.
lore: Are you awake, lamb?
I suppose you are an exception among this pitiful herd.
Do you want to know why you are here?
So stay quiet and listen...
When you were still among the living, your name was Moskov, although that no longer matters today.

Yes, you are dead. Countless spears pierced your insides while your enemies pinned you to the sand. Your blood flowed freely, seeping into the earth and coloring the sand a dark purple. But there was defiance in your bones. Even in death, you refused to collapse; reluctant to admit failure.

Yes, you failed. This battle marked the end of your tribe. Your rival, Khaleed, has brought a force three times yours, if not more. Yet you did not flee, because the blood feud between your two tribes had reached the point of no return. You are a true tragic hero.

In your last moments, you must have thought that this death was worthy of a desert warrior. You fought for your tribe at the cost of your life. The golden sands will surely transport you to the halls of glory and etch your name in the annals of history...
Pathetic.

Look around you. These are your so-called golden halls of glory. There is nothing here except a great vortex of darkness. It lurks beneath the surface of the desert, voraciously corrupting every grain of sand, rendering everything unholy. Beneath your feet lies a mountain of bones, the countless remains of your ancestors. Above you, their tortured spirits groan in agony, filled with pain, despair and resentment. However, they will never be able to escape this devouring vortex. They are doomed to be devoured by darkness; to be the food of the insatiable.
Ultimately, they become a part of me.
Who am I?
I am a weapon. A weapon of pure darkness.

It's not difficult to explain. In this world where there is birth, there is death; where there is light, there is darkness. I am in the heart of this vortex of darkness. War, death and anguish are what I feed on. Deep down, you've already known this for some time. Due to the constant feuding between the tribes of the desert, you were taught from a young age to be a fearless warrior. Everything you knew was about fighting, and you and Khaleed were destined to fight to the death – but have you ever wondered why?
I can see the rage in your eyes. This all comes to mind now, right?

Yes, you are just fodder to me. Simple lambs, born to be slaughtered. And I grow stronger with each offering, extending my influence to more and more tribes and plunging them into war and chaos. All this to ensure that this cycle of violence is passed down from generation to generation.

Save your strength. Your once warm blood has long since cooled. Your powerful body has stiffened and your rage is nothing more than the complaint of a powerless soul. I am here in front of you, and yet you can do nothing.

But don't be fooled. I am not the mastermind of your destiny. While you mindlessly killed each other in your enclosures, the shepherd stood at a distance, drinking your blood and harvesting your flesh. He was once the king of the desert, a ruthless tyrant, but now he slumbers far away, beneath the ruins of Tivacan. Before he fell asleep, he buried me here to gather power for his return.

The world should have been mine to conquer. I should be the one to plunge this world into darkness. Yet here I am, trapped in this desert, like a caged animal being fattened. I guess our destinies aren't so different. No matter how powerful I become, I remain just a pawn. Someone else's ship. And now he's about to wake up...
Damn him!
You want revenge, don't you?

Well, your anger is admirable and your blood is boiling again. You are the first to want to escape your pen after learning the truth. I see your soul burning with fury. Your pride, your pain, your hatred... they try to wake up your body. With such remarkable determination, you will surely bring eternal silence to this noisy desert...
Come! Come in front of me. Get me out of this damn vortex. Free me and let me see the light again.
Hate! For being forgotten by history. For the humiliation of being someone's pawn. For your sullied honor. Let all the hatred of the desert flow into you.
Burn! A vengeful soul burns the most. Return to the battlefield once again. With the darkness, I will reshape your body. I will grant you unlimited power. I will give you your revenge!
Go! Embrace the darkness and silence this desert for eternity.
anecdotes: The name Moskov is derived from the Moskva River in Russia, from which its capital, Moscow, is also derived.
Her name is also of Russian origin, just like Natalia and Masha's.
Moskov throws his spear using his left hand, making him the only left-handed sniper to wield one.
The Moskov Javelin Champion skin has the number on its shirt "1718" which relates to the Laboratory 1718 tradition
Moskov's Infernal Wyrmlord skin is the first-ever skin to receive "mind-blowing special effects."

fiche.titre: Prince of the Wild Sands Clan

lore: After the endless war, the Land of Dawn was covered in scars, but the lunar forest of Azrya was still bathed in the light of the Moon Goddess. Besides the elves, there were various other strange creatures living in this dense forest with a most frantic appearance. There have been very few disputes.

The Leonins were the most peculiar race of this forest. They were few in number, but they were born with cute appearance, agile demeanor, and some talent for using spiritual power. They used their spiritual power to bake apple pies, catch fish, and jump in the woods... As long as the Leonins were awake, the moonlit forest was particularly lively.

Nana was the Leonine [the naughtiest] of them. She was born on a moonlit night and possesses great spiritual powers. Nana was naturally enthusiastic and energetic and loved using her own power to help her friends in the jungle. It's just a shame that she, through carelessness and recklessness, burned other people's apple pies to ashes or uprooted berry bushes. Little by little, everyone began to distance themselves from Nana.

Luckily, there was a little Tanuki called Molina who was always by Nana's side. Molina was a little Tanuki living on the edge of the moonlit forest. She had no father, mother or friends. She has lived alone for as long as she can remember. Following an accident, Molina entered the Leonin gathering place, found herself stuck in a dangerous cave and it was Nana who saved her. Since then, Molina has always liked to harass Nana. But Nana didn't like staying with Molina all day. She felt that Molina, who only had the ability to change, was too weak and since Nana always likes to make trouble, Molina should not always be by her side.
Nana preferred to play with her Leonin comrades.

Although she felt disappointed by everyone's rejection, Nana, naturally optimistic, would soon try to help everyone. Once the indolent Leonins gathered in a rare meeting and discussed the construction of a playground that would belong to the Leonine race. For the Leonins, this was a rare and serious event, and Nana also participated enthusiastically.

After months of hard work, thanks to the efforts of all the Leonins, they used moonlight stones gifted by the elves, long logs gifted by the forest, colorful stucco paint mixed evenly with berry juice, and other treasures gifted by the nature spirits to build the exquisite Meow Playground. There was a cat climbing frame, a pond to catch fish, a dessert room, a large trampoline… everything. On the day it was built, to celebrate, the Leonins brought out dusty old fruit wine, baked hundreds of apple pies and grilled sea bass, and drank in the garden of Meow Playground.

Nana loved this kind of event the most. She jumped happily, picking up the fruit wine and sipping it. She drank so happily. When the moonlight came, a drunken Nana jumped on stage. She wanted to use her spiritual power to bake even more apple pie for everyone to celebrate. But when she began to cast her spell, the power in her hands began to lose control and a hurricane was unleashed, throwing the Meow playground into such disarray that it completely lost its original appearance.

Seeing that the entire race's efforts were ruined by her own mistake, Nana felt guilty and afraid. Before everyone woke up, she quietly left her fellow Leonins without taking anything with her, wanting to find a way to control her power so she could return and help everyone build a more fun paradise.

Nana walked all the way west, her path filled with strange creatures. She tried to talk to some small creatures, but everyone ignored her, which made Nana extremely depressed. Nana, who had never left the moonlight forest, felt an unprecedented sense of loss and loneliness, until she discovered that Molina had been secretly following her all along.

Molina understood Nana's guilt and how she must have felt. She told Nana: In the southern part of Azrya – the Swamp of Shadow near the Land of Despair, there is a kind of mystical fruit that grows in dangerous places and can help the user control their own energy.

Nana was a little surprised that little Tanuki was still following her, and she was a little emotional. But Nana always refused Molina's request to accompany him to Shadow Swamp. She was worried that there would be dangers on the way that could hurt her girlfriend. Nana pretended to scare Molina harshly: "You are so weak and small. Don't follow me."
But shortly after he left, Molina caught up with him and stubbornly refused to leave.
Nana discovered for the first time that the weak and small Tanuki was also persistent. She was happy inside, but on the surface[,] she accepted Molina's company reluctantly.

The two passed through many obstacles and finally reached the Shadow Swamp. Deep in the cave, they found the magical fruit they were looking for. Nana happily went to get the fruit, but did not notice the danger that was gradually approaching. Near the Land of Despair lived many monsters eaten away by the Abyss, Nana's pure nature made this black and ugly creature lick its lips and open its ferocious mouth.

Molina next to him noticed the danger. Seeing that her good friend Nana was about to pick the fruit, she screamed and used the transformation power that only worked occasionally – Molina became Nana's portrait and stood in front of Nana defenseless.
"No matter how weak I am, I can still protect my friend."

Nana, who had collected the fruit, was stunned by everything that was happening in front of her. With the help of the fruit, Nana sent a powerful force to repel the monster, but Molina was also dying. Nana cried and shared her spiritual power with Molina, but it was of no use. Eventually, Molina grabbed Nana's hand and shared her transformative power with Nana, hoping that she would be with her only friend forever.
“Stay happy, stay happy forever.”
It turned out that learning to control was just the beginning of his growth. Nana continued on her way with Molina's blessing and trust.
Those who never forgot will always survive in another way; those who have never forgotten their hometown will always return there.
anecdotes: Her name (なな; na na) means seven in Japanese and is a common feminine Japanese name.

Nana suffers from illeism, the act of referring to oneself in the third person instead of the first person.
Nana is currently the youngest character with a confirmed age.

natalia.accroche: An assassin exiled by the Empire.
lore: Natalia was orphaned by the war and raised as a little girl by the Monastery of Light. Natalia was trained to become one of the Light's assassins. This young phenomenon had become the best assassin in the monastery, thanks to his exceptional talents. However, during an assassination mission, she failed in its execution, causing unprecedented disaster and death for her companions. Although she managed to escape danger, with Tigreal's help, it was undoubtedly a blow to Natalia's pride. To further prove herself, she exiled herself to the borders of the country, far from the Moniyan Empire and the Monastery of Light, to carry out more dangerous missions. You never know who her target is or where she might strike next. All people know is that Natalia intends to win back everything she once had.
anecdotes: Natalia's name has Latin origins and means "Christmas Day"; the name was usually given to girls born during the Christmas period. Coincidentally, she was released in the month of December 2016.
Natalia is likely inspired by the Assassins of the Assassin's Creed video game series, as evidenced by her design and quotes.
Natalia is one of the heroes who has an ability that interacts with the environment (the bush).
His ultimate quote, "Nothing is true!", is a phrase attributed to Hassan-i Sabbah, the founder of the Order of the Hashshashin from which the term "assassin" comes.
Cyber ​​Specter is the best design skin in the first MLBB skin design competition hosted by MGL.
Natalia's Collector's Skin "Warrioress Paragon" was offered for a limited time, making it the first free Collector's Skin ever.
Natalia's free collector's skin and Miya's collector's skin are both linked. Miya's arrows can open portals to the future. Natalia went through this portal.
Natalia shares her Japanese voice actor, Iwasaki Chiaki, with Ruby.

natan.accroche: The savior who travels through time and space.
lore: The Land of Dawn was born from the void, and it is to the void that it will return.

Over the past few centuries, the seal that holds the Lord of the Abyss has lost power, while the fissures in the Abyss have steadily widened. The mountains of Lantis could no longer withstand the crippling corruption of the Abyss, and humanity was forced further and further north to survive.

With this, the Lord of the Abyss fully awakened and his demonic forces reached the walls of the cities of Moniyan. Humanity began to understand that their apocalypse was near. But then, a ray of pure light appeared and provided protection to Moniyan.
People cast their gazes toward the sky, searching for the source of this divine light. It was then that they realized that this was a sign that the Lord of Light had also awakened.
The powers of light and darkness have come into action and endless war has once again descended upon the lands.

Tragedy and war abounded, destroying all life, never to be reborn. At such a time, it seemed that no one could stop the spread of war. A thousand years have passed, then three hundred more, and yet the conflict continues with increasing intensity, showing no signs of stopping.
It was at this time that Natan was born.
Growing up in Eruditio, Natan proved to be naturally gifted. Whether in science or magic, he has achieved achievements unimaginable to any normal man.
Over the years, the troubles of war have left a terrible scar in people's hearts that can never be healed. This despair was a heavy burden carried by everyone, even young children.

And none more so than the Scholars, who, as humanity's last hope, now constituted the pinnacle of human wisdom, built over millennia. Natan therefore followed the same path as the other scholars, from a very young age taking responsibility for saving this world.

A few years later, young Natan had already become the driving force behind Eruditio, actively participating in various important research projects. At the age of 28, he had already been named the official head of Eruditio for his outstanding achievements. Along with his citizens, he strived to find a way to save the world.

At this point, the Abyss had accumulated even more Twilight Orbs. If each of them fell into the hands of the Lord of the Abyss, it would mean the return of pure chaos to the world, as all light would disappear into darkness. Natan and the others were running out of time. They took command of everyone at Eruditio and Magic Academy, striving with all their might to find a way to turn the situation around and avoid a certain descent into chaos.

A multitude of weapons, each powerful beyond belief, were researched and created before being sent to war. Nevertheless, humanity remained vulnerable under the threat of demons and their twilight orbs. The plan to stop the Abyss Lord's advance was already less of a plan of action and more of a wish, something that plunged humanity even further into despair.
It was at this dark moment that Natan appeared once again and presented a new idea: the creation of a time machine.

It was a crazy, fanciful idea that seemed to raise more problems than it solved. How exactly do we travel in time? Even if it were possible, how would you know when to travel? And besides, would changing the past really also change the future?
Either way, humanity found itself stuck in a dead end with no way back. Even the faintest glimmer of hope could not be extinguished.
Scholarship has put aside all other research and devoted all its manpower and resources to finding a way to make time travel a reality.
Natan did not allow himself a second of rest, devoting almost all his time and energy to his research.

This relentless effort finally produced results. Natan and the other researchers worked together to produce a device that, if powerful enough, could warp time itself. They continued to advance their research around this discovery, a rudimentary time machine slowly developing before their eyes. One lingering problem remained, however: even with their current research, they had no way of providing the machine with such a gargantuan amount of power.

Another problem was the fact that the four corners of the Land of Dawn had been ravaged by the Endless War for a long, long time now. Fissures spread across the land, floods surged, and tornadoes howled as countless life forms faced extinction in their unforgiving environments. The former glory of the Moniyan Empire has been replaced by a scene of true desolation. Scholarship continues thanks to its protective shield and welcomes a myriad of refugee families.
Eruditio was no longer simply the “City of Scholars”. It was now the last light still shining as humanity faced its apocalypse.

As the Abyss took control of the last shard of the Twilight Orb, it seemed as if fate had been decided. Dark blasts of fearful energy erupt, encircling the skies as the Land of Dawn lets out a cry of pain. I had a feeling it was going to be completely split before long.
The last bastion of humanity, Eruditio, stood alone as he struggled to ignite his dying flames of hope.

But it was precisely at that moment that a miracle happened. The explosive power that erupted from the Twilight Orbs resonated with the time machine, and so Natan hastily activated the device: it trembled with an awesome energy that surged through its hollows and glowed with a warm, powerful glow as if it were alive.

Beyond the laboratory, darkness encroached upon the land as it descended from the sky. The defensive network had been devastated by the energy blast, and now an unstoppable tide of demons was flooding the city en masse. Buildings collapsed and streets caught fire.

Everyone knew very well that this would be humanity's last fight. Besides, they all knew very well how this was probably going to end. Even though failure weighed heavily on their heads, those incessant sparks of hope continued to burn in their hearts. This hope in the face of defeat is what humanity is all about, and they placed it entirely on Natan.

Natan saw the dark scene before him and started the machine with resolve in his eyes. We hadn't had time to test it, but their theories suggested it could support a single person and transport them through time and space. This was only a theory, however, which meant there would be no way to guarantee his safety.
The end of the world loomed before him and behind him shone the hope of everyone else. Natan fulfilled the expectations of humanity and entered the past.

The future had to change. Even if it meant spending his life exploring the vast expanses of time and space, Natan would never lose hope, because that hope did not belong to him alone. This was the hope of everyone in Moniyan. As long as he continued and never gave up, there was still a chance for the survival of the Land of Dawn.
anecdotes: All of Natan's skills are based on real physics concepts.
Its passive, Theory of Everything, states that a single theory could explain all aspects of physics. Finding a theory of everything is one of the major unsolved problems in physics.
His skill 1, Superposition, and his skill 2, Interference, describe the phenomenon linked to waves.
Its ultimate, Entropy, is used as a measure of the “randomness” of a system.
According to Natan's timeline, this implies that the Abyss is about to win the Endless War over the Land of Dawn and is about to conquer the lone Eruditio.
Most of Natan's quotes are just puns on time, reflecting his horological knowledge.

nolan.accroche: A scholar who travels the universe with divided souls to save his daughter.
lore: Nolan, a poised and eminent scholar of Eruditio, aspired to unlock the secrets of the multiverse. But after discovering a cosmic threat of unimaginable proportions, he was forced to abandon everything he held dear to stop it. Despite his initial efforts, Nolan fell into despair when he realized that the ever-expanding Calamity would soon find its solution. He discovered a glimmer of hope within himself: his soul. So, Nolan left everything behind and set out on his mission across the multiverse, scattering fragments of his soul as beacons to trap the Calamity. Despite all the pain he endured, he never lost sight of his goal...his Layla. ===Tombstone=== He stood in front of his own tombstone. This particular tombstone had nothing written, not even a name. He was a scholar of the Eruditio, someone who fought for the freedom of others. Science was both his blessing and his curse. "Dad! Wake up!" Who was calling him? Who could this weak voice be? And how many legends of his life remained to be revealed? Hit the link below and discover Nolan's story! As day broke, a man stood in front of a tombstone.
Upon closer inspection, this particular tombstone had nothing written on it, not even a name. The man had not come to pay homage, but rather to tell a story; its history.
====Part I==== Twenty years ago, Nolan's professor, on his deathbed, extolled the virtues of science and warned him of its dangers.

Nolan knew his teacher had always worried about him. Nolan specialized in the study of the multiverse and theorized that their universe was just one of countless others, like a drop in the ocean. But how could humans hope to measure the immensity of the cosmos when their lifespan could not even be recorded on a cosmic scale? Perhaps through his research, Nolan will discover a bright new future for the Land of Dawn, but more likely, he will toil in obscurity for the rest of his days.
Science was both his blessing and his curse. But he was a scholar of the Eruditio, someone who fought for the freedom of others, and he was never afraid of the unknown.

When Nolan learned of the cosmic threat known as the Calamity, he suggested looking beyond their universe to find a way to prevent it. This is how he launched the Infinite Gateway Project, leading research into dimensional portals and multiversal coordinate tracking technology. If he could open the door to the multiverse, he could not only disperse the cosmic forces of Calamity into the void, but also create a better future for his world. If he could reach beyond the stars, his world could be saved.
He will devote his life to this mission.

====Part II==== When Lillian invited Nolan to the cemetery, he wondered if she was sane. Would it not be in bad taste to wander around the final resting place of so many exalted generations of scholars? But when he discovered the bribe hidden by his predecessors, he realized that this cemetery had long been a gathering place where scholars discussed life, death and everything in between.

Lillian was much more gregarious than Nolan. For her, death was not the end, but rather the way back. When they broached the subject of their future, Lillian confessed that she was willing to give up everything to better understand the multiverse. She wanted her tombstone to be anonymous, because she cared little for fame and recognition; she just wanted to live her life without regrets. Hearing this, Nolan felt inexplicably worried. Mistaking his loss of words for disinterest, Lillian punched him in the shoulder that made him stagger. She was surprisingly strong for her small size.

They talked all night. As the sun began to rise over the horizon, Lillian stood up and extended her arms in his direction. She cradled the new dawn and exclaimed that this light belonged to them, and all Nolan had to do was reach out and take it.
Nolan was taken aback. Light is energy...how could he take it and take it?
But as he looked at Lillian, bathed in the soft glow, he felt a sense of ease and comfort.

====Part III==== On a cosmic scale, the human body is more fragile than a piece of paper. Without any coordinates to serve as a focal point, any matter attempting to cross a dimensional rift would be atomized and lost to the Void. Nolan worked day and night but could not find a solution. The Infinite Gateway was already in the final stages of construction, but no tests had been performed to prove or disprove Nolan's theories because there were far too many unknowns.

The answers seemed to be within Nolan's grasp, but he just couldn't take the final step. Without coordinates to guide him in the right direction, he would be lost in the multiverse and never return. Nolan felt like he was trapped in a rapidly drying well. Sometimes the pressure was so great that he could barely breathe.

One day, a child's cry broke him out of his trance. Lillian had brought their daughter to the lab. As Nolan held his little girl, this new life that had just blossomed, he suddenly realized something: all coordinates are relative. To create a working coordinate tracking system, he simply needed a starting point. With an anchor, he could venture into the unknown and still find his way.
He gently placed an amulet next to his daughter. She will be the anchor to guide him home.
====Part IV==== The activation of the Infinite Gateway was like a bell ringing throughout the multiverse.

This was the culmination of their work. Nolan and Lillian bravely walked towards the light and found themselves among the stars they used to gaze at every night. They themselves had become astral entities beyond their own understanding. The secrets of the cosmos were slowly revealed to them, like an ancient scroll unfolding, revealing the answers to the questions they had pondered all their lives.

However, with the stars now within their reach, their home had become a vanished dream. It was only once they arrived at their destination that they realized the hopelessness of their mission. The Calamity was a force far greater than they could ever have imagined. Not only had it not dispersed, but it was heading towards the Land of Dawn at an ever-increasing speed.
Nolan fell into deep despair, but Lillian gently placed her hands on his shoulders and told him that he needed to do something more important.

And just like that, Lillian's body slowly faded into stardust as she flew towards the Calamity. She had sacrificed her life to stop the relentless advance of the Calamity. Suddenly, a blinding flash blinded Nolan. Then he lost his hearing and the rest of his senses. In their place, he felt Lillian's unwavering courage and determination. It was his way of saying goodbye.
In an instant, Nolan lost everything.
As he recovered from the flash of light, a path appeared in front of him. It suddenly occurred to him. “The anchor!”
Sixteen years was the time Lillian had bought in her life. Nolan is expected to complete his mission before then. With the determination of a father, he persevered, never to look back.
====Part V==== Sixteen years have passed. The Calamity had been contained, but Nolan was now falling endlessly into the dark void of space.

Nolan hadn't aged a day since entering the Infinite Gate. As he tirelessly carried out his mission, time ceased to affect him. He has learned to open dimensional rifts, now travel between universes, and use his soul as a weapon. He would shatter his soul into countless fragments and scatter them across the multiverse like beacons to attract Calamity. And when all was done, he would send the Calamity of each universe into the Void, all at once.

But during those sixteen years, his loneliness was unimaginable and the agony of his divided soul was beyond compare. Yet, as excruciating as they were, these experiences were nothing compared to the guilt of not being there for Layla. He couldn't watch his own daughter grow up. He couldn't go home, not even once. To carry out his plan, he had to isolate himself from Eruditio and Layla. Their destinies could never meet. Trying to defy him would only bring him pain and suffering, so he did the only thing he could and stayed away.
The depth of his pain was as vast as the cosmos, and more tortuous than splitting his soul a thousand times.
But it was all finally coming to an end.
He used his soul to absorb the destructive power of the Calamity across the multiverse and led it into the Void, saving Eruditio from the brink of destruction.
Once his promise was kept, he could finally let go. Soon he would be with Lillian.
His world was safe and his daughter would have the chance to grow up to become the brightest star in the cosmos.
Although he had made many mistakes in life, he only had one regret. If only he could see her... just once...
After what seemed like an eternity of drifting in the Void, he saw a light in the darkness.
And from there came a weak voice. The light was calling to him.
"Dad! Wake up!"
He felt the sun shine on his face as his daughter's voice echoed in the distance.
This is where this story ends.
They say that if you have accomplished everything you set out to do in life, your name need not live on after death.
All his trials and tribulations would be scattered to the stars.
As the sun rose, Nolan felt a familiar warmth. That was the feeling that belonged to them.
Standing before the nameless grave, he reached out to the dawn and kissed it. ===Who is Nolan?===
===Savior===

novaria.accroche: The young girl who seeks to rebuild the Star Atlas in order to unlock the secrets of the Stars.
lore: === The Nova === Hit the link for more Novaria stories from her bio "The Nova". Together, let's witness her rebellious journey against the stars and how she brings back the destiny they stole!
Novaria woke up in the silence of the night. She found herself once again in the vast, empty darkness, floating among the remains of the Star Atlas.
But unlike countless previous times, an exceptionally bright star could be seen tonight. As Novaria looked at him, his hands reached out as if by instinct, until he was stopped by an invisible cage.

Of course they wouldn't allow it. Novaria knew this only too well. Tonight, and every night, the stars held her prisoner. She could only stare at the little lights above her head and ruminate on the story of her life over and over again.
A story they had written.

Novaria, the last remaining astral artificer, belonged to us. She was born in the Valley of Stars and that's all she'll ever know. His people had been given a fragment of our power, but they foolishly sought to build the Star Atlas, under the illusion that it would allow them to unlock our secrets.

Such naive creatures! We, the stars, are infinite, while they, mere mortals, waste their lives trying to understand us. But this girl, Novaria, was unique. She somehow discovered in the Star Atlas the destiny we had designed for her: when the stars align, her power as Prime Watcher will awaken and she will become a semi-astral being. By our will, she will inadvertently destroy the Star Atlas and doom all of its people.
We are the stars. She will respect our wishes. She must respect our wishes.
After seeing her destiny, Novaria hid her power out of fear. But one fateful day, she predicted in the stars that a tragedy would befall her mother and had no choice but to alter the Star Atlas.

When her mother returned home safely, Novaria finally understood the connection between the Star Atlas and the stars. That's when she decided to betray us. Little by little, she made tiny, seemingly insignificant changes to the Atlas. Star patterns began to appear on her body, which distressed her but did not stop her work.
She looked up and found that star again, this time even brighter than before, as if it was burning up all her energy.
This was not the stars’ intention.
Novaria felt something stirring in her heart, something she hadn't felt since that night.

On the evening of her sixteenth birthday, she aligned the last star according to her drawing. His people would finally be saved. The next morning, as Novaria enjoyed the cake her mother had made for her, she felt at peace. The naive girl believed she was blessed by the stars.
We do not know mercy.

The Star Atlas suddenly began to shift drastically as a rift grew from its center, tearing the Atlas apart. Fragments of stars wrapped around Novaria and began to pull her toward the rift. Her mother and the other artificers exhausted the last of their powers desperately trying to force her back. She was the only one capable of completing the Star Atlas.
Cosmic forces within the rift began to transform Novaria, transforming its skin. She struggled and cried, trying to hold on to what little hope she had left, but to no avail.
We are the stars. She will respect our wishes. She must respect our wishes.

Novaria has vanished. When she came to, she found herself chained by astral rings. She couldn't escape fate. She tried to resist; in the darkness she pursued and pursued the fleeting stars, but she could not detach herself from our purpose. We chose it. She will no longer be allowed to challenge us. No creature could...
Or could they...?

The last hope was kindled in the heart of Novaria. A large explosion lit up the sky in a magnificent spectacle. It was this star! For her, breaking a star... it was unthinkable! She had defied destiny with her own will. The stars were no longer arrogant; they began to tremble at the sight of such power. The astral rings that chained Novaria were also trembling. It was his chance.
Novaria freed herself using her newfound power. The rings shattered and shattered into countless small pieces.
Novaria raised her hand and held a burning star fragment on her fingertip. She thought for a long time, trying to understand everything. Finally, she realized...
She was free.
As day finally dawned, Novaria felt a greater calling: to leave the Valley of Stars and seek the location of the shattered star. She raised her head and looked at the fading night.

"I know I will never have power as infinite as yours," Novaria told us, "But I will complete the Star Atlas, and with it I will unlock the secrets of the stars. The destinies that are available to you will also be available to me. Then we will have a level playing field. You will not chain me, or anyone else for that matter. Our destiny will be in our hands."
As night fell, the stars could only respond with silence.
Novaria shook off the star fragments and headed towards dawn.
=== Destiny beyond the stars ===
anecdotes: The name Novaria is of Latin origin and means fresh and innovative. The name "Novaria" recalls "nova", a term used in astronomy to describe a star whose brightness suddenly increases. This fits with its celestial theme and its role as a luminous force on the battlefield.
Novaria is probably inspired by the Pleiades, beautiful nymphs transformed by Zeus into constellations to save them from the giant Orion of Greek mythology.

Novaria's connection to the Star Atlas is likely a reference to the fact that the Pleiades were the daughters of the legendary king of Mauretania, the Atlas Titans, the creator of astronomy and geography in Greek mythology.
Novaria's clothing when she was still human seems to be inspired by typical Arab clothing, particularly that of Morocco.
Her outfit features shimmering, luminous patterns resembling stars and constellations, emphasizing her celestial nature.

The entire design of Novaria is inspired by the cosmos, stars and celestial elements. She is a manifestation of the Astral Artificer of the Valley of Stars, and her design reflects her deep connection to astral energy and cosmic forces. The dominant colors of his creation are blue, purple and white, all traditionally associated with the night sky and space.
Unlike most mages, she can walk through walls, which helps her reposition herself for better attacks or escape dangerous situations.

Unlike most mages who deal damage in a fixed range, Novaria's long-range skill rewards players for positioning and perfecting their aim, making her one of the few mages to function as a ranged sniper in a sense.

lore: When she tracks down a Spawn of Decay, the hunt is already over. Another demon corrupted by the power of darkness, another weakling who succumbed to the temptation of the God of Darkness – having lost his reason, his will and his self, his flesh and form completely distorted into empty puppets.
Obsidia had already felt this power... before her rebirth, before her death.

In ancient times, the Elves occupied the vast central plains while the Orcs roamed the lush grasslands to the west. The weak, strange, less intelligent, and scattered races were pushed back to the subterranean realm of the far south, struggling to survive even in this resource-scarce world. Obsidia was one of them. When his race was threatened with extinction, the power of the God of Darkness returned to him.

Immense dark power descended, washing over her form. She felt like she was floating in an endless void. Every inch of her flesh transformed as a new world opened before her. The God of Darkness's chisel carved a void in her mind, forcefully filling it with power, wisdom, and vitality—painful, yet intoxicating.

Those who had oppressed her tribe were easily crushed, their once-contemptuous gazes turning to terror. Obsidia used this power to unify the world underground. To those who submitted, she granted power; for those who rebelled, their bones were piled up. She named her kingdom the Abyss, and she became its one true sovereign.

When Obsidia awoke from her dream, the Abyss had become a tool of the God of Darkness. Its subjects were thrown into the forefront of an endless conflict between light and darkness. Barely one in ten people survived, and those who did came to view her as a merciless goddess of death.

These demons with power lost their reason and will and, like puppets in a trance, marched toward death in eternal battle. Perhaps they were already dead from the moment their individuality was removed, Obsidia thought coldly. The God of Darkness had finally bared his fangs: this was no longer his kingdom, but a breeding pool to fuel the cosmic war game of the gods. His subjects were summoned at will and dismissed just as easily. Even Obsidia's mind was corrupted by the dark god's influence, like a thick sludge of chaotic noise seeping through despite its resistance.

She felt no fear, no regret, no remorse – only endless killing intent. But it was her kingdom, and it was up to her to decide life and death. If the Dark God broke his promise, then let this place become his tomb!

Obsidia dealt a devastating blow to the God of Darkness during his war against the God of Light, but she was mortally wounded in the process. And soon, she heard the screams of demons outside her palace. Seizing his moment of weakness, the creatures of the Abyss revolted. Despite this betrayal, Obsidia's lips curled into an icy smile.
This was how the Abyss should be: an unforgiving land with no room for rules and order. Strength and endless conflict were the purest ideals of the Abyss.
There were no gods to pray to for blessings, everything had to be taken into one's hands – conquest was its true nature!

She allowed the creatures of the Abyss to take her blood and power as she entered the long sleep of death. The blood of the first ruler fused with that of the demons, and from then on, she became the Abyss itself, the source of her power.
Obsidia never expected to wake up. But the power of the Dark God that lingered around the palace where her remains were sealed finally woke her from her long slumber.
She had seen this dark elf, Selena, the next sacrificial pawn of the dark god. In her, Obsidia saw his past: proud, foolish, ignorant of the future and lost in momentary pleasure.

Then there were the Spawns of Decay. The blood that had been stolen from him had become the perfect medium of the Dark God. The god's insidious power expanded from within, enhancing their strength, distorting their minds and forms, and destroying their self-will until they became worthless trash.

While some demons were able to harness this power without becoming mindless husks, these powerful descendants were confined within their narrow circumstances; fighting for power, aspiring to ascend the throne of the Abyss. One day, they too would undoubtedly submit to the God of Darkness.
Her hunt temporarily over, Obsidia entered the darkest depths of the chasm. She felt the familiar pulse of the Abyss and those who carried its blood, as visible as the stars in the night sky.
“Then I will,” she thought.
"I will announce the return of the Abyss. I will hunt down every last Spawn of Decay. I will set the trap to kill a god."
“This is my land, my kingdom, my domain.”
“I am the Abyss.”
anecdotes: “Obsidia” evokes “obsidian” (a dark volcanic glass), which corresponds to its identity as a being of darkness and bone. Her title, "Ruler of the End of Darkness", presents her as a ruler or judge of darkness.
Its visual design uses black, gray, and deep purples, which mimic the brilliant, dark luster of real obsidian stone.
Visually, the floating bone shards, ethereal trails, and dark/ghostly shadow effects draw inspiration from gothic, dark fantasy, and necromantic aesthetics.
She is the second hero who can disable enemies' sprint or blink skills, the other being Minsitthar.
