odette.accroche: Innocent princess who grew up in Swan Castle and genius mage who excels with sword and scepter.
lore: Swan Castle located near Azure Lake was the stronghold of Prince Alvin of the Moniyan Empire. The first lord of this country, Prince Alvin I, was a hopelessly romantic crown prince. To marry a woman of humble birth, he resigned and yielded the throne to his brother, Sirius IV, leaving Lumina City and settling in the countryside now known as Swan Castle.

The Alvin house and its romanticism were then passed down from generation to generation. Prince Alvin II also assumed his royal title from a young age: his brother and eldest son Prince Alvin I focused on religious activities and later became archbishop of the Church of Light. Princess Odette was the [third generation] descendant of the family, and the love story of this elegant and adorable swan princess perfectly attested to the romantic nature of the descendants of House Alvin.

Having a right to the throne, Prince Alvin and his family understood the delicate situation they found themselves in and rarely became involved in domestic politics or had much contact with other nobles. Since her childhood, Odette led a peaceful and quiet life within the Château des Cygnes, without ever leaving their territory. But the seemingly calm girl was full of curiosity and longing for the outside world.

By the time she reached adolescence, she found the courage to hide under a coat and sneak out to visit the nearby market without her parents' permission. The naive princess once tried to pay for bread with a whole bag of gold coins and gave a beggar all the jewelry she had on her after hearing his routine heartbreaking story, but these little delinquencies just outside her home were enough to make Odette feel adventurous.

But ultimately, her adventures got her into trouble: this clueless young princess only learned what powerlessness felt like when she was harassed by a few thugs in a tavern... Fortunately, in a drunken stupor, Lancelot drew his sword and chased these men away. But Odette no longer knew what to do when she saw her rescuer injured and falling to the ground, her eyes filled with tears. So she made a decision that went against her family's rules: bring the unconscious Lancelot back to the Château des Cygnes.

In a room at the top of their castle tower, Odette bandaged Lancelot's wound and cast her family's healing spell with a scepter to heal him with the help of a young servant. She spent the whole day and night watching over Lancelot who was about to die, and only breathed a sigh of relief and smiled wearily when the man finally opened his eyes...

In the following days, Odette hid Lancelot inside the Swan Castle so that he could recuperate, and she brought him food every day with the maid and listened to the interesting romantic knight of Castle Gorge play the harp and sing songs about the adventures he had across the land. These songs were amusing melodies that Odette had never heard as she only knew royal music, and the lyrics once again piqued her strong curiosity and desire for the outside world.

Odette's meetings with Lancelot became the greatest pleasure of her day. As she opened up to this new friend, she also told him about her little adventures as rebellious delinquents and even learned from him some sword fighting techniques for self-defense.

As they bounced around over time, Lancelot slowly became reluctant and withdrawn. He no longer played these funny songs in praise of the hero Lancelot, but often sang the love story between a knight and a young girl, exalting a kind and beautiful princess.
The innocent Odette did not understand the reason for her change, until the devious servant suddenly asked her in a whisper: "Who do you think Lancelot plays these songs to, Your Grace?"
The servant's words woke the blind princess. Odette finally understood that someone was subtly courting her!

It was once again the mischievous young servant who persuaded Odette not to run away or ignore her court that the princess had the courage to confront Lancelot's feelings. But she still didn't know if she was also in love with him.

As Lancelot's wound healed each day, Odette knew that the day of his departure was approaching. Her morale sank and one day a letter delivered by her father troubled her even more: "Duke Baroque was proposing to me on behalf of his son? What a boring suitor!"
But Odette suddenly realized: wasn't the “romantic knight of Castle Gorge” from the stronghold of House Baroque? So the Duke's son must be...

Despite her heart beating wildly, Odette had to feign calm in front of her parents. But when she returned to her room, she couldn't help but laugh inside and even danced happily with the maid. But not knowing how to face Lancelot, Odette realized she couldn't bring herself to see him now.
But against all expectations, Lancelot left a letter and left without goodbye a few days later. Depressed, Odette finally realized how much she adored him...
Until the evening, after having made her decision, Odette wrote a letter to her parents before quietly leaving the Château des Cygnes.
She would follow in the footsteps left by Lancelot and seek the love of her life...
anecdotes: Odette's full name is Princess Odette Alvin.
The sword that Odette carries is used as a focus point for her spells. She does not use the sword by conventional means.
Since Gaius founded the empire, the ruling Monian dynasty has never changed, as Silvanna is a direct descendant of Gaius. This means that Odette, Silvanna and Dyrroth have a common ancestor.
The fact that the ruling dynasty never changed shows us its connection to Vexana, who was also a princess of the Monian Empire.
One of his quotes implies that the sword is a gift. The sword offered by Lancelot.
Lancelot is referenced in two of his quotes: "Don't ask me why a mage carries a sword!" » "This sword is a gift."
Odette is inspired by a character of the same name in Swan Lake.
Her "Black Swan" skin also refers to another character from the same opera.
The music for his Ultimate, Swan Song is taken from Swan Lake (Ballet Suitte), OP by Tchaikovsky. 20

At first, it could be purchased with Battle Points. Now it can only be obtained by new players through quests, purchased from the Shard Shop using 120 Hero Shards, or from the Lucky Shop using 20 Lucky Gems.
Odette is the only hero that cannot be purchased with Battle Points or Diamonds.

paquito.accroche: The hero who uses both fists to protect hope and love.
lore: The Abyss grew in power, plunging the Land of Dawn once again into the thick fogs of eternal war. It was a true calamity that spread suffering throughout the Land of Dawn. Especially the southern border of the Moniyan Empire. The rampant menace and corruption of the Abyss has left this place in ruins, and it now stands as a barren wasteland.

The Empire had long since stopped trying to reclaim these lands, and the numbers of those fleeing to the heart of the Moniyan for a new life grew by the day. Those who did not want to leave their homeland stayed behind and struggled to make ends meet, but they failed to unite and offer resistance to the advance of the Abyss. Instead, they have adopted brutal force and violence in their efforts to lay claim to the earth's dwindling resources. Conflict reigned over everything.

Like the distant Land of Despair, this frontier has fallen into deep decline, an abyss without a glimmer of hope. Until that day comes. A man with a distinctive scar on his back and fists of iron roamed these chaotic lands, purging the injustice and cruelty that dominated them. A long-lost warmth returned to people's hearts as one malevolent force after another fell before him.
No one knew where this man came from. And so, those he saved would simply call him the “Heavenly Fist”. Yet his name was Paquito.

Paquito was born in a small southwest village of Moniyan. To survive and thrive in a country like this, so far from the royal capital, you had to be strong. And so[,] he had only one dream since he was a little boy: to become the strongest fighter in the world. Paquito tempered his mind, body, and spirit by every means possible in his quest for this power.
A reluctant man walked through his village, witnessing the incredible effort Paquito was putting into his training. That's why he decided to stay and trained Paquito, taking him as a student.

In the months that followed, Paquito's abilities improved at an exponential rate as he trained under his master. Yet his departure was approaching. Before leaving, he said this to Paquito: the summit, the true essence of combat, does not lie in destruction. It's not about attacking.
Paquito continued tirelessly to perfect his technique in the years following the departure of his master. However, he still had difficulty embodying this essence that his master spoke of.

This left him with uncertainty deep in his heart, so he too left his village, still determined to become the strongest in the world. And so[,] he sought powerful adversaries as he roamed the lands. As he traveled the mountains of Lantis, he found a land rife with injustice and evil. Therefore, he would enter the fray, fighting for justice and annihilating evil, becoming known as the "Heavenly Fist".

As Paquito relentlessly advanced, a mysterious figure known as the "Dominator" gained great power in the Moniyan Empire. He commanded his subordinates and launched a grand plan to take control of the earth. To fuel his plans, the Dominator plundered these lands already on the verge of collapse, leaving behind cruelty and massacre.

Paquito heard about this series of tragedies, and it made his blood boil. He has sworn to stop this Dominator and eradicate all traces of his control. In his mission to unmask this dark figure and his true identity, Paquito discovered that he was none other than his former master. He had searched for the true essence of what it means to fight, but instead he had been eaten up and spat out by the harsh realities of this world. He had lost everything he once stood for, becoming cruel and ruthless.

Paquito's loyalty and friendship to his former master clashed with the justice and morality that had always been so dear to him. He made his decision. The student and the master began an unprecedented battle. Paquito held his ground and received the first of his master's crushing blows – a reward for the teaching he had received. Then they started exchanging blows; a collision of two colossal forces. The master's technique had only strengthened over the years, with dominant advances hitting Paquito until he was on the brink of death. Strength began to leave his body and Paquito thought of those he had worked to save from oppression; their grim looks, how they wanted nothing but peace. It was then that he had his epiphany: the true essence of combat was not to attack or destroy, but rather to defend hope wherever it might be found.
Paquito forced the Dominator to defeat, and the master looked at his former student, filled with regret. His evil forces were subdued and peace flourished in the land.

It was then that Paquito put his bag on his shoulders and prepared to hit the road again, telling his master: our world is bigger than we think, with powerful adversaries awaiting our arrival, not to mention the powers of evil...
He counted on his two fists. With them, he would fight for the hopes and dreams of all who needed him.
anecdotes: Paquito is based on Manny Pacquiao, a former professional boxer from the Philippines, who is also the current brand ambassador for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. This is also evident in Paquito's left-handed stance, similar to his real-life counterpart.
In Teutonic first names, the name Paquito means “free”.
When first leaked, Paquito was originally named Parry.

The Manny Pacquiao skin for Paquito was initially exclusive to players in the Philippines when it was released as a special collaboration in 2021. It came with special effects, voice lines, and animations referencing Pacquiao's real-life boxing career.
When Paquito is affected by crowd control effects being disabled, he is shown in a common defensive stance.

lore: name = Verri Crow Princess of Askati Forest As the princess of the Crow clan of Askati Forest, she was born with mutated blood. The mutation could gain its incredible abilities if awakened. When Alice invaded the Askati Forest, Pharsa, awakened, chased Alice away and lost her sight. After that, her lover transformed into a crow to replace her eyes. === Bio === The Raven people of Askati Forest are one of the oldest races still in existence in the Land of Dawn. This race was united by the Raven King, Osana, under whose leadership they perfected the art of Sky Magic. This unique school of magic allows its wielder to transform into a bird, soar through the skies and strike at enormous distances. However, only those whose blood is "awakened" can use it.

The noble Princess Pharsa was born with an unknown blood type that would have enormous potential if awakened, but despite their best efforts, her baffled tribesmen failed to unleash its true power. Soon, Pharsa's special blood became a burden, as ill-intentioned opportunists across the land sought to harvest it for their own benefit. On the day of Pharsa's wedding, the tyrannical witch Alice invaded the Askati Forest, mercilessly killing countless ravens and leaving a trail of smoldering ruins in her wake. Numbed to the core by the carnage around her, Pharsa let Osana's ancient crown fall to the ground. His appearance began to change, as an unprecedented power flowed through his veins: his blood had been awakened. Pharsa's eyes darkened, while one side of her hair turned pure white, and she flew into the sky to unleash a torrential assault of horrible magical power, fierce enough to drive Alice away.

Verri, the love of his life, could not bear to see his fiancée suffer a life of blindness alone and chose to accompany Pharsa wherever she went, using his own magic to become permanently linked to Pharsa and allowing her to see through her eyes. Pharsa wishes her power had never awakened, she wishes even more that her home hadn't been destroyed, but this witch took everything from her, and now it was time for revenge...
anecdotes: When Pharsa was first released, she was known as Fasha. Its name was later changed to Pharsa.

"Pharsa" could be inspired by the Arabic word for "bird" or "eagle", which corresponds to Pharsa's avian and flight abilities. As a mage hero with a powerful bird companion and the ability to glide through the air, this interpretation fits his design and skills well.
Pharsa is a very rare female first name often used by the Muslim community which means "Riding".
In some languages, her name is Fasha, which may be an abbreviation of the Arabic word Farasha meaning "Butterfly", symbolizing beauty, transformation and freedom.
As the princess of the Crow Clan of the Askati Forest, she was born with mutated blood.
Before her rework, she was temporarily banned from Brawl games because her ultimate skill gave her enemies a huge disadvantage due to its short cooldown, range, and damage.

phoveus.accroche: A former soldier from the frontiers of the Empire who took on the chains of sin to defend his people.
lore: Phoveus was once a Moniyan soldier from the borders of the Lantis Mountains. His unit, made up of fourteen hardened warriors, was well known among the locals for their reckless bravery, fighting the Abyss using dubious but effective methods.

During a disastrous Empire offensive, Phoveus was forced to summon the power of an evil god to turn the tide. Despite the lives he saved, Phoveus was labeled a sinner for conspiring with a demon. On the way to his execution, the Evil God attempted to take over Phoveus' body, but Phoveus took advantage of the situation to bond with the Evil God in a stone monolith. While the Empire continues to condemn Phovéus as a sinner, those on the border will forever consider him a hero.
The nameless monolith, beneath the crimson twilight of Moniyan's sky, the scent of blood wafting in the cold air hinted at a horrific battle not long ago.

The wheels of a prison cart bounced shakily over rocks as it was pulled along the mountain road. "Farewell to yesterday, to forgotten glories, on this familiar night. Open my chest and engrave this oath in the hearts of those on the border..."
In the carriage, a shadowy figure revealed itself through a gap in the cage. His armor broken, his face mutilated and his empty eyes glinting coldly in the moonlight.
"Silence!"
A soldier screamed as he hit the cart, interrupting the mumbled song. Growing anger rose to his face as he cursed the prisoner:
"We lost thirteen thousand good men in this battle! And what you did... it's like spitting on their graves!"

The wind rose like a sharp knife. After a few moments of silence, Phoveus turned and retreated into the darkness. The voice rang out from the cart once again, but this time it was not the chants of the border guards. Instead, thirteen names were whispered over and over again. These seemingly ordinary names once brought joy and hope to the villages of the Lantis Mountains. These were the names of fathers, brothers and sons who had protected the border for generations. But now they were just names written disdainfully on a piece of Moniyan Border Regiment paper.
“Your men will be remembered as sinners and traitors, just like you.”

At this moment, a stone monolith carried in the same wagon began to move. Phoveus watched in disbelief as an eye slowly opened on the monolith; the same eye that led him to this destiny. She focused on Phoveus, reflecting the madness in his eyes.

This meeting was not a coincidence. Centuries ago, Phoveus' ancestor sealed an evil god atop a great pillar. The pillar eroded over the years until it finally became a monolith on the border of the Moniyan Empire and the Abyss. After this fateful battle, the monolith was placed in the wagon to be moved. Phoveus knew everything about the demon, and the demon knew everything about him.
“Take back my power and claim everything that is rightfully yours…”

Phoveus remained silent but did not notice his hand unconsciously moving towards the whispering monolith. The thirteen names echoed again in the darkness, this time accompanied by the sound of nails scraping against stone. He had invoked these names countless times. They were etched into his soul, as were the trusting eyes, the exhausted smiles, and the exhausted faces that responded.

But all that was no more. All that remained were the anonymous tombstones erected at the border. The border they protected with blood and tears and from which they could not find peace even in death. Phovéus is then reminded that names are only useful to the living.

When the Abyss began to relentlessly attack Mount Lantis Pass, trying to break the Empire's defensive line, a desperate Phoveus found himself staring at a giant demonic eye. He felt as if the eye was peering into his soul, searching for something... "Ah, he desires power overwhelming enough to stop this senseless slaughter."

Under the influence of the demonic entity, Phoveus and his men managed to rout the Abyssal forces that day. The trumpet of momentary victory and the frustrated howls of the Abyss were carried to the center of the Empire, fueling the Empire's ambitions to reconquer lost territories.

Thus, the Imperial Knight Tigreal was sent to the pass with a force of thirteen thousand soldiers. They arrived in good spirits, with their golden armor shining in the afternoon sun. But when the fighting began, Phoveus realized that these men had lived in the light for too long and had forgotten how insidious the darkness could be.

The cunning of the Abyss and the inexperience of the Empire's field commanders caused their entire second regiment to be surrounded by the Abyssal forces. Phoveus looked desperately at his men still holding the line, their battered bodies refusing to fall, and closed his eyes. He told Tigreal that he would rather be cursed by the world than let another comrade become a nameless tombstone. Defying Tigreal's orders, Phoveus called to the eye. When he appeared before him, he used his blood to break the demon's seal.

An instant later, Phoveus slammed into the middle of the battlefield and began pushing the Abyss back, giving Tigreal and the remaining soldiers time to retreat. But in the eyes of the Empire, there was no greater sin than colluding with a demon. On the other hand, the lives of the soldiers he saved had no consequence on his crime. Phoveus was branded a traitor and imprisoned for execution.

Back in the chariot, demonic power began to wrap around Phoveus' arms like hellish chains. Spikes protruded from it and pierced deep into Phoveus' flesh. Finally! The Evil God had patiently waited and plotted for this very moment, and now he was about to take the flesh and blood of his former enemies.

The cart turned, revealing Phoveus' calm face in the moonlight. There was a determination in his eyes that a desperate man should not have had. Phoveus suddenly grabbed the chains and, with the weight of his own soul, began to push the demon back into the monolith. The more the demon struggled, the tighter the chains became. In the process, Phoveus' body and soul began to merge with a monolith as its power flowed into him.

"We are alike in one way. We have the patience of wise men, hiding our true ambitions or that fateful day. Unfortunately, you will never have the chance to know the words engraved on the back of this monolith..."
Phovéus wiped the dust from the monolith, revealing the ancient oath engraved on it:
“Our will is your eternal fetter.”
The cage burst into pieces to reveal Phoveus, covered in chains and pulsing with power. With a heavy step, he backed heavily towards the border, dragging the monolith behind him.
The monolith now imprisoned two souls, but Phoveus had never felt so liberated, for he had finally gained the power to save his people.
anecdotes: Phoveus is the 7th and is one of the heroes offered free to players when they are released. The other free heroes are Faramis, Belerick, Silvanna, Luo Yi, Benedetta, Mathilda, Floryn, Edith and Julian.
Phoveus is the third hero to be given away for free during Event 515 (of 2021). The others are Faramis, Luo Yi and Julian.
In the old voice lines, Astaros speaks in Latin on some quotes.
He was once a magic damage hero, but was retooled to physical damage while retaining some magic damage.

Phoveus has not received a skin since its release on May 11, 2021, breaking the record for the longest time for a hero to receive a skin other than the base skin, which is Faramis (1255 days) in a few main days as of June 30, 2020.
He teamed up with the ranger squad, but was reworked to become a lone warrior.
His English voice actor, Jordan Reynolds, is married to Valentina's voice actress, Mara Junot. Outside of MLBB, they are also known for voicing Adam Warlock and Storm from Marvel Rivals.

popol-and-kupa.accroche: Boy and an Icefield Wolf, partners who understand each other well.
lore: The Feldans are an ordinary nomadic tribe found in the middle of Northern Vale. Like most local populations, they live near the forest and lead a peaceful and quiet life as experienced hunters.

But there was one exception. Popol, a naughty boy who was known as the expert prankster and little adventurer of the tribe, always seemed to be the center of attention. Unlike the other calm and composed Northern Valers, he was full of vigor and imagination. Thanks to Northern Vale's warrior tradition, Popol had mastered the art of spear throwing since childhood. He often joined the adults in their hunt and returned with a cart full of prey.
Listening to adults sing songs about legendary heroes after drinking was his favorite pastime. He dreamed of becoming one of them and having his name sung by others like Popol, the Intrepid.

However, his tribe members did not take his ambition seriously and laughed it off as if it were a childish dream. Popol apparently couldn't stand it. In order to impress others, he played all sorts of well-planned pranks on them, which resulted in the villagers, especially children, viewing him as a monster and staying away from him.

The more alienated he was, the more he wanted to get their attention by playing even more pranks. However, it continued to produce the opposite effects. In the end, he had no friends left. Alone and desperate, he decides to do something extraordinary to reverse his image once and for all.

One dark night, Popol left the village and ventured into the mountains. He planned to kill a fierce ice wolf all by himself to impress others. He stumbled into the thick forest and examined his surroundings curiously. As expected, he lost his orientation in the darkness and fell into a trap.

As Popol fell into the deep pit, he hit his head on a rock, staring into his line of vision. After regaining consciousness, he looked around, wondering where he was, and the first thing he saw at the bottom of the hole was a pair of glowing blue eyes, which scared him. But when the moonlight shone into the trap, he saw the owner of the eyes - a trapped ice wolf, to whom he later gave the name Kupa. One of its front legs was trapped and injured by a beast trap, and because of starvation it could barely move.

Popol could have killed Kupa there and then, but when he raised his spear, he saw the same loneliness in Kupa's eyes. If he killed Kupa, he would find himself completely alone in the darkness of the trap. Hesitantly, he put down the spear and tried to help Kupa.

At first, they were defensive and hostile towards each other. But over time. The two lonely souls finally let their guard down and considered themselves to be of the same gender. Although they were trapped in the pit, they felt a warm sensation in each other's presence. The beast trap became the bridge of their friendship. And perhaps because of their loneliness, Popol treated Kupa as a listener and playmate. He even playfully threw snowballs at Kupa's muzzle.
But at this point, Kupa was almost starving. Popol hesitated for a moment, before sharing the food he was carrying with the dying Kupa.

However, Popol decided to feed Kupa and Kupa was eventually saved from starvation. In Kupa's mind, all humans were cold and ruthless like hunters. It was usually always a life or death situation between them and the ice wolves. But Popol was different. Having been hunted alone in the forest since birth, Kupa felt Popol's kindness and warmth for the first time. Over time, Popol and Kupa began to survive on rats and other small creatures, which Popol caught with his spear and then shared with Kupa.

A few days passed and the two struck up a subtle friendship. Unfortunately, they didn't have much food or rats left to survive. And to make matters worse, their first visitors were not people who came to rescue them, but a group of vultures. They rushed to the trap and began to attack. Popol threw his spear at the vultures, but he could not repel them, while Kupa could only fight aimlessly with a free paw.

Under the continuous harassment of vultures, they became food for the birds. It was at this moment of danger that Popol made a remarkable decision: he threw down the spear and with all his might, tore open the beast trap, in order to help Kupa escape. With his back exposed, he was grabbed by a vulture and lifted from the trap in mid-flight. Just as Popol was losing all hope, a thunderous roar erupted. Kupa jumped out of the pit and threw himself at the vulture, freeing Popol from its grip.

Now, while fighting side by side, Popol and Kupa showed incredible synergy and fended off all the vultures for good. From now on, they become the best partners in the adventure. They traveled across the frozen lands and began a new chapter in their adventure story together.
anecdotes: Popol & Kupa draw heavy inspiration from Nordic and Arctic tribal cultures, particularly their hunting traditions and close ties to animals like wolves and dogs. His fur-lined outfit and tribal markings resemble the Inuit, Sami and Viking hunters of the Viking Age who lived in icy regions.

Popol and Kupa are the first heroes whose names and titles are shared. Although he is considered a hero alongside Popol, Kupa is a summoned unit, due to the fact that he summons her to be resurrected.

Popol is one of the few heroes who breaks the 4th wall through one of his quotes. Specifically, he refers to either his "Dark System" teammates or those of lower rank in certain matches involving him.
Popol and Kupa are the only snipers in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang with a full set of four skills.
Kupa is based on Fenrir, who is a monstrous wolf in Norse mythology. In Old Norse texts, Fenrir plays a key role during the events of Ragnarök.

Nunu & Willump from League of Legends, Rexxar from Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, and Beastmaster from Dota 2 are some of the Summoner/Beastmaster type heroes in other RTS/MOBA games, similar to Popol and Kupa.
The duo's playstyle is similar to that of traditional beast tamers or shamans of various cultures.
Popol and Kupa, Kadita and Lunox share the same English-speaking voice actress, Alicia Gerrard.

rafaela.accroche: An angel loved and respected by the people of this world.
lore: With the end of the Golden Age, a monstrous abyssal fissure has once again opened within the Land of Dawn, and from its depths dark energies rise once again.
The darkness of the night was about to fall again. The Abyss loomed menacingly.

To protect this world, the Lord of Light has selected a number of pure maidens who will become pregnant with angels. Legends said that only women could be angels – for example, those chosen by the Lord of Light could only give birth to daughters.

Argus and Rafaela are twin siblings born in the Moniyan Empire. The Sacrists of the Monastery of Light forced their mother to imbibe holy water, in the name of the Lord of Light. Therefore, she would give birth to an angel in her temple. Their mother was certainly an ordinary woman, she and her lover faithfully devoted to each other. Yet, under the supervision and persuasion of the sacrists, she had no choice but to accept the "honor" bestowed upon her by the Lord of Light.

The pregnancy of the one carrying an angel is an incredibly long and slow process. During these three years, his heart grew heavy, tortured by the solitude of such a long ordeal. She longed for her lover, longed to be with him again. After two years, she couldn't take it anymore and escaped the temple to find him; together they lived happily once again. But it will only be a short-lived happiness.
The sacrists did not take long to find her. Her lover was killed before her eyes for threatening to desecrate the divine lineage of the Lord of Light, and she was sent back to the monastery.
Another year passed, at the end of which she died in childbirth. To everyone's surprise, she gave birth to a pair of twins: one of whom was a baby boy.

The child's eyes strangely resembled those of his late mother's lover. The Cleric of Light soon realized this, realizing that the boy was born of humanity – and yet, incredibly, he possessed the power of angels. The sacrists attempted to kill him but their efforts were thwarted, for every time they tried, a dazzling light burst from Rafaela, protecting her brother from all harm.
This was considered a miracle. So they gave up any idea of ​​killing the boy. Instead, in silent unanimity, it was decided that the circumstances of his birth should remain a secret from everyone.
The Monastery of Light hid the truth so masterfully that even the twins themselves knew nothing about it.

Argus and Rafaela therefore grew up together, following the same education and training. What set them apart, however, was the fact that she was seen as a magnificent ray of light: a holy and immaculate being. In people's eyes, Rafaela was their only true angel. Argus, on the other hand, was kept in the shadows and forever deprived of the glory that was rightfully his.

However, Rafaela loved her brother very much, as she loved him. The two underwent entirely different treatments, and Argus was constantly warned that his only choice was to live in his shadow, but the two were nonetheless an inseparable couple who cared deeply for each other. Both were extremely good-hearted and, as soon as they came of age, swore to uphold their common mission: to use their power to protect peace and spread Light.

The praise and admiration came in waves, but alas, it only fell on Rafaela. Even though Argus was just as exceptional as his sister and, like her, had gone to great lengths to maintain the path of Light, everyone's praise was instead directed only at the gentle Rafaela. While he fought for the Light, it was in darkness that Argus remained.

Rafaela witnessed this and repeatedly wanted to speak on behalf of her brother: to change people's attitudes towards him. However, she didn't succeed even once. She didn't understand: why was he treated like an outcast? No matter how hard he tried, no matter how much he sacrificed, they knew everything and yet they treated him the same...

Rafaela was an always attentive soul, and so she quickly noticed that Argus' attitude towards humanity was beginning to change. In his eyes, human nature was malicious and selfish. That being the case, why should he even bother trying to curry favor with them? The twins had several arguments about this, as Rafaela conversely believed that the Abyss was the root of all darkness in life. She believed that humanity was good and kind, but that these qualities disappeared once tainted by the Abyss. Neither was willing to change their point of view, no matter how hard they tried to persuade the other.
The two diverge in terms of individual philosophies. Over time, however, their battlefield tactics also began to differ.

Amidst the battle, Argus persevered tirelessly, eager for a quick victory, but ultimately fell into the demons' trap. Rafaela ordered the troops to retreat, but Argus ignored her as he headed towards the demons' nest.

Argus returns from the enemy camp with a demonic blade in his hand, a weapon emitting a malevolent aura. A dark, menacing mist swirled around him. Although Rafaela worked hard to purge him of this darkness, he broke away and killed the troops all around her before escaping.

From that moment on, Rafaela tirelessly searched for every tidbit about her brother's whereabouts. His behavior did not surprise the Monastery of the Sacrists of Light; on the contrary, they claimed that they had long considered him a corrupt soul and that this day was inevitable. Their words shook Rafaela to her core, and for the first time, her faith was shaken as well. She punished them severely and left the Monastery of Light to find her lost brother.

Several months have passed. Finally, it was in the Arid Lands that she found Argus. What she didn't realize, however, was that the Argus she knew was now long gone. The golden aura in which he once bathed, his radiant wings, were nowhere to be seen; and in their place was an oppressive aura of cruelty and pitch-black wings.

There was no going back now... Rafaela wanted to increase her staff and put an end to this, as was her duty. Yet memories of the past floated through her mind, one after the other, and she couldn't bring herself to do it. Argus looked at her from afar and silently turned to leave.

From then on, he will only sink further into the darkness of the Abyss. Constantly wracked with pain and confusion, constantly sinking deeper and deeper. Over time, Rafaela became the woman she is today: an angel admired by all, savior of the apocalypse and incarnation of Light. Despite this, she could never bear to face the one who was closest to her.
Time passes, never to return. No matter human or angel, no one can go back.
anecdotes: Rafaela is the first healer and pure support in the game.
The skin of Rafaela, “Goddess of Fertility,” may be based on Isis, the goddess of healing and magic, and was crucial to ancient Egyptian religious beliefs.
Rafaela is one of the few heroes in the game to receive an official tournament skin, "Biomedic MPL Special".
She is one of the heroes who does not have a base skin.
Argus and Rafaela are dysgotic twins

pouvoirs: Power of Holy Light by healing allies and dealing damage to enemies.

roger.accroche: A werewolf wandering the dark forest in search of revenge.
lore: Ignoring the villagers' warnings, Roger decided to settle just on the edge of the Black Forest, just a few kilometers east of the Megalith Wastes. His countless years in the Imperial Army had made him a resolute man...and perhaps too stubborn for his own good. Regardless, now that his days as a soldier were over, he was determined to hunt in the dark forests and make a living from its riches.

The Black Forest was home to all manner of unsavory vermin. But none were more terrifying than the hundreds of wolves lurking in the shadows. With their new Wolf King, White Fang, having awakened ancient magical abilities within him, they became even more ferocious. And while the forest lacked prey, wolves gradually expanded their hunting territory and began to appear outside the forests. Still hunting in packs, they began to attack unwary travelers who dared to pass by.

Determined to keep this threat at bay. Roger followed Whitefang's pack. finally finding them huddled around a small village. He had barely arrived when a guttural howl broke the calm of the night. send out the wolf pack and ravage everyone in its path.

The village was thrown into chaos, with White Fang himself standing in the middle, about to feast on an injured little girl. Without wasting any time, Roger lunged directly at the beast and ripped the girl from its grasp. White Fang jerked back, digging his claws into the hunter's chest as he tried to pull the girl to safety.

Undeterred by his injuries, Roger managed to repel the vicious horde, warning White Fang never to return to the village with the same ferocity as that of the wolves. The Wolf King retreated with his pack, but when he looked back, Roger felt his blood run cold with the hatred in the wolf's eyes.

Haunted by the terror he felt that day, Roger couldn't help but fear that White Fang would return for revenge. He began training the surviving villagers to fight wolves, especially the little girl he saved whose name he later learned was Ruby.

However, soon after, Roger noticed bizarre changes in his body. He suspected that they were somehow connected to the injuries White Fang had inflicted on him. Concerned for the safety of others, the hunter fled the village in secret.
Returning home, Roger's suspicions were soon confirmed, as the ancient magic carried by White Fang had begun to infect his own body.
“Even the pure-hearted, the one who never once misses his nightly prayers, is powerless to resist the curse of the lupine when the full moon looms in the night sky.”

The moment quickly arrived. When the glow of the full moon illuminated the vast grasslands around the Black Forest, Roger could do nothing but watch in horror as his body slowly changed shape, transforming into a spitting image of White Fang himself. Fearing harm to those he was sworn to protect, he had no choice but to leave his home and embark on his own journey. <!--"old tradition"-Roger lived outside the Dark Forest, east of the Megalith Desert. He was an experienced hunter who hunted for a living. Many dangerous animals live in the Dark Forest, and the most fearsome among them are not the rare magical creatures but the old wolf king "White Fang", who leads a ruthless pack of more than a hundred strong wolves. They were a cooperative pack of predators under the control of their leader, White Fang, who also possessed the influence of an evil power that awakened magical abilities in him.

To meet their hunting needs, the wolf pack gradually began to prowl outside the confines of the Dark Forest, often attacking travelers along the way. In the spirit of justice, Roger considered getting rid of this public menace and followed in the footsteps of the White Fang. Roger caught up with White Fang and caught him off guard just as the Wolf King was about to devour a little girl, Ruby. Roger shot the White Fang and ended his life by cutting open the wolf's belly. Roger had defeated White Fang, but the evil power lurking inside White Fang contaminated the hunter.

The evil powers were dark enough to prevent even a man with the purest heart, a man who never forgets to say his prayers at night, from turning into a werewolf under the full moon. Under the call of the moon, Roger was shocked to discover that the old legends were true. He had become a Lycanthrope, commonly known as a werewolf. To avoid losing his sanity by transforming and harming his family, Roger had no choice but to flee far from home.-->
anecdotes: The name Roger has Germanic origins and means "famous spear" or "renowned warrior". It comes from the old High German name Hrodger, which is composed of two elements: "hrod" meaning "fame" or "glory" and "ger" meaning "spear".
Roger is currently the only Fighter/Marksman hybrid hero in MLBB, known for his ability to switch between human and werewolf forms.
The character of Roger is the fusion of the hunter and the big bad wolf from Little Red Riding Hood, just like Ruby, whose main character she is based on.
Roger smokes a cigar upon his initial release, but was returned to comply with MLBB age classifications. His match model always has his cigar when observed closely.

Roger is mentioned by Chang'e in one of his quotes. This is a reference to his wolf form, as wolves are known to hunt many types of prey, including rabbits, Chang'e's favorite animal. This hostile relationship is one of the most popular relationships in fiction.
He also takes some inspiration from Warwick from League of Legends and Ursa and Lycan from Dota 2.
Roger's "Anubis" skin is inspired by the Egyptian god Anubis, featuring golden armor and a jackal-like werewolf form.
His "Phantom Pirate" skin is somewhat inspired by cursed pirate myths like The Flying Dutchman and Davy Jones' crew from Pirates of the Caribbean.
He shares the same Japanese voice actor, Tsuyuzaki Wataru, with Clint,

ruby.accroche: A girl who grew up with Roger's help.
lore: It could have been just another peaceful night in a remote village near the outskirts of the Dark Forest, but they were interrupted by the vicious howls of wolves in the distance. In a small cabin, a little girl was kneeling by her bed and praying. Next to her were disproportionate giant scythes. Indeed, she prayed for the return of the legendary Hunter – Roger. Only he could save the village from wolf vandalism.

Years earlier, Roger had saved his family from a pack of wild wolves, which they had accidentally encountered while wandering the Land of Dawn. His bravery wreaked havoc among the wolves. At the request of the village elders, Roger ultimately stayed to train the villagers. One day he left the village without warning and no trace was found.

What happens in fairy tales can rarely be the same in reality. On a silent, moonless night, Pale Tusk, the new Wolf King, took the village by surprise and slipped away with his people. In the end, Ruby's grandfather and grandmother both died, protecting Ruby, who in turn narrowly escaped by hiding under her grandparents' corpse.

No one could imagine that from the moment she witnessed the death of her grandparents, her character would completely change. Indignant, she got up, picked up the scythes and, to everyone's shock, rushed into the pack of wolves and slaughtered almost all of them. Beneath his seemingly weak appearance now hid a disturbing and irritable soul. Pale Tusk was the only survivor among the wolves. Looking to the horizon, Ruby was determined to put an end to everyone who was responsible for the deaths of all those good, innocent people, including her grandparents.

Pale Tusk has never been defeated before, but this time it happened in the most severe way. But during a fight, Ruby hesitated to shoot the wolf, who seized the opportunity and knocked Ruby down, scratching her in the left eye. Surprisingly, Pale Tusk didn't want to kill, but turned and fled.
Ruby gradually regained consciousness after Pale Tusk left, but unfortunately, she lost an eye during the battle. Now, every time she hears the wolves howling, her eye fills with rage and pain.
anecdotes: The name Ruby is named after the gemstone ruby, which is red and symbolizes passion, strength and vitality. This fits with his red-themed design, scythe, and blood-related lifestealing abilities. The color red (ruby) also represents blood, aggression and power, matching its vampiric life-stealing gameplay.
Her appearance could be inspired by RWBY's Ruby Rose, who herself is alluded to in the fairy tale character Little Red Riding Hood.
Its story and title “Little Red Riding Hood” also refer to Little Red Riding Hood. Additionally, in the game files, she is called Xiaohongmao, which translates to "Little Red Riding Hood" in Chinese.

Its original story was reinstated upon the release of the so-called "family update", as the story of Ruby ripping out the heart of Haas the wolf (later renamed Whitefang) still beating and drinking his blood, as well as Ruby falling into madness, was deemed too dark and disturbing for many of the game's younger audiences.
Old Ruby, full image, her eyepatch is over her left eye, but in the game model it's in her right eye.
Ruby eyes are blue in color but the model has green eyes.

Ruby has one of the highest lifesteal rates in the game. Her passive (Let's Dance!) allows her to gain huge vamp spells from items and skills. With the right build, she can recover all of her HP in just a few attacks!
She is inspired by Little Red from Moonton's Magic Rush, which is also a clear reference to Little Red Riding Hood.
She shares her Japanese voice actor, Iwasaki Chiaki, with Natalia.

saber.accroche: A swordsman seeking invincibility, used by Laboratory 1718.
lore: A swordsman seeking invincibility, used by Lab 1718. Formerly called Duan Meng and obsessed with kendo, Saber came to Lab 1718 to transform in order to pursue perfection, but his memory was erased and he was transformed into a killing machine. The torture of his memories pushed him to permanently destroy the laboratory and set out in search of the past. ===Knowledge=== Deep in the northern mountains of the Riverlands of Cadia lies a quiet and peaceful village. This village is home to the legendary Tianyin Swordmaster sect and is also where Duan Meng spent his childhood perfecting his technique.

As soon as he was old enough to pick up a bamboo sword, Duan Meng was determined to become a great sword master. While everyone was still sleeping, he would already be training hard and would continue until the sun set and the moon was clear and bright.

He knew that the requirements for entering the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect were high, and so, after countless days and nights of training in wind, rain, and snow, the gates of the holy temple finally opened to Duan Meng. Soon, his extraordinary talent and obsession with swordsmanship attracted the attention of the leader, Master Longma, who was once a disciple of the Great Dragon and the spiritual leader of the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect. Under the guidance of Master Longma, Duan Meng soon excelled among his peers and became the leader of the new generation of students.

Over time, Duan Meng grew tired of the stoic life of personal cultivation in the mountains. His obsession with swordsmanship and his innate ambition made him eager to challenge stronger foes so that he could create his own legend and spread it across the world like the legendary swordsmen who inspired his personal journey. However, Master Longma refused his request to go down the mountain.

"It is not yet time. You have not yet become a truly invincible swordsman." The young and lively Duan Meng refused to agree with his master's point of view. He had enough confidence in his own abilities and hoped to improve his swordsmanship through constant combat alone.

Over the next few years, Duan Meng traveled throughout the Riverlands of Cadia, defeating one swordsman after another, including the adherents of the Dragon Altar. He continued to climb towards the title of “Best Swordsman” without a single defeat.

That was until Duan Meng met a man who would become his ultimate rival, Zhixu. This man came from nowhere and had no teacher. His life was like that of a sword, perfectly formed and complete in itself.

In their battle, Duan Meng was defeated, completely unable to fight back. In order to one day defeat Zhixu, Duan Meng isolated himself in the mountains and embarked on a painstaking training program for three long years.

At the end of these three years, Duan Meng felt ready to fight Zhixu again and came out of the mountains. But as fate would have it, his opponent made even greater progress during these three years. He was defeated again and his sword was even cut in two by his opponent.

Duan Meng's repeated failures reminded him of his master's words: "It is not yet time. You have not yet become a truly invincible swordsman." However, Duan Meng knew that he had already done everything he could and there was no way the sword in his hand could become any faster or stronger.

In order to seek a truly invincible style of swordsmanship, Duan Meng left the confines of the Riverlands of Cadia and traveled across the Land of Dawn. During his travels, he heard rumors about Lab 1718, that they could boost the human body's potential through artificial transformation, granting additional power. Duan Meng couldn't help but inquire further. If this rumor was true, he might still have a chance to reach the pinnacle of swordsmanship. As long as he could get stronger, he was ready for anything.

At that time, the evil scientists from Laboratory 1718 were also interested in this swordsman from the East. They were preparing a new augmentation project to create a human weapon. As soon as the two sides reached an agreement, an unprecedented transformation began.

After numerous experiments and operations, the project finally came to fruition and a being with mechanical strength, human sword skills, and sentience was born. But after waking up, Duan Meng had forgotten everything about himself, including his own name. His creator then gives him a new code name: Saber. A sword from the 1718 Laboratory, the Saber became a tool used to hunt down those who stood against them.

Of course, this was all part of Lab 1718's plan. They intended to attract the right person to help them carry out their human weapons plan. Once the transformation was completed, Duan Meng, who once dreamed of reaching the pinnacle of swordsmanship, no longer existed. Instead, the merciless mechanical killer, Saber, was born.

Even though her creators were convinced that they had achieved great success, over time, the familiar movements, the feeling of holding her sword in her hands, kill after kill, day after day, something began to stir within Saber. As a warrior, he could not accept being reduced to the status of a mere killing machine, and could feel the memories buried deep within his mind fighting to be remembered again. He begins to question his own past and the meaning of his existence.

Late that night, tormented by fragments of his memories, Saber severed the neural control implant in his head, destroyed the humanoid weapons project laboratory, and embarked on the long, lonely path to exile.

In the years that followed, Laboratoire 1718 never gave up its quest for what it considered to be a failed product. Through the constant fighting and wandering that followed, Saber was determined to rediscover his name and origin. The fragments of his memory constantly bubbled to the surface, guiding him towards the slow discovery of his past. There was one thing he was certain of: he knew that he had not yet become a truly invincible swordsman and that he still had a destined opponent waiting for his next challenge.
anecdotes: In the first version of the game, there was a quote that Saber's favorite sport was baseball.
His "Force Warrior" skin is the first Starlight membership skin. Additionally, his “Iron Hound” skin is the first skin in the revamped Starlight membership.
He is equipped with two swords with Fanny, Lapu-Lapu, Karina and Martis.
In the first version, he wears a helmet with the letter H which represents Professor Henry.
His skin “Codename Storm” is the first Legend skin.
He is the first Assassin in the game.
In old lore, Saber and Alpha were like brothers who escaped from the lab with Beta, who was killed.

selena.accroche: Dark elf girl fallen into the Abyss.
lore: To the south of the Moniyan Empire lies a bottomless chasm, carved into this barren landscape as if an ancient demon used the sharpest blades to carve a disfiguring scar into the Land of Dawn. People call this the Shadow Abyss.
Locked at the bottom of this legendary abyss is the most terrible demon in the Land of Dawn: the Dominator of the Abyss. But as the seal slowly fades, the will of the abyss gradually strengthens.

The demons at the bottom of the abyss continually hatch plots to strengthen the power of darkness, persuading misguided believers to offer them sacrifices for their evil cause. They use these sacrifices to feed the "Devil of the Abyss", a monster formed of the purest dark energy that waits in the darkness to devour its prey.

Selena, a young Dark Elf, was sacrificed to the Shadow Abyss by fanatics in exchange for dark energy, and as Elves are the Devil of the Abyss' favorite sacrifice, Selena was immediately offered by the demons. The Abyss Devil thrust maniacally into Selena, intense pain and despair spreading to every corner of the young Elf's body. Just as she was about to be consumed by the dark magic, a miracle happened: a warm blue light enveloped the girl, and the dark abyssal magic and this mystical power began to wage a savage battle inside her fragile young body.

Selena awoke to find herself lying in the depths of the abyss, her skin now a mysterious blue tone and her lavender eyes filled with a scarlet glow, with the Devil of the Abyss lying quietly beside her.

The Abyss Demons were busy wondering what had just happened. They didn't know that the will of the Abyss had arrived. This girl is deeply loved and that love has protected her from darkness. The Abyss and the Moon Goddess – these two opposing forces have achieved balance within his body. An ancient and heavy voice echoed in the demons' minds: "Leave these girls to me." She will become the most powerful warrior in the Shadow Abyss! The demons obeyed the orders of the abyss and left her there. When Selena reappeared before the demonic inhabitants of the Abyss, with the Devil of the Abyss at her side, she had completely forgotten her past.

She discovered that she could skillfully manipulate the abyss to release dark magic, a demon capable of tearing her enemies to shreds. The will of Shadow Abyss designated her as its voice, making it her duty to rule over the demonic inhabitants. Even the proud Queen of Blood Magic began to feel disconcerted upon seeing this young Dark Elf, not only because the abyss had chosen her, but also because Alice could sense the terrible power that lay inside this seemingly cute and mischievous young girl.
anecdotes: With the exception of her base skin "Wasp Queen", all of Selena's skins were initially released for a limited time.

The name Selena comes from the Greek name "Selene" (Σελήνη) or Selina, meaning "moon" or "moon goddess". In Greek mythology, Selene was the Titan goddess of the moon, often depicted riding a chariot across the night sky.
Selena was one of the first MLBB heroes to have two distinct skill sets in one hero. Her switching mechanics make her both an assassin and a mage, depending on the form.
According to lore, Selena ignores and breaks the rules of time, meaning that even if time is stopped, backwards or forwards, she can do the exact opposite of any of the three that happens.

Selena was supposed to release on Chang'e's release date, but the developers decided to delay her release until a month later (after Kaja) because some of them saw her as overpowered and others saw her as underpowered.
Her Abyssal Arrow (2nd skill in Elven form) can stun enemies for up to 2.5 seconds, making it one of the longest stuns in the game!

During his time on the Advanced Server before release, his second Elven Form skill, name = Abyssal Arrow, lasted up to 4 seconds, which was later reduced to 3 seconds due to it being an overwhelming CC for a single skill.
Selena's Abyssal skin "Lady Vengeance" pays a wicked homage to Kerrigan from Starcraft.

Selena's Zenith skin "Curse of Cinder" is a reference to Ashes. In Selena Zenith's story, her half-sisters call her Little Ash. The name "Cinder" is also a shortened form of "Cinderella", from the classic fairy tale. Additionally, her outfit, theme, and skin story are inspired by it, while Vexana's Zenith skin is inspired by Snow White.
She and her older sister, Karina, share their Japanese voice actor, Nokubi Naoko.

The voice actress of her S. T. U. N. skin in the 2021 515 Together music video, Kim Eun Jae, is known for providing vocals for Rumi from Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters. Coincidentally, both characters belong to the same species as half-demons.

silvanna.accroche: Princess of the Moniyan Empire and Queen Regent.
lore: The prince had disappeared and no one knew if he was dead or alive! For the sake of the country and the safety of its people, King Aurelius II had decreed to expand the Order of Imperial Knights and establish fortresses on the outskirts of Moniyan, to strengthen the defense of the empire. Meanwhile, the Imperial Knights continued their search for clues to the prince's whereabouts. The Imperial Knight is sought after day after night. They had almost crossed the entire Land of Dawn, but all they found was an interminable wait. The Aurelius royal family was drowning in sorrow. For young Silvanna, the tragic memory of this time was too heavy. As a princess, Silvanna has always had a heart of justice and compassion since she was little. After her brother's disappearance, she kept the queen company almost daily. For years, they had both been waiting for a miracle to happen in the Imperial Castle. However, in the meantime, day after day, and year after year later, the queen eventually became ill and bedridden due to physical and mental exhaustion.

Ten years had passed after this tragic event. As the Queen and King grew older, Princess Silvanna, now a remarkable adult, always wanted to do something for her empire. She wanted to let go of the grief, but every time she thought of her brother, the sadness and frustration always came back to her. Every night in her dream, Silvanna felt like her brother was within her reach, but she just couldn't hold him. Shortly after, on the day of Silvanna's coming-of-age ceremony, she decided to ignore her princess status and join the Imperial Knights. Maybe this was the only way she could cope with the pain! In the Order of Knights, Silvanna would have to undergo intensive training. She would no longer be treated like a royal. Silvanna had strong faith and worked harder than others. Her faith had made her more and more powerful. All the scars on his body were the best proof of his training journey. In a short time, she had become the most powerful female knight among the Imperial Knights. But even then, Silvanna still couldn't get Tigreal's special approval. Tigreal knew the cruelty of the true battlefield and knew there was no room for error. Deep down, Tigreal saw that Silvanna had already acquired all the skills of a knight. He could also see Silvanna's determination. But after all, she was a royal of the empire. Tigreal did not want another successor to the empire to be at any risk again.

But one day, suddenly, the army of Demons arrived at the gates of the empire... Moniyan was faced with disaster and war. Tigreal ordered Silvanna to remain in the empire while he leads the entire Order of Knights into battle.

Halfway there, Tigreal received a report from the Order of Knights that, to prove herself, Silvanna had crossed the forbidden zone, the Imperial Sanctuary, where countless unknown creatures lurk. Even Tigreal himself didn't have the confidence to escape unscathed. At this moment, a sharp cry came from afar, making Tigreal shudder. He immediately takes the elites of the Order of Knights back to the Imperial Sanctuary while the rest of the knights march towards the outskirts of the empire to fight the demons. On the way, he prayed that he would be able to arrive in time. He prayed that his fear would not come true.

In front of the gods of the Imperial Sanctuary, a giant figure slowly approached the injured knight. The Seed of Light was shining in the distance and its powerful opponent was approaching. In the Imperial Archives, Silvanna once read a legend about the Seed of Light in the Imperial Sanctuary. But the powerful creature that keeps the Seed of Light before her became an obstacle she could not overcome. But Silvanna knew that only when she was protected by the Lord of Light could she truly become the Holy Knight and lead the empire to victory in battle. And for this reason, she was ready to sacrifice her life...

But that was not necessary, Silvanna's determination impressed the God of Light and he passed on some of his magical powers to Silvanna. With this power in hand, she overtook the Guard and put an end to the chaotic army. Once the battle was won and peace returned, Silvanna's courage earned her great fame.
With power, courage and royalty in her blood, she became the princess of the Moniyan Empire and perhaps… also its protector.
anecdotes: The name Silvanna is a variation of the feminine Silvana or Sylvana, meaning “she who lives in the forest” in Latin.
Alternatively, Silvana is also an Italian female given name as the female counterpart of Silvano, which is an Italian male given name.
Silvanna is the only hero capable of inflicting Restrain status.
Silvanna is the first hero to have a skin based on a player's credit score.
Early in her development, Silvanna was supposed to be a tank destroyer mix, but the developers decided to focus more on her magical fighter identity.
Silvanna's armor and spear resemble medieval European knights, blending holy warrior aesthetics with magical power. Its design is inspired by the culture of medieval knights.

His in-game quotes "Moniyan warriors, show your teeth" is an idiomatic expression meaning show your strength or willingness to fight. (like an animal showing its teeth). The phrase is British English usually used in Europe, as the Moniyan Empire is based in Europe.
The fact that the ruling dynasty has never changed shows us its relationship with Odette and Vexana.
Silvanna shares her Japanese voice actor, Takada Sakie, with fellow heroes Moniyan, Carmilla and Lesley.
