sora.accroche: A pure, free-spirited boy with unwavering determination, drifting across the golden sands.
lore: A pure, free-spirited boy with unwavering determination, drifting across the golden sands. Amid the windswept sands of Agelta's barren lands, a boy named Sora drifts as freely as flowing clouds. Pure and free-spirited, he brandishes his fists surrounded by ever-changing clouds, sometimes like thunderclouds crackling with fierce lightning, other times accumulating in thick cumulus clouds to protect him from the fury of the desert. Adventure calls to Sora like a seductive song, drawing him deep into the unexplored ruins of the desert where he seeks mysterious wonders. Yet the people know that when droughts threaten and despair sets in, he will ride the winds, bringing the precious rains their parched lands need. Sora now continues his journey along the ancient Emerald Road, carrying rain-bearing clouds to every corner of the desert and bringing hope to every desperate tribe.
=== A Cloudseeker's Song === Ninety-nine oases crossed, ninety-nine sandstorms weathered.
Deep within the ancient ruins, where thunder calls, mystical clouds gather.
Mystical clouds, oh mystical clouds, grant me your life-giving rain, protect me from the swirling sands and wake the sleeping earth...
—The Traveler's Camel Bell, A Cloud Seeker's Song

Centuries ago, a struggle born of greed triggered a catastrophic explosion of a fragment of the Twilight Orb in the heart of Agelta, wiping out many ancient cities and reducing the once magnificent Emerald Road to ruins. Since this cataclysm, Agelta has become known as the Agelta Drylands, consumed by the relentless sands, its former glory fading into the endless burning expanse. Yet there are still young souls moved by this ancient song of the cloud seeker, who dare to chase the clouds across the dunes with unwavering determination. Just like Sora, who first heard the cloud seeker's song during a devastating drought.
"Elder! I will definitely find the mystical clouds! And bring life back to this desert!"

Sora declared his intention with ardent conviction, but the tribal elder just shook his head with a weary, knowing smile – adults, after all, should never risk their lives on meaningless legends. But Sora did not let himself be influenced, his voice resonated in every corner of his tribe. When the moon reached the top of the dunes, other young hearts kindled by her determination gathered in the shadows. They carried their travel bags and set off together into the vast unknown, chasing the dreams of the mystical boxes.

At first, the adventure seemed full of wonder and possibility. But with only endless seas of sand stretching out before them, their true ordeal began. As their wineskins dried under the merciless sun, hope withered like flowers in the burning desert. "I can feel it in the air: the mystical clouds are resting not far from here. Just a little further!" Sora showed an expression of contentment. The others closed their eyes and sniffed the air. They also began to feel this crisp mist sensation in the air. This quickly lifted their weary souls, and they continued on their way, crossing the dunes to… an oasis! Was it just a coincidence, or had their collective hope sparked a miracle?

But their quest was far from over, and after this blessed respite came another round of howling sandstorms. When the strongest storm hit, they lost all direction, cowering against the rocks, clutching their precious packs in their arms. But amid the howling winds, Sora gathered their cloaks piece by precious piece and weaved them into an ingeniously designed tent, as if conjuring his own cloud against the fury of the sandstorm. Outside their tent, the wind and sand raged with ancient fury; inside, Sora imagined a future full of hope: they would find the mystical clouds, the elders would welcome them home with unspeakable pride, and their tribe would blossom with life again... As the light in Sora's eyes shone brighter than the desert sun, his once-shaken companions found comfort.

After crossing ninety-nine oases and withstanding ninety-nine sandstorms, the mystical clouds still eluded them. Even as Sora's faith burned intact, his companions' resolve crumbled one by one until he could no longer hold them back. They finally reached the heart of the desert, where no mystical clouds awaited them, only ruins swallowed up by endless sand. Worse still, a colossal sandstorm that devoured the skin fell upon them, threatening to bury them along with every trace of their desperate journey.
"It's over. There are no mystical clouds."
“This whole trip was a wild ride!”
"Sora, how long are you going to keep lying to yourself!"

As his companions collapsed in despair and anguish, Sora fixed his gaze on the approaching storm, and from his eye came a sound: the faint but unmistakable rumble of thunder. "Hey, remember the end of the song? 'In the heart of ancient ruins, where thunder calls, mystical clouds gather'. We're almost there!"
Sora turned to his broken companions:
“I will carry all our hopes to the end!”
Without hesitation, he jumped into the maw of the storm.

The fury of the storm grabbed Sora and pulled him inward, but instead of being torn apart, he found himself floating in a strange place. Here he saw puffs of clouds and streaks of sand that took the shapes of the young adventurers who had traveled here in search of the mystical clouds.
Sora suddenly heard their voices echo:
“I swore to my friends that I would find the mystical clouds!”
“I will no longer let Agelta be a wasteland of despair!”
“Our tribe will flourish again with life!”

Following the echoes, Sora saw a strange radiance pulsing in the center of space – a fragment of the Twilight Orb whose explosion had once fractured the Agelta Wastelands, its lingering energy still coursing through that sacred space. This energy possessed the miraculous capacity to transmute the abstract into reality; the unfulfilled dreams of all those adventurers seeking power had been touched by its influence, crystallizing in the monuments that surrounded it. An immense surge of determination filled Sora's heart as he reached out for the power core: if this could truly give form to their hopes, then let it resonate with him...with everyone who had ever sought the clouds in this desert!

In an instant, the clouds and illusions dissipated, flowing toward Sora's outstretched hands – evaporating, expanding, soaring into the sky, condensing into living clouds. Thunder cracked like the awakening of the world as Sora emerged from the eye of the storm, transformed into a mystical cloud like in the legends. His took the form of swelling cumulus clouds to protect against the fury of the sandstorm, then storm clouds to shatter the ancient debris with lightning - until finally, the chaos became silent.

When the storm cleared, the skies opened. The long-awaited rain fell in torrents, and his companions finally understood the true meaning of the Cloudseeker's Song: he who seeks the mystical cloud must, through unwavering determination, become the cloud itself.

Now, Sora carries clouds in his palms that will never fade, as eternal as the determination in his heart. He travels the vast golden sands of Agelta with Belerick and Floryn, breathing new life into a parched land. When new adventurers passed by singing this ancient song, the cloud that guided them stopped to join their chorus.
"Ninety-nine oases crossed, ninety-nine sandstorms resisted..."
anecdotes: The name Sora is derived from the Japanese word "空 (sora)", meaning "sky", "heavens" or "empty space". For this reason, the name is often associated with feelings of freedom, openness, hope and serenity.

When Sora was first leaked, he was called Cirrus. In meteorology, cirrus clouds are delicate, wispy white clouds that form at high altitudes, usually above 20,000 feet. Due to their altitude, they are composed entirely of ice crystals. This feature also aligns well with Sora's cloud-based appearance.
Some social media posts indicate that Sora and Floryn are lovers, although these images were considered edits and are confirmed to be fake.
Sora is the first hero to have 2 different Ultimates by swiping left to Thunder Form and right to Torrent Form.

sun.accroche: The immortal Monkey King, resolute and inflexible like the mountain that carried him.
lore: The immortal Monkey King, resolute and inflexible like the mountain that carried him. Sun, the immortal mountain spirit born from a magical stone, wandered freely between heaven and earth until one day the cries of a group of pandas caught his attention. It was from them that he learned of the existence of death. Although confused by this sudden revelation, the pandas mistook him for the mountain deity. In particular, a little panda named Li Li fell in love with Sun and devoted his days to picking peaches for the Monkey King. But when a flash flood hit the panda village one day, Li Li was lost in the torrents while searching for peaches. Sun arrived too late, and despite the pleas of the other pandas, he was unable to bring his friend back from the dead. It was then that Sun suffered a loss for the first time. Unable to understand his grief, he fell into a deep sleep. Millennia have passed, and many more would have passed if Sun had not been awakened by a battle between dragons. After slaying the Black Dragon and unknowingly saving the Riverlands of Cadia, he questioned the Silver Dragon about immortality and finding his purpose. Instead of the answer he sought, the dragon gave him the name Sun and the task of being the guardian of the earth. But what does this imply? Sun was once again lost in thought... ===An immortal existence=== Before the cataclysmic upheaval awakened him, he had been asleep for millennia.

Deep in a long dream, he contemplated majestic waterfalls in all their splendor and hills adorned with flowery fauna. A little panda emerged from the green woods and called out to him. In the end, all these visions converged on a single butterfly, emerging from the confines of its sleeping reverie.

He has awakened now, a being born from the spiritual energy of the mountain, formed within the rocks and forged over millennia. His domain spanned the limitless expanse of creation, heaven and earth submitting to his whim, and his alone. But at the height of his celebrations, he finally discerned a deep and unknown emotion seeping into his existence. Perched on a solitary branch, he gazed for centuries at full moon nights, perplexed by the barely perceptible melancholy that threaded its way deep into his heart like a delicate thread.

"Great Monkey King! Look what I brought! I climbed to the highest peak and picked the plumpest peaches!" He looked at the bustling scene under the tree, and memories of that small figure, a little panda named Li Li, stirred within him. In the eternity of his existence, this moment marked a brief but significant interlude.

At that time, he roamed freely among the sprawling mountains between heaven and earth. The mysteries of its origin and final destination eluded him, but an unprecedented feeling of freedom enveloped him. It was only when a mournful wail fell on his ears that he was drawn to the black and white creatures, who were crying because of what they called "death." What was this “death”? Intrigued by this mysterious entity, he cast a single fleeting glance, and thus unknowingly became entangled in their story. In the story presented to him, the very essence of the mountain spirit had frozen into a stone, forming an immortal being, none other than himself, the great Monkey King.

At first, he brushed aside the disturbances and moved to another mountain peak, where he continued to rise early in the morning, drenched in dew, reveling in the isolation of the mountains. However, a small creature deep in the forest cried incessantly, invoking the Monkey King's name with persistent cries that echoed through the canopy, disturbing its peaceful solitude. Annoyed, but curious, he parted the thick veil of the forest and fell on the source of the tumult: his little limbs were damaged and worn out by incessant work. At that moment, their gazes intertwined and a radiant glow flickered in the creature's eyes.

Saving the creature and its kin from the raging torrent was enough of an afterthought. These creatures were marked by intractable stubbornness. Well aware of the merciless power of river floods during the rainy season, they nevertheless clung tenaciously to their meager homeland. The Monkey King had lived eons and developed miraculous abilities akin to godhood. Among his many skills was complete mastery of river diversion and the construction of shrines on rocking slopes. He passed on these skills not out of charity but solely out of a desire for peace and tranquility.

Yet a panda had a tenacity that exasperated the Monkey King. Day after day, he clumsily crossed the hills and valleys just to present to the Monkey King what he considered to be the finest peaches. It was an unwavering devotion that the Monkey King could not avoid.

Despite the Monkey King's initial irritation, as the days turned into seasons, he grew accustomed to the daily ritual of eating a perfectly ordinary peach, as well as the presence of the panda who had introduced himself as Li Li. The Monkey King even began to slightly enjoy their mundane conversations. Mortals possessed a primordial penchant for naming everything, and Li Li was no exception. He chattered endlessly, insisting that the Monkey King had a name. The pandas even named their village Spirit Creek. Invariably, Li Li always asked him the same question.
“Did you come up with a name today?”
"No, I don't need such things."
"I know you're the great immortal Monkey King, but that's not your name, is it? Everything in this world still needs a name."

It was really very upsetting. The Monkey King moved to a higher mountain and, as expected, the mornings became peaceful again. However, a particular desire began to awaken within him. He found himself drawn back from the once disruptive hustle and bustle, eagerly awaiting the arrival of this little panda who would defy all odds to cross the mountain forests. As the days passed in silence, his desire only intensified. He was suddenly seized with the urge to seek out Li Li and ask her why everything in the world had to have a name. It had become a maddening distress that had taken root within him.

However, as he came down from the mountain, he heard those pitiful groans again. But this time, it was Li Li who had succumbed to what the pandas lamented as death. Three days earlier, rain had caused another flood. The fierce roar of the currents could not reach the most distant peaks, and when the river carried Li Li away, he still clung to a peach. In his final moments, he reassured his friends, unwavering in his belief, that the Monkey King would surely come to his aid, for there was nothing the Monkey King could not do.

"You must be able to save Li Li, right? He believed in you! Please use your divine powers! We implore you, great Monkey King, please save him!" The Monkey King was frightened by his helplessness. What was life? What was death? How could he save Li Li when he couldn't even understand these concepts? Question after question swirled through his mind like a storm.
"I can't save him. I can't save anyone! I'm not a god, I'm... I'm..."
Who was he? He didn't even have a name.
" Leave me alone ! »
He ran forward, his mind consumed by the idea of ​​the permanence of death.
He fled to the north. But where was he going? Where do we go after death?
Then a revelation struck him like a bolt of lightning: the path north pointed to the very mountain of his birth. Did death mean he would never see Li Li venturing across the hills and rivers again?
One's birthplace, one's home held the power to console even the most broken souls... At least that's what he heard the pandas say one day.

He finally arrived at the place of his birth, where the broken stones from which he was born still stood atop the peak. He gathered them in a tight embrace, and in that moment, those cold, lifeless stones seemed to vibrate with palpable heat. He allowed himself to fall asleep and slept there for millennia, until the world convulsed and roared, waking him once more.

His consciousness plunged back into the upheaval that had awakened him. It turned out to be a black dragon, covered in blood and relentlessly crashing into a barrier that had inexplicably formed around it.
“Where did this annoying fly come from?”

He defeated the dragon only to see the arrival of another, identical in appearance but silver instead of black. However, this one wasn't there to fight. The silver dragon began to explain what had happened while the Monkey King slept and how the land had changed greatly over the ages. Crowds of refugees had fled the ravages of war and sought refuge here. The silver dragon seemed to be a guardian responsible for their safety. However, a schism had torn him and his brothers apart. For the sake of these mortals, the silver dragon had no choice but to suppress his own kin, a painful duty that had inadvertently caused a cataclysmic vortex in the northern sea. In light of this calamity, the silver dragon had decided to calm the storm with its own body.

The Monkey King, who was now fully awake, listened half-heartedly while gathering his own thoughts. What was the meaning of existence for an immortal like him? He still hadn't found the answer in all his sleep. But before him stood the silver dragon, apparently sharing the same fate.

Perhaps this creature could reveal the answers to the questions that had eluded it. "Since I helped you, answer this question for me. You're an immortal, aren't you? Do you ever get bored of just... existing?"

The dragon laughs. It had been ages since anyone had asked such a question, and never so bluntly. The last one to inquire... well, that's a story for another day. The story now focused on the stone monkey.

"Fate weaves its tapestry for all living beings, guided by the hand of fate. Yet you and I, unbound by life or death, are exempt from their mortal suffering. Thus, it is our sacred duty to protect the world, the cycle of life, and the fleeting moments between them. Stay vigilant here, and when the time is right, I will reveal to you the truth you seek."
"Wait, who are you? How do you know all this?"

The dragon had already disappeared into the waves, leaving behind ripples that spiraled into the vortex. "Allow me to grant you a name," an echoing voice sounded, "One that embraces the cosmos of existence. As guardian of this realm, your name will embrace all. You will be known as 'Sun'." As the sea began to calm down after the dragon descended, Sun's heart also regained a sense of serenity. But then he realized...

"What kind of answer was that? That's complete nonsense! I was just tricked into standing guard here. Well, I have a name now, but how is it written? All that about the cosmos and such... it's gibberish to me."

After muttering for a while, Sun settled back down on the same rock. This time he looked up at the sky, as if hearing a familiar voice. How he longed to see Li Li again so he could finally tell her his name.
anecdotes: The classic inspiration for the character is Sun Wukong from the 16th century Chinese novel: Journey to the West. His staff and ability to summon clones are direct references to the mythological figure.
Its name comes from a Chinese word meaning “grandchild or descendant.”

The old version of Sun was able to summon three clones, one of his name = Simian God and two of his name = Clone Techniques, but the reworked version can only summon two clones, one of his name = Endless Variety and one of his name = Clone Techniques.
When Sun's clones are defeated, they swing their staff and disappear.
Its internal name is Wukong.
His “Rock Star” skin is a visible nod to Elvis Presley.
Wicked Flames' English voice actor Jimmie Yamaguchi also provides Zilong's current voice.

suyou.accroche: An exorcist from Zhu'an who inherited the power of Immortal Nuo.
lore: Thundering drums and gongs, blazing lights. Suyou was lying quietly on the edge of a tall building with his hands behind his head. His lips stretched into a smile as he observed Zhu'an's bustle at night. A prosperous city reflected in his eyes. Under the eaves, laughter could be heard as children wearing traditional Nuo masks ran past. “Immortal Nuo, bless the land, Immortal Nuo, our most auspicious guardian! Little did the carefree children know that right above them, Suyou, the last successor of the Exorcists of Nuo, was listening, with the sacred mask and blade of Nuo, looking down with a smile. Suyou jumped to her feet like a spring and enjoyed a long stretch. He had just woken up from a dream about the past. Over ten years ago, the sky darkened and the wind howled while moans could be heard from all directions. The lingering obsessions and evil thoughts of the dead had gathered in this place, creating a phenomenon known as the Echo of Wickedness and threatening to consume the entire village. A young Suyou could only cower in fear among the rubble and wait helplessly for death to claim him. Suddenly, a massive figure broke through the clouds with a trident in hand. His fierce stature stood between the village and the echoes of wickedness like an angry mountain. The next moment, an agile figure wielding a holy blade rushed in front of Suyou, towards the evil scourge. He was an exorcist from Nuo. With a single blow, he split the sky. With another, he swept away the scourge like freshly fallen dust. There was no need for a third. That day, the fearsome power of Immortal Nuo was deeply engraved in a boy's heart. Inspired by the miracle he had witnessed, Suyou decided to travel the country, helping people in any way he could, as its savior.

Ten years passed and Suyou found himself following trails to a small town near Zhu'an in the Cadia Riverlands. The city was shrouded in echoes so thick you wondered how anything could survive in such a place. But the townspeople lived happily, unaware of the danger in which they found themselves. Strange phenomena were forming due to the concentration of echoes, only for the townspeople to look away without a care in the world. Suyou quickly found the reason. An old exorcist lived in the town and maintained a kind of fragile balance. The same one who had saved him all those years ago. Even as the echoes were about to devour the town, the old exorcist continued to lie and reassure the townspeople that everything was fine. Young Suyou didn't understand how his hero could have fallen into such a state. Suyou firmly believed that deceiving these people could only lead to disaster. Why was the old exorcist playing with their lives? The slightest misstep would surely doom them all. Suyou was forced to conclude that the exorcist was a fraud, so he set out to warn the town of the danger they were in. However, this caused complete panic and only accelerated the growth of echoes. It was only then that Suyou realized that the world was not filled with valiant heroes, but with ordinary people with their countless worries and fears. And the oversaturation of negative emotions is what creates the echoes of unkindness. After learning of the impending disaster, their fear would only fuel the echoes until they devoured everything. For the townspeople, their faith and hope were the silver lining that protected them in this dire situation. Nuo's power comes not from the heavens, but from the strength of human faith. The old exorcist has always struggled with fear and uncertainty in people's hearts. But the human heart easily wanders and gets lost without direction. Those guiding them were the Exorcists of Nuo, using faith to manifest Immortal Nuo. To repair his mistake, Suyou helped the old exorcist prepare the Nuo ritual. The exorcist had spent most of his life fighting the Echoes, and the countless injuries he had suffered in these battles left him unable to perform the ritual any longer. As luck would have it, he passed the sacred Nuo mask and blade to young Suyou to continue in his place. Suyou put on the mask and held the blade tightly. For the first time, Suyou took the stage as Nuo's exorcist: he performed the ritual dance and sang the ancient songs to summon the Immortal Nuo.

The sky suddenly darkened, as if Suyou had returned to the past. Unaware of the impending catastrophe, the masses looked at Suyou with fear and expectation. Only then could Suyou understand...What is Nuo? Nuo is faith. People's hearts are like candle flames, swaying in the direction the wind blows. And at that time, as Nuo's exorcist, Suyou was that wind. When people see your resolution, they will believe. When people see your smile, they will rejoice. When people see your fear, they will cower. And when people see your hesitation, they will doubt. Their faith comes from you, and the faith you evoke from them is the power of Nuo! As night fell, the faith of the townspeople under the stage became like flames and illuminated Suyou's performance. Immortal Nuo once said: “Do not fear evil. People chanted “Immortal Nuo will protect us from harm! » over and over again in their hearts. Thus, Immortal Nuo gained the power to dispel evil. Immortal Nuo said: “Do not fear disaster. People chanted “Immortal Nuo will save us from disaster!” again and again in their hearts. Thus, Immortal Nuo gained the power to avert disaster. Little by little, something emerged from the people. He gathered around the Nuo mask, the holy blade, and the statue of Immortal Nuo. The hopes of the people, the power of the human heart, and the sparks of their faith came together and manifested in the three-headed, six-armed Immortal Nuo. Nuo is faith, and Immortal Nuo is the resulting miracle. The sparks of their faith, gathered to give shape to the body. The thoughts of the people, sharp as an edge to cut through despair.

Suyou wielded the sacred blade and guided the people. He summoned Immortal Nuo and cut off the echoes of malice. He split the sky, just like his predecessor. He saw the faith of the people and heard their prayers. At this very moment, he had understood the true meaning of being a Nuo exorcist. Suyou carried the power of immortal deity in his body to guide people to enlightenment. It was his duty. After passing on the sacred relics and knowledge of the ritual to Suyou, the old exorcist left without a trace. The world still assumes that those who shoulder great responsibilities must bear heavy burdens and undergo trials. But Suyou was free, wandering from place to place, enjoying the sights and sounds. Sometimes he would perform the Nuo ritual to reaffirm people's faith, and other times he would draw his sacred blade to reduce evil manifestations. He has seen what the power of faith and the human heart are capable of, and he returns it in kind. His love for the world and his faith in others allow him to protect every glimmer of hope. Just like his name, Suyou, in the Cajun language... Exorcist of evil and wanderer in this world.
anecdotes: Suyou (肃游) is a Chinese name meaning "solemn" (肃) and "traveler" (游).
His concept “Nuo” is based on the Chinese folk religion of exorcism. Nuo means oath or chasing away evil spirits.
Its gaming sound effects are based on real samples.
His 3 weapons, the halberd, the double blades and the war bow, are hidden in the form of pieces of jade on his waist. He wears a different mask for a different weapon.
His 3 different masks can be seen in this intro and in the game when he uses his different grappling skills.
Technically, Suyou has 6 skills.
Suyou is the second hero to have a level 5 Ultimate skill, the first being Julian.

Although it has not been officially confirmed, Suyou is believed to be one of the heroes created through an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Lukas and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
Suyou is the first hero to have the throw and hold mechanic.
His favorite drink is tea.
In official promotional videos, Suyou is depicted as having a fondness for hot springs.

terizla.accroche: Once an eccentric master blacksmith, but now vengeful on the side of the Abyss.
lore: Once an eccentric master blacksmith, but now vengeful on the side of the Abyss. The once revered master craftsman was now known as the famous Executioner of the Abyss, but Terizla didn't care. Since the moment he had been labeled a heretic by the Church, he had only wielded his hammer in revenge, waiting for the day when he could finally soothe the troubled souls of those close to him. ===The Fallen Blacksmith=== As one of the most powerful institutions in the Land of Dawn, the inquisition of the Monastery of Light has garnered both extreme respect and absolute terror from its inhabitants. The mere thought of having to traverse its hallowed halls and enigmatic depths would make even the most fervent followers of the Light shudder involuntarily. For deep within this solemn place lay the Renaissance Gate, the dungeon housing the Church's deepest secret: a past so dark that it could leave even the bravest soul petrified with fear.

Ten years ago, deep within the dungeons of the Inquisition, a guard slowly opened an iron door to check on the imprisoned victim, only to find her completely abandoned. The dark, desolate cell was empty except for a bloody message that stained its unforgiving walls. Heavy with hatred, the vile words read:
Overthrow the faith... The light will perish...

Appalled, the guard stood in the deserted dungeons, in silence and pure horror. Very quickly, news of the escape spread, taking the entire Monastery of Light by storm: the heretic Terizla has escaped!
“Blacksmiths must respect freedom, maintain their know-how in their work and never be subject to the rules of the Church! This is what Terizla openly shouted during a large gathering of blacksmiths.

As leader of the Freesmiths' Guild and spiritual leader of the anti-Church alliance in Lumina City, Terizla has repeatedly ignored the Church's commandments while openly defending fellow smiths sanctioned by the Church. His blatant disregard for the monastery's teachings has earned him both the disfavor of the Church and the label of a "known heretic" in Lumina City.

In addition to his rebellious side, the principled Terizla was also known for his exceptional craftsmanship. He was a man of great competence, respected by his peers for his unrivaled rigor and precision. His meticulous eye did not allow the slightest error in the forge. Any apprentice who tried to cheat him with faulty work was severely punished. The frustrated apprentices often complained among themselves, but not a single one dared to voice their grievances against Terizla out loud.

Terizla's know-how and standards, as severe and demanding as they may be, have always given the best. creations from the forge. Due to their high quality, the works of the Free Blacksmiths Guild were valued throughout the Moniyan Empire and quickly gained popularity as soon as they hit the market. So, seething with jealousy over the guild's success, the competitors bribed Terizla's apprentices to send a secret message to the Church: the "heretic" Terizla had always designed his creations using dark magic!

Before her son's sixth birthday, Terizla spent days in her workshop just outside of town, preparing a special gift for her son: a finely detailed statue of their family. Terizla skillfully worked on the statue with so much care and attention that it took her until the very day of her son's birthday to finally complete it. Eager to surprise her young son with his gift, Terizla ran home excited. What awaited him, however, was the ambush of Raven assassins sent by the Church.
Realizing something was wrong, Terizla struggled to escape the siege, but was immediately pinned to the ground.
"My wife! My son!"

Amid Terizla's heartbreaking cries, the Knights of the Church and the Ravens stormed the fortress of the Freesmiths' Guild. Within minutes, the air was filled with echoes of screams and cries of anguish.
The Raven leader grabbed Terizla by the hair and forced him to watch the fortress burn to the ground. "See them burn. Hear them scream. This is what heretics deserve!"

The Ravens then brought Terizla back to the Monastery of Light. They threw him deep into the dungeons and chained his bloodied and beaten body with enchanted chains. Alone in his cell, Terizla carefully raised his tired head and looked at his iron handcuffs, only to discover the symbol of the Freesmiths' Guild carved deep within the links.

The iron wrought by his own hands now imprisoned their masterful creator. Struck by the irony of his situation, Terizla felt a burning hatred rise in his veins. In a fit of rage, Terizla lashed out, violently pulling on the chains, screaming in both anger and agony. He vowed to fight the Church to the death and make it pay for everything it had done. But despite all his efforts, he could not free himself from the force of his own creation.

Just as he was about to give up, Alice, the Demon Queen, entered the cell. "How pathetic to see your entire family wiped out by the Church. The Blood Demon lifted Terizla's chin with his long, sharp nail. Do you want revenge? I can help you..."
Terizla looked up as Alice leaned closer and whispered. "The only thing I ask in return? Join the Abyss. Unleash the horror of your legendary skill on all those who have wronged you."

As soon as he heard his cursed promise of vengeance, the flickering glow of the dungeon's solitary lamp roared in Terizla's impassive eyes and the master blacksmith was no more. Alice has successfully transformed the Abyss into a new artisan with an insatiable appetite for revenge.
As he walked away from Lumina City forever, the only thing Terizla took with him was the statue he had made before this horrible event.

In his condemned abysmal forge. Terizla crafted enchanted weapons for the demonic army in the Desolation, accompanied only by the faint illusion of his wife standing at his side. Over and over he tried to talk to her, telling her how much he wanted to touch her face again. And each time, Terizla encountered nothing but the rhythmic echo of his hammer hitting the anvil.

Over time, his hatred towards the Church and its faithful grew even stronger. Driven by unfathomable anguish and hatred, Terizla threw all followers of the Light captured by the Abyss into her furnace, using them as raw materials for her terrible enchanted creations.
Terrifying, talented and tormented, the once revered master blacksmith had transformed into the famous executioner of the Abyss.

Anyone unfortunate enough to find themselves in the cursed forge of Terizla would find the walls stained with the blood of its victims, representing a macabre fresco: a man with outstretched arms, protecting his family.
"One day, I will destroy the Church and Moniyan with my own hands..."
“I’m going to get revenge!”
===Anne===
anecdotes: In this latest patch note, he shared the role (Fighter/Tank) of Hilda, as both are equipped with an ax as their own weapon.
However, Skill 2 is different from Hilda due to the delay she needs to spam her skill.
Terizla does not gain any attack speed from items. He is one of three heroes to do so along with Kimmy and Marcel.
Execution Strike (second skill) can damage more than some mages' skills if all hits land.
Penalty Zone (Ultimate) was tested with different CC effects before the pull mechanics were finalized.
Terizla was one of the few physical combat heroes to use mana before it was eventually removed in a later update.

affiliations: Church of Light, Moniyan Empire, Necrokeep (hostile)
relations: Vexana, Faramis, Leomord (enemies as Necrokeep team)

thamuz.accroche: The lord of the Fire Demons who seeks to reignite the flames of the Abyss through war and violence.
lore: *In the Determination event, Thamuz claims himself as the Dark Lord and wants name=Lunox|image=Lunox to join him.

* Thamuz appears in the lore of name=Helcurt|image=Helcurt, in which when name=Helcurt|image=Helcurt was tasked with defending the Sovereign of the Abyss, name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia, the opposing forces marching towards her palace were led by none other than Lord Lava himself.
* In the Dyrroth trailer, Thamuz praises name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth, seeing a part of himself in the Demon Prince, mentioning that he "inherited his brutality and his valor".
*name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth also mentions Thamuz in one of his voice lines, mocking how his enemy should have been taught by Thamuz, praising his own technique.

* Thamuz is also half-heartedly mentioned in two of name=Helcurt|image=Helcurt's voice lines, describing him as a "walking puddle of lava with a pair of dull blades", while calling him out in a mocking tone. Their relationship could be attributed to that of father and pet. * Thamuz appears to show genuine empathy towards his species, depicting him as a strict but well-meaning leader, prioritizing the survival of his tribe above all else, as shown in multiple artworks posted to official accounts. * A figure that closely resembles Thamuz appears in the name=Nolan|image=Nolan cutscene, in which he talks about the origins of Light and Darkness and the Age of Strife. anecdotes: === Knowledge ===
During the Determination event, Thamuz claims himself as the Dark Lord and wishes name=Lunox|image=Lunox to join him.

Thamuz appears in the lore of name=Helcurt|image=Helcurt, in which when name=Helcurt|image=Helcurt was charged with defending the Sovereign of the Abyss, name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia, the opposing forces marching towards her palace were led by none other than Lord Lava himself.
In the Dyrroth trailer, Thamuz praises name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth, seeing a part of himself in the Demon Prince, mentioning that he "inherited his brutality and his valor".
name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth also mentions Thamuz in one of his voice lines, mocking how his enemy should have been taught by Thamuz instead, praising his own technique.

Thamuz is also half-heartedly mentioned in two of name=Helcurt|image=Helcurt's voice lines, describing him as a "walking puddle of lava with a pair of dull blades", while calling him out in a mocking tone. Their relationship could be attributed to that of father and pet.

Thamuz appears to show genuine empathy towards his species, portraying him as a strict but well-meaning leader, prioritizing the survival of his tribe above all else, as shown in multiple artworks posted to official accounts.

A figure that closely resembles Thamuz appears in the name=Nolan|image=Nolan cutscene, in which he talks about the origins of Light and Darkness and the Age of Strife. Considering that the events took place at an unknown time in the past, one could hypothesize that Thamuz has been fighting for the Abyss for longer than expected.
With the recent change in Thamuz lore mentioning an ancient Lava Lord, it could also be that this character is one of the ancient Lava Lords.

In Mobile Legends Adventure, Thamuz encountered name=Uranus|image=Uranus several times over an unspecified period of time. Every time name=Uranus|image=Uranus sees him, her hatred for him grows each time. === Fire Demon Biology ===

In the name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia concept video, Thamuz's race, the Fire Demons, do not appear to naturally grow their heads as they do in typical depictions of their species. This could suggest that Thamuz may have carved it himself to assert his dominance as the rightful Lord of Lava.
This is further reinforced by the entry in Chapter 1 of his Mastery Code, where Thamuz is described as having "forged his body from lava".
The molten cores found inside a Fire Demon's chest constitute its life force. As long as it exists, the Fire Demon cannot die.

Thamuz's scythes are extensions of his body, made entirely of crystallized shards from his own molten core. Thamuz scythes are made specifically from obsidian. === Belerick sacrificed himself! Who is responsible? ===
During the Abyss' invasion of the Moonlight Forest (in "Belerick Sacrificed Himself! Who's Responsible?"), Thamuz indirectly killed Belerick, as he sacrificed his life to defend the Tree of Life.
When name=Belerick|image=Belerick was revived, his skills were retooled to better counter opponents who continuously deal damage. One of these enemies is Thamuz.
It is unknown if name=Belerick|image=Belerick grew specifically to defend against him.
However, there are many real cases of plants evolving and adapting to specific threats. === The demons are approaching ===

In the official comic "Demons Approaching", Thamuz reveals that he is in possession of one of the "Nine Demon Lords of the Abyss", an orange crystal that Astaros recognizes as "Gamunti". However, due to the new tradition of name=Phoveus|image=Phoveus, it is unclear whether this remains canon or not. === The Abyss: Will of the Sovereign / Post-Rework ===

In the Sovereign's Will cutscene, Thamuz interrupts name=Alice|image=Alice and name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth from harvesting name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia's blood. Convinced that his corruption still lives in his blood, he expresses his frustration at name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia's past crimes against his people, corrupting them into the Spawns of Decay.
Shortly after, Thamuz encounters a hesitant corrupted Fire Demon before being forced to kill it, further fueling his rage.

Due to the Fire Demon's small size, it is possible that Thamuz was forced to kill a young member of his species, making this the second depiction of the death of a young, the first being Mila, in name=Arlott|image=Arlott's lore.

In the Season 38 seasonal storyline, name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia encounters a Fire Demon corrupted by the God of Darkness and on the verge of transforming into the Spawn of Decay, collapsing as he fears not only for himself, but also for his tribe members.
The fire demon, in his final moments, isolates himself from the rest of his people to protect them from diseases, in the name of Lord Thamuz. === Sea Nexus ===

The Annihilator is heavily based on H.P. Lovecraft and his works of cosmic horror, primarily from the Cthulhu Mythos, in which beings commonly known as "Outer Gods" (a term popularized by the heavily Lovecraft-inspired role-playing game "Call of Cthulhu") exist beyond human comprehension.

They are described to serve purposes far beyond mortal comprehension, and are known by many names (in Thamuz's case he is also known as "The Great Scourge"), very similar to the lore that accompanies the skin.
Additionally, a squid-shaped buckle adorned with wings can be seen on his model, strongly reminiscent of the more common depiction of Cthulhu (the titular Outer God).
Some vocal lines in The Annihilator directly reference Thamuz's original vocal lines.
“I am the will of the abyss.” / “I am the will of destruction, the end of all realities.”
“Everything will burn!” / “All will perish!”
“Annihilation awaits.” / “Annihilation awaits all who oppose me.”
“A new abyss, forged in the fires of hell.” / "Once I devour the lighthouses, I will create a new beacon."
=== Miscellaneous ===
The original Thamuz hero showcase video on the official YouTube channel has undergone an abrupt change in thumbnail design.
Thamuz had four different walking animations for his scytheless form throughout his development.
On the advanced server before its release, Thamuz was running on all fours without his scythes.
Upon release, he instead walked on his hind legs, leaning slightly inward, with his arms extended outward.

During his software overhaul in patch 1.6.84 on May 24, 2022, his posture was changed to be more upright and began jogging, closer to how a human person would run. However, this change would soon be reverted to the previous version with an unknown number of subsequent updates.
During his September 17, 2025 overhaul, he received a new scythe-free animation, similar to the one removed in patch 1.6.84.
Thamuz was the first hero introduced by the Abyss faction, preceding heroes like name=Alice|image=Alice, name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth, and name=Selena|image=Selena in the story.
His passive Grand Lord Lava was one of the first abilities in the game to consistently deal true damage based on enemies' HP.
Some players compare his look to Balrog from Lord of the Rings or Ifrit from Final Fantasy.
His weapons, the Molten Scythians, return to him of their own accord, similar to boomerangs.
After his rework, Thamuz now has different glow effects on his model during his ultimate, depending on his skin.
When Thamuz moves, a trail of lava forms behind him, showing his burning presence. He is one of the rare heroes whose footsteps leave elemental effects on the battlefield.
Unfortunately, this has since been removed after its redesign.
On December 18, 2025, Thamuz received a skin survey with a design very reminiscent of the Chaos Space Marine known in the Warhammer franchise.
Thamuz shares the same Japanese voice actor, Nakamura Taishi, with Franco and Grock.
Thamuz has alternate splash art for his Elite skin, Liquid Fire.

Thamuz's Starlight skin, Sanctified Flame, had an unexpected change in patch 1.8.08. Originally, his Starlight Skin's card design showed a tongue in his mouth, but has since been transformed into a hollow blue energy. The reason for this change is currently unknown.
Thamuz is one of the few characters with a chance-based passive. The other two are name=Belerick|image=Belerick, with his Deadly Thorns, and name=Faramis|image=Faramis, with Vicious Retrieval.

tigreal.accroche: Leader of the Order of Light, guardian of the Moniyan Empire.
lore: Tigreal was born into the noble Wertz family. Since the establishment of the Moniyan Empire, House Wertz has continually provided military talent to the empire and guarded Moniyan's imperial power and national security for generations. The Tigreal generation is no exception. His father Gareth is the Empire's Minister of Defense and the Emperor's right-hand man, while his uncle Eckert is in charge of the border guards stationed in the most dangerous area between the southern part of the Empire and the Land of Despair.

Although thousands of years have passed since the shocking changes that divided the empire, rumors and threats about the Abyss, heretics, and terrible creatures have never been far away. Since he was a child, Tigreal has received systematic military training in Lumina City, constantly learning various combat skills such as fighting, swordsmanship, and horse riding. The whole family had high hopes for him, hoping that one day he could take up the banner of his father's generation and become the most loyal and faithful guardian of Moniyan.

At the age of sixteen, Tigreal joined the Imperial Army with full dedication and was drafted into the ranks of the Garrison Army. During his four years in the Garrison Army, Tigreal led his troops to almost every part of Moniyan, further exercising Tigreal's command and leadership ability, earning him the favor of the Order of Light.

Subsequently, Tigreal joined the Knights of Light thanks to his exceptional military talent and leadership ability. In the Moniyan Empire, only the most loyal and courageous fighters who had undergone extensive training were eligible to be elected Knights of Light, and Tigreal became the youngest member of the Knights in history. He was the glory of his family and a genius in the eyes of the Moniyan people. Everyone believed that he would become a hero in the history of Moniyan, just like the martyrs of previous generations of Walk of Heroes.

However, few people have such a smooth life. Just when people thought a star was about to rise, a heavy blow soon fell on Tigreal. In the Drylands, in a battle launched to completely drive the demons of the Abyss, who had long held the area underground, Tigreal served as commander of the Second Regiment in an army composed of the Order of Light and the Imperial Border Guard. He was deployed on the left flank of the battlefield and launched an attack against the demonic army. However, due to an error from the command center, the second regiment went in alone and was besieged by the demon army.

Subsequently, the command center ordered the Second Regiment to leave some of the soldiers behind to close the rear and disperse to break through the encirclement. At this time, Tigreal was determined to live or die with his troops, but the elderly and experienced deputy Roland stopped Tigreal and caused him to retreat with the main force he commanded, while he and a small number of fighters held off the enemy. Aiming to retain a few effective soldiers, Tigreal reluctantly led the troops to withdraw.

After the battle, the demonic army, which had long been entrenched where the southern part of the empire met the Barren Lands, was completely wiped out, but only the Second Regiment suffered heavy losses, the unit remaining to hold back the enemy having been completely wiped out. Looking at the dead bodies and blood all over the ground, Tigreal felt full of guilt for the decision he had made.

After this battle, in order to cover up their mistakes, the senior officers of the Knights refused to give the soldiers of the Second Regiment the honor they deserved, and called these soldiers "disobedient" because they were greedy for merit and this led to unnecessary sacrifices. Subsequently, they tried to use the medals and promotions to encourage Tigrayal to remain silent. Feeling the stress of the unsuccessful struggle and pressure from family, Tigreal left Moniyan and came to the cold Northern Valley. In the icy and snowy north, Tigreal formed a deep friendship with the rugged tribes of the Northern Valley and, more importantly, fighting side by side again and again, Tigreal realized that as a knight, the life of a companion is more important than the outcome of a battle: because we choose to fight to protect everyone around us. If fighting only means sacrifice, then victory has no meaning.

After that, Tigreal returned to Moniyan, returned to the Knights of Light, and became the leader of the Knights over the years, guarding everything in Moniyan with determination and bravery day after day. In folklore, as long as there is a place where darkness invades, there will be the fearless Warrior of Dawn to guide everyone in chasing away the darkness.
anecdotes: Tigreal's passive has been reworked twice to date.
His first passive granted him a bonus to armor and magic resistance when he made a basic attack, stacking up to 5 times.
His second passive granted him 15% more armor and magic defense against items.
There are many inconsistencies and ironies in Tigreal's quotes:
“A real man never hides in a bush,” while most Tigrayan players hide in the bushes.
“A true knight never says die,” but he has said it before.
He is based on Bedivere from Magic Rush.
His current English voice actor, Zach Lazar Hoffman, also provides the voice of Yu Zhong, as does his current Japanese voice actor, Yano Masaaki, for Alucard and Barats.

uranus.accroche: Guardian made of lightning and air, guards the Heavenly Palace.
lore: The Heavenly Palace - Legend has it that the city floating above the skies of the Land of Dawn was once home to the Gods. This mysterious place is also said to hold the key to ruling the world. Ages ago, the ruler of the Heavenly Palace used the technological secret of the ancients to create Uranus, then ordered him to guard the city and wait for a new ruler to emerge.

When the scholars of the Land of Dawn found and opened the gates of the Heavenly Palace, the battle between the Zenith of Dawn and the Dark Abyss quickly spread throughout the kingdom, disrupting the solitude of the ancient city. Both forces sought to occupy the Heavenly Palace as a symbol of victory, their heroes unleashing the full extent of their power and ultimately finding themselves at a stalemate. The massive influx of energy generated during the incessant battles finally awakened the city's defense system, converting the released energy into pure lightning, injected into Uranus and awakened from its dormancy in the depths of the Heavenly Palace. “Leave now, intruder!” » he roared as he awoke, charging onto the battlefield fueled by lightning, ether and ready to fulfill his destiny. Their objective: to purge these wild intruders who had disturbed the tranquility of the Heavenly Palace.
anecdotes: their name, "Uranus", comes from the primordial Greek god of the sky, who was the father of the Titans. Uranus is also the name of the seventh planet in the solar system, which corresponds to the hero's cosmic theme.
Their name was almost "Ouranos", the original Greek spelling of the god Uranus. The developers chose "Uranus" to match the name of the planet and make it easier to recognize on a global scale.
Uranus is one of the oldest beings in gaming history.
They are the guardians of the Heavenly Palace which is one of the playable maps in the game before it is replaced by Sanctum Island.

Unlike most tanks that rely on shields or lifesteal, Uranus quickly regenerates HP over time, making him one of the hardest heroes to take down. His passive (Radiance) allows him to accumulate HP regeneration whenever he takes damage, allowing him to excel in prolonged fights.

vale.accroche: The heir of Wind Fort, a wind mage.
lore: ["]Valir, my beloved brother. You lost everything the day we made the pact. I will ensure that the Fire Kingdom restores everything to the way it once was. Although you still wish to avenge your cruel father, I do not blame you as long as you can chase away the storm in your heart. Nothing is as important as your happiness, not even my life.["] Vale fell into deep contemplation as he wrote his letter to Valir. These opening lines took Vale back to the days of his youth, when he and Valir were the closest of friends.

As Vale fell further into nostalgia, he remembered the day they met at a royal party. Since then, they both felt a strong affinity with each other's magic. For a long time, Vale and Valir were inseparable. Together, they left many memories in the Valley of the Winds, the Kingdom of Fire and many other exotic lands. When unrest engulfed the Fire Kingdom, Valir quickly took his leave. Only Vale knows exactly how much Valir sacrificed that day.

As time passed, the day of the Pact approached. Vale's magical abilities to control the winds had become more sophisticated over the years. In fact, he was the only member of his family who could change the winds through magic. However, Vale had never shown his magic to anyone before. Vale waited and waited for the day of the pact to come. That day, he would stage a spectacular display of wind magic for Valir. Vale thinks Valir will see his magic, remember the precious times they spent together, and look back at how things were in their youth.
anecdotes: Despite being developed before several other heroes (name=Selena, name=Aldous, name=Claude, name=Belerick, name=Lunox, name=Thamuz, name=Leomord, name=Kimmy, name=Harith, name=Minsitthar, name=Hanzo, name=Kadita, and name=Badang), Vale was not released on the original servers until after all of them. Having been locked on the test servers for almost an entire year, he took longer to be released than any other hero. If you sort the heroes in the "Heroes" page by "Sale Time", Vale will appear between Claude and Leomord, instead of after Badang. The order of heroes is due to its earlier introduction in advanced servers.

valentina.accroche: Former head of House Paxley who would stop at nothing to resurrect her lover.
lore: House Paxley ruled the regions near the Lantis Mountains, south of the Moniyan Empire. Generations of the house had guarded these areas for the Empire, defending against invasion from the Abyss with magic and swords.

As the eldest daughter of the patriarch of the house, Valentina had high hopes since birth. She underwent rigorous training and grew to become a proud perfectionist, the most qualified heir to lead this noble house.
As she grew up, she traveled to the border and helped the house fend off wave after wave of invading demons.

News of the victories in the Lantis Mountains became the only thing that could reassure civilians. As a result, House Paxley quickly rose among the nobles, while Valentina became the youngest and only female member of the house council.

Seeking allies, Valentina journeyed alone into the Moonlight Forest despite the Empire's prolonged hostility towards the Elves. The Elf King, Estes, refused Valentina's request, saying that the Elves had no interest in the human war. An elf hero named Irlan, however, was moved by Valentina's heartfelt words. Unlike Estes, he believed that with the fall of the human empire, the demise of Moonlit Forest would also be imminent.
A few heated words were exchanged, after which Irlan followed Valentina out of the moonlit forest with his friends.
Since then, elves and humans have fought side by side on the battlefields of the Lantis Mountains.

After the days and nights spent with Valentina, risking their lives, Irlan realized that he had fallen desperately in love with her. But Valentina was distraught when Irlan revealed his feelings for her: she had always been taught that a noble lady should not indulge in ridiculous romances and that she should marry someone of equal status for the sake of the house. Nevertheless, Irlan's passionate courtship awakened the feelings buried deep in Valentina's heart. She experienced the wonderful joy of being loved for the first time.

Just when Valentina was pretending to be calm but didn't really know how to react, Irlan took the opportunity at the House Paxley election meeting and proposed that he was willing to fight under Valentina's command with the other Elves permanently, but on one condition: Valentina had to say yes to his marriage proposal.

Irlan's suggestion perfectly solved the problem that was troubling Valentina. Now she could follow her heart and accept her feelings for the sake of the house. And so[,] they shared their sacred vows under the moonlight, and Valentina became the head of their house as the house clapped with joy. But among the enthusiastic crowd, his uncle remained silent: the position should belong to him according to the rules of the house.

With the help of the Elves, House Paxley gained power every day and Valentina was given the title "Duchess" of the Moniyan Empire. And she also counted on Irlan who showered her with love. Accustomed to facing death, Valentina finally tastes the sweetness of life.

But then disaster suddenly struck: after biding their time and gathering their forces, the Abyss once again attacked the stronghold of House Paxley with powerful troops. Before the Emperor's reinforcements arrived, House Paxley was left to its own devices.

Realizing that the strength of the house was no match for the army of the Abyss, Valentina decided to resort to the last expedient: gathering all the mages of the house and casting the "Coffin of Souls", a forbidden spell that, when completed, could create a deadly zone and devour all the souls of the living. Even demons would not be spared.
To cover the mages preparing the spell at their backs, Valentina and Irlan led the bravest warriors to the forefront, confronting the Abyss army head-on.

The battle began and thousands of demons invaded the Elves and humans like the waves of the ocean. But the alliance remained firm as the strongest rock, letting the waves of troops from the Abyss break into a thousand pieces.

But these brave soldiers still fell one after the other. Seeing this, Valentina became more anxious as she waited for the signal for the end of the spell. Their plan was to withdraw from the battlefield with all their troops as soon as the signal came, so that the magic zone covering the front line would destroy the demon army in one fell swoop.

However, Valentina suddenly noticed the Soul Casket symbol appearing above the engaged armies, but the rear had not fired any withdrawal signals! Confused, she turned around to find her own uncle and the mages mocking her.

Knowing that she had been shamelessly betrayed, Valentina shouted for everyone to stand down immediately. At the last moment before the coffin fell, Irlan used his last strength to push Valentina out of the area, before falling on the battlefield losing his soul.
The Battle of Lantis thus ended and the invincible legend of Valentina continued. But only Valentina herself knew what price she had paid for this victory...
The Duchess executed all those who betrayed her and escorted the body of her beloved to Aberleen Castle.

She built a sacred hall in commemoration of Irlan and the other martyrs and has since dedicated her life to seeking a way to bring back Irlan's soul. During this process, Valentina became more and more desperate and eventually turned to dark magic and awakened a trace of consciousness from the evil god of trickery, Kalon.

Kalon told Valentina of the miraculous powers of the Heart of Anima, a broken piece of the Twilight Orb, and tricked her into signing a blood pact with him. According to the blood pact, Valentina would gain immortality and the power of shadow, but at the cost that since then all the souls of House Paxley had to be contaminated by Kalon. And when his power truly awakened, he would be resurrected thanks to a descendant of Paxley.
To prevent Kalon's return, Valentina left a prophecy informing her descendants that if the Cursed One appeared, they must get rid of the person at all costs.
Since then, Valentina had been hiding in the shadows, silently awaiting the appearance of the Heart of Anima, the day when her beloved's soul could be recovered...

valir.accroche: Heir to Fire Throat, fire mage.
lore: To the southwest of the Land of Dawn lies an active volcano that endangered the lives of anyone who dared to approach it. “Hell of Fire” was what people called this place. It was also known as the testing ground for mages seeking to master flame spells. After leaving the magic academy, Valir resided there for five years while carrying a ten-year promise to Vale. He hoped that this day would come sooner, but at the same time, he also hoped that this day would never come. One day, Valir cast his arcane flame magic towards the volcano but the result did not live up to his expectations.

In the Western Desert there was a man who was looking for Valir. The betrayal of the years was something he could never forgive. With much anger and hatred, and to maintain the reputation of the magic academy, he decided to hunt down the traitor. The moment he felt unusual arcane power being released from the volcano, he smiled.

Long-term habitation in this "Hell of Fire" has brought changes to Valir's body. His skin was burned by the volcano's flames, but to become the Son of Flames, he had to combine the power of his arcane flame magic with the volcano's hellfire. His body and his will must withstand the tests of these burning lavas. Suddenly, a strong wind blew, bringing a familiar feeling to Valir. Vale had come! They had never met since childhood. This meeting gave rise to the first fight between them, between fire and wind. The Windtalker and Son of Flame use all their magic to attack each other. No words were exchanged, but they shared a common thought: they didn't want to kill each other. However, their fight generated great power, which made the volcano worse. If the volcano erupted, they would surely die in hell.
There are five years left – can’t you wait for Vale!?

Before Vale said anything, Valir heard another familiar voice, it was Gord. Gord's presence interrupted this fight between these brothers. He wanted to abolish Valir's arcane magic, because in his mind, her pure arcane wisdom should never be tarnished. However, the arcane spell he cast on Valir was stopped by Vale. Vale turned to sympathy as he looked at Valir's tortured body. He didn't want anyone to hurt his brother. However, Valir did not need such sympathy.

One of them was his master who wanted to destroy his apprentice for his apparent betrayal. Another of them was his closest brother. However, he was also the son of the one who killed Valir's father. The sacred flame would never go out. Valir managed to combine the power of his arcane flame magic with hellfire and release powerful energy. With this power, the lava became unstable. During this time, Valir gained a powerful body while his eyes became scarlet flames. At that time, Vale could understand his father's concerns. This kind of power amazed Gord, and as a teacher, he would rather kill his student than let him be possessed by this crazy power.

Valir's flame, Vale's wind, and Gord's arcane power aggravated the volcano, leading to a great collapse. After that, Vale and Gord tried to find Valir, but they couldn't find him. Vale knew that in his heart Valir was still alive and that their promise of ten years was not yet broken. The five years made Valir great, what would happen after five more years? Vale knew that the next time they met, it wouldn't be as friends and brothers. Rather, it would be the greatest fight for their lives.
anecdotes: The name “Valir” means “Valley” in Bengali language.

Valir's original skills were very different from his current version, focusing more on fire blasts than CC and sustain. Its burn damage can kill enemies even after it stops attacking (if they are still on fire).
Valir is the only mage with a skill capable of repelling multiple enemies at once.

lore: The young Duchess guarding Necrokeep. Vexana was the majestic ruler of Necrokeep, the gentle mother of the undead, but also the only glimmer of light that penetrated the Mist, bringing hope to this cursed land shunned by both life and death. === Undying Hope === Princess Vexana Gaius had never set foot outside of Lumina City, and she had no desire to do so. The capital Moniyan was warm, opulent and full of life. A horrible fortress in the southern hinterlands was the last place she intended to spend the rest of her life.

On the other hand, she knew that she was bound to her father's will. Duke Atticus of Ridgeburg had proposed to House Gaius a union through marriage, and Lord Gaius considered Vexana the most suitable partner. And now she found herself alone in her carriage on a long journey south.
She glanced at the letter that the duke had sent her to present his future home:
These are the southern lands blessed by the ancient gods, where torrential rains come and go and silver grass bathes in the glow of the moon.
Vexana admired the duke's thoughtfulness, but these poetic words failed to ease her unease.

To make matters worse, Vexana didn't even meet her host when she arrived in Ridgeburg. He was told that Duke Atticus had left the castle the day before, urgently seeking to clean up a demonic infestation along the border.

DEMONS? Vexana's nausea turned into a slow, creeping terror. She had difficulty understanding her misfortune. Looking around at the damp, grimy walls of the castle, she thought of her sunny, pastel room in Lumina City. She had hot baths, sumptuous banquets, and maidens attending to her every need. Now all she had was a sinister-looking knight named Leomord, who she believed was better suited to patrolling the brigs than her corridor.

However, she remained hopeful. Maybe if she wrote to her father about the conditions of her new house, he would change his mind. Indeed, it would be unwise to entrust a poor girl like her in charge of such a terrible fortress. As she wrote her letter, her peace was disturbed by external turmoil.

Apparently, a pile of thorns had been left at the castle gate. The locals must be trying to intimidate me! Vexana shuddered at the thought. She immediately asked Ser Leomord to find the culprits. But to their surprise, the disbelievers were just... a group of barefoot children.

According to the children, these thorns were called Moonlight Grass. Despite their gruesome appearance, herbs could help calm the mind when brewed properly. The people of Ridgeburg sympathized with Vexana's plight and simply intended to offer her comfort, although it obviously didn't go as well as they had expected.

Maybe I judged these people too harshly. Vexana breathed a sigh of relief and her lips parted slightly to reveal a shy smile. She patted the children on the heads and thanked them for their kindness. Just another week, she thought. Maybe I could last another week in this soggy pile of rocks.
So a week passed, two weeks, then three...

Atticus's letters were the only company she had during her lonely nights in this strange land. With each stroke of the pen, she couldn't help but feel his pain...and his desire to return home. After all, this was precisely what she was going through herself. She wanted nothing more than to ease his grief, and maybe for him to do the same for her as well. More than she wanted to admit, she had developed a strange affection for the man she had never met.

And then the letters stopped abruptly, dashing any hope that Vexana had secretly harbored in her heart. However, she did not relapse into her earlier panic and anxiety; she now had the company of Ridgeburg and its people – her people.

Two years passed in a flash. The meek and immature Princess of the North has become a capable and decisive Duchess of the South. Walking through the muddy streets, solving one problem after another, big or small, Vexana didn't want to leave. With Atticus gone, she was the town's greatest and only hope.
Until that day, as if fate had heard his thoughts, the herald came knocking at his door...
“The Duke is back!”

Vexana's heart skipped a beat, then thumped so hard against her chest that the cheers that had erupted in the streets were drowned out. For two long years she had waited for this day, except when she saw Atticus' face for the first time, she only felt a cold shiver run down her spine.
In her letters, the Duke seemed lively and spirited, but the man standing before her was quite the opposite. His gaze was hollow and empty, his face a picture of resignation...

The wedding was soon held again, and the nobles and commoners of Pentaga all gathered in Ridgeburg to watch this long-awaited union join in holy matrimony. With a bouquet in hand, the stunning bride had her eyes on no one but her groom as he opened the box containing their wedding ring.
However, instead of a ring, a pair of magical wings came out of the box, followed by an evil voice echoing through the sacred walls:
Embrace the world of death!

Everyone in the room gasped in horror as Duke Atticus and his men twisted and writhed, their bodies slowly resembling those of the demons of the Abyss. The city's sworn protectors were its ruin, as they began to ravage everything in sight.
Vexana froze as an enraged Atticus lunged at her, his sword raised high...
"STOP!"

The heavy beast stopped abruptly, as if Vexana's voice rekindled a long-extinguished flame within it. The bride reached out to his heart and all that was left of him inside. “Atticus, please…it’s not you.”

And with a simple touch, Atticus apparently managed to regain a trace of consciousness and froze. Fighting the demon he had become, for the sake of his people and his own, Atticus ordered Ser Leomord to pierce his heart.
With his last breath, Atticus entrusted Ridgeburg to Vexana and revealed the dark secret hidden from all but Ridgeburg's royal family...

Eons ago, during the Endless War, the agony and resentment of hundreds of thousands of dying warriors condensed into a terrible curse. He could devastate anything with the stench of Abyss magic, but those without it would also suffer a fate worse than death.
"The Mist...if there is no other choice—"

"Atticus looked deeply into the eyes of his bride; his demonic hands reached out to her sweet face. A mixture of emotions shone in his eyes. Regret, gratitude and serenity. Until the inevitable claws of death tore her from his arms.
Inside the city, demon knights attacked everyone in sight; outside, other demonic forces were on their way.
In desperation, Vexana raised Atticus' scepter; the magical power that flowed deep in her blood exploded: she chose to keep this city forever!

A dark fog rose into the sky and engulfed all of Ridgeburg. Any townspeople who came into contact with the fog groaned in pain, their skin losing its color in an instant. The demon knights collapsed into ashes, while those outside the gates turned around and rushed towards the Abyss.

Vexana could almost feel her mind slipping out of her body. Amidst the chaos unfolding before her, she fell to her knees, her heart heavy with guilt. The inhabitants, however, came to surround their young duchess, not with reproaches or hatred but to thank her for having saved them from the grip of the Abyss...

Since then, the black fog had enveloped Ridgeburg for a hundred years. As the formidable fortress fell into ruin, its name was forgotten and people came to know it as Necrokeep, the land of the undead and home of restless souls.

In the early morning, the children pushed open the ruined door of the school; and when night fell, the whole family sat around a half-collapsed dining table, the food on the plate long turned to dust. It was all useless, but only in this way could they feel some semblance of life.
Not once had Vexana thought about leaving again.
Since then, she had fully assumed her role as leader of the city, but to the people of Necrokeep, she was also the gentle mother who loved and cared for them all.
Vexana firmly believed that one day, she would find a way to undo the curse... and that her people would regain a taste for life.
=== Song of ancient times === I want to live To wake up with you When the world sleeps deeply Tender is the morning dew On the released rays of the sun
I want to live Walk among the spring flowers And walk on the dead leaves Too cold the snow in the moonlight Melt in the humid summer breeze
I want to live To sip the morning brew While the fragrance rises to the eaves To share the joy and the sorrow Taste all the bittersweet
Your warmth, your breaths And your blooming smiles How I want to live To wait for your return Until all the greens and all the colors are no more
O how I want to live For the laughter of the old For the innocence of the newborn For the birds on the wings For the lingering melodies
Do I have to bear all the sins So that you come back to me Tell me all the suffering Is only a ghostly dream

anecdotes: Her full name is Vexana Gaius.

The name "Vexana" possibly comes from the Latin word "vexare", which means to torment, distress or harass. This could symbolize her ability to curse, harm, and control enemies through her necromantic powers, fitting her role as a necromancer who manipulates the spirits of the dead and inflicts torment on her enemies.
Her scepter belongs to Duke Atticus, her fiancé, whom Alice had corrupted on the day of their supposed wedding.
As confirmed in his Mastery Code Chapter 4, the soul of Duke Atticus, the former ruler of Ridgeburg/Necrokeep and fiancé of Vexana, is present in the Eternal Guard.
In Project NEXT, a major update aimed at reworking and balancing older heroes in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Vexana was one of the revamped heroes alongside several others.

Vexana is the first hero to receive a Zenith-quality skin in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Its “Twisted Fairytale” skin, introduced between March 25 and April 30, 2024, marked the beginning of this very rare skin category. Currently, Vexana and name=Selena are the only heroes with the Zenith skin.

Zenith skins might have a fairytale theme, as their effects, trailer, and names indicate their theme. Vexana's Zenith skin, "Twisted Fairytale", is heavily inspired by Snow White while Selena's Zenith skin, "Curse of Cinder" is inspired by Cinderella.
Vexana is one of the heroes who underwent drastic changes during her rework. The other hero is Bane and his name = Aurora.
Vexana and Silvanna are related by blood.

Lord Gaius and Emperor Gaius are different personalities. In the first case, this is the title and surname of Vexana's father, and in the second, the title and surname of the first ruler of the Moniyan Empire, from which the surname "Gaius" comes.

Its current English voice actor in its 2022 revamp, Erica Mendez, is known for her several roles in English dubs of Japanese anime, such as [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gon Freecss Gon Freecss] (which is also in the form of a skin for Dyrroth) from the 2011 version of Hunter × Hunter, Diane from The Seven Deadly Sins, and Megumin from KonoSuba. In video games, she has voiced many characters such as Kamisato Ayaka from Genshin Impact, White Lily Cookie and Black Pearl Cookie from Cookie Run: Kingdom and Maki Harukawa from Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony.
