wanwan.accroche: The Agile Tiger of the Oriental Fighters and a young girl full of life who wields the Crossbow of Tang.
lore: The Agile Tiger of the Eastern Fighters is a lively young girl who wields the Tang crossbow. Wanwan grew up in a remote mountain mansion and had a carefree childhood. It was only after meeting Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, Yin, the current vessel of the Evil God Lieh, and the other Eastern Fighters guarding the Dragon Altar that she realized that she had long ago been chosen by the Agile Tiger of the Four Immortals. Wanwan would find herself embroiled in events that would affect the past and future of the river lands of Cadia.

Can a young girl just venturing out into the world take on the duty of protecting the entire Cadia Riverlands? Despite everything she has been through, Wanwan still has many questions and has decided to head out into the big world to discover her own truth. ===Beyond the Mountains=== Many years ago, a stillborn child was abandoned in the mountains. The Spirit of the Agile Tiger, who was then looking for a successor, entered the scene and felt sorrow for the child who was not given a chance. So, he ended his search and gave his power to give the little girl a new life. As she inherited the power of an oriental fighter, marks appeared on her face and she grew a tiger's tail. And as luck would have it, the master of the Tang clan was walking in the forest and found the blessed child. He adopted her and named her Tang Wanwan. So the mountains now had a very noisy “little tiger”.

Under the care of her adoptive father, Wanwan grew into a rambunctious girl. She loved to talk, as if to compensate for her inability to greet the world when she was born. She was always chatting, usually to herself, and bouncing with her tail swaying in the wind. The mountains and forests became her playground. Sometimes she would shoot her arrows into the blue sky, imagining she was flying to the vast world beyond.
But the arrows always fell to the ground.

Only the wind, which flowed freely through the forest, noticed the disappointment in the girl's eyes, so he reached out as he passed by to pat her head. But the wind didn't realize it, even before it could pass, the girl's smile had already returned, brighter than ever.
“It’s okay,” Wanwan thought, “I will definitely see the world one day!”
But before Wanwan could leave the mountains, someone broke in first.
That day, Wanwan found a seriously injured stranger passed out in the mountains.

When the man regained consciousness, he told Wanwan that his name was Yu Zhong. Finally, Wanwan had found someone to talk to! Then began the daily stream of questions, although they were rarely answered. But when he spoke, his view of the outside world revived Wanwan's curiosity.
This lasted for a few years while Yu Zhong slowly recovered, but one day he suddenly decided to leave.
“Where are you going?” » asked Wanwan.
“The world.”
"I want to go too! Can I come?!"
“There is nothing to be seen of the old world, for I will forge a new one.”
Wanwan didn't understand the meaning of these words but knew the answer. Before Yu Zhong left, he gave him a Dragon Orb. “One day this will lead you to me.”
The Dragon Orb was an enigmatic object that was always cold to the touch, as if it could never get any warmth from Yu Zhong's presence.

Before Wanwan could feel sad about her friend leaving, her long-absent father suddenly returned. He asked Wanwan to pack his things quickly and they left the mountains that night. “Are we running from something?” Wanwan wondered. Her father didn't explain and she didn't ask. Wanwan just hid the Dragon Orb and followed. She was excited to be able to see what Yu Zhong said for herself.

They finally arrived at Floral Falls. Hidden by immense mechanisms, it was a utopia for those seeking refuge from the conflicts of the world. Here, Wanwan finally met someone her own age; someone with whom she could have a lively exchange. And this person was Yin, a young man who was a bit simple but fair and passionate. Similar in age and education, the two men became best friends and were almost inseparable. Often, when the adults were busy, they would sneak out of the valley to listen to stories of what was happening in the riverlands of Cadia. Yin was worried about many things, but Wanwan could barely contain her excitement. Although Floral Falls was also isolated from the world, it was a step further from his home in the mountains.
And step by step, Wanwan believed that she would finally see the world she had imagined when she was a child, the world mentioned by Yu Zhong, and the world that she and Yin talked about.

The years have passed. Rumors of the Black Dragon's reincarnation began to spread throughout the Riverlands of Cadia. At first, Wanwan thought it was just the latest gossip. But a few days later, she heard a familiar name among the rumors and felt uneasy in her heart. At that moment, the Dragon Orb began to grow hot, as if giving a warning or perhaps indicating answers. Wanwan bid farewell to her father and Yin and left to find Yu Zhong.
With a new purpose in her step, Wanwan followed the news regarding the Black Dragon and, with the help of the Dragon Orb, finally arrived at the Dragon Altar.

Inside, the new Eastern Fighters gathered for the first time, but could not stop Yu Zhong from merging with the power of the Black Dragon. Wanwan had unknowingly played a role in Yu Zhong's plan, bringing the Dragon Orb that allowed him to defeat the Evil God Lieh.
As Yu Zhong and Luo Yi chased after Lieh, he took one last look at Wanwan. A thousand questions came to his mind.
—Come back... Did you know from the beginning that I was the Agile Tiger of the Eastern Fighters?
—Did you lead me here just to obtain the power of the Black Dragon?
— I have traveled so far, but I have never even taken the time to discover the world.
—It is the duty of the Eastern Fighters to protect the Riverlands of Cadia, but I have never lived my life as an Eastern Fighter; all this time, I lived like Tang Wanwan.

Countless questions raced through his mind. Wanwan sat where she was, buried her face in her hands, closed her eyes and tried to sort through all the thoughts that were running through her mind. Her thoughts drifted with the wind, back to the forest where she was born, back to the cottage with Yu Zhong, back to the Flower Falls where she played with Yin, and beyond, to the Dragon Altar and beyond...
The girl took a deep breath and jumped up.
It was already dawn. She sat there for a whole day and night.
“Ahhh, I still don’t understand!”
"Eastern Fighters, Cadia Riverlands, Black Dragons and Evil Gods... it's too much!"
"Whether I'm the Agile Tiger or an Oriental Fighter, I'm still Tang Wanwan! And I make my own decisions!"
"Wait, Black Dragon—No, Yu Zhong! One day, I will ask you in person about the truth about the dragon orb! Dragon Altar! I will return to tell everyone my decision!"
The girl grabbed her crossbows, packed her things, and left the dragon altar.
When Wanwan walked out of the mountain gate, she raised her hand and shot an arrow into the sky.
Carried by the wind, he flew higher and higher, beyond the mountains and towards the great unknown. ===Secret History of the Dragon Altar===
===Eastern fighters gather===

anecdotes: "Wan" (丸) can mean "round" or "small", possibly referring to his small size, or "Wan" (玩) means "play" or "fun", matching his playful and mischievous personality. In Chinese, repeating syllables (like “Wanwan”) is a common naming style for cute and playful characters.
It is based on the Four Symbols (White Tiger of the West).
Wanwan "Darting Star" somewhat refers to the accurate description of the White Tiger. It is sometimes called the White Tiger of the West (西方白虎; Xīfāng Báihǔ)
If she is allied with the Oriental Fighters, she will interact with their members. She will say the following lines:
“You’re so good at telling lame jokes, Zilong.” — From Wanwan to Zilong.
"Baxia! I didn't paint that turtle on your face! [laughs]" — Wanwan to Baxia
“Ling, it’s so hard to see your smile!” —Wanwan to Ling
Wanwan and the others will gain bonus movement speed on the battlefield if they team up with one or more members of the Oriental Fighters.

Wanwan's light, form-fitting outfit resembles the outfit worn by Chinese martial artists and acrobats. The cropped top and high collar and armbands are practical for agility, reflecting traditional wuxia (martial arts heroes) and kunoichi (female ninjas).
Wanwan is one of the only snipers with a built-in purifier effect, making him one of the hardest heroes to control in the game!
Unlike other snipers who can freely throw their ultimates, Wanwan must first hit all of an enemy's weaknesses (vital points) to unlock Tang's crossbow.
Wanwan "Pixel Blast" had music from 515 UNITE but abbreviated.

One of the biggest jokes in the Mobile Legends community is that Wanwan is constantly nerfed no matter how balanced or weak she becomes. Every time new patch notes are released, players joke that Wanwan is still in the "Adjusted" section.
She shares her Japanese voice actor, Akane Fujikawa, with Lylia.

x-borg.accroche: An uncontrollable flame determined to take revenge on Eruditio.
lore: So you've finally come out of hiding, Rooney. It's a shame we had to burn your precious laboratory to get you here.
Oh, that's right, you're tied up and you can't talk. It doesn't matter, you don't need to talk. I've heard enough of your lies. Today you listen.

Don't give me that look. You know very well who I am! It's X.Borg! How could you forget this name? Oh, today I am also called the Eruditio Nightmare, a monster that is neither a man nor a ghost. A being cursed by fire. Some even call me the Child of Disaster...
Why do you always have this incredulous look? Are you forgetting your old days? So let me refresh your memory.

The story begins with this scar on my forehead. While my brother and I were working in the mine, a stone came loose and almost hit my brother. I got this scar when I used my head to protect him. Why my head? Well, if any other part of our body was affected and disabled, we wouldn't be able to work!
I'm sure you're wondering what all this has to do with you, right? What a stupid question. This energy tower used to mine the mountain was built on your orders, correct?
Your great Eruditio built this tower in our city, but none of us knew what it was. After all, we were just happy to have work.

You could say that my fate was my fault, that I should have known the risks of the job when I signed up. But if you came from a poor town like me, you might see how precious the things you take for granted are to us. Maybe, just maybe, working in this mine could help my family move to Eruditio. For a poor child like me, it was a unique opportunity.

But who would have thought that you, who gave us so much hope, cared so little for the lives of so many people, including children like me. You, great scholars, viewed us as tools and looked the other way when it came to your research. You knew what you were exploiting, but you didn't care.

First, people who came into contact with the ore began to fall ill one after another. I tried to ignore it, but then I passed out and fell into the liquid agent we were operating with. The pain... It felt like every inch of my skin was burning from underneath. Can you imagine what I went through? Of course you can, you are the Eruditio prodigy!

Funny enough, I finally managed to access Eruditio, but as a lab rat. They operated on me and transformed me into what I am now. At that moment, I remember your voice screaming frantically, like a little insect buzzing in my ear. You must have been afraid that they would ruin your precious science experiment, right? After the pain finally went away, you personally came and told me that I was the first successful case, that I was “the one.” I had merged with the power of the ore and survived. Boy, you really had a way with words. You convinced me that, as an elected official, I should stay at Eruditio and continue to help you in your research. And in exchange, you would take care of my family and my city.

And I believed it... I really believed it. The scar on my head, the burning pain, the surgery, and being separated from my family... it was all worth being the one. I really thought I was going to make a name for myself, that I would be part of a great future. After all, a few months ago I was just a poor kid who worried about food and clothes, but now I had a mission! I was the chosen one!
You have no right to judge me. You were born with a silver spoon, a citizen of Eruditio with the riches of the world before you. Do you even know what hunger feels like?

Later, when I finally returned to my hometown, can you guess what I found? This damn mineral, which poisons the earth and torments my people. Those who could leave had already left. Those who couldn't simply accepted their fate. They asked me where I had been all these years and I told them. I was with the monsters who did this to them.
All these... eyes filled with anguish... staring at me... their hatred... consuming me... LEAVE! Ugh, my head. No wait, those were all illusions... just illusions...
There was no one there to look at me, Rooney. Each of them has already been buried to pave the way for your research.
So I set the whole thing on fire. The fire lasted three days and three nights. It was the only thing I could give them. I have burned your sins and cleansed my house.

Then I came to the Eruditio with a gift for you all. Don't get me wrong, I don't hate Eruditio. I don't even hate you. After all, it was thanks to you that I finally understood that this so-called wonderful future had no place for me. But I found my own purpose.
You see, the world is a cruel place. And fire is my gift to this cruel world. Is there anything more appropriate?

Eh? What is this? Let me guess, you mean to tell me that the people at Eruditio are innocent? You should know that in this world, bad things happen to good people, and worse things happen to worse people.
As your laboratory caught fire, I was born again. The place where you planned to change the world is now a pile of ashes. HAHAHAHA!
Shut up, Rooney! Stop ringing my ear! It's too late for your lies. Look, it's already dawn.
anecdotes: The name X.Borg could probably mean "Experimental Cyborg", referring to his half-human, half-machine nature. "X" could symbolize "Experimental", as X.Borg was a test subject in Eruditio's failed technology project. "Borg" comes from "Cyborg", meaning a human with mechanical enhancements.
X.Borg appears to suffer from pyromania due to his personality and abilities in the game.
Alongside Masha, X.Borg is the only hero with more than one HP bar.

X.Borg is the first MLBB hero to have two distinct HP bars: Armor HP (outer bar), functions as a shield and absorbs damage. True HP (inner bar), when his armor breaks, he enters a weaker "Frenzy" state.
With Armor HP included and excluded, X.Borg has the lowest base HP in the game at level 1, with 998 and 2195 respectively. He also has the lowest base HP at level 15 with 2524 (without armor HP.)
Pecados Rioter is the first ever MLBB skin obtainable by playing and reaching Grandmaster in Magic Chess!
The hero's name is similar to that of the Power Rangers Megaforce called X Borgs.
What's strange is that the in-game model of X.borg wears a mask when he uses it in a match.

xavier.accroche: Former member of the Knights of Light determined to forge his own path.
lore: Former member of the Knights of Light determined to forge his own path. Xavier was a member of the Knights of Light who were given the title "Arbiter of Light". After suppressing the Freesmiths' Guild of Terizla, Xavier experienced a decade of inner struggle and discouragement. And when he received the order to capture the two "heretics", Yin and Melissa, he was once again forced to choose between duty and conscience... === The Knight: Darkness Before Dawn ===

"Fear and dread from you will be upon every beast and bird. Your verdict will be accepted by every soul that walks the earth. And every path on which the Light shines, by your hand they will be traced." - Arbitrator of Light

Xavier was a glorious member of the Knights of Light, a force that rivaled the Moniyan Empire's Order of Light. Aside from being the youngest Arbitrator of Light, he was also known for his unusual quirks...

Xavier was born into an ordinary merchant family in Lumina City. The only unusual thing, if anything, was his mother, a Light Elf. Probably due to his Elf lineage, Xavier was born with extraordinary intelligence and eyes the color of the purest sapphire. Xavier's father once had high hopes for Xavier, thinking he could bring a fortune to his business. Xavier, however, showed no interest in the family business and joined the Monastery of Light upon coming of age. Before his departure, his mother, who also believed in the King of Light, gave him a magical cape made by the Elves.

For followers of the Light, the Monastery of Light was the sacred place that they would sacrifice everything to be a part of, but very few of them could pass the difficult, if not impossible, entrance tests. This was not the case for Xavier, and the reason goes back to his childhood.

When night fell, little Xavier often left the house to play with the cats in the street. He gave each of these ordinary cats a new identity, either the "hero" or the "evil dragon", while he himself was the "commander" overseeing the battlefield. Xavier had been immersed in his imaginary heroic adventure, until the day the “evil dragon” disappeared. He went looking for him and found him surrounded by a pack of stray dogs. The latter was about to tear the “evil dragon” to pieces! Without thinking, Little Xavier rushed to the side of the “evil dragon” and held him in his arms. He closed his eyes and, for the first time, felt burning rage coursing through his veins. The pain didn't come as he expected. It was as if a mysterious substance had leaked from Xavier's body and stopped the stray dogs in their tracks. Xavier was relieved. Still holding the "evil dragon", he did not realize that the miracle had been created by himself, and that this was the first awakening of his control over mystical magic - a rare power that few people in history had ever possessed.

In the monastery library, Xavier found the perfect spell for his mystical magic in an ancient tome, a spell that allowed his power to steadily increase with the amount of magic around him. Under his control, the highly compressed magic particles would fission and explode, creating immense destructive energy in an instant.

Xavier's talent was soon discovered by the Bishop of the Monastery of Light, Rod Sidon. The bishop recruited Xavier into the Knights of Light, a force composed entirely of loyal followers of the King of Light. The Knights of Light had been forcibly disbanded by the Emperor several times throughout history. It was only recently rebuilt.

After that, Xavier gained countless merits in the missions entrusted by the Church and was highly praised by the bishop. At the ensuing Gathering of Light, the bishop placed the insignia of Light on Xavier's chest and announced him as the Arbiter of Light.

Xavier was given the mission to remove heretics from the Freesmiths' Guild shortly after. According to the order, he was supposed to cover the Church's secret force, the "Ravens", to attack the heretics' stronghold. This special force recruited by the bishop brought together people from all walks of life eager to atone for their sins. They were like crows hidden among the shadows, whose sole purpose was to peck at any dirt that could hinder the descent of the Light. At all costs.

With his signature attack, Xavier broke through the fortress defense with a simple snap of his fingers. However, the sight that followed made him stop dead in his tracks. The fortress was full of women, children and old people, and on the ground was a mother injured by her mystical magic, still desperately protecting her baby... Yet the "Ravens" rushed in and finished off the survivors with sick pleasure.

Xavier stumbled into the depths of the fortress, trembling. From the wife of a master blacksmith, he learned the truth behind the repression. It wasn't about suppressing heretics, but about stealing the Smiths' enchantment secrets! For the first time, Xavier had doubts about the mission entrusted by the archbishop. But just when he was wondering whether to perform the "wipeout", a "Crow" behind him had already launched his flying knife.
The woman was killed in an instant, when Xavier felt movements in the shadows behind her. There was a red-haired child hiding in the shadows, scared and helpless.

Xavier roared in rage: “I have sworn to punish heretics, but never to tolerate such a vile massacre! The “Ravens” were stunned. Still furious, Xavier orders the “Ravens” to evacuate the premises, before secretly placing the child in the Church orphanage.
The other Arbitrator of Light, Alucard, witnessed the entire incident. He tried to cover up the incident from Xavier, but somehow the information reached the bishop's ears.

For the bishop, what Xavier was doing was tantamount to siding with the heretics. Completely disappointed, the Bishop sent Xavier to the borders of the Empire to carry out dangerous missions against the Abyss. During the ten years that followed, Xavier was not haunted for a moment by what he saw in the fortress. He no longer had this passion for the tasks assigned to him and often made fun of his colleagues with sarcasm.

This situation lasted until Rod Sidon became the new archbishop, who then decided to give Xavier a second chance and called Xavier back to his side. Lead the guards who maintain order in Lumina City. Xavier takes on this new position with renewed enthusiasm. The signs of heresy in Lumina City have almost disappeared, and the Church took advantage of the opportunity and claimed that this was all due to the new archbishop following the oracle of the King of Light.

However, during this period, Xavier understood the injustice in Lumina City and no longer believed the Church's propaganda. He returned to taunting his colleagues with sarcastic remarks and did only the bare minimum to complete his task. More than once, the urge to resist or leave came to Xavier's mind. It was only the vow he had made to serve the Archbishop and fight for the Light all his life that held him back.

Behind Xavier's facade of indifference was a never-ending struggle, and with each passing moment he had to convince himself not to succumb to the gaping emptiness in his heart. He was waiting for the turn of events – either to die, or to leave, or to change.
During the Gathering of Light hosted by the Archbishop, Xavier was given a secret mission to patrol Lumina City and eliminate all signs of heresy.
During the mission, Xavier encountered Melissa and Yin who were being chased by demons. The sign of heresy was a shame for the prestige of the Church!

Xavier looked at the two young people in silence. He was supposed to arrest these two suspected heretics on the spot, but looking at Yin who was injured while protecting the child on the side of the road, the image of the mother holding her child in the fortress ten years ago suddenly came to his mind.
The young Xavier then had no other choice, but now? "Should I stop them, let them go, or..."
Xavier said to himself: “This time, the choice is mine.”
=== The Knight: Emerging Light ===
anecdotes: The name Xavier is derived from the Basque word Etxeberria, meaning “new house” or “bright”.
He is the first hero whose voice lines contain when:
inflict damage;
kill a hero/Lord;
using callback; And

Although it has not been officially confirmed, Xavier is considered one of the first heroes created due to an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou, Lukas and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
Although Xavier is marketed to have the first "comprehensive attack skill", there are previous hero skills that fit the classification of "comprehensive attack skills".
His old passive also allowed him to immobilize enemies within his range in three seconds.
When enemies are within range, their movement speed is gradually reduced until they are completely immobilized. This was removed before the official server release.

One of Xavier's quotes, "Tough enemies I don't fear; stupid allies..." refers to one of the game's biggest matchmaking issues, where players frequently encounter less skilled players on their team, especially in a high-ranked match.

Xavier had an overhaul of his passive according to patch 1.7.44 MLBB. While his passive no longer increases all damage from his skills, the developers gave him an increase in base damage and movement speed in exchange for his overhaul.

His English voice actor, Kaiji Tang, is a well-known voice actor for Gojo Satoru from Jujustu Kaisen, in which he happened to have a collaboration skin of the same character voiced by his original Japanese voice actor, Yuichi Nakamura.

lore: Dragon City is located northeast of Cadia Riverlands, connecting the Frozen Sea and the Sea of ​​Hope. This is the only passage permitted for all ships sailing from Northern Vale to Cadia Riverlands and further south. The geological advantage allowed this city to develop foreign trade, making it a thriving port and booming port city.

But this brilliant city has never known a single day of peace since its creation. Pirates from the Frozen Sea and the Sea of ​​Hope had invaded this city, attacking the port and pillaging the merchant ships. After years of unsuccessful resistance against pirates, the city's residents built a powerful navy, the Paenlong Fleet, to fight pirates and protect their homeland and trade routes.

The general of this naval fleet was the legendary hero Yi Sun-shin. Born and raised in Dragon City, Yi Sun-shin grew up witnessing countless tragedies happening around him: ships being attacked and fishermen murdered in cold blood by pirates. This is how the young Yi Sun-shin decided to become an admiral and protect his homeland.

Yi Sun-shin spent his entire childhood training and preparing for the future. He learned the techniques of sailing, archery and combat. He even ventured into the Dragon Altar and gained all the knowledge he could from the ancients.

At the age of 18, Yi Sun-shin finally joined the naval fleet, although he was only a sailor then. Over the next decade, Yi Sun-shin followed the fleet into numerous battles, traveling between the Frozen Sea and the Sea of ​​Hope and fought the notorious pirates. He showed unprecedented wisdom and leadership in battle, and gradually, after years of battle, he became the captain of the entire Paenlong fleet.

Under the command of Yi Sun-shin, the legendary fleet defeated the pirates time and time again, driving almost all the pirates back into the Sea of ​​Hope and restoring peace to this once devastated Dragon City.

As Yi Sun-shin continued to launch assaults, the pirates fell into a period of despair. The despair of not being able to win against Yi Sun-shin had also made one thing clear: if they still wanted to dominate the ports of Dragon City, they had to eliminate Yi Sun-shin. However, they knew they could not defeat him at sea. So, like evil pirates, they resorted to trickery. In disguise, the buccaneers infiltrated Dragon City]] and spread rumors, claiming that Yi Sun-shin was not content to rule, just the naval fleet, but instead wanted to rule the entire Dragon City and the Sea of ​​Hope, after achieving something so extraordinary.

Just as the pirate expected, the city's leaders took the gossip for accusations and the rumors for truth. In no time, they removed Yi Sun-shin from office and made him a commoner. Seeing this, the treacherous pirates moved on to the next part of the plan. They spread another rumor that the pirates were gathering near the Frozen Sea, providing an opportunity to hunt them down once and for all.

Although Yi Sun-shin strongly advised against it, the ruler took the bait and sent most of the Paenlong fleet on this mission, leaving only a few ships behind, to protect the port. But what they didn't know was that the pirates from the Frozen Seas and the Sea of ​​Hope joined forces and set up a trap in the northern part of the Frozen Sea, waiting for the fleet to fall directly into it.

The battle was a massacre. Without Yi Sun-shin to lead, the rudderless navy was no match for the pirates, many veterans drowned, and most battleships sank. Flanked by the pirate coalition, the once legendary navy was nearly wiped out.

Shortly after these events, the victorious coalition of pirates sailed into Dragon City, threatening to return and leave the place in ruins. Without a navy to protect them, the townspeople were frightened. Many civilians considered abandoning the homeland they had built. Some even suggested that the city give all their properties to the pirates, in exchange for their lives.

It was at this desperate moment that Yi Sun-shin once again defended his people. He gave a motivational speech, restoring hope and morale to those who were trying to escape or surrender. He mobilized civilians and armed them. Soon he formed a new fleet consisting of many fishing boats and a few battleships.

When the pirate coalition was at their doorstep, Yi Sun-shin led this new fleet to confront them, making a stink in his final fight, knowing that he would have to sacrifice his life, for the greater good. Yi Sun-shin ordered his own ship to charge forward and lead the way, despite heavy artillery fire from the pirate ships. Encouraged by Yi Sun-shin's heroic actions, Paenlong's brave men sailed forward and miraculously won the battle, even after being in a situation of extreme numerical inferiority. The pirate coalition of more than one hundred and fifty battleships was defeated by only twelve ships and a few fishing boats.

The pirates, who controlled both seas, were devastated in this battle and were unable to invade Dragon City for at least the next decades. As for Yi Sun-shin, he rebuilt the Paenlong fleet for the good of Dragon City and ensured its surveillance of the seas.
anecdotes: Yi Sun-shin (이순신) was a Korean naval commander in real life who was considered one of the greatest naval commanders and a hero in history, tied only with Horatio Nelson, having never been defeated at sea nor lost a single ship under his command during the invasion of the enemy (Japan), making Yi Sun-shin the only Korean hero in the game. In the game, his name is spelled Yi Sun-shin, but the romanization correct of its historical name is Yi Sun-sin (이순신).
Yi Sun-shin is the second hero based on a real historical figure, along with Zilong, Lapu-Lapu, Minsitthar and Zetian.
His armor and weapons are inspired by traditional Korean warriors from the Joseon era.
Currently, Yi Sun-shin is the only hero in the game who can change both the appearance and function of the ally base, as well as one who has skins that change the ally base accordingly.

The Turtle Ship Geobukseon (거북선) was an armored warship that he used to dominate naval battles. The Turtle Ship (Geobukseon) was a revolutionary warship designed by the real Admiral Yi Sun-sin in the late 16th century and plays a key role in its MLBB design.
Yi Sun-shin is the first and, so far, only Assassin/Marksman hero in the game, while Lesley is a Marksman/Assassin.
He shares his Japanese voice actor, Hirose Ryuichi, with Gusion, who is also an Assassin hero whose attack and difficulty levels are almost equal.

yin.accroche: A young martial artist on a journey to defeat the evil God within.
lore: A young martial artist on a journey to defeat the evil God that dwells within him. Among the four renowned members of Forsaken Light, a young man from the East stands out. Known as Yin, this simple and upright martial artist sometimes exudes a sinister aura, creating a stark contrast that leaves many wary of him. Few people know that his wild and violent behavior comes from the evil God, Lieh, who resides within him. This is why Yin left his home in the Riverlands of Cadia: to perfect himself in the Land of Dawn and find a way to defeat Lieh. But Yin's struggles in this foreign land had the opposite effect; as a being who thrives in chaos, the more Yin fights, the quicker Lieh can reclaim his power. Thus, Lieh began to pass his power onto Yin, watching him sink deeper into madness with every act of righteousness and chivalry, and driving him towards the self-destruction Lieh desired. However, even knowing the risks, Yin continues to exercise this power, because for him, abandoning his code and ignoring the suffering of others would not make him better than Lieh. Yin never backs down from a challenge, God or no God.
=== The right fist ===

For those who have endured a lifetime of conflict and longed for peace, the Floral Falls, hidden by mystical mechanisms, is a true utopia where the past is forgotten. But Yin's story is a little different: he arrived here before his life really began. Many years ago, one spring day, the hermits of the valley found a bamboo basket floating on the river. If they hadn't looked closer, they wouldn't have seen the baby inside who would have made a single sound. While the hermits felt sorry for the abandoned boy, he faced the cruelty of the world with joyful laughter. Whoever sent him down the river left him without a name or identifiable memories. Perhaps they knew the child would drift to this isolated sanctuary and intentionally left no connection with the outside world? Regardless, the boy's life began anew in Floral Falls and he was given a name. In the spring breeze, the hermits named it Yin, in homage to the beginning of the lunar year, when life begins again. They also gave him a blessing: always look forward, always look upward, because every day is the start of something new.

Yin lived up to the expectations placed on him. Although growing up in Floral Falls wasn't easy, Yin was able to learn many valuable lessons. Solitary hermits, tired of worldly affairs, transmitted not only their martial arts but also their code of chivalry. Yin was a diligent student, but the more obedient he became, the more worried the hermits who raised him became. Unlike the other residents of Floral Falls, who had lived their lives and grown tired of the world, a boy should not be afraid of making mistakes. What good is the fist if you have nothing to fight for? Without tripping, how can you learn to hold on? If we never cling to anything, how can we learn to let go? But it was at this time, while practicing martial arts, that Yin met Wanwan of the Tang clan, who had come to explore this strange abode. For the first time, Yin met someone his own age. Wanwan, energetic and cheerful, gradually introduced him to what it is to be young and free. They always played together and time passed quickly. Yin began to see the vast and complex world outside the valley in a different light. Maybe getting out and seeing the world wouldn't be a bad idea? As a sensible child, Yin never expressed his thoughts to the elders, so he never realized that they shared his feelings.

Years later, when Wanwan left to fulfill her duties as an oriental fighter, Yin's heart became restless. His yearning for the outside world clashes with the traditions of the valley, leaving him torn between two worlds. He isolated himself and practiced alone, and his doubts gradually became a reserve of negative energy. And this negative energy, in turn, would attract disaster. One fateful afternoon, an ominous aura flew from across the valley and entered Yin's body before he could react. As Yin struggled to resist the invading consciousness, another figure suddenly appeared and sent Yin flying with a heavy blow. Seizing this opportunity, the evil consciousness took control of Yin's body and began to fight the alien. Yin found himself facing an unprecedented dilemma. He knew that if he failed to break free from what was controlling him, not only would he harm the person in front of him, but he would also bring calamity to Floral Falls. But the more he tried, the more he became a helpless spectator in his own body.

As Yin's spirit declined and the evil consciousness took more control, he began to consider a dark ultimatum. Perhaps making a tomb for this evil was the only way to save everyone... But just as Yin was about to accept this fate, a familiar voice echoed through the valley. "Yin! Don't you dare give up!" A young girl wielding a crossbow leapt onto the battlefield and stood between Yin and her opponent. It was Wanwan, his first friend, who brought him joy and a new outlook on life. As emotions flooded, an immense surge of determination and courage allowed Yin to break free from the evil's control. Seeing this, his opponent, a man with a dragon aura, stopped his attack. "Wanwan, I must face the great evil that lies within him. This boy is no match for him and will be devoured. I must prevent this disaster from turning into a calamity." But Wanwan showed no signs of hesitation. Yin had never seen this side of her and he was deeply moved. "Baxia once said the same thing about you, Yu Zhong. I believe in Yin, just like I believed in you." But Yu Zhong remained unmoved. “I won’t let anyone get in the way of my plans, not even you, and he—” At that moment, Yin, barely managing to stand up, stopped Yu Zhong mid-sentence. “I will never let my friends down!”

Yu Zhong explained everything to Yin, leaving Yin feeling shaken and lost for the first time in his life: as a vessel of the Evil God, he had unwittingly become the most dangerous threat to Flower Falls, and perhaps all of the Cadia Rivers. That night, Yin packed his things and left quietly in the moonlight. He didn't tell anyone about the words Yu Zhong had said to him: "If you have the will to take on this responsibility, then travel to the Moniyan Empire." There, you may find a way to defeat the Evil God..." Behind him, his mentors debated endlessly: "Letting such an innocent child face the Evil God alone is too cruel. "The white monkey sage may know a method to exorcise the evil god." “Did we raise this child all these years and then abandon him now?” After listening to these arguments, the white monkey proclaimed: “There are ways to deal with the Evil God, but the boy has already chosen his path. He chose to carry this burden. It's not up to us to stop it.
The young man left Floral Falls, ready to cross the vast and stormy sea. Before him was a whole new world, full of excitement and challenges.

yu-zhong.accroche: Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, intends to unify the Riverlands of Cadia through conquest and usher in an era of prosperity.
lore: Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, intends to unify the Riverlands of Cadia through conquest and usher in an era of prosperity. Yu Zhong, the conqueror born from the power of the Black Dragon, sought to break the seal of the Inverted Scale hidden within the Dragon Altar and forge a new future for the Riverlands of Cadia. However, he was defeated by his older brother, Baxia, and left to die in the mountains. After ten years of arduous training and travel, Yu Zhong found himself returning to the Dragon Altar. He faced the oriental fighters, broke the seal of the inverted ladder and faced in a final battle the evil god, Lieh, who caused the disappearance of the previous black dragon. Eventually, with the help of his dear friend Wanwan, Yu Zhong regained his true identity and emerged victorious. Now that the Inverted Black Dragon Scale has been restored, Yu Zhong sets out on the path of conquest. === Dragon's Roar === During the Age of Endless War, the last of the dragon race, the Black and White Dragon Twins, opened a path to the Riverlands of Cadia to save their people from annihilation. However, their journey would be paved with many sacrifices, including that of the Black Dragon himself. To stop the pursuit of the evil god, Lieh, the exhausted Black Dragon made one last stand and swallowed Lieh in battle. But in doing so, he also sealed his own fate.

Lieh lay dormant for millennia while the riverlands of Cadia enjoyed peace and prosperity. From within, he slowly corrupted the Black Dragon until finally plunging him into darkness. Under Lieh's influence, the Black Dragon sought to use the Yin Yang Eye to expand his dark power. The ensuing war shook the heavens themselves, until finally the White Dragon incarnated within the Dragon Altar to defeat his corrupted brother. Baxia was the only oriental fighter to survive the war.

From then on, the name of the Black Dragon became taboo and the White Dragon became known as the Great Dragon. Thirty-five years ago, Baxia learned that the power of the Black Dragon had been reincarnated as a boy. However, when Baxia found him, he couldn't bring himself to harm the innocent child.

Baxia informed the parents that their son had the destiny to rule the Riverlands of Cadia and was to be taken to the Dragon Altar to receive guidance from the Great Dragon. While shedding tears of joy and sorrow, the couple agreed and named the boy “Yu Zhong” – hoping that one day he would fly to the heavens.

At the Dragon Altar, Yu Zhong quickly proved himself to be a formidable warrior. But he was also aware that his rapidly growing power was becoming a concern for his older brother Baxia. For Baxia, mindset was more important than strength, especially when it came to the descendants of the Black Dragon who had once strayed from the right path.

To sharpen his mind, Baxia took Yu Zhong on a journey through the Riverlands of Cadia. Along the way, Yu Zhong used his power to help those in need, leaving behind many heroic tales. Yu Zhong understood what Baxia wanted him to see, and he was moved by the human spirit shining through suffering. However, behind these moments of inspiration, he begins to question the very nature of suffering.

Why do people always yearn for heroes to save them? What made them so weak that they couldn't even protect their loved ones from disaster? The Great Dragon had always indulged in the dream of an idyllic region of the Cadia River. He entrusted his disciples with the role of guardians of the land so that the people could forget the past and move forward. But if an unfathomable calamity were to occur, what would happen to this earth?

The shadow of the Black Dragon began to swell in Yu Zhong's eyes, and inexplicable voices whispered of ancient memories that did not belong to him – the power of the Black Dragon, aligned with Yin energy, was his birthright.

Yu Zhong was destined to reclaim the power of the Black Dragon and guide the world toward his ideals: the people were to be transformed by fire into warriors capable of rising and defending the river lands of Cadia against future crises. And to achieve this, great sacrifices were necessary.
With this new determination, Yu Zhong entered the Dragon Soul Forbidden Zone.

When Baxia arrived to stop him, instead of fear or hesitation, Yu Zhong felt a sense of liberation. The two had never seen eye to eye, and now they could finally settle their differences in a clash of fists.

For the first time, the two disciples faced each other with all their strength. Yu Zhong, lacking his elder's experience, was eventually knocked off the mountain peak by Baxia and disappeared into the thick forest below.

Nearly succumbing to his injuries, Yu Zhong was saved by the most unlikely person; a cheerful young girl named Wanwan from the Tang clan. Recognizing the power of the White Tiger within her, Yu Zhong was initially tempted to eliminate this possible threat to the Black Dragon, but he realized that these sinister thoughts were not his own.

Wanwan, unaware of Yu Zhong's inner conflict, treated him as a friend while Yu Zhong occasionally gave him advice as an elder. Yu Zhong's draconian ideals were continually worn down by the pure-hearted girl until his true aspirations were revealed: through conquest, he would create a world of harmony, free from evil, where everyone could live with the innocence of a child.

Years later, spiritual master Luo Yi will reunite with Yu Zhong and take him on the next stage of his journey. Before leaving, Yu Zhong sealed a part of his true self into a dragon orb and presented it to Wanwan as a sign of their friendship. Then, with Luo Yi, he set out to reaffirm his destiny.

After ten years of traveling and training across the Riverlands of Cadia, they arrived at the Dragon Altar where Yu Zhong attempted once more to open the seal within. Thanks to Luo Yi's preparations, the Eastern Fighters were prevented from interfering with Yu Zhong by a magic circle that only descendants of the Black Dragon could pass through.

Yu Zhong finally released the inverted scale that had been sealed for a thousand years, awakening the full extent of the Black Dragon's fearsome power. However, the calamity that once led to the demise of the Black Dragon – the Evil God, Lieh – also emerged from the seal, intending to corrupt Yu Zhong's heart as it had done with the Black Dragon.

But Yu Zhong was not the former Black Dragon and he would not give up his personal emotions and desires. If he couldn't even retain his true self, what right did he have to offer freedom to the world?

Even so, engaging in a conflict of wills with a god was tantamount to a death sentence. After just a few rounds, Lieh looked ready to crush Yu Zhong's will once and for all. But at this critical moment, Wanwan, who had long sensed that something was wrong with the Dragon Orb and used it to locate the Dragon Altar, was able to bypass the seal and enter the forbidden area. She rushed towards the battle, hoping to stop Yu Zhong and bring him back to his senses.

As she approached, a burst of light suddenly shot out from the dragon orb towards Yu Zhong. Everything had gone according to his plan. The light containing his true self reinfused with Yu Zhong, allowing him to regain control for a split second, and that moment was all he needed to expel Lieh's consciousness from his body. With this victory over the Evil God, Yu Zhong unleashed a thunderous roar as he claimed his rightful power.

Wanwan's kindness and innocence played a vital role in realizing Yu Zhong's ambitions. He knew she would find him and deliberately gave her a part of himself in his attempt to defeat Lieh. But has he thought about how using the girl's innocence to achieve his own ends might affect her? Or maybe this was seen as a necessary “sacrifice”?
Only Yu Zhong himself knew the answers to these questions. But what the world knew was this:
At that moment, Yu Zhong had truly become the Black Dragon. A great change was coming to the riverlands of Cadia, a change that was long overdue. === Secret History of the Dragon Altar ===

yve.accroche: Guardian of the balance of the universe.
lore: Aurora was the first person to discover Yves. It was the first time that such a mysterious, cold and emotionless creature appeared in the Land of Dawn.

Huge energy fluctuations came from the temporal rift. Aurora believed that Zhask had returned and that she would finally have the opportunity to avenge her beloved. But it turned out that she saw someone who seemed even more powerful.

Yve descended from the sky above the frozen ocean. She considered everything and everyone elusive and was only interested in finding Zhask. His instincts told him that his old enemy had appeared here.

Yve just glanced at Aurora indifferently, then turned and left. While Aurora was hesitant about whether or not to pursue this mysterious visitor, Yve unleashed a blast of tremendous energy, temporarily closing the temporal rift. She then turned around and left.

This time, the rift opened by Yve has existed for thousands of years since the Ancients triggered the great explosion using the Twilight Orb. No one can get close to it and no one knows where it leads. Only Aurora watches him closely at all times, waiting to take revenge on her archenemy Zhask for her lover Tobias.
Aurora clearly understands what kind of powerful energy it would take to bridge the time gap: that's why she had a premonition: maybe Zhask and Tobias will return.

Yve comes from Mithlora, a mysterious region of the galaxy. Its people are few in number but possess immense strength. However, they also have a sworn enemy: the Swarm. As the most skilled hunters in the universe, born with great power, Yve's race must find and confront the Swarm wherever it appears. Their endless multiplication means destruction and destruction means imbalance.

Zhask and Yve, like their races, are natural enemies. With great strength comes great responsibility. As the most powerful dominator among thousands of swarms, Zhask wishes to lead his swarm to invade and multiply endlessly, and thus spread it across the galaxy. And only by killing Zhask can Yve prove her strength and gain the recognition of her people.
They have been destined enemies since time immemorial.

For as long as she can remember, Yve has known her mission. She is confident in her strength, which she has relied on to eliminate many threats to the balance of the plane. But her frustrations began when she met Zhask. Even with her great power and after fighting Zhask several times in different parts of the universe, and even though she was so close to success, Yve still failed to eliminate Zhask's swarm.

The story that follows is that of an endless chase. The devious Zhask moves from one planet to another. The creatures of these planets cannot offer any resistance against Zhask, so the rapidly multiplying Swarm destroys their homes one after another. And every time Yve arrives on these devastated planets, her innate sense of Mithlorean responsibility and sense of self-doubt will stir up turmoil in her heart.

Running after Zhask has become Yve's obsession. She found Zhask in the Land of Dawn. She expected that he would have arrived too late and that it too would be nothing but ruins. But she was surprised to find that the heroes of the Land of Dawn are strong and courageous, and they swear to protect their homeland at the cost of their lives. This made it difficult for Zhask to complete his plans and saved him time.

The hunters of Mithlora will not allow all the destroyers of the harmony of the universe to run rampant. Yve will eventually fight Zhask in a duel here. She knows that she and her destined enemy will fight their final battle here.
anecdotes: Early concepts of Yve's design showed her as a celestial mage with star-based powers, but her initial designs were more grounded and simpler, focusing more on magical robes and basic energy effects. However, as her design was refined, she evolved into a grander, space-themed character, with her final design incorporating celestial and cosmic motifs that fit her role as protector of the stars.

Yve is certainly one of the most powerful beings in history, especially in the context of the Cosmic World. As protector of the stars, she possesses immense control over cosmic energy and space manipulation, positioning her as a force to be reckoned with.
One of Yves' quotes, "with great power comes great responsibility" is a variation of a quote popularized in the Spider-Man comics created by Stan Lee.

Yve's ultimate creates an optical illusion where if you compare her ultimates together you will notice that one is larger and the other is smaller even though they are just the same size in comparison.

zetian.accroche: Recognized by the heavens and beloved by her people, the Celestial Empress of the riverlands of Cadia ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm.
lore: Recognized by the heavens and beloved by her people, the Celestial Empress of the riverlands of Cadia ascends to bring peace to the mortal realm. Zetian is the Empress of Shendu, the divine capital of the riverlands of Cadia, as well as the "tombkeeper" who erected the anonymous monument to the memory of the Ancients. Millennia ago, she used the last power of her phoenix spirit to create Shendu, a sanctuary for the mortals of the Riverlands of Cadia. Exhausted by this feat, she fell into a deep sleep. A thousand years passed before she was reincarnated at the Lake of Reflection and returned to the Divine Capital as a mortal to ascend once again to godhood. Through millennia of introspection, his determination has remained unwavering; the phoenix has found its eternal nest in the divine capital. Today, she ascends the throne once again as empress to usher in an era of unprecedented peace and prosperity for a kingdom in bloom. === By decree of heaven === Spring has adorned the divine capital, painting it with a riot of flowers. At the foot of the Phoenix Terrace, a sea of ​​people gathered, drawing countless eager gazes to its summit. At the top of the terrace, the Empress, resplendent in her phoenix dress, ascended the steps with royal grace. Although it was not a long path, Zetian traveled it for countless seasons.

Ancient chronicles tell that millennia ago, the Ancients sacrificed themselves to stop the descent of the Twin Gods. The first eastern fighters of the Riverlands of Cadia chose the same path, passing down their power to protect the lands and rivers. Among the remains of the Ancients was a woman who had made a bet with the White Dragon. She wagered that even without the gift of divine cultivation, the mortals of the Riverlands of Cadia could prosper in peace for a thousand years under her tutelage. This woman, drawing on the ancient art of manipulating Yin and Yang, harnessed the phoenix spirit of her bloodline to found a mortal city: Shendu. She becomes the first sovereign. Shortly after, the War of the Twin Dragons broke out in the Riverlands of Cadia. The woman disappeared amidst the chaos, but left behind her phoenix spirit, which protects the divine capital to this day. Millennia passed, and although various noble families and ministers successively ruled the capital, none could inherit the power left by its founder. Legend whispered that whoever obtained the spirit of the phoenix would inherit its imperial heritage. Zetian had this historical tale engraved in his heart since childhood. More than twenty years ago, she was just a wandering orphan with no memory of where she came from. Her first memory was meeting a man nicknamed Wu near the Lake of Reflection, who then took her under his wing. Wu, a humble merchant, traveled the riverlands of Cadia with Zetian, teaching him to read and write and instilling in him compassion for all under the heavens. With a keen intellect, she witnessed the suffering of the people and realized that the power of the phoenix spirit protecting Shendu was almost exhausted. She thought of the legend of the creation of the Divine Capital, but considered it more of a fable than a fact. If fate does not favor you, carve your own path through your will and effort. Indeed, this maxim has proven true. As Zetian opened the doors of the bureaucracy with brilliantly composed political treatises, maintaining an outwardly gregarious but inwardly aloof attitude, it gradually moved closer to the epicenter of power. She even led armies to put down rebellions, and not only gained fame, but also built a formidable list of accomplishments. Gradually, people stopped talking about the past, for Zetian, shining like the first light of dawn, was all they could see.

But until a few days ago, Zetian was still unaware that the path she had taken was both her heritage and a decree from Heaven. At this time, Zetian was passing the Lake of Reflection below Dragon Ridge, the place where his memories began. The lake was as clear as day, and when she looked down, what she saw was her life reflected in the water. All her life she has been surrounded by a whirlwind of gossip. Some say she was cruel and violent, some say she was just and dutiful, some say she was insidious and malicious, and some say she sympathized with the people... Her name carried both merits and demerits. Along the way, she looked into her own heart. She had never given up on her childhood ambitions, but even she couldn't understand why a little girl would set her life's aspiration to such an ambitious goal as founding an empire. While he was deep in thought, a gust of wind stirred the surface of the water, and suddenly the reflection in the lake pulled Zetian into the water. It was not a reflection!

"Here, I erect this monument, to perpetuate the will of the Ancients, to ensure peace for all generations to come..." In her daze, she heard a woman's voice. "The Twin Gods will reignite the flames of war, and only he who demonstrates selfless determination can bring deliverance to the mortal realm." "Although these mortals cannot attain godhood, they possess a different type of power, rivaling the gods... Yet this power is elusive and requires the Divine Capital to safeguard it." — It was his own voice. As her forgotten past life was told by herself, Zetian finally understood. In a lost chapter of history, the woman who founded the Divine Capital had overused her power to protect the Riverlands of Cadia and fell into a deep sleep at the bottom of the Lake of Reflection. Millennia passed until the fateful battle between Baxia the Mystic Turtle and the reincarnation of the Black Dragon awakened her... in the form of a young girl. Even though she had lost her memory after a long sleep, her ancient decree remained engraved in her very being. During the two decades of strenuous efforts, hard work day and night, and countless slanders and accusations, she never considered surrendering. The anonymous monument had become the Lake of Reflection, its waters capable of revealing a person's true personality. The ripples on the surface of the lake, like echoes of unspoken words, left no trace of the wind or the passage of time that had created them.

If one has lived sincerely, there is no need to leave one's name in history. At the top of the Phoenix Terrace, the Empress, resplendent in her phoenix dress, was climbing the steps. The proclamation begins, each word ringing powerfully: “By decree of Heaven – In times forgotten, the Ancients created a wondrous realm of Yin and Yang in a celestial vessel. To protect the riverlands of Cadia, the Four Immortals initiated the Great Awakening before entering a deep sleep. the Ancients and the virtues of those who preceded them. I accept the Will of Heaven and its mandate. I will respond to Heaven and Earth, bring comfort to the people, maintain the foundations of the State, and safeguard the Divine Capital. As the decree ends, Zetian watches the masses from the top. His incarnation from millennia ago had long since exhausted his divine power; in truth, she had no power to dictate this succession. The real succession is found here, in the hearts of the people. The power that had once dissipated to protect the mortal world now flowed once again into his fingertips, drawn to the collective will of the people – the phoenix spirit of his lineage, once lost, now revived by the devotion of his subjects. With a simple thought, peonies bloomed on his forehead and a majestic phoenix rose from his fingertips. All witnesses bowed in reverence before the phoenix as it observed the flourishing divine capital. The Will of Heaven and the hearts of people become one. Once his good work is done, the Phoenix waits to be crowned. The age of the gods is over; it is time for her to rise like the dawn. By decree of Heaven, Empress Zetian ascends her throne.
anecdotes: She is based on China's only female emperor, Wu Zetian.
This makes her the fifth hero based on a real historical figure, along with Zilong, Yi Sun-shin, Lapu-Lapu and Minsitthar.
His phoenix motifs were most likely inspired by the combination of Western and Chinese cultural representations of phoenixes.

lore: Many great civilizations have been built over a long history of discovery and enlightenment. This was not the case for the Kastiyans, however, whose bloody history was etched in struggle and brutality. For countless eons, the Kastiya Swarm has plundered and devoured to maintain the prosperity of its own race. The Swarm's vicious nature made them eager to encroach and breed endlessly.

As king of Kastiya, Zhask knew exactly what he and his race needed. The terrifying Swarm was able to follow Zhask's example, appearing anywhere in the universe, then devouring everything in its path. The scourge of the Swarm was more prolific than any other race. No planet in known history has ever been completely safe from the Swarm – and the most terrifying thing was that the Swarm could never be completely wiped out.
Of course, the Kastiya Swarm also had its nemesis – Mithlora.

Mithlora was a mysterious region among the stars. The race that lived there was small in number, but naturally powerful. As one of the most advanced hunters in the universe, blessed with immense power, Mithlora's mission was to maintain the balance of the universe. Therefore, the ever-present Swarm had to face the ever-vigilant Mithlora.

A veteran hunter of Mithlora had once destroyed Kastiya, home of Zhask, but the Swarm could not be completely wiped out. In fact, the destruction of their hometown sparked a raging crusade to wildly expand and ravage other planets. Led by King Zhask, they took absolute pleasure in plundering and breeding their own kind. In the midst of their savagery, Mithlora had sent a fearsome new hunter – Yve.

Zhask was not afraid of this new threat. On the contrary, he enjoyed the thrill of the hunt. Even though Kastiya had already been reduced to dust, Zhask and his Swarm believed that any area of ​​the starry sky could become the new Kastiya II - as long as they kept reproducing.

With great strength and cunning, Zhask has foiled Yve's efforts to track down the scourge countless times. Due to the Swarm's reproductive capacity, the planets that had been invaded had virtually no power to fight back. The creatures of these planets quickly disappeared from the desolation of Zhask.
Although those of Mithlora never needed help from others, the weakness of these planets isolated Yve to some extent. Zhask was always 2 steps ahead of his Mithlorean pursuer.
Yve would still find himself on a completely pillaged and ruined planet, with Zhask already on the run to his next foray into the known universe.

Zhask was immersed in the pleasure of plunder. He enjoyed the thrill of the hunt and the endless slaughter. Even with Yve's best attempts to stop him, Zhask still managed to escape under the cover of her swarm.
The scars on his body did not deter Zhask from continuing his plundering journey. Without pause, Zhask crossed the space-time continuum again and arrived in a new area.

Two of Zhask's ancient quotes: "Arkarmasan... Burrsossii!..." and "Ssh...shalosha...arraghh..." are spoken over Kastiyan. This is the first language originally created by gaming.

His epic skin (Bone Flamen) is named after the ancient Roman religion, where a flamen was a priest assigned to one of the fifteen deities with official cults during the Roman Republic; the meaning of the skin's name is then "Priest of Bone".

zhuxin.accroche: A mysterious young woman who guides ember butterflies using her Spirit Lantern.
lore: A mysterious young woman who guides amber butterflies using her Spirit Lantern. Zhuxin is an enigmatic young woman from the town of Zhu'an, nestled in the mountains of the Cadia Riverlands. Using her Spirit Lantern, she guides the ember butterflies and walks between life and death. She is able to hear the desires of mortal hearts, and those who successfully overcome her trials will have their wishes granted. For nearly a thousand years, she has wandered in search of the purest desires to realize, in the hope of one day finding her own.

===A wish=== Who is she really? What are its activities? Where does she wander? Some call her unpredictable, others a researcher in the arms of the night and still others an enigma. His entire existence is shrouded in secrecy. What do I wish for? What do you want? What do everyone dream of?
The city of Zhu'an, a dreamlike place where the supernatural is found in every corner.

Divinatory rituals, dancing paper dolls, incense that makes you dream... there is no shortage of strange wonders and no shortage of fables that arise from this enchanted city. Among them, the most enigmatic is perhaps “his” story.

Legend has it that a mysterious young woman named Zhuxin can often be seen wandering at night in Zhu'an with a lantern in her hand. She possesses the ability to summon ember butterflies, which she uses as a medium to satisfy the deepest desires of mortals.

Zhuxin cared neither about wealth nor power, only the purest wishes had value in his eyes. It is said that anyone who accepts his help will be subjected to his trials, which can range from betting entire fortunes to crossing the line between life and death. Some try to curry favor with her, while others call her a malicious witch, but she doesn't care what others think. When people say she's temperamental, she's the first to nod. However, once a pact is made and the butterflies begin to dance, neither heaven nor earth, nor life nor death can stop him from fulfilling a wish.
No one knew where she came from or what her purpose was, only that she was always searching for something. His existence was as enigmatic as the night itself.
But Zhuxin didn't always like the night.

A thousand years ago, Zhuxin was just an orphan wandering the streets of Zhu'an. For her, the night represented only danger. In the darkness, the wickedness of human nature emerged to dance with the devil.

But Little Zhuxin loved bright flames. Every year, during the summer solstice celebrations, townspeople lit countless braziers throughout the city. Their warm glow made the smiles of every passerby more radiant and welcoming, but Zhuxin still kept her distance. The elders say that Zhuxin was born an orphan. According to stories, she was found crawling out of the coffin after her parents died. She possessed such extreme Yin energy that people considered her a bad omen. Little Zhuxin could only approach the warmth of the lingering embers after the crowd had returned home. On lucky evenings, she could even find a flowery pastry among the discarded leftovers.
And on those nights, under the glowing embers, Zhuxin held her pastry tightly in her small, soot-covered hands and felt warmth in her heart.

But even these small comforts would not last. When the balance between Yin and Yang was broken, war broke out in the riverlands of Cadia. Monsters emerged from the shadows and terrorized the continent. Fear gripped the entire city. People were hiding in their homes and no one dared to come out to light the braziers. Little Zhuxin endured many freezing nights until she finally exhausted the last bit of her warmth.
Surrounded by darkness, she took her last breath.

But Zhuxin's Yin energy prevented his soul from dissipating. Was she still alive or had she become an apparition? What should she do? Where should she go? She tried to find answers, but couldn't escape the night, no matter how hard her little legs tried. It was a strange feeling; she no longer needed to breathe, but had never felt so suffocated. Whether in life or death, in light or in darkness, was there anyone who had an answer? Was there anyone who could spark a glimmer of hope?
A light pierced the darkness.
Little Zhuxin opened her eyes as a pure light descended from the heavens: it was the Great Dragon, the guardian deity of the Riverlands of Cadia and one of the twin dragons.
“Are you here to chase me away?”
The Great Dragon did not respond. Instead, he manifested a flower-shaped lantern that gently fell towards Zhuxin.

As she touched his hand, ember butterflies flew from the lantern and lit up the night. Little Zhuxin suddenly found herself floating in the cosmos with the Great Dragon. In the sea of ​​​​quiet clouds, the candle of the lantern illuminated the sky, and they were conversing in the clouds. The Great Dragon explained that Zhuxin could not pass into the afterlife because she had no wishes. If we live and die without desire, what meaning is there in life? But if we can leave without regrets, there will be nothing to fear. Only by fulfilling her wish can she embark on the next journey.
"My wish? What could it be?"
“Child, I gave you this lantern to light the way, but your wish is something you must seek for yourself.”
“Could I…have anything to wish for?”
"Naturally. Your existence is proof of that."
Zhuxin bid farewell to the dragon and left with the lantern.

At first, she wandered aimlessly, not even knowing what she was looking for. Finally, she thought that if she still couldn't find her wish, maybe she should grant others' wishes first. So she summoned her ember butterflies as messengers, seeking, listening, and granting countless wishes.

Night after night, Zhuxin listened to the hearts of strangers. Sometimes she fell into the trap of their plans; other times, she exposed their true intentions with plans of her own. Until the day when, by chance, she granted a wish so sincere that her lantern lit up enough to warm her heart; it was the same feeling from his childhood.

Zhuxin then realized that only these genuine wishes were worth pursuing. However, mortals are complicated creatures and their hearts are too easily led astray by wealth and power. So, she began organizing various trials to test the value of people's wishes. Even when her trials caused people to misunderstand, fear, and curse her, she never fought back, because none of that mattered.

What really mattered was finding those forgotten wishes buried in the ashes and giving them a gentle tap to reignite their flames. When she helped a young man bring a flower to his blind sister, Zhuxin was able to sense the sweet scent of flowers for the first time. When Zhuxin helped a crying soul who had perished in a foreign land deliver a letter to his wife, she understood that death cannot separate true love. Each precious wish made his lantern shine brighter and the world in his eyes became more alive.
Although Zhuxin has yet to find her own wish, she now understands that it must be something bright enough to bring warmth to the long night; enough to make this trip interesting.
His existence was undoubtedly worthy of such a wish.
